shader_type spatial;
render_mode blend_add, depth_draw_never, unshaded, cull_disabled;
// Мерцающий столб света Выброса: цилиндр, ярче у земли, полосы-лучи, дрожь.
// seed у каждого столба свой — расставляет контроллер.
uniform vec4 col_low : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.72, 0.3, 1.0);
uniform vec4 col_high : source_color = vec4(0.85, 0.16, 0.04, 1.0);
uniform float intensity = 0.0;
uniform float seed = 0.0;
uniform float speed = 3.0;

varying vec2 v_uv;

void vertex() {
	v_uv = UV;
}

void fragment() {
	float flick = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(TIME * speed + seed * 17.0 + sin(TIME * 2.3 + seed) * 2.0);
	float streaks = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(v_uv.x * TAU * 6.0 + TIME * 1.5 + seed * 9.0);
	float grad = pow(clamp(1.0 - v_uv.y, 0.0, 1.0), 1.7);   // гаснет к вершине
	float f = grad * flick * streaks * intensity;
	vec3 col = mix(col_low.rgb, col_high.rgb, clamp(v_uv.y, 0.0, 1.0));
	ALBEDO = col * f;
	ALPHA = clamp(f * 1.3, 0.0, 1.0);
}

ФАЙЛ: res://emission_fx/shaders/shockwave_ring.gdshader
----------------------------------------

shader_type spatial;
render_mode blend_add, depth_draw_never, unshaded, cull_disabled;
// Ударная волна Выброса: фронт-кольцо по земле + затухающий след внутри.
// ring_pos (0..1) ведёт контроллер: 1.0 = край арены (половина стороны квада).
uniform vec4 ring_col : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.45, 0.12, 1.0);
uniform vec4 inner_col : source_color = vec4(0.5, 0.07, 0.03, 1.0);
uniform float ring_pos = 0.0;
uniform float ring_width = 0.055;
uniform float intensity = 0.0;
uniform float speed = 1.0;

varying vec2 v_uv;

void vertex() {
	v_uv = UV;
}

void fragment() {
	vec2 c = v_uv - 0.5;
	float ang = atan(c.y, c.x);
	// рябь на фронте: волнистая кромка, дрожит по времени
	float wob = 0.025 * sin(ang * 16.0 + TIME * 7.0 * speed) + 0.012 * sin(ang * 31.0 - TIME * 11.0 * speed);
	float d = length(c) * 2.0 + wob;
	float r = clamp(ring_pos, 0.0, 1.4);
	float band = smoothstep(r - ring_width, r, d) * (1.0 - smoothstep(r, r + ring_width * 0.7, d));
	float inner = clamp(smoothstep(r, 0.0, d) * 0.3 * (0.7 + 0.3 * sin(ang * 6.0 + TIME * 2.0)), 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 col = ring_col.rgb * band + inner_col.rgb * inner;
	float f = clamp(band + inner, 0.0, 1.0);
	ALBEDO = col * intensity;
	ALPHA = f;
}

# entities/artifacts/base_artifact.gd
extends Collectible
class_name BaseArtifact

## Базовый класс для всех артефактов

# Параметры
@export var artifact_name: String = "Artifact"
@export var artifact_value: int = 10
@export var artifact_rarity: GameEnums.Rarity = GameEnums.Rarity.COMMON
@export var energy_reward: float = 5.0
@export var effect_duration: float = 0.0
@export var color: Color = Color.WHITE  # ← ЭТОЙ ПЕРЕМЕННОЙ НЕ ХВАТАЛО!

# Визуал
@onready var mesh_instance: MeshInstance3D = $MeshInstance3D if has_node("MeshInstance3D") else null
@onready var light: OmniLight3D = $OmniLight3D if has_node("OmniLight3D") else null
@onready var particles: GPUParticles3D = $GPUParticles3D if has_node("GPUParticles3D") else null

# Состояние
var rotation_speed: float = 1.0
var float_amplitude: float = 0.2
var float_speed: float = 2.0
var original_y: float = 0.0


func _ready():
    collectible_name = artifact_name
    value = artifact_value
    rarity = artifact_rarity

    add_to_group("artifacts")
    add_to_group("artifacts_" + get_rarity_name())

    original_y = position.y
    _apply_model_mesh()
    _update_visual()
    _ready_hook()

    pass # print("Артефакт создан: " + artifact_name + " (" + get_rarity_name() + ") ценность: " + str(value))


func _process(delta):
    # Вращение
    rotate_y(rotation_speed * delta)
    
    # Парение
    if float_amplitude > 0:
        position.y = original_y + sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.001 * float_speed) * float_amplitude


func _ready_hook():
    """Для переопределения в наследниках"""
    pass


func _collect_hook(collector: Node):
    # Применяем эффект к коллектору
    if collector.has_method("add_energy"):
        collector.add_energy(energy_reward)
    
    if effect_duration > 0 and collector.has_method("apply_effect"):
        collector.apply_effect(artifact_name, effect_duration)
    
    pass # print("Эффект артефакта применен к " + str(collector))


func _update_visual():
    var rarity_color = _get_rarity_color()

    if mesh_instance and mesh_instance.material_override:
        mesh_instance.material_override.albedo_color = rarity_color
        mesh_instance.material_override.emission = rarity_color

    if light:
        light.light_color = rarity_color

    if particles and particles.process_material:
        var material = particles.process_material as ParticleProcessMaterial
        if material:
            material.color = rarity_color


# ==================== 3D-МОДЕЛЬ АРТЕФАКТА (пак подготовщика, задача 13) ====================

## Ключ модели из имени скрипта: battery_artifact.gd -> "battery" ->
## models/artifacts/artifact_battery.glb. Нет модели - прежняя сфера сцены.
func _model_key() -> String:
    var script_path: String = str(get_script().resource_path)
    var base := script_path.get_file()  # battery_artifact.gd
    return base.trim_suffix("_artifact.gd").trim_suffix(".gd")


## Подмена сферы на модель; редкость читается эмиссией поверх родных
## материалов (клоны, originals не тронуты) + свет/частицы как раньше.
func _apply_model_mesh():
    if mesh_instance == null:
        return
    var key := _model_key()
    if key.is_empty() or key == "base":
        return
    var path := "res://models/artifacts/artifact_%s.glb" % key
    if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
        return
    var ps := load(path) as PackedScene
    if ps == null:
        return
    var inst := ps.instantiate() as Node3D
    if inst == null:
        return
    var src := _find_mesh_instance(inst)
    if src == null or src.mesh == null:
        inst.queue_free()
        return
    mesh_instance.mesh = src.mesh
    mesh_instance.material_override = null  # иначе модель зальётся одним цветом
    var rarity_color := _get_rarity_color()
    for i in mesh_instance.mesh.get_surface_count():
        var mat := mesh_instance.mesh.surface_get_material(i) as StandardMaterial3D
        if mat == null:
            continue
        var clone := mat.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
        clone.emission_enabled = true
        clone.emission = rarity_color
        clone.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.35
        mesh_instance.set_surface_override_material(i, clone)
    inst.queue_free()


func _find_mesh_instance(node: Node) -> MeshInstance3D:
    if node is MeshInstance3D:
        return node
    for child in node.get_children():
        var found := _find_mesh_instance(child)
        if found != null:
            return found
    return null


func _get_rarity_color() -> Color:
    match rarity:
        GameEnums.Rarity.COMMON:
            return Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
        GameEnums.Rarity.RARE:
            return Color(0.3, 0.5, 1.0)
        GameEnums.Rarity.LEGENDARY:
            return Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2)
    return Color.WHITE


func _spawn_collect_effect():
    if particles:
        particles.emitting = true
        await get_tree().create_timer(particles.lifetime).timeout


func set_rarity_and_value(new_rarity, new_value: float):
    # Принимает и строку из конфига ("common"/"rare"/"legendary"),
    # и GameEnums.Rarity; value в Collectible типизирован как int
    if new_rarity is String:
        match String(new_rarity).to_lower():
            "rare":
                rarity = GameEnums.Rarity.RARE
            "legendary":
                rarity = GameEnums.Rarity.LEGENDARY
            _:
                rarity = GameEnums.Rarity.COMMON
    else:
        rarity = new_rarity as GameEnums.Rarity
    value = int(new_value)
    add_to_group("artifacts_" + get_rarity_name())
    _update_visual()
    pass # print("Редкость изменена на " + get_rarity_name() + ", ценность: " + str(value))


func get_artifact_name() -> String:
    return artifact_name


func get_energy_reward() -> float:
    return energy_reward


func get_info() -> Dictionary:
    var info = super.get_info()
    info["artifact_name"] = artifact_name
    info["energy_reward"] = energy_reward
    info["effect_duration"] = effect_duration
    return info

# entities/base/collectible.gd
extends Node3D
class_name Collectible

## Интерфейс для собираемых объектов (артефакты, ресурсы)

signal collected(collector: Node, value: int)
signal expired(collectible: Collectible)

# Параметры
@export var collectible_name: String = "Collectible"
@export var value: int = 10
@export var rarity: GameEnums.Rarity = GameEnums.Rarity.COMMON
@export var lifespan: float = 0.0  # 0 = бесконечно

# Состояние
var is_collected: bool = false
var spawn_time: float = 0.0
var collection_cooldown: float = 0.5  # Защита от множественного сбора


func _ready():
    add_to_group("collectibles")
    spawn_time = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
    
    if lifespan > 0:
        _start_lifetime_timer()
    
    _ready_hook()
    pass # print("Collectible создан: " + collectible_name + " ценность: " + str(value), "Collectible")


func _ready_hook():
    """Для переопределения в наследниках"""
    pass


func _start_lifetime_timer():
    var timer = Timer.new()
    timer.wait_time = lifespan
    timer.one_shot = true
    timer.timeout.connect(_on_lifetime_expired)
    add_child(timer)
    timer.start()
    pass # print("Таймер жизни запущен: " + str(lifespan) + "с", "Collectible")


func _on_lifetime_expired():
    if not is_collected and is_instance_valid(self):
        expired.emit(self)
        pass # print("Collectible истек: " + collectible_name, "Collectible")
        queue_free()


# ==================== ПУБЛИЧНОЕ API ====================

func get_value() -> int:
    return value


func get_rarity() -> GameEnums.Rarity:
    return rarity


func get_rarity_name() -> String:
    return GameEnums.Rarity.keys()[rarity].to_lower()


func collect(collector: Node) -> bool:
    if is_collected:
        pass # print("Попытка собрать уже собранный collectible", "Collectible")
        return false
    
    # Защита от множественного сбора
    if Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 - spawn_time < collection_cooldown:
        pass # print("Слишком рано для сбора", "Collectible")
        return false
    
    is_collected = true
    
    # Хук для эффектов
    _collect_hook(collector)
    
    collected.emit(collector, value)
    pass # print("Collectible собран: " + collectible_name + " ценность: " + str(value), "Collectible")
    
    # Эффект сбора
    _spawn_collect_effect()
    
    queue_free()
    return true


func _collect_hook(_collector: Node):
    """Для переопределения в наследниках"""
    pass


func _spawn_collect_effect():
    """Эффект при сборе"""
    # Создаем простой эффект частиц
    if has_node("GPUParticles3D"):
        var particles = $GPUParticles3D
        particles.emitting = true
        await get_tree().create_timer(particles.lifetime).timeout


func get_age() -> float:
    return (Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0) - spawn_time


func get_lifetime_remaining() -> float:
    if lifespan <= 0:
        return INF
    return max(0.0, lifespan - get_age())


func get_info() -> Dictionary:
    return {
        "name": collectible_name,
        "value": value,
        "rarity": get_rarity_name(),
        "age": get_age(),
        "lifetime": lifespan,
        "remaining": get_lifetime_remaining()
    }

# entities/bosses/boss_base.gd
extends CharacterBody3D
class_name BossBase

## Ежедневный босс (спека D19): идёт к краю Зоны («уходит»), автоатака по
## ближайшему мутанту, generic-скиллы по кулдаунам. Мутанты бьют его сами
## (группа "stalkers" - их FSM видит цель). Смерть -> died(id, sparks).

signal died(boss_id: String, sparks: int)
signal escaped(boss_id: String)

var boss_id: String = ""
var boss_name: String = ""
var sparks: int = 3
var max_hp: float = 1000.0
var hp: float = 1000.0
var move_speed: float = 2.0
var shield: float = 0.0
var damage_total: float = 0.0   # весь полученный урон (вклад рейда)
var _exit_point: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO
var _skills: Array = []                 # [{id, cd, dmg, r, ...}]
var _skill_cd: Dictionary = {}          # id -> готовность (msec)
var _attack_cd: float = 0.0
var _hp_label: Label3D = null
var _hp_bar_fg: MeshInstance3D = null   # заливка полосы HP (шейдер-дискайрд по ratio)
var _hp_bar_mat: ShaderMaterial = null  # её материал - сюда пишется ratio/цвет
var _bar_w: float = 3.0
var _bar_h: float = 0.35
static var _bar_shader: Shader = null   # общий шейдер полос всех боссов
var _vampiric := false

const AUTO_ATTACK_DMG := 26.0
const AUTO_ATTACK_RANGE := 4.0
const AUTO_ATTACK_CD := 1.2
const EXIT_REACH := 6.0
const ENGAGE_RADIUS := 16.0   # мутанты ближе - босс стоит и дерётся
const AGGRO_RADIUS := 40.0    # мутанты дальше - босс идёт к ним сам
var _side_step_time: float = 0.0
var _blink_cd: float = 0.0
var dash_dir: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO
var dash_time: float = 0.0
var _aggro: bool = false


func setup(id: String, data: Dictionary, stat_mult: float, from: Vector3, to: Vector3,
		display_name: String = "", tint: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) -> void:
	boss_id = id
	boss_name = str(data.get("name_ru", id))
	sparks = int(data.get("sparks", 3))
	move_speed = float(data.get("speed", 2.0))
	max_hp = BossHuntData.BOSS_BASE_HP * float(data.get("hp_x", 20.0)) * stat_mult
	hp = max_hp
	_exit_point = to
	_skills = data.get("skills", [])
	global_position = from
	add_to_group("stalkers")
	add_to_group("bosses")
	add_to_group("enemies")

	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	cap.radius = 1.4
	cap.height = 4.0
	col.shape = cap
	col.position.y = 2.0
	add_child(col)

	var model_id := str(data.get("model", "flesh"))
	var model_path := "res://models/animals/%s_anim.glb" % model_id
	var model_scale := float(data.get("scale", 1.8))
	if ResourceLoader.exists(model_path):
		var model: Node3D = load(model_path).instantiate()
		model.scale = Vector3(model_scale, model_scale, model_scale)
		add_child(model)

	boss_name = display_name if display_name != "" else boss_name
	_hp_label = Label3D.new()
	_hp_label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	_hp_label.no_depth_test = true
	_hp_label.font_size = 52
	_hp_label.pixel_size = 0.01
	_hp_label.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3)
	_hp_label.outline_size = 10
	_hp_label.position.y = 2.0 + model_scale * 2.2
	_hp_label.text = boss_name
	add_child(_hp_label)
	# Полоса HP: фон + заливка (шейдер отбрасывает UV.x > ratio), билборд
	# вручную в vertex - позиционных офсетов нет, depletion всегда слева
	_bar_w = 1.6 * model_scale + 1.2
	_bar_h = clampf(0.18 * model_scale, 0.3, 0.6)
	var bar_y := 2.0 + model_scale * 1.55
	var bg := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bg_mesh := QuadMesh.new()
	bg_mesh.size = Vector2(_bar_w, _bar_h)
	bg.mesh = bg_mesh
	bg.material_override = _make_bar_material(Color(0.05, 0.03, 0.03, 0.85), 1.0, 0)
	bg.position.y = bar_y
	add_child(bg)
	_hp_bar_fg = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var fg_mesh := QuadMesh.new()
	fg_mesh.size = Vector2(_bar_w, _bar_h)
	_hp_bar_fg.mesh = fg_mesh
	_hp_bar_mat = _make_bar_material(Color(0.9, 0.25, 0.15, 0.95), 1.0, 1)
	_hp_bar_fg.material_override = _hp_bar_mat
	_hp_bar_fg.position.y = bar_y
	add_child(_hp_bar_fg)
	# Пробуждённый окрас (гильд-босс): аддитивное свечение поверх текстур
	if tint.a > 0.0:
		var overlays: Array = []
		_collect_meshes(self, overlays)
		for mesh in overlays:
			mesh.material_overlay = _make_glow(tint)

	for s in _skills:
		_skill_cd[str(s.get("id", "")) + str(s.get("cd", 0.0))] = 0


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if hp <= 0.0:
		return
	_attack_cd -= delta
	_blink_cd = maxf(_blink_cd - delta, 0.0)
	_tick_skills()
	# Полоса/% обновляются каждый кадр: ветки ниже выходят ранними return
	_update_label()
	var mutants := _mutants_in(10000.0)
	# Автоатака по ближайшему
	if _attack_cd <= 0.0 and not mutants.is_empty():
		var nearest: Node = mutants[0]
		for m in mutants:
			if m.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < nearest.global_position.distance_to(global_position):
				nearest = m
		if global_position.distance_to(nearest.global_position) <= AUTO_ATTACK_RANGE:
			if nearest.has_method("take_damage"):
				nearest.take_damage(AUTO_ATTACK_DAMAGE(), self)
			_attack_cd = AUTO_ATTACK_CD
	# Ход к краю (стоячие боссы speed 0 не двигаются). Без телепорт-рывков:
	# только velocity + move_and_slide, стрейф при столкновении.
	if dash_time > 0.0:
		dash_time -= delta
		velocity = dash_dir * 48.0
		move_and_slide()
		return
	# Стоячий босс (speed 0): если бой далеко - мигает к ближайшему мутанту,
	# чтобы не простаивать весь рейд (раз в 6с, Туманница/Столп)
	if move_speed <= 0.01:
		var far_all := _mutants_in(10000.0)
		if not far_all.is_empty():
			var nearest: Node = far_all[0]
			for m in far_all:
				if m.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < nearest.global_position.distance_to(global_position):
					nearest = m
			if nearest.global_position.distance_to(global_position) > 25.0 and _blink_cd <= 0:
				_blink_cd = 6.0
				var dir_b: Vector3 = (nearest.global_position - global_position)
				dir_b.y = 0.0
				global_position += dir_b.normalized() * (nearest.global_position.distance_to(global_position) - 18.0)
		return
	if move_speed > 0.01:
		var walk_target := Vector3.ZERO
		var near := _mutants_in(ENGAGE_RADIUS)
		var far := _mutants_in(AGGRO_RADIUS)
		if not near.is_empty():
			# Втягивание: дерётся с теми, кто рядом
			velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		elif not far.is_empty():
			# Агрессия: идёт К ближайшему мутанту в радиусе агро
			var tgt: Node = far[0]
			for m in far:
				if m.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < tgt.global_position.distance_to(global_position):
					tgt = m
			walk_target = tgt.global_position
		else:
			# Патруль к краю Зоны
			walk_target = _exit_point
		var dir := walk_target - global_position
		dir.y = 0.0
		if dir.length() > 2.0:
			dir = dir.normalized()
			velocity = dir * move_speed
			move_and_slide()
			# Стрейф при столкновении: перпендикуляр, сторона меняется раз в 2с
			if get_slide_collision_count() > 0:
				_side_step_time += delta
				var side: float = 1.0 if fmod(_side_step_time, 4.0) < 2.0 else -1.0
				var perp: Vector3 = dir.cross(Vector3.UP) * side
				velocity = perp * move_speed
				move_and_slide()
			else:
				_side_step_time = 0.0
		else:
			velocity = Vector3.ZERO


func _make_bar_material(col: Color, ratio: float, priority: int) -> ShaderMaterial:
	if _bar_shader == null:
		_bar_shader = Shader.new()
		# Билборд вручную (матрица из осей камеры) - работает с любого угла
		_bar_shader.code = """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, depth_test_disabled;

uniform float ratio : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 1.0;
uniform vec4 fill_color : source_color = vec4(0.9, 0.25, 0.15, 0.95);

void vertex() {
	MODELVIEW_MATRIX = VIEW_MATRIX * mat4(
		INV_VIEW_MATRIX[0], INV_VIEW_MATRIX[1], INV_VIEW_MATRIX[2], MODEL_MATRIX[3]);
}

void fragment() {
	if (UV.x > ratio) {
		discard;
	}
	ALBEDO = fill_color.rgb;
	ALPHA = fill_color.a;
}
"""
	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
	m.shader = _bar_shader
	m.render_priority = priority
	m.set_shader_parameter("ratio", ratio)
	m.set_shader_parameter("fill_color", col)
	return m


func _update_label() -> void:
	if _hp_label:
		var pct := int(100.0 * hp / maxf(max_hp, 1.0))
		_hp_label.text = "%s %d%%" % [boss_name, pct]
	if _hp_bar_mat:
		var ratio := clampf(hp / maxf(max_hp, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
		_hp_bar_mat.set_shader_parameter("ratio", ratio)
		# зелёный -> жёлтый -> красный по остатку
		var col: Color
		if ratio > 0.5:
			col = Color(0.95, 0.75, 0.15).lerp(Color(0.35, 0.85, 0.25), (ratio - 0.5) * 2.0)
		else:
			col = Color(0.9, 0.2, 0.12).lerp(Color(0.95, 0.75, 0.15), ratio * 2.0)
		col.a = 0.95
		_hp_bar_mat.set_shader_parameter("fill_color", col)


func AUTO_ATTACK_DAMAGE() -> float:
	return 26.0 * maxf(1.0, max_hp / (BossHuntData.BOSS_BASE_HP * 20.0))


## Для Выброса и прицеливания: босс жив?
func is_alive() -> bool:
	return hp > 0.0


func take_damage(amount: float, _source = null) -> void:
	if hp <= 0.0:
		return
	var dmg := float(amount)
	# Выброс выжигает сталкеров 999999 - босса только ранит (10% макс HP + 200)
	if dmg > max_hp * 0.3:
		dmg = max_hp * 0.10 + 200.0
	if shield > 0.0:
		var absorbed: float = minf(shield, dmg)
		shield -= absorbed
		dmg -= absorbed
	hp -= dmg
	damage_total += dmg
	if hp <= 0.0:
		hp = 0.0
		died.emit(boss_id, sparks)
		queue_free()


# ==================== СКИЛЛЫ (generic) ====================

func _tick_skills() -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	for s in _skills:
		var key := str(s.get("id", "")) + str(s.get("cd", 0.0))
		var cd_ms: int = int(float(s.get("cd", 0.0)) * 1000.0)
		if cd_ms <= 0:
			_passive(s)
			continue
		if now < int(_skill_cd.get(key, 0)):
			continue
		_skill_cd[key] = now + cd_ms
		_cast(s)


func _mutants_in(r: float) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for m in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("mutants"):
		if is_instance_valid(m) and m.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= r:
			out.append(m)
	return out


func _cast(s: Dictionary) -> void:
	match str(s.get("id", "")):
		"quake":
			for m in _mutants_in(float(s.get("r", 8.0))):
				if m.has_method("take_damage"):
					m.take_damage(float(s.get("dmg", 25.0)), self)
		"snipe":
			var targets := _mutants_in(30.0)
			var best: Node = null
			for m in targets:
				if best == null or _hp_of(m) > _hp_of(best):
					best = m
			if best and best.has_method("take_damage"):
				best.take_damage(float(s.get("dmg", 40.0)), self)
		"blink":
			var mutants := _mutants_in(20.0)
			var away := global_position
			if not mutants.is_empty():
				var centroid := Vector3.ZERO
				for m in mutants:
					centroid += m.global_position
				centroid /= mutants.size()
				away = global_position + (global_position - centroid).normalized() * 12.0
			global_position = Vector3(away.x, global_position.y, away.z)
		"dot_zone":
			_spawn_dot(global_position, float(s.get("r", 4.0)), float(s.get("dmg", 8.0)), float(s.get("t", 6.0)))
		"summon":
			for i in range(int(s.get("n", 2))):
				_spawn_minion(float(s.get("hp_frac", 0.25)))
		"stun_nearest":
			var mutants2 := _mutants_in(6.0)
			if not mutants2.is_empty():
				var m = mutants2[randi() % mutants2.size()]
				m.set_meta("hunt_stun_until", Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(float(s.get("t", 3.0)) * 1000.0))
				if m.has_method("take_damage"):
					m.take_damage(15.0, self)
		"dash":
			dash_dir = (_exit_point - global_position).normalized()
			dash_time = 0.25   # рывок растянут на 0.25с - без телепорта
		"shield":
			shield = float(s.get("amount", 800.0))
		"regen":
			hp = minf(hp + max_hp * float(s.get("frac", 0.05)), max_hp)
		"vampiric":
			_vampiric = true
	# Пассив вампиризма тикает всегда
	if _vampiric:
		var near := _mutants_in(8.0)
		if not near.is_empty():
			hp = minf(hp + max_hp * 0.02 * near.size() * get_physics_process_delta_time(), max_hp)


func _passive(_s: Dictionary) -> void:
	pass


func _hp_of(m) -> float:
	return float(m.get("hp")) if "hp" in m else 100.0


func _collect_meshes(node: Node, out: Array) -> void:
	for ch in node.get_children():
		_collect_meshes(ch, out)
	if node is MeshInstance3D:
		out.append(node)


func _make_glow(tint: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var glow := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	glow.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	glow.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	glow.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	glow.albedo_color = Color(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, 0.35)
	return glow


func _spawn_dot(pos: Vector3, r: float, dps: float, t: float) -> void:
	var zone := Area3D.new()
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var sph := SphereShape3D.new()
	sph.radius = r
	col.shape = sph
	zone.add_child(col)
	zone.global_position = pos
	add_child(zone)
	var tick := Timer.new()
	tick.wait_time = 0.5
	tick.autostart = true
	zone.add_child(tick)
	tick.timeout.connect(func():
		for m in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("mutants"):
			if is_instance_valid(m) and m.global_position.distance_to(pos) <= r and m.has_method("take_damage"):
				m.take_damage(dps * 0.5, self))
	var life := get_tree().create_timer(t)
	life.timeout.connect(func(): zone.queue_free())


func _spawn_minion(hp_frac: float) -> void:
	var mini := CharacterBody3D.new()
	mini.add_to_group("mutants")
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	cap.radius = 0.8
	cap.height = 2.2
	col.shape = cap
	col.position.y = 1.1
	mini.add_child(col)
	var mini_script := GDScript.new()
	mini_script.source_code = '''
extends CharacterBody3D
var hp := 100.0
func _physics_process(_d):
	for m in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("mutants"):
		pass
'''
	# v1: мелочь - просто тело с HP, мутанты бьют её как цель группы "bosses_minions"
	mini.add_to_group("stalkers")
	mini.set_meta("minion", true)
	mini.set_script(null)
	get_parent().add_child(mini)
	mini.global_position = global_position + Vector3(randf_range(-3, 3), 0.5, randf_range(-3, 3))
	var lbl := Label3D.new()
	lbl.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	lbl.text = "🩸"
	lbl.position.y = 2.6
	mini.add_child(lbl)

# Скелетная анимация (модели models/animals/* и кровосос):

# 0 = не нормализовать размер

# Множители статов (лаборатория + звёздность), задаётся до add_child,
# применяются в _ready() после статов наследника
var _stat_health_mult: float = 1.0
var _stat_damage_mult: float = 1.0
# Звёзды этого типа (1-5): для подписи и эффектов
var star_level: int = 1

# Навигационный компонент
var navigation_component: NavigationComponent
var zone_controller: Node = null

@onready var detection_area: Area3D = $DetectionArea
@onready var attack_timer: Timer = $AttackTimer


func _ready():
        if not detection_area:
                push_error("Mutant: DetectionArea не найден!")
                return
        
        if not attack_timer:
                push_error("Mutant: AttackTimer не найден!")
                return
        
        # Создаем навигационный компонент
        _setup_navigation_component()
        
        detection_area.body_entered.connect(_on_stalker_detected)
        detection_area.body_exited.connect(_on_stalker_lost)
        
        attack_timer.wait_time = attack_cooldown
        attack_timer.one_shot = true
        attack_timer.timeout.connect(_on_attack_cooldown_ended)
        
        add_to_group("mutants")
        
        # Генерируем точки патруля вокруг места появления
        _generate_patrol_points()
        
        zone_controller = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("zone_controller")
        if zone_controller and zone_controller.has_method("register_mutant"):
                zone_controller.register_mutant(self)
        
        # Запомнить базовую высоту модели для процедурной анимации
        var model := get_node_or_null("Model")
        if model:
                _model_base_y = model.position.y
                _model_skeletal = not model.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false).is_empty()
                if _model_skeletal:
                        _setup_skeletal_animation(model)
                        _model_base_y = model.position.y
        
        health = max_health
        
        # Множители применяются последними: наследник уже задал базовые статы
        if _stat_health_mult != 1.0:
                max_health *= _stat_health_mult
                health = max_health
        if _stat_damage_mult != 1.0:
                damage *= _stat_damage_mult
        
        # Звёзды в подписи - после того как наследник настроит Label3D
        _apply_star_label.call_deferred()


func set_health_multiplier(value: float):
        _stat_health_mult = value


func set_damage_multiplier(value: float):
        _stat_damage_mult = value


func set_star_level(stars: int):
        star_level = maxi(stars, 1)


## Синергия (v0.30.0 «ЗОНА МУТИРУЕТ»): домножает статы УЖЕ стоящего на поле
## мутанта (_ready давно прошёл). HP растёт вместе с текущим запасом.
func apply_synergy_buff_live(hp_mult: float, dmg_mult: float, speed_mult: float) -> void:
        if not is_equal_approx(hp_mult, 1.0):
                max_health *= hp_mult
                health = minf(health * hp_mult, max_health)
        if not is_equal_approx(dmg_mult, 1.0):
                damage *= dmg_mult
        if not is_equal_approx(speed_mult, 1.0):
                speed *= speed_mult


func _apply_star_label():
        """Дописываем звёзды к подписи мутанта (если она есть)"""
        if star_level <= 1:
                return
        var label = get_node_or_null("Label3D")
        if not label:
                var found = find_children("*", "Label3D", false, false)
                if not found.is_empty():
                        label = found[0]
        if label:
                label.text += " " + "★".repeat(star_level)


# ==================== ЭКСКЛЮЗИВНЫЙ ВАРИАНТ (ЧЁРНЫЙ ЯЩИК) ====================

var _variant_type: String = ""
var _variant_name: String = ""
var _variant_tint: Color = Color.WHITE
var _variant_speed_mult: float = 1.0
var _variant_accent: Color = Color.WHITE


## Вариант окраса/имени для эксклюзивных мутантов трека наград.
## Зовётся из spawn_manager ДО add_child: перекраска и имя применяются
## после _ready наследника (deferred), звёзды допишутся поверх имени.
func apply_exclusive_variant(type: String, display_name: String, tint: Color, speed_mult: float = 1.0, accent: Color = Color.WHITE) -> void:
        _variant_type = type
        _variant_name = display_name
        _variant_tint = tint
        _variant_speed_mult = speed_mult
        _variant_accent = accent
        _apply_variant_look.call_deferred()


func _apply_variant_look():
        # deferred: наследник успевает отработать _ready (перетирает тип/скорость) —
        # теперь эксклюзив закрепляется поверх.
        if not _variant_type.is_empty():
                mutant_type = _variant_type
        if not is_equal_approx(_variant_speed_mult, 1.0):
                speed *= _variant_speed_mult
        if _variant_tint != Color.WHITE:
                _tint_model(_variant_tint)
        if _variant_name.is_empty():
                return
        var label = get_node_or_null("Label3D")
        if not label:
                var found = find_children("*", "Label3D", false, false)
                if not found.is_empty():
                        label = found[0]
        if label:
                label.text = _variant_name
                if _variant_accent != Color.WHITE:
                        label.modulate = _variant_accent


func _tint_model(tint: Color):
        """Умножает albedo всех материалов модели на tint (общие ресурсы не трогаем)."""
        var stack: Array = [self]
        while not stack.is_empty():
                var node = stack.pop_back()
                for child in node.get_children():
                        stack.append(child)
                var mi := node as MeshInstance3D
                if mi == null or mi.mesh == null:
                        continue
                for si in range(mi.mesh.get_surface_count()):
                        var mat := mi.get_active_material(si)
                        var base_mat := mat as BaseMaterial3D
                        if base_mat == null:
                                continue
                        var dup: BaseMaterial3D = base_mat.duplicate()
                        dup.albedo_color = Color(
                                base_mat.albedo_color.r * tint.r,
                                base_mat.albedo_color.g * tint.g,
                                base_mat.albedo_color.b * tint.b,
                                base_mat.albedo_color.a)
                        mi.set_surface_override_material(si, dup)


# ==================== СКЕЛЕТНАЯ АНИМАЦИЯ ====================
# Модели из models/animals/* (CC0, Quaternius): все клипы внутри модели,
# имена вида «AnimalArmature|Walk». Проигрыватель общий для всех мутантов.

func _setup_skeletal_animation(model: Node3D):
        """Нормализует размер модели и подбирает клипы по суффиксам имён"""
        var players = model.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false)
        if players.is_empty():
                return
        _anim = players[0]
        _model_skeletal = true

        var names := _anim.get_animation_list()
        _clip_death = _match_clip(names, ["death"])
        _clip_move = _match_clip(names, ["walk", "fast_flying"])
        _clip_run = _match_clip(names, ["run", "gallop"])
        _clip_attack = _match_clip(names, ["punch", "attack_headbutt", "attack_kick", "attack", "bite_front", "headbutt"])
        _clip_idle = _match_clip(names, ["idle"])

        # Циклические - передвижение и стойки, одиночные - атаки/смерть/реакции
        for n in names:
                var low := n.to_lower()
                var one_shot := low.ends_with("attack") or low.ends_with("punch") \
                        or low.ends_with("death") or low.ends_with("bite_front") \
                        or low.ends_with("headbutt") or low.contains("hitreact")
                _anim.get_animation(n).loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_NONE if one_shot else Animation.LOOP_LINEAR

        # Повтор одиночного клипа (атаки) доступен сразу после завершения
        _anim.animation_finished.connect(func(_name): _current_clip = "")

        # Нормализация размера: локальный AABB модели -> целевая высота, ноги на землю
        if model_target_height > 0.0:
                var aabb := _compute_model_aabb(model)
                if aabb.size.y > 0.001:
                        var s := model_target_height / aabb.size.y
                        model.scale = Vector3.ONE * s
                        model.rotation.y = deg_to_rad(model_yaw_degrees)
                        model.position.y = _model_base_y - aabb.position.y * s


func _match_clip(names: PackedStringArray, suffixes: Array) -> String:
        for suffix in suffixes:
                for n in names:
                        if n.to_lower().ends_with(suffix):
                                return n
        return ""


func _compute_model_aabb(model: Node3D) -> AABB:
        """Габариты модели в её локальном пространстве (до масштабирования)"""
        var result := AABB()
        var first := true
        var inv := model.global_transform.affine_inverse()
        for mi in model.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
                var rel: Transform3D = inv * mi.global_transform
                var box: AABB = rel * mi.get_aabb()
                result = box if first else result.merge(box)
                first = false
        return result


func _update_skeletal_anim():
        """Состояние -> клип: патруль идёт, погоня бежит, атака бьёт"""
        if _anim == null or not use_builtin_clip_player:
                return
        if current_state == State.DEAD:
                return

        var want := ""
        match current_state:
                State.ATTACK:
                        want = _clip_attack if _clip_attack != "" else _clip_idle
                State.CHASE:
                        want = _clip_run if _clip_run != "" else _clip_move
                State.PATROL:
                        var moving := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length() > 0.6
                        want = _clip_move if moving else _clip_idle

        if want != "" and want != _current_clip and _anim.has_animation(want):
                _anim.play(want, 0.2)
                _current_clip = want


func _ground_below_y() -> float:
        """Высота земли под мутантом (для парения). Рей вниз с маской рельефа."""
        var space := get_world_3d().direct_space_state
        var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(
                global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.0,
                global_position + Vector3.DOWN * 12.0, 1)
        var hit := space.intersect_ray(query)
        if hit and hit.has("position"):
                return hit["position"].y
        return _spawn_position.y


func _setup_navigation_component():
        # Создаем NavigationAgent3D если его нет
        var nav_agent = get_node_or_null("NavigationAgent3D")
        if not nav_agent:
                nav_agent = NavigationAgent3D.new()
                nav_agent.name = "NavigationAgent3D"
                add_child(nav_agent)
        
        # Создаем компонент навигации
        navigation_component = NavigationComponent.new()
        navigation_component.entity = self
        navigation_component.nav_agent = nav_agent
        navigation_component.move_speed = speed
        add_child(navigation_component)
        # "NavigationComponent добавлен для мутанта"  # (лог отключён)


func _physics_process(delta):
        if current_state == State.DEAD:
                # D10: летающий труп не висит в воздухе - плавно оседает на рельеф
                if hover_height > 0.0 and not is_on_floor():
                        velocity.x = 0.0
                        velocity.z = 0.0
                        velocity.y = maxf(velocity.y - gravity * delta, -3.0)
                        move_and_slide()
                return
        
        # Гравитация или парение (летающие мутанты держат высоту над рельефом)
        if hover_height > 0.0 and Time.get_ticks_msec() < hover_suppressed_until_ms:
                # Парение заглушено грав-аномалией (D10): тело тянет вниз
                velocity.y -= gravity * delta
        elif hover_height > 0.0:
                var target_y := _ground_below_y() + hover_height
                if hover_bob_amplitude > 0.0:
                        target_y += sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0 * hover_bob_speed) * hover_bob_amplitude
                velocity.y = clampf((target_y - global_position.y) * 2.5, -2.5, 2.5)
        elif not is_on_floor():
                velocity.y -= gravity * delta
        
        # NavigationComponent обновляется сам в своём _physics_process
        
        match current_state:
                State.PATROL:
                        _patrol(delta)
                State.CHASE:
                        _chase(delta)
                State.ATTACK:
                        _attack(delta)
        
        # Плавный разворот в сторону движения (для моделей)
        var horizontal := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z)
        if horizontal.length() > 0.5:
                var target_yaw := atan2(-horizontal.x, -horizontal.y)
                rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, target_yaw, 8.0 * delta)
        
        # Антизастревание: 6 секунд на месте (в т.ч. на крыше дома) - телепорт домой
        if global_position.distance_to(_stuck_pos) < 0.15 and current_state != State.DEAD:
                _stuck_time += delta
        else:
                _stuck_pos = global_position
                _stuck_time = 0.0
        if _stuck_time > 6.0:
                _stuck_time = 0.0
                global_position = _spawn_position + Vector3(randf_range(-2, 2), 1.0, randf_range(-2, 2))
                if navigation_component:
                        navigation_component.stop()
                current_state = State.PATROL
                patrol_points.clear()
                _generate_patrol_points()
                # print("Мутант: застрял - возвращён на точку спавна")
        
        # Скелетная анимация: состояние -> клип
        _update_skeletal_anim()

        # Процедурная анимация статичной модели (скелетная анимирует сама себя)
        var model := get_node_or_null("Model")
        if model and not _model_skeletal and not disable_body_bob:
                var t := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
                # Воздух-наклон после 0.3с в воздухе: у земли is_on_floor мигает на кочках
                _air_time = 0.0 if is_on_floor() else _air_time + delta
                if _air_time > 0.3:
                        model.rotation.x = lerp_angle(model.rotation.x, clampf(velocity.y * 0.04, -0.2, 0.2), 2.0 * delta)
                elif horizontal.length() > 0.5:
                        # бег: подпрыгивание + крен + лёгкий наклон носа вниз
                        var gait: float = clampf(horizontal.length() / 6.0, 0.4, 1.5)
                        model.position.y = _model_base_y + absf(sin(t * horizontal.length() * 2.4)) * 0.08 * gait
                        model.rotation.z = sin(t * horizontal.length() * 1.2) * 0.05
                        model.rotation.x = lerp_angle(model.rotation.x, -0.10, 3.0 * delta)
                else:
                        # стойка: дыхание
                        model.position.y = _model_base_y + sin(t * 1.8) * 0.02
                        model.rotation.z = lerp_angle(model.rotation.z, 0.0, 3.0 * delta)
                        model.rotation.x = lerp_angle(model.rotation.x, 0.0, 3.0 * delta)
        
        move_and_slide()


## Грав-аномалия глушит парение на время (D10); пока флаг активен,
## тело тянет гравитацией. Повторные вызовы продлевают глушение.
func suppress_hover(duration: float = 1.0) -> void:
        hover_suppressed_until_ms = maxi(hover_suppressed_until_ms, Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(duration * 1000.0))


func _generate_patrol_points():
        """Точки патруля в радиусе patrol_radius от точки спавна"""
        _spawn_position = global_position
        patrol_points.clear()
        for i in range(patrol_points_count):
                var angle = TAU * i / patrol_points_count + randf_range(-0.4, 0.4)
                var dist = patrol_radius * randf_range(0.4, 1.0)
                var pos = _spawn_position + Vector3(cos(angle) * dist, 0.0, sin(angle) * dist)
                patrol_points.append(pos)


func _patrol(_delta):
        if patrol_points.is_empty():
                # Если нет точек патруля, просто стоим
                if navigation_component and not navigation_component.is_navigating():
                        # Ищем сталкеров
                        # Ищем сталкеров (редко: перф толпы, v0.23.1)
                        if _target_scan_tick(_delta):
                                _find_best_target()
                return
        
        var target_pos = patrol_points[current_patrol_index]
        
        # Без сталкеров ходим НАПРЯМУЮ: сотня мутантов непрерывно запрашивает
        # пути у навмеша и роняет FPS (репорт: толпа тормозит в затишье,
        # с волной - норм). Препятствия страхует антизастревание v3;
        # сталкеры рядом - навмешь (обход строений) как раньше
        if target_stalker == null:
                var dir3: Vector3 = target_pos - global_position
                var dir2 := Vector2(dir3.x, dir3.z)
                if dir2.length() > 0.5:
                        var dir := Vector3(dir2.x, 0.0, dir2.y).normalized()
                        velocity.x = dir.x * speed * 0.6
                        velocity.z = dir.z * speed * 0.6
                else:
                        velocity.x = 0.0
                        velocity.z = 0.0
        elif navigation_component and not navigation_component.is_navigating():
                navigation_component.move_to(target_pos)
        
        # Прибытие по горизонтали: вертикальные 1.8м до навмеша съедали порог
        # и превращали подход к точке в ползание с "цель достигнута" каждый кадр
        var to_point = target_pos - global_position
        if Vector2(to_point.x, to_point.z).length() < 1.5:
                current_patrol_index = (current_patrol_index + 1) % patrol_points.size()
                if target_stalker != null and navigation_component:
                        navigation_component.move_to(patrol_points[current_patrol_index])
        
        # В патруле тоже ищем цели
        if _target_scan_tick(_delta):
                _find_best_target()


func _chase(_delta):
        if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker) or (target_stalker.has_method("is_alive") and not target_stalker.is_alive()):
                if _target_scan_tick(_delta):
                        _find_best_target()
                if not target_stalker:
                        current_state = State.PATROL
                        target_stalker = null
                        if navigation_component:
                                navigation_component.stop()
                return
        
        var to_target = target_stalker.global_position - global_position
        var horizontal_dist = Vector2(to_target.x, to_target.z).length()
        if horizontal_dist < 2.0:
                current_state = State.ATTACK
                _try_attack()
        elif horizontal_dist < 2.6:
                # Мёртвая зона навигации (в 2.5м путь сразу finished): идём напрямую
                var dir = Vector3(to_target.x, 0.0, to_target.z).normalized()
                velocity.x = dir.x * speed
                velocity.z = dir.z * speed
        elif horizontal_dist > detection_radius * 1.5:
                # Потеряли цель
                target_stalker = null
                current_state = State.PATROL
                if navigation_component and navigation_component.is_navigating():
                        navigation_component.stop()


func _attack(_delta):
        if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker) or (target_stalker.has_method("is_alive") and not target_stalker.is_alive()):
                current_state = State.PATROL
                target_stalker = null
                if navigation_component:
                        navigation_component.stop()
                return
        
        var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
        if dist > 3.0:
                current_state = State.CHASE
                return
        
        # Не двигаемся во время атаки
        if navigation_component and navigation_component.is_navigating():
                navigation_component.stop()
        
        velocity.x = 0
        velocity.z = 0
        
        # Пытаемся атаковать
        _try_attack()


func _find_best_target():
        # D19: босс охоты - приоритетная цель (группа "enemies")
        var bosses := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies")
        for b in bosses:
                if is_instance_valid(b) and b.global_position.distance_to(global_position) < 200.0:
                        target_stalker = b
                        if current_state == State.PATROL:
                                        current_state = State.CHASE
                        return
        # У кромки повадка новую цель не берём: сначала возвращаемся к дому
        if _spawn_position.distance_to(global_position) > leash_radius * 0.85:
                return
        var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
        var nearest = null
        var nearest_dist = INF
        
        for s in stalkers:
                if not is_instance_valid(s):
                        continue
                if s == self:
                        continue
                if s.has_method("is_alive") and not s.is_alive():
                        continue
                
                var dist = global_position.distance_to(s.global_position)
                if dist < detection_radius and dist < nearest_dist:
                        nearest_dist = dist
                        nearest = s
        
        if nearest:
                target_stalker = nearest
                current_state = State.CHASE
                spotted_stalker.emit(nearest)
                # "Мутант нашёл цель: ", nearest.name  # (лог отключён)


## Общий троттлинг скана целей (v0.23.1): не чаще TARGET_SCAN_INTERVAL секунд.
## Фаза сдвинута randf() — толпа не сканирует в одном и том же кадре. true = пора.
func _target_scan_tick(delta: float) -> bool:
        _target_scan_cd -= delta
        if _target_scan_cd > 0.0:
                return false
        _target_scan_cd = TARGET_SCAN_INTERVAL + randf() * 0.1
        return true


func _on_stalker_detected(body: Node3D):
        if not is_instance_valid(body):
                return
                
        if body.has_method("take_damage") and body.is_in_group("stalkers"):
                # Если у сталкера есть артефакт - сразу в приоритет
                if body.has_method("has_artifact") and body.has_artifact():
                        target_stalker = body
                        current_state = State.CHASE
                        spotted_stalker.emit(body)
                # Иначе если нет цели или новая цель ближе
                elif not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker) or (target_stalker.has_method("is_alive") and not target_stalker.is_alive()):
                        target_stalker = body
                        current_state = State.CHASE
                        spotted_stalker.emit(body)
                else:
                        var dist_to_new = global_position.distance_to(body.global_position)
                        var dist_to_current = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
                        if dist_to_new < dist_to_current:
                                target_stalker = body
                                spotted_stalker.emit(body)


func _on_stalker_lost(body: Node3D):
        if body == target_stalker:
                _find_best_target()


func _try_attack():
        if current_state != State.ATTACK:
                return
        
        if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker) or (target_stalker.has_method("is_alive") and not target_stalker.is_alive()):
                return
        
        if attack_timer.time_left > 0:
                return
        
        if target_stalker.has_method("take_damage"):
                var _aura_dmg: float = float(get_meta("aura_dmg", 0.0))
                target_stalker.take_damage(damage * (1.0 + _aura_dmg), self)
                attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)
                attack_timer.start()
                # Удар: одиночный клип, после завершения обновление вернёт стойку/бег
                if _anim and _clip_attack != "" and use_builtin_clip_player:
                        _anim.play(_clip_attack, 0.1)
                        _current_clip = _clip_attack


func _on_attack_cooldown_ended():
        # Можно атаковать снова
        pass


## D20: лечение от аур поддержки (Моховик/Цветень/Живица)
func heal_hp(amount: float) -> void:
        health = minf(health + amount, max_health)


func take_damage(dmg: float, _source = null):
        var actual_damage = max(dmg - armor, 1.0)
        health -= actual_damage
        
        if health <= 0:
                die()


func die():
        if current_state == State.DEAD:
                return

        current_state = State.DEAD

        # Клип смерти: труп лежит, пока клип не доиграет (1..3 с)
        var corpse_time := 1.0
        if _anim and _clip_death != "" and use_builtin_clip_player and _anim.has_animation(_clip_death):
                _anim.play(_clip_death, 0.15)
                _current_clip = _clip_death
                corpse_time = clampf(_anim.get_animation(_clip_death).length, 1.0, 3.0)

        if zone_controller and zone_controller.has_method("add_biomass"):
                zone_controller.add_biomass(biomass_cost * 0.5)

        died.emit(self)

        var timer = Timer.new()
        timer.wait_time = corpse_time
        timer.one_shot = true
        timer.timeout.connect(queue_free)
        add_child(timer)
        timer.start()


func set_patrol_points(points: Array[Vector3]):
        patrol_points = points
        current_patrol_index = 0


func _exit_tree():
        if zone_controller and zone_controller.has_method("unregister_mutant"):
                zone_controller.unregister_mutant(self)

# entities/mutants/bloodsucker.gd
extends BaseMutant
class_name BloodsuckerMutant

@export_enum("Underground", "Swamp", "NightKing") var subspecies: String = "Underground"
@export var invisibility_duration: float = 5.0
@export var invisibility_cooldown: float = 10.0
@export var ambush_range: float = 8.0
@export var leap_damage: float = 40.0

var is_invisible: bool = false
var can_go_invisible: bool = true
var invisibility_timer: Timer
var leap_timer: Timer
var mesh_instance: MeshInstance3D


func _init():
		# Анимациями управляет сам (_setup_animations: Walking/Running по состояниям),
		# общий проигрыватель base_mutant отключён
		use_builtin_clip_player = false


func _ready():
		match subspecies:
				"Underground":
						health = 80.0
						max_health = 80.0
						speed = 7.0
						damage = 25.0
						armor = 5.0
						biomass_cost = 80.0
				"Swamp":
						health = 100.0
						max_health = 100.0
						speed = 6.0
						damage = 30.0
						armor = 8.0
						biomass_cost = 100.0
				"NightKing":
						health = 150.0
						max_health = 150.0
						speed = 9.0
						damage = 40.0
						armor = 15.0
						biomass_cost = 150.0

		mutant_type = "bloodsucker"

		mesh_instance = $MeshInstance3D

		super._ready()

		if has_node("Model"):
				_setup_bloodsucker_anim()

		invisibility_timer = Timer.new()
		invisibility_timer.one_shot = true
		invisibility_timer.timeout.connect(_on_invisibility_ended)
		add_child(invisibility_timer)

		leap_timer = Timer.new()
		leap_timer.one_shot = true
		leap_timer.wait_time = 2.0
		leap_timer.timeout.connect(_on_leap_ended)
		add_child(leap_timer)

		_setup_label()
		# "Bloodsucker mutant initialized: ", subspecies  # (лог отключён)


var _bs_anim: AnimationPlayer
var _bs_current_anim: String = ""


func _setup_bloodsucker_anim():
	"""Walking из модели, Running подсаживается из bloodsucker_run.glb.
	Алиасы Walk/Run - под матчинг суффиксов базовой системы анимации"""
	var model := get_node_or_null("Model")
	if model == null:
		return
	var players = model.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false)
	if players.is_empty():
		return
	var ap: AnimationPlayer = players[0]
	var run_scene: PackedScene = load("res://models/bloodsucker_run.glb")
	if run_scene:
		var run_inst: Node = run_scene.instantiate()
		for dap in run_inst.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false):
			for anim_name in (dap as AnimationPlayer).get_animation_list():
				if not ap.has_animation(anim_name):
					ap.get_animation_library("").add_animation(anim_name, (dap as AnimationPlayer).get_animation(anim_name))
		run_inst.queue_free()
	var lib: AnimationLibrary = ap.get_animation_library("")
	if lib.has_animation("Walking") and not lib.has_animation("Walk"):
		lib.add_animation("Walk", lib.get_animation("Walking"))
	if lib.has_animation("Running") and not lib.has_animation("Run"):
		lib.add_animation("Run", lib.get_animation("Running"))
	model.rotation.y = PI

func _physics_process(delta):
		if current_state == State.DEAD:
				return

		if can_go_invisible and not is_invisible and current_state == State.PATROL:
				_try_go_invisible()

		_update_invisibility_visuals()

		super._physics_process(delta)
		_update_bloodsucker_anim()


func _try_go_invisible():
		if not can_go_invisible or is_invisible:  # Добавлена проверка is_invisible
				return

		is_invisible = true
		can_go_invisible = false

		invisibility_timer.wait_time = invisibility_duration
		invisibility_timer.start()

		# "Bloodsucker стал невидимым!"  # (лог отключён)


func _on_invisibility_ended():
		if not is_invisible:  # Защита от множественных вызовов
				return

		is_invisible = false
		# "Bloodsucker стал видимым"  # (лог отключён)

		await get_tree().create_timer(invisibility_cooldown).timeout
		can_go_invisible = true


func _update_invisibility_visuals():
		if not mesh_instance:
				return

		var alpha = 0.2 if is_invisible else 1.0
		if mesh_instance.material_override:
				mesh_instance.material_override.albedo_color.a = alpha


func _patrol(delta):
		var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
		var nearest_stalker = null
		var nearest_dist = INF

		for stalker in stalkers:
				if is_instance_valid(stalker):
						var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
						if dist < detection_radius and dist < nearest_dist:
								nearest_dist = dist
								nearest_stalker = stalker

		if nearest_stalker:
				target_stalker = nearest_stalker
				current_state = State.CHASE

		super._patrol(delta)


func _chase(_delta):
		if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
				current_state = State.PATROL
				return

		# Поводок: невидимка не уходит далеко от своей территории
		if _spawn_position.distance_to(global_position) > leash_radius:
				target_stalker = null
				current_state = State.PATROL
				# "Кровосос: добыча увела от территории, возврат"  # (лог отключён)
				return

		var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
		velocity.x = direction.x * speed
		velocity.z = direction.z * speed

		if is_invisible and is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
				var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
				if dist < ambush_range:
						_ambush_attack()

		if global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position) < 2.0:
				current_state = State.ATTACK


func _ambush_attack():
		if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
				return

		# "Bloodsucker атакует из засады!"  # (лог отключён)
		is_invisible = false
		invisibility_timer.stop()

		var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
		velocity.x = direction.x * speed * 2.0
		velocity.z = direction.z * speed * 2.0
		velocity.y = 2.0

		target_stalker.take_damage(leap_damage, self)
		attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)

		leap_timer.start()


func _on_leap_ended():
		pass


func _attack(_delta):
		if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
				current_state = State.PATROL
				return

		var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
		if dist > 2.0:
				current_state = State.CHASE
				return

		if attack_timer.is_stopped():
				target_stalker.take_damage(damage, self)
				attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)
				attack_timer.start()
				# "Bloodsucker атакует!"  # (лог отключён)


func take_damage(dmg: float, source = null):
		if not is_invisible:
				dmg *= 1.5

		if is_invisible:
				is_invisible = false
				invisibility_timer.stop()
				# "Bloodsucker стал видимым из-за урона"  # (лог отключён)

		super.take_damage(dmg, source)


func _setup_label():
		var label = Label3D.new()
		label.name = "MutantLabel"
		label.position = Vector3(0, 2.5, 0)
		label.font_size = 24
		label.outline_size = 2
		label.outline_modulate = Color.BLACK
		label.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.2)  # красный
		label.text = "🩸 КРОВОСОС"
		add_child(label)


func _update_bloodsucker_anim():
		# Патруль шагает, погоня бежит (клипы Walking/Running)
		if _bs_anim == null:
				return
		var want := ""
		match current_state:
				State.CHASE:
						want = "Running"
				State.PATROL, State.ATTACK:
						want = "Walking"
		if want != "" and _bs_current_anim != want and _bs_anim.has_animation(want):
				_bs_anim.play(want)
				_bs_current_anim = want

# entities/mutants/chimera.gd
extends BaseMutant
class_name ChimeraMutant

@export var is_night_only: bool = false
@export var leap_distance: float = 15.0
@export var leap_damage: float = 50.0
@export var secondary_head_damage: float = 10.0

var can_leap: bool = true
var leap_timer: Timer
var is_leaping: bool = false
var leap_target: Vector3
var leap_time: float = 0.0
var _leap_from: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO
var _leap_vx: float = 0.0
var _leap_vy: float = 0.0
var _leap_vz: float = 0.0
var _leap_t_total: float = 0.0

func _ready():
	health = 250.0
	max_health = 250.0
	speed = 10.0
	damage = 30.0
	armor = 25.0
	biomass_cost = 200.0
	mutant_type = "chimera"
	
	# Целевая высота модели: нормализация по AABB в base_mutant
	model_target_height = 1.5
	super._ready()
	_setup_gallop()
		
	leap_timer = Timer.new()
	leap_timer.one_shot = true
	leap_timer.wait_time = 4.0
	leap_timer.timeout.connect(_on_leap_cooldown_ended)
	add_child(leap_timer)
	
	_setup_label()
	# "Chimera mutant initialized"  # (лог отключён)


func _physics_process(delta):
	if current_state == State.DEAD:
		return
	
	if is_leaping:
		_handle_leap(delta)
		return
	
	super._physics_process(delta)
	_update_gallop(delta)


func _find_new_target():
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	var nearest = null
	var nearest_dist = INF
	
	for s in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(s):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(s.global_position)
			if dist < detection_radius * 2 and dist < nearest_dist:
				nearest_dist = dist
				nearest = s
	
	if nearest:
		target_stalker = nearest
		current_state = State.CHASE


func _patrol(delta):
	_find_new_target()
	super._patrol(delta)


func _chase(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		_find_new_target()
		if not target_stalker:
			current_state = State.PATROL
			return
	
	# Поводок: прыжки за жертвой через всю карту запрещены
	if _spawn_position.distance_to(global_position) > leash_radius:
		target_stalker = null
		current_state = State.PATROL
		# "Химера: добыча увела от территории, возврат"  # (лог отключён)
		return
	
	# Застрял у дома - прыжок прямо через препятствие (кинематика проходит сквозь)
	if can_leap and not is_leaping and _stuck_time > 1.5:
		var stuck_dist: float = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
		if stuck_dist > 3.0 and stuck_dist < 30.0:
			_start_leap()
			return
	
	var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
	velocity = direction * speed
	
	if can_leap and not is_leaping:
		var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
		if dist < leap_distance and dist > 5.0:
			_start_leap()
	
	if global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position) < 2.5:
		current_state = State.ATTACK


func _start_leap():
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		return
	
	# "Chimera: прыгаю!"  # (лог отключён)
	is_leaping = true
	can_leap = false
	leap_target = target_stalker.global_position
	leap_time = 0.0
	
	# КИНЕМАТИЧЕСКИЙ прыжок на попадание: позиция - функция времени.
	# Низкая дуга: T короткий, пик = g*T^2/8; посадка ровно на цель в момент T.
	var to_target = leap_target - global_position
	var flat_dist = Vector2(to_target.x, to_target.z).length()
	_leap_t_total = max(flat_dist / (speed * 2.0), 0.35)
	_leap_from = global_position
	_leap_vx = to_target.x / _leap_t_total
	_leap_vz = to_target.z / _leap_t_total
	_leap_vy = (to_target.y - global_position.y) / _leap_t_total + 0.5 * gravity * _leap_t_total
	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	
	leap_timer.start()


func _handle_leap(delta):
	leap_time += delta
	var t = min(leap_time, _leap_t_total)
	
	# Кинематика параболы - физика в полёте не участвует,
	# траекторию никто не перезапишет:
	# x(t) = x0 + vx*t; y(t) = y0 + vy0*t - g*t^2/2
	var pos = _leap_from
	pos.x += _leap_vx * t
	pos.z += _leap_vz * t
	pos.y += _leap_vy * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t
	global_position = pos
	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	
	# Нос по дуге: вверх на взлёте, вниз на падении
	var model := get_node_or_null("Model")
	if model:
		var vy: float = _leap_vy - gravity * t
		model.rotation.x = clampf(vy * 0.05, -0.35, 0.35)
	
	if leap_time >= _leap_t_total:
		global_position.y = max(global_position.y, leap_target.y)
		_land()


func _land():
	# "Chimera: приземлился!"  # (лог отключён)
	is_leaping = false
	
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	for stalker in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(stalker):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
			if dist < 5.0:
				stalker.take_damage(leap_damage, self)
				attacked_stalker.emit(stalker)
	
	_find_new_target()


func _on_leap_cooldown_ended():
	can_leap = true


func _attack(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
	if dist > 3.0:
		current_state = State.CHASE
		return
	
	if attack_timer.is_stopped():
		target_stalker.take_damage(damage, self)
		
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.3).timeout
		if is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
			target_stalker.take_damage(secondary_head_damage, self)
			attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)
		
		attack_timer.start()
		# "Chimera атакует!"  # (лог отключён)


func _setup_label():
	var label = Label3D.new()
	label.name = "MutantLabel"
	label.position = Vector3(0, 3.5, 0)  # Выше, потому что химера большая
	label.font_size = 28
	label.outline_size = 2
	label.outline_modulate = Color.BLACK
	label.modulate = Color(0.8, 0.2, 0.8)  # фиолетовый
	label.text = "🦎 ХИМЕРА"
	add_child(label)

# ==================== ГАЛОП ПО КОСТЯМ (rig, кости захардкожены) ====================

var _skeleton: Skeleton3D
var _leg_roots: Array = []
var _wing_roots: Array = []
var _head_root: int = -1
var _rest_rot: Dictionary = {}
var _gallop_phase: float = 0.0
# Длина цикла шага в метрах: частота галопа = скорость / STRIDE,
# лапы не скользят относительно земли
const GALLOP_STRIDE: float = 2.2


func _setup_gallop():
	var model := get_node_or_null("Model")
	if model == null:
		return
	# chimera_rig_anim.glb (задача помощника) несёт СВОИ клипы через
	# AnimationPlayer - процедурный галоп пишет в те же кости и ломает позу
	# ("бег на двух ногах"). Есть клипы - процедурник полностью отключён,
	# анимацию ведёт базовый клип-плеер (idle/walk/gallop/attack/death)
	if model.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false).size() > 0:
		disable_body_bob = true  # клип галопа качает корпус сам, боб задвоит
		return
	var skels = model.find_children("*", "Skeleton3D", true, false)
	if skels.is_empty():
		return
	_skeleton = skels[0]
	disable_body_bob = true  # галоп качает кости сам
	# Ноги захардкожены по анатомии рига (автопоиск путал плечи с лапами):
	# 16=Bone_045 зад-лево, 54=Bone_018 перед-право, 30=Bone_051 зад-право, 60=Bone_024 перед-лево
	_leg_roots = [
		{"bone": 16, "phase": 0.0},
		{"bone": 54, "phase": 0.0},
		{"bone": 30, "phase": PI},
		{"bone": 60, "phase": PI},
	]
	# Крылья: задние верхние концевые цепочки -> корень у развилки
	var bone_count := _skeleton.get_bone_count()
	var kids := {}
	for j in range(bone_count):
		var par := _skeleton.get_bone_parent(j)
		if par >= 0:
			kids[par] = int(kids.get(par, 0)) + 1
	var wing_roots := {}
	for l in range(bone_count):
		if int(kids.get(l, 0)) != 0:
			continue
		var gp: Vector3 = _skeleton.get_bone_global_rest(l).origin
		if gp.y > 0.6 and gp.z > 0.4:
			var b := l
			var guard := 0
			while b >= 0 and guard < 14:
				var par2 := _skeleton.get_bone_parent(b)
				if par2 < 0:
					break
				if int(kids.get(par2, 0)) > 2 and b != l:
					break
				b = par2
				guard += 1
			wing_roots[b] = true
	var wi := 0.0
	for b in wing_roots:
		_wing_roots.append({"bone": b, "phase": wi})
		wi += 1.3
	for entry in _leg_roots + _wing_roots:
		var b: int = int(entry["bone"])
		_rest_rot[b] = _skeleton.get_bone_pose_rotation(b)


func _update_gallop(delta: float):
	"""Частота шага = скорость / длину цикла: лапы не скользят"""
	if _skeleton == null:
		return
	var move_speed := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length()
	var gait: float = clampf(move_speed / 6.0, 0.0, 1.4)
	_gallop_phase += delta * (move_speed / GALLOP_STRIDE) * TAU
	for entry in _leg_roots:
		var b: int = int(entry["bone"])
		var swing: float = sin(_gallop_phase + float(entry["phase"])) * 0.45 * gait
		_skeleton.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, _rest_rot[b] * Quaternion(Vector3(1, 0, 0), swing))
	for entry in _wing_roots:
		var b: int = int(entry["bone"])
		var flap: float = sin(_gallop_phase * 0.5 + float(entry["phase"])) * (0.22 + 0.18 * gait)
		_skeleton.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, _rest_rot[b] * Quaternion(Vector3(0, 0, 1), flap))

uid://dpxbb2vc42yvu

# entities/mutants/controller_mutant.gd
extends BaseMutant
class_name ControllerMutant

@export var control_range: float = 15.0
@export var control_duration: float = 5.0
@export var control_cooldown: float = 10.0

var control_timer: Timer
var is_controlling: bool = false
var controlled_stalker: Node3D = null
var can_control: bool = true

func _ready():
	health = 80.0
	max_health = 80.0
	speed = 4.0
	damage = 0.0
	armor = 10.0
	biomass_cost = 100.0
	mutant_type = "controller"
	
	# Целевая высота модели: нормализация по AABB в base_mutant
	model_target_height = 1.8
	super._ready()
	
	control_timer = Timer.new()
	control_timer.one_shot = true
	control_timer.timeout.connect(_on_control_ended)
	add_child(control_timer)
	
	_setup_label()
	# "Controller mutant initialized"  # (лог отключён)


func _physics_process(delta):
	if current_state == State.DEAD:
		return
	
	if is_controlling:
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		move_and_slide()
		return
	
	super._physics_process(delta)


func _patrol(delta):
	# Перф (v0.23.1): скан целей не каждый физ-кадр
	if not _target_scan_tick(delta):
		super._patrol(delta)
		return
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	var nearest_stalker = null
	var nearest_dist = INF
	
	for stalker in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(stalker):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
			if dist < detection_radius and dist < nearest_dist:
				nearest_dist = dist
				nearest_stalker = stalker
	
	if nearest_stalker:
		target_stalker = nearest_stalker
		current_state = State.CHASE
	
	super._patrol(delta)


func _chase(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
	velocity = direction * speed
	
	if can_control and not is_controlling:
		var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
		if dist < control_range:
			_try_control()
	
	if global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position) < 2.0:
		current_state = State.ATTACK


func _try_control():
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		return
	
	# "Controller пытается взять контроль!"  # (лог отключён)
	is_controlling = true
	can_control = false
	controlled_stalker = target_stalker
	current_state = State.ATTACK
	
	_apply_control_effect(target_stalker)
	
	control_timer.wait_time = control_duration
	control_timer.start()


func _apply_control_effect(stalker: Node3D):
	if stalker.has_method("set_controlled"):
		stalker.set_controlled(true, self)
		# "Controller взял под контроль!"  # (лог отключён)


func _on_control_ended():
	if is_instance_valid(controlled_stalker) and controlled_stalker.has_method("set_controlled"):
		controlled_stalker.set_controlled(false, self)
		# "Controller отпустил контроль"  # (лог отключён)
	
	is_controlling = false
	controlled_stalker = null
	
	await get_tree().create_timer(control_cooldown).timeout
	can_control = true
	
	if is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.CHASE
	else:
		current_state = State.PATROL


func _attack(_delta):
	if is_controlling:
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		return
	
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
	if dist > 2.0:
		current_state = State.CHASE
		return
	
	if can_control and not is_controlling and control_timer.is_stopped():
		_try_control()


func take_damage(dmg: float, source = null):
	if is_controlling and randf() < 0.3:
		# "Контроль прерван уроном!"  # (лог отключён)
		control_timer.stop()
		_on_control_ended()
	
	super.take_damage(dmg, source)


func _setup_label():
	var label = Label3D.new()
	label.name = "MutantLabel"
	label.position = Vector3(0, 2.8, 0)
	label.font_size = 24
	label.outline_size = 2
	label.outline_modulate = Color.BLACK
	label.modulate = Color(0.8, 0.4, 1.0)  # сиреневый
	label.text = "🧙 КОНТРОЛЛЕР"
	add_child(label)

# entities/mutants/dog_mutant.gd
extends BaseMutant
class_name DogMutant

@export var pack_bonus: float = 1.2
@export var dodge_chance: float = 0.3

func _ready():
	health = 50.0
	max_health = 50.0
	speed = 8.0
	damage = 8.0
	armor = 0.0
	biomass_cost = 30.0
	mutant_type = "dog"
	
	# Целевая высота модели: нормализация по AABB в base_mutant
	model_target_height = 0.9
	super._ready()
	
	_setup_label()
	# "Dog mutant initialized"  # (лог отключён)


func _physics_process(delta):
	if current_state == State.DEAD:
		return
	
	var nearby_dogs = _count_nearby_dogs()
	if nearby_dogs > 0:
		var original_speed = speed
		speed = original_speed * (1.0 + (nearby_dogs * 0.1))
		super._physics_process(delta)
		speed = original_speed
	else:
		super._physics_process(delta)


func _count_nearby_dogs() -> int:
	var count = 0
	var mutants = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("mutants")
	
	for mutant in mutants:
		if mutant == self:
			continue
		if mutant is DogMutant and global_position.distance_to(mutant.global_position) < 10.0:
			count += 1
	
	return count


func _patrol(delta):
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	var nearest_stalker = null
	var nearest_dist = INF
	
	for stalker in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(stalker):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
			if dist < detection_radius and dist < nearest_dist:
				nearest_dist = dist
				nearest_stalker = stalker
	
	if nearest_stalker:
		target_stalker = nearest_stalker
		current_state = State.CHASE
	
	super._patrol(delta)


func _chase(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
	velocity = direction * speed
	
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
	if dist < 2.0:
		current_state = State.ATTACK


func _attack(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
	if dist > 2.0:
		current_state = State.CHASE
		return
	
	if attack_timer.is_stopped():
		target_stalker.take_damage(damage, self)
		attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)
		attack_timer.start()
		# "DogMutant атакует!"  # (лог отключён)


func take_damage(dmg: float, source = null):
	if randf() < dodge_chance:
		# "DogMutant уклонился!"  # (лог отключён)
		return
	
	super.take_damage(dmg, source)


func _setup_label():
	var label = Label3D.new()
	label.name = "MutantLabel"
	label.position = Vector3(0, 2.5, 0)
	label.font_size = 24
	label.outline_size = 2
	label.outline_modulate = Color.BLACK
	label.modulate = Color(1, 0.8, 0.4)  # светло-оранжевый
	label.text = "🐕 СОБАКА"
	add_child(label)

# entities/mutants/flesh.gd
extends BaseMutant
class_name FleshMutant

@export var aggression_threshold: float = 30.0
@export var charge_speed: float = 15.0
@export var charge_damage: float = 35.0
@export var charge_cooldown: float = 5.0

var accumulated_damage: float = 0.0
var can_charge: bool = true
var is_charging: bool = false
var charge_target: Vector3
var charge_timer: Timer

func _ready():
	health = 200.0
	max_health = 200.0
	speed = 6.0
	damage = 15.0
	armor = 20.0
	biomass_cost = 60.0
	mutant_type = "flesh"
	
	# Целевая высота модели: нормализация по AABB в base_mutant
	model_target_height = 1.6
	super._ready()
	
	charge_timer = Timer.new()
	charge_timer.one_shot = true
	charge_timer.wait_time = charge_cooldown
	charge_timer.timeout.connect(_on_charge_cooldown_ended)
	add_child(charge_timer)
	
	_setup_label()
	# "Flesh mutant initialized"  # (лог отключён)


func _physics_process(delta):
	if current_state == State.DEAD:
		return
	
	if is_charging:
		_handle_charge(delta)
		return
	
	super._physics_process(delta)


func _patrol(delta):
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	var nearest_stalker = null
	var nearest_dist = INF
	
	for stalker in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(stalker):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
			if dist < detection_radius and dist < nearest_dist:
				nearest_dist = dist
				nearest_stalker = stalker
	
	if nearest_stalker:
		target_stalker = nearest_stalker
		current_state = State.CHASE
		accumulated_damage = 0.0
		# "Flesh стал агрессивным!"  # (лог отключён)
	
	super._patrol(delta)


func _chase(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var direction = (target_stalker.global_position - global_position).normalized()
	velocity = direction * speed
	
	if can_charge and not is_charging:
		var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
		if dist < 10.0 and dist > 4.0:
			_start_charge()
	
	if global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position) < 2.0:
		current_state = State.ATTACK


func _start_charge():
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		return
	
	# "Flesh начинает таран!"  # (лог отключён)
	is_charging = true
	can_charge = false
	charge_target = target_stalker.global_position
	
	charge_timer.start()


func _handle_charge(_delta):
	if is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		charge_target = target_stalker.global_position
	
	var direction = (charge_target - global_position).normalized()
	velocity = direction * charge_speed
	velocity.y = 0
	
	move_and_slide()
	
	if is_on_wall() or global_position.distance_to(charge_target) < 2.0:
		_end_charge()


func _end_charge():
	# "Flesh закончил таран!"  # (лог отключён)
	is_charging = false
	
	var stalkers = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("stalkers")
	for stalker in stalkers:
		if is_instance_valid(stalker):
			var dist = global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position)
			if dist < 4.0:
				stalker.take_damage(charge_damage, self)
				attacked_stalker.emit(stalker)
				# "Flesh нанёс урон тараном!"  # (лог отключён)
	
	if is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.CHASE
	else:
		current_state = State.PATROL


func _on_charge_cooldown_ended():
	can_charge = true


func _attack(_delta):
	if not target_stalker or not is_instance_valid(target_stalker):
		current_state = State.PATROL
		return
	
	var dist = global_position.distance_to(target_stalker.global_position)
	if dist > 2.0:
		current_state = State.CHASE
		return
	
	if attack_timer.is_stopped():
		target_stalker.take_damage(damage, self)
		attacked_stalker.emit(target_stalker)
		attack_timer.start()
		# "Flesh атакует!"  # (лог отключён)


func take_damage(dmg: float, source = null):
	accumulated_damage += dmg
	
	if accumulated_damage > aggression_threshold and current_state == State.PATROL:
		current_state = State.CHASE
		accumulated_damage = 0.0
		# "Flesh разъярен!"  # (лог отключён)
	
	super.take_damage(dmg, source)


func _setup_label():
	var label = Label3D.new()
	label.name = "MutantLabel"
	label.position = Vector3(0, 2.8, 0)  # Выше, потому что плоть крупная
	label.font_size = 24
	label.outline_size = 2
	label.outline_modulate = Color.BLACK
	label.modulate = Color(0.9, 0.5, 0.5)  # розовый
	label.text = "🐗 ПЛОТЬ"
	add_child(label)
