# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Общий фреймворк сборки боссов ОХОТЫ: процедурные части + риг + 4 клипа.
# Части жёстко привязаны к костям (vertex group = кость) — без weight paint.
import bpy
import math
from mathutils import Quaternion, Vector

FPS = 30


def new_scene():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    return bpy.context.scene


def make_armature(name, bones):
    """bones: [(name, parent|None, head(x,y,z), tail(x,y,z))]."""
    ad = bpy.data.armatures.new(name)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, ad)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
    eb = ad.edit_bones
    created = {}
    for name, parent, head, tail in bones:
        b = eb.new(name)
        b.head = head
        b.tail = tail
        if parent:
            b.parent = created[parent]
        created[name] = b
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
    return obj


def mat_simple(name, color, emission=None, estrength=1.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m:
        return m
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.8
    if emission:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission, 1.0)
        b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = estrength
    return m


def add_part(name, kind, size, loc, mat, bone, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    """Примитив-часть, все вершины в группу кости, арматурный модификатор."""
    if kind == 'box':
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    elif kind == 'cone':
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=6, radius1=size[0], radius2=size[1],
                                        depth=size[2], location=loc)
    elif kind == 'sphere':
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=8, ring_count=6, radius=size, location=loc)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = name
    obj.scale = size if kind == 'box' else (1, 1, 1)
    obj.rotation_euler = rot
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    vg = obj.vertex_groups.new(name=bone)
    vg.add(list(range(len(obj.data.vertices))), 1.0, 'REPLACE')
    return obj


def bind_parts(parts, arm):
    for p in parts:
        mod = p.modifiers.new("Arm", 'ARMATURE')
        mod.object = arm
        p.parent = arm


# ---- анимация ----

class Anim:
    def __init__(self, arm, mw=None):
        self.arm = arm
        self.mw = mw or arm.matrix_world
        if arm.animation_data is None:
            arm.animation_data_create()

    AXIS = {'X': (1, 0, 0), 'Y': (0, 1, 0), 'Z': (0, 0, 1)}

    def wq(self, bone, axis, deg):
        pb = self.arm.pose.bones[bone]
        rest_w = self.mw @ pb.bone.matrix_local
        axis_vec = self.AXIS.get(axis, axis)
        q_world = Quaternion(Vector(axis_vec).normalized(), math.radians(deg))
        rq = rest_w.to_quaternion()
        return rq.inverted() @ q_world @ rq

    def reset(self):
        for pb in self.arm.pose.bones:
            pb.rotation_quaternion = (1, 0, 0, 0)
            pb.location = (0, 0, 0)

    def action(self, name):
        act = bpy.data.actions.new(name)
        act.use_fake_user = True
        self.arm.animation_data.action = act
        while len(self.arm.animation_data.nla_tracks) > 0:
            self.arm.animation_data.nla_tracks.remove(self.arm.animation_data.nla_tracks[0])
        return act

    def pose(self, f, spec):
        """spec: {bone: [(axis, deg, phase_offset)...] или ('move', (dx,dy,dz))}"""
        sc = bpy.context.scene
        sc.frame_set(f)
        for bone, moves in spec.items():
            q = Quaternion((1, 0, 0, 0))
            move = None
            for mv in moves:
                if mv[0] == 'move':
                    move = mv[1]
                    continue
                axis, deg = mv[0], mv[1] + (mv[2] if len(mv) > 2 else 0.0) * 0.0
                q = self.wq(bone, axis, deg) @ q
            pb = self.arm.pose.bones[bone]
            pb.rotation_quaternion = q
            pb.keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=f)
            if move:
                rest_w = self.mw @ pb.bone.matrix_local
                m = rest_w.to_quaternion().inverted().to_matrix() @ Vector(move)
                pb.location = pb.location + m
                pb.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)


def light_and_cam(sc, center, dist, out_w=560, out_h=560):
    sc.render.engine = 'BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
    sc.display.shading.color_type = 'MATERIAL'
    sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = out_w, out_h
    cam = bpy.data.objects.new("VCam", bpy.data.cameras.new("VCam"))
    sc.collection.objects.link(cam)
    cam.location = Vector(center) + Vector((dist[0], dist[1], dist[2]))
    dir_v = Vector(center) - cam.location
    cam.rotation_euler = dir_v.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    sc.camera = cam
    sun = bpy.data.objects.new("Sun", bpy.data.lights.new("Sun", 'SUN'))
    sun.data.energy = 3.0
    sun.rotation_euler = (0.9, 0.2, 0.6)
    sc.collection.objects.link(sun)
    return cam


def render_clips(out_dir, arm, clips, center, cam_dist, prefix=""):
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    light_and_cam(sc, center, cam_dist)
    for cname, (f0, f1) in clips.items():
        act = bpy.data.actions.get(cname)
        if not act:
            continue
        if arm.animation_data.action_slot is None and len(act.slots):
            arm.animation_data.action_slot = act.slots[0]
        arm.animation_data.action = act
        sc.frame_set(int((f0 + f1) / 2))
        sc.render.filepath = rf"{out_dir}\{prefix}check_{cname}.png"
        bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
        print('  rendered', cname)


def export_glb(path, arm):
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    sc.frame_set(1)
    bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=path, export_format='GLB',
                              export_animation_mode='ACTIONS', export_animations=True,
                              export_apply=False)
    print('  EXPORT OK', path.split('\\')[-1])

# ================= ТУМАННИЦА (4 м, парящая в саване) =================
def tumannitsa():
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 2.6), (0, 0, 3.0)),
        ('body', 'root', (0, 0, 2.2), (0, 0, 1.0)),
        ('veil', 'body', (0, 0, 1.4), (0, 0, 0.2)),
        ('armL', 'body', (-0.55, 0, 2.6), (-1.0, -0.15, 1.7)),
        ('armR', 'body', (0.55, 0, 2.6), (1.0, -0.15, 1.7)),
        ('handL', 'armL', (-1.0, -0.15, 1.7), (-1.25, -0.2, 1.1)),
        ('handR', 'armR', (1.0, -0.15, 1.7), (1.25, -0.2, 1.1)),
        ('head', 'root', (0, 0, 3.05), (0, 0, 3.75)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('TumannitsaArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    veil = mat_simple('veil', (0.75, 0.78, 0.85), (0.45, 0.55, 0.75), 1.2)
    dark = mat_simple('shade', (0.25, 0.28, 0.35))
    eye = mat_simple('eyes', (0.1, 0.1, 0.12), (0.7, 0.9, 1.0), 2.5)
    # саван: конус + внутренний тёмный слой
    P(parts, 'veil_outer', 'cone', (1.15, 0.25, 3.0), (0, 0, 1.35), veil, 'veil')
    P(parts, 'veil_inner', 'cone', (0.8, 0.15, 2.4), (0, 0, 1.5), dark, 'veil')
    # капюшон/голова
    P(parts, 'hood', 'sphere', 0.55, (0, 0, 3.35), veil, 'head')
    P(parts, 'face', 'sphere', 0.34, (0, -0.18, 3.3), dark, 'head')
    for dx in (-0.14, 0.14):  # глаза-точки
        P(parts, f'eye_{dx}', 'sphere', 0.05, (dx, -0.42, 3.36), eye, 'head')
    # руки-рукава
    for sx, up, hand in ((-1, 'armL', 'handL'), (1, 'armR', 'handR')):
        P(parts, f'sleeve_{sx}', 'cone', (0.28, 0.1, 1.3), (sx * 0.75, -0.05, 2.15), veil, up,
          rot=(math.radians(-25 * sx), 0, 0))
        P(parts, f'hand_{sx}', 'sphere', 0.16, (sx * 1.12, -0.18, 1.4), eye, hand)
    bind_parts(parts, arm)
    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    # idle: парение + колыхание савана
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.14 * math.sin(t)), ), ('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
            'veil': [('Y', math.sin(t * 0.7) * 5.0)],
            'armL': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 6.0)], 'armR': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 6.0)],
            'head': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.8) * 3.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    # walk = дрейф вперёд-назад (стоит на месте по лору)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 6):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, -0.5 * math.sin(t), 0.12 * math.sin(t * 2)))],
            'veil': [('Y', math.sin(t * 1.4) * 7.0)],
            'armL': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 9.0)], 'armR': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 9.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    # attack: руки вскинулись, саван вспыхнул рывком
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'armL': [('Z', k * -40.0), ('X', k * -25.0)],
            'armR': [('Z', k * 40.0), ('X', k * -25.0)],
            'handL': [('X', k * -15.0)], 'handR': [('X', k * -15.0)],
            'head': [('X', k * -12.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.5, k * 0.2))],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    # death: оседание + растворение (усадка и наклон)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 32.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, -1.6 * t)), ('Z', 25.0 * t)],
            'veil': [('X', 18.0 * t)],
            'armL': [('Z', 50.0 * t)], 'armR': [('Z', -50.0 * t)],
            'head': [('X', -25.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'tumannitsa_anim.glb'), arm)
    render_clips(OUT, arm, clips, center=(0, 0, 2.0), cam_dist=(3.2, -4.6, 1.6), prefix='tum_')
    print('TUMANNITSA DONE')


# ================= ПОЖИРАТЕЛЬ (3.5 м пятиногая пасть-бочка) =================
def pozhiratel():
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 2.3), (0, 0, 2.9)),
        ('maw', 'root', (0, 0, 2.5), (0, 0, 3.1)),
        ('jaw_top', 'maw', (0, -0.5, 3.0), (0, -1.1, 2.9)),
        # 5 ног по кругу
        ('leg1', 'root', (1.2, 0.0, 1.5), (1.7, 0.0, 0.4)),
        ('leg2', 'root', (0.37, 1.14, 1.5), (0.53, 1.63, 0.4)),
        ('leg3', 'root', (-0.97, 0.71, 1.5), (-1.37, 1.02, 0.4)),
        ('leg4', 'root', (-0.97, -0.71, 1.5), (-1.37, -1.02, 0.4)),
        ('leg5', 'root', (0.37, -1.14, 1.5), (0.53, -1.63, 0.4)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('PozhiratelArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    hide = mat_simple('hide', (0.45, 0.28, 0.18))
    hide2 = mat_simple('hide2', (0.36, 0.22, 0.15))
    maw = mat_simple('maw', (0.16, 0.05, 0.04), (0.8, 0.15, 0.1), 0.9)
    tooth = mat_simple('tooth', (0.92, 0.88, 0.75))
    # бочка-туловище
    P(parts, 'barrel', 'sphere', 1.25, (0, 0, 2.1), hide, 'root')
    P(parts, 'barrel_top', 'sphere', 0.95, (0, -0.2, 2.75), hide2, 'maw')
    # пасть: верхняя челюсть-крышка + зубы по кругу
    P(parts, 'jawtop', 'sphere', 0.78, (0, -0.35, 3.05), hide2, 'jaw_top')
    for i in range(8):
        a = math.tau * i / 8
        P(parts, f'tooth_{i}', 'cone', (0.09, 0.02, 0.3),
          (math.cos(a) * 0.62, -0.35 + math.sin(a) * 0.62, 2.55), tooth, 'jaw_top',
          rot=(0, 0, -a))
    # глазки-бугорки вокруг
    for i in range(5):
        a = math.tau * i / 5 + 0.5
        P(parts, f'eye_{i}', 'sphere', 0.11, (math.cos(a) * 1.05, -0.15 + math.sin(a) * 1.05, 3.0),
          tooth, 'maw')
    # 5 ног: бедро + ступня
    for i, leg in enumerate(('leg1', 'leg2', 'leg3', 'leg4', 'leg5')):
        a = math.tau * i / 5
        hx, hy = math.cos(a) * 1.2, math.sin(a) * 1.2
        fx, fy = math.cos(a) * 1.7, math.sin(a) * 1.7
        P(parts, f'thigh_{i}', 'cone', (0.34, 0.2, 1.4), (hx, hy, 1.15), hide2, leg,
          rot=(math.radians(-70), 0, -a + math.pi / 2))
        P(parts, f'foot_{i}', 'sphere', 0.3, (fx, fy, 0.22), hide, leg)
    bind_parts(parts, arm)
    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    # idle: пасть дышит, бочка колышется
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.08 * math.sin(t)))],
            'jaw_top': [('X', -8.0 + math.sin(t) * 7.0)],
            'maw': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    # walk: впялить шаг — ноги по очереди
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        spec = {'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.06 * abs(math.sin(t * 2.5))))]}
        for i, leg in enumerate(('leg1', 'leg2', 'leg3', 'leg4', 'leg5')):
            a = math.tau * i / 5
            spec[leg] = [('X', math.sin(t + a) * 14.0)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    # attack: пасть раскрывается широко + рывок вперёд
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'jaw_top': [('X', k * -38.0)],
            'maw': [('X', k * 8.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.7, k * 0.1))],
            'leg1': [('X', k * -12.0)], 'leg2': [('X', k * -6.0)], 'leg5': [('X', k * -6.0)],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    # death: ноги подкашиваются, бочка опрокидывается
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        spec = {'root': [('move', (0, 0.3 * t, -0.9 * t)), ('Y', 55.0 * t)]}
        for i, leg in enumerate(('leg1', 'leg2', 'leg3', 'leg4', 'leg5')):
            spec[leg] = [('X', 30.0 * t)]
        spec['maw'] = [('X', 12.0 * t)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'pozhiratel_anim.glb'), arm)
    render_clips(OUT, arm, clips, center=(0, 0, 1.9), cam_dist=(3.6, -5.2, 1.8), prefix='poz_')
    print('POZHIRATEL DONE')


# ================= СТОЛП ГРОЗЫ (6 м тотем на дугах-ногах) =================
def stolp():
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 3.1), (0, 0, 3.9)),
        ('totem', 'root', (0, 0, 3.9), (0, 0, 5.4)),
        ('crown', 'totem', (0, 0, 5.4), (0, 0, 6.1)),
        ('legL', 'root', (-1.1, 0, 2.6), (-1.8, 0, 0.9)),
        ('footL', 'legL', (-1.8, 0, 0.9), (-2.0, 0, 0.1)),
        ('legR', 'root', (1.1, 0, 2.6), (1.8, 0, 0.9)),
        ('footR', 'legR', (1.8, 0, 0.9), (2.0, 0, 0.1)),
        ('legB', 'root', (0, 0.9, 2.6), (0, 1.6, 0.9)),
        ('footB', 'legB', (0, 1.6, 0.9), (0, 1.85, 0.1)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('StolpArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    stone = mat_simple('stone', (0.22, 0.24, 0.3))
    stone2 = mat_simple('stone2', (0.16, 0.18, 0.24))
    glyph = mat_simple('glyph', (0.5, 0.5, 0.6), (0.45, 0.65, 1.0), 2.6)
    arc = mat_simple('arc', (0.3, 0.34, 0.42))
    # тотем: ярусы
    tiers = [(0, 3.1, 1.15, 1.0), (1.05, 3.9, 0.95, 0.9), (2.0, 4.6, 0.8, 0.8), (2.85, 5.3, 0.62, 0.75)]
    for i, (y, h, r1, r2) in enumerate(tiers):
        P(parts, f'tier_{i}', 'cone', (r1, r2, h), (0, 0, y + h / 2), stone if i % 2 == 0 else stone2, 'totem')
        P(parts, f'glyph_{i}', 'box', (0.1, 0.5, 0.5), (r1 * 0.92, 0, y + h / 2), glyph, 'totem')
    # корона: 4 зубца
    for i in range(4):
        a = math.tau * i / 4
        P(parts, f'crown_{i}', 'cone', (0.12, 0.02, 0.8),
          (math.cos(a) * 0.3, math.sin(a) * 0.3, 5.75), glyph, 'crown',
          rot=(0.35 * math.sin(a), -0.35 * math.cos(a), 0))
    # лицевая щель с эмиссией
    P(parts, 'face', 'box', (0.16, 0.34, 0.6), (0.68, 0, 4.7), glyph, 'totem')
    # дуги-ноги (3 штуки): сегменты
    for tag, leg, foot in (('L', 'legL', 'footL'), ('R', 'legR', 'footR'), ('B', 'legB', 'footB')):
        P(parts, f'arc_{tag}_a', 'box', (0.3, 0.3, 1.9), (1.45, 0, 1.75) if tag != 'B' else (0, 1.45, 1.75),
          arc, leg, rot=(math.radians(-18) if tag != 'B' else math.radians(-18), math.radians(18) if tag == 'L' else (-math.radians(18) if tag == 'R' else 0), 0))
        P(parts, f'arc_{tag}_b', 'box', (0.26, 0.26, 1.1), (1.8, 0, 0.55) if tag != 'B' else (0, 1.75, 0.55),
          stone2, foot, rot=(math.radians(-30), 0, 0) if tag != 'B' else (math.radians(-30), 0, 0))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)
    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.1 * math.sin(t)))],
            'totem': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
            'crown': [('Z', math.sin(t + 0.8) * 5.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'legL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 8.0)], 'legR': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 8.0)],
            'legB': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi / 2) * 8.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.06 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
            'totem': [('Y', math.sin(t) * 2.5)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (8, -1.0), (18, 1.0), (30, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'totem': [('X', k * -6.0)],
            'crown': [('Z', k * 14.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.4, k * 0.25))],
            'legL': [('X', k * -8.0)], 'legR': [('X', k * -8.0)], 'legB': [('X', k * -8.0)],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 30)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0.4 * t, -2.2 * t)), ('Y', 45.0 * t)],
            'legL': [('X', 20.0 * t)], 'legR': [('X', -20.0 * t)], 'legB': [('X', 20.0 * t)],
            'crown': [('Z', 30.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'stolp_anim.glb'), arm)
    render_clips(OUT, arm, clips, center=(0, 0, 3.2), cam_dist=(5.0, -7.4, 2.8), prefix='sto_')

# ================= ХРОМЕЦ (2.5 м тощий двуногий бегун) =================
def hromets():
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 1.5), (0, 0, 1.75)),
        ('spine', 'root', (0, 0, 1.55), (0.12, 0, 2.05)),
        ('neck', 'spine', (0.12, 0, 2.05), (0.3, 0, 2.25)),
        ('head', 'neck', (0.3, 0, 2.25), (0.5, 0, 2.3)),
        ('jawL', 'head', (0.42, 0.08, 2.2), (0.58, 0.1, 2.14)),
        ('jawR', 'head', (0.42, -0.08, 2.2), (0.58, -0.1, 2.14)),
        ('armBig', 'spine', (-0.05, -0.3, 1.7), (-0.75, -0.55, 1.25)),
        ('clawBig', 'armBig', (-0.75, -0.55, 1.25), (-1.05, -0.7, 0.85)),

    arm = make_armature('HrometsArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    skin = mat_simple('skin', (0.5, 0.42, 0.3))
    skin2 = mat_simple('skin2', (0.4, 0.34, 0.24))
    clawm = mat_simple('claw', (0.85, 0.82, 0.72))
    eye = mat_simple('eye', (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), (1.0, 0.5, 0.2), 2.2)
    P(parts, 'torso', 'box', (0.4, 0.5, 0.7), (0.05, 0, 1.7), skin, 'root')
    P(parts, 'chest2', 'box', (0.3, 0.4, 0.5), (0.1, 0, 2.0), skin2, 'spine')
    P(parts, 'neck_b', 'box', (0.16, 0.16, 0.5), (0.2, 0, 2.15), skin2, 'neck',
      rot=(0, math.radians(-24), 0))
    P(parts, 'head', 'box', (0.34, 0.28, 0.24), (0.42, 0, 2.26), skin, 'head')
    for tag in ('jawL', 'jawR'):

        P(parts, f'eye_{dx}', 'sphere', 0.045, (0.52, dx, 2.3), eye, 'head')
    # асимметрия: большая рука-коса и рудимент
    P(parts, 'arm_big', 'box', (0.22, 0.22, 1.15), (-0.4, -0.42, 1.5), skin, 'armBig',

    P(parts, 'claw_big', 'cone', (0.12, 0.02, 0.75), (-0.9, -0.62, 1.05), clawm, 'clawBig',
      rot=(0, math.radians(-35), math.radians(20)))
    P(parts, 'arm_small', 'box', (0.13, 0.13, 0.62), (0.33, 0.38, 1.5), skin2, 'armSm',
      rot=(0, math.radians(-14), 0))
    # двуногие кривые ноги
    for tag, leg, shin, px, py in (('L', 'legL', 'shinL', -0.32, 0.13), ('R', 'legR', 'shinR', 0.35, -0.03)):
        P(parts, f'thigh_{tag}', 'box', (0.18, 0.2, 0.85), (px, py, 1.15), skin2, leg)
        P(parts, f'sh_{tag}', 'box', (0.12, 0.14, 1.0), (px * 0.9, py * 0.8, 0.5), skin, shin)
        P(parts, f'foot_{tag}', 'box', (0.26, 0.4, 0.14), (px * 0.85, py * 0.6 - 0.1, 0.06), clawm, shin)
    bind_parts(parts, arm)
    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 73, 6):
        t = f / 72 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.02 * math.sin(t * 2)))],
            'neck': [('X', math.sin(t) * 4.0), ('Y', math.sin(t * 0.7) * 6.0)],
            'head': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.7) * 3.0)],
            'armBig': [('X', math.sin(t) * 3.5)],
            'spine': [('Z', math.sin(t * 0.6) * 3.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 72)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 25, 2):   # быстрый семенящий шаг
        t = f / 24 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'legL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 30.0)], 'legR': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 30.0)],
            'shinL': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 2.0)) * 35.0)],
            'shinR': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 2.0 + math.pi)) * 35.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.04 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
            'spine': [('X', 8.0)],
            'armBig': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 10.0)],
            'armSm': [('X', math.sin(t) * 12.0)],
            'neck': [('X', -6.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 24)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (6, -1.0), (13, 1.0), (24, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'armBig': [('X', k * -60.0)],
            'clawBig': [('X', k * -25.0)],
            'spine': [('Y', k * -12.0), ('X', k * -8.0)],
            'head': [('X', k * -10.0)],
            'jawL': [('X', k * -14.0)], 'jawR': [('X', k * -14.0)],
            'legL': [('X', k * -20.0)], 'legR': [('X', k * 12.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.3, k * 0.05))],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 24)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 37, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 26.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0.2 * t, -0.55 * t)), ('Y', 40.0 * t)],
            'legL': [('X', 35.0 * t)], 'legR': [('X', -25.0 * t)],
            'shinL': [('X', -30.0 * t)],
            'neck': [('X', -20.0 * t)], 'head': [('X', -15.0 * t)],
            'armBig': [('Z', 40.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 36)
    export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'hromets_anim.glb'), arm)
    render_clips(OUT, arm, clips, center=(0, 0, 1.2), cam_dist=(2.6, -3.8, 1.3), prefix='hro_')
    print('HROMETS DONE')


# ================= МАТЬ-В-БОЛОТЕ (4 м морда на корневищах) =================
def mat_bolota():
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 2.2), (0, 0, 2.8)),
        ('mound', 'root', (0, 0, 1.7), (0, 0, 0.9)),
        ('maw', 'root', (0, -0.6, 2.0), (0, -1.3, 1.9)),
        ('jaw', 'maw', (0, -1.0, 1.75), (0, -1.7, 1.7)),
        ('rootlegFL', 'root', (-0.9, -0.2, 1.2), (-1.6, -0.5, 0.25)),
        ('rootlegFR', 'root', (0.9, -0.2, 1.2), (1.6, -0.5, 0.25)),
        ('rootlegBL', 'root', (-0.7, 0.5, 1.2), (-1.3, 0.9, 0.25)),
        ('rootlegBR', 'root', (0.7, 0.5, 1.2), (1.3, 0.9, 0.25)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('MatBolotaArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    moss = mat_simple('moss', (0.32, 0.42, 0.22))
    moss2 = mat_simple('moss2', (0.26, 0.34, 0.18))
    mawm = mat_simple('mawm', (0.12, 0.08, 0.05), (0.35, 0.15, 0.05), 0.7)
    glow = mat_simple('glowm', (0.6, 0.75, 0.4), (0.5, 0.75, 0.25), 1.8)
    # курган-тело
    P(parts, 'mound_b', 'sphere', 1.15, (0, 0.45, 1.35), moss, 'mound')
    P(parts, 'mound_t', 'sphere', 0.85, (0, -0.05, 1.85), moss2, 'mound')
    # морда-маска на фронте
    P(parts, 'faceplate', 'sphere', 0.62, (0, -1.0, 2.15), moss2, 'maw')
    P(parts, 'maw_hole', 'sphere', 0.42, (0, -1.35, 1.9), mawm, 'maw')
    for dx in (-0.3, 0.3):  # глаза-щели светятся
        P(parts, f'eye_{dx}', 'box', (0.24, 0.12, 0.1), (dx, -1.45, 2.42), glow, 'maw')
    # гребень
    for i in range(5):
        z = 2.5 + i * 0.16
        P(parts, f'crest_{i}', 'cone', (0.12, 0.02, 0.5 - i * 0.06), (0, 0.1 + i * 0.12, z),
          moss2, 'mound', rot=(math.radians(100), 0, 0))
    # пасть: верхняя губа + зубы
    P(parts, 'lip', 'cone', (0.55, 0.3, 0.5), (0, -1.1, 2.25), moss, 'maw')
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.pi * (0.15 + 0.7 * i / 5)
        P(parts, f'tooth_{i}', 'cone', (0.07, 0.02, 0.24),
          (math.cos(a) * 0.42, -1.28, 1.85 + math.sin(a) * 0.1), moss2, 'jaw')
    # корневища-ноги (4)
    for tag, leg, px, py in (('FL', 'rootlegFL', -1.25, -0.35), ('FR', 'rootlegFR', 1.25, -0.35),
                             ('BL', 'rootlegBL', -1.0, 0.7), ('BR', 'rootlegBR', 1.0, 0.7)):
        P(parts, f'root_{tag}', 'cone', (0.26, 0.12, 1.7), (px, py, 0.8), moss2, leg,
          rot=(math.radians(65), 0, math.atan2(py, px) + math.pi / 2))
        P(parts, f'clawroot_{tag}', 'cone', (0.18, 0.04, 0.5), (px * 1.08, py * 1.08, 0.18),
          moss, leg, rot=(math.radians(80), 0, math.atan2(py, px) + math.pi / 2))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)
    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.09 * math.sin(t)))],
            'mound': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
            'maw': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.5) * 3.0)],
            'jaw': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.7) * 5.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        spec = {'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
                'maw': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)]}
        for i, leg in enumerate(('rootlegFL', 'rootlegFR', 'rootlegBL', 'rootlegBR')):
            spec[leg] = [('X', math.sin(t + i * math.pi / 2) * 10.0),
                         ('Y', math.cos(t + i * math.pi / 2) * 5.0)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'maw': [('X', k * -10.0)],
            'jaw': [('X', k * -24.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.6, k * 0.08))],
            'rootlegFL': [('X', k * -14.0)], 'rootlegFR': [('X', k * -14.0)],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        spec = {'root': [('move', (0, 0.2 * t, -0.9 * t)), ('X', 12.0 * t)],
                'maw': [('X', 15.0 * t)], 'jaw': [('X', 20.0 * t)]}
        for leg in ('rootlegFL', 'rootlegFR', 'rootlegBL', 'rootlegBR'):
            spec[leg] = [('X', 25.0 * t), ('Y', 25.0 * t)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'mat_bolota_anim.glb'), arm)
    render_clips(OUT, arm, clips, center=(0, 0, 1.7), cam_dist=(3.8, -5.6, 1.8), prefix='mat_')
    print('MAT_BOLOTA DONE')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    tumannitsa()
    pozhiratel()
    stolp()
    hromets()
    mat_bolota()
    print('ALL BOSSES DONE')

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Босс 1/6: КОСТОЛОМ — костяной колосс-сборщик 5.5 м, хребты-шипы.
import bpy, math, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, r'E:\StalkerRevert\StalkerRevert\inbox\hunt_boss_models')
from boss_kit import *
import importlib
import boss_kit
importlib.reload(boss_kit)
from boss_kit import *

OUT = r'E:\StalkerRevert\StalkerRevert\inbox\hunt_boss_models'
sc = new_scene()

BONE = (0.86, 0.84, 0.78)
BONE_DK = (0.62, 0.60, 0.54)
MARROW = (0.5, 0.42, 0.3)
EMI = (1.0, 0.85, 0.55)

m_bone = mat_simple('bone', BONE)
m_dk = mat_simple('bone_dark', BONE_DK)
m_marrow = mat_simple('marrow', MARROW, EMI, 1.6)

BONES = [
    ('root', None, (0, 0, 2.6), (0, 0, 3.4)),
    ('spine1', 'root', (0, 0, 3.0), (0, 0, 4.0)),
    ('spine2', 'spine1', (0, 0, 4.0), (0, 0, 4.8)),
    ('chest', 'spine2', (0, 0, 4.8), (0, 0, 5.5)),
    ('head', 'chest', (0, 0, 5.5), (0, 0, 6.2)),
    ('jaw', 'head', (0, 0, 5.7), (0.7, 0, 5.45)),
    # руки
    ('armL', 'chest', (-1.1, 0, 5.2), (-1.9, 0, 4.4)),
    ('foreL', 'armL', (-1.9, 0, 4.4), (-2.5, 0, 3.4)),
    ('clawL', 'foreL', (-2.5, 0, 3.4), (-2.9, 0, 2.6)),
    ('armR', 'chest', (1.1, 0, 5.2), (1.9, 0, 4.4)),
    ('foreR', 'armR', (1.9, 0, 4.4), (2.5, 0, 3.4)),
    ('clawR', 'foreR', (2.5, 0, 3.4), (2.9, 0, 2.6)),
    # ноги
    ('legFL', 'root', (-0.75, 0, 2.5), (-0.95, 0, 1.2)),
    ('shinFL', 'legFL', (-0.95, 0, 1.2), (-1.0, 0, 0.15)),
    ('legFR', 'root', (0.75, 0, 2.5), (0.95, 0, 1.2)),
    ('shinFR', 'legFR', (0.95, 0, 1.2), (1.0, 0, 0.15)),
    ('legBL', 'root', (-0.7, 0, 2.5), (-1.15, 0.55, 1.25)),
    ('shinBL', 'legBL', (-1.15, 0.55, 1.25), (-1.25, 0.75, 0.15)),
    ('legBR', 'root', (0.7, 0, 2.5), (1.15, 0.55, 1.25)),
    ('shinBR', 'legBR', (1.15, 0.55, 1.25), (1.25, 0.75, 0.15)),
]
arm = make_armature('KostolomArm', BONES)

parts = []
P = lambda *a, **kw: parts.append(add_part(*a, **kw))

# торс из позвонков + рёбра
for i, z in enumerate((2.7, 3.3, 3.9, 4.5)):
    P(f'spine_{i}', 'box', (1.5 - i * 0.08, 1.1, 0.55), (0, 0, z), m_bone, 'spine1')
    for sx in (-1, 1):  # рёбра
        P(f'rib_{i}_{sx}', 'box', (0.5, 0.16, 0.4), (sx * (0.9 - i * 0.05), 0, z + 0.18),
          m_bone, 'spine1')
# таз
P('pelvis', 'box', (1.7, 1.2, 0.8), (0, 0, 2.55), m_dk, 'root')
# голова: череп + челюсть + рога
P('skull', 'box', (0.75, 0.9, 0.85), (0, 0, 5.75), m_bone, 'head')
P('jaw', 'box', (0.6, 0.7, 0.28), (0.3, 0, 5.45), m_dk, 'jaw')
for sx in (-1, 1):
    P(f'horn_{sx}', 'cone', (0.14, 0.03, 0.9), (sx * 0.34, 0, 6.35), m_dk, 'head',
      rot=(0.5 * sx, 0, 0.25 * sx))
# глаза-впадины светятся
P('eyeL', 'sphere', 0.09, (-0.22, -0.44, 5.8), m_marrow, 'head')
P('eyeR', 'sphere', 0.09, (0.22, -0.44, 5.8), m_marrow, 'head')
# шипы-хребет по спине
for i in range(6):
    z = 2.5 + i * 0.62
    s = 0.5 - i * 0.04
    P(f'spike_{i}', 'cone', (s * 0.3, 0.03, s), (0, 0.55, z + 0.2), m_dk, 'spine1',
      rot=(math.radians(105), 0, 0))
# руки: плечи-шипы + сегменты + когти
for sx, up, fore, claw in ((-1, 'armL', 'foreL', 'clawL'), (1, 'armR', 'foreR', 'clawR')):
    P(f'shoulder_{sx}', 'sphere', 0.42, (sx * 1.12, 0, 5.1), m_dk, up)
    P(f'upper_{sx}', 'box', (0.55, 0.55, 1.5), (sx * 1.5, 0, 4.75), m_bone, up)
    P(f'fore_{sx}', 'box', (0.45, 0.45, 1.6), (sx * 2.2, 0, 3.85), m_bone, fore)
    for k in range(3):  # когти-пальцы
        P(f'claw_{sx}_{k}', 'cone', (0.1, 0.02, 0.65),
          (sx * 2.55 + k * 0.16 - 0.16, -0.18, 3.0), m_dk, claw, rot=(math.radians(160), 0, 0))
# ноги: бедро/голень/ступня
for tag, leg, shin, px, py in (('FL', 'legFL', 'shinFL', -0.85, -0.1),
                               ('FR', 'legFR', 'shinFR', 0.85, -0.1),
                               ('BL', 'legBL', 'shinBL', -1.1, 0.6),
                               ('BR', 'legBR', 'shinBR', 1.1, 0.6)):
    P(f'thigh_{tag}', 'box', (0.62, 0.62, 1.7), (px, py, 1.85), m_bone, leg)
    P(f'sh_{tag}', 'box', (0.45, 0.45, 1.35), (px * 1.05, py * 1.15, 0.65), m_dk, shin)
    P(f'foot_{tag}', 'box', (0.72, 1.0, 0.3), (px * 1.05, py * 1.1 - 0.1, 0.12), m_bone, shin)

bind_parts(parts, arm)

# ================= клипы =================
an = Anim(arm)
CLIPS = {}

# idle: дыхание, хребет шевелится, челюсть клацает редко
an.reset()
act = an.action('idle')
for f in range(1, 97, 8):
    t = f / 96 * math.tau
    an.pose(f, {
        'root': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 1.5), ('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * math.sin(t)))],
        'spine1': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
        'chest': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.6) * 2.5)],
        'head': [('X', math.sin(t + 1.0) * 3.0), ('Y', math.sin(t * 0.5) * 5.0)],
        'jaw': [('X', abs(math.sin(t * 0.5)) * -10.0)],
        'armL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.5)], 'armR': [('X', math.sin(t + 1) * 2.5)],
    })
CLIPS['idle'] = (1, 96)

# walk: тяжёлый шаг, 1.6 с
an.reset()
act = an.action('walk')
WF = 48
for f in range(1, WF + 1, 3):
    t = f / WF * math.tau
    an.pose(f, {
        'legFL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 20.0)], 'shinFL': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 1.8)) * 22.0)],
        'legFR': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 20.0)], 'shinFR': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 1.8 + math.pi)) * 22.0)],
        'legBL': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi / 2) * 18.0)], 'shinBL': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 1.8 + math.pi / 2)) * 20.0)],
        'legBR': [('X', math.sin(t + 3 * math.pi / 2) * 18.0)], 'shinBR': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 1.8 + 3 * math.pi / 2)) * 20.0)],
        'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.1 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
        'spine1': [('Y', math.sin(t) * 3.0)],
        'armL': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 8.0)], 'armR': [('X', math.sin(t) * 8.0)],
        'head': [('X', math.sin(t * 2) * 2.0)],
    })
CLIPS['walk'] = (1, WF)

# attack: замах двумя руками вверх -> сокрушительный удар вниз
an.reset()
act = an.action('attack')
K = [(1, 0.0), (8, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)]
for f, k in K:
    an.pose(f, {
        'armL': [('X', k * -55.0)], 'foreL': [('X', k * -25.0)],
        'armR': [('X', k * -55.0)], 'foreR': [('X', k * -25.0)],
        'clawL': [('X', k * -15.0)], 'clawR': [('X', k * -15.0)],
        'chest': [('X', k * -10.0)], 'head': [('X', k * -8.0)],
        'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.4, k * 0.15))],
        'jaw': [('X', k * -14.0)],
    })
CLIPS['attack'] = (1, 28)

# death: оседание, крен набок, развал
an.reset()
act = an.action('death')
for f in range(1, 43, 3):
    t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
    an.pose(f, {
        'root': [('Z', 16.0 * t), ('move', (0, 0, -1.7 * t))],
        'spine1': [('Y', 12.0 * t)],
        'legFL': [('X', 30.0 * t)], 'legFR': [('X', 30.0 * t)],
        'legBL': [('X', 30.0 * t)], 'legBR': [('X', 30.0 * t)],
        'armL': [('Z', 30.0 * t)], 'armR': [('Z', -30.0 * t)],
        'head': [('X', -20.0 * t), ('Z', 18.0 * t)],
    })
CLIPS['death'] = (1, 42)

export_glb(os.path.join(OUT, 'kostolom_anim.glb'), arm)
render_clips(OUT, arm, CLIPS, center=(0, 0, 3.2), cam_dist=(7.5, -10.5, 3.6))
print('KOSTOLOM DONE')

----------------------------------------
ФАЙЛ: res://inbox/hunt_skill_icons/README.md
----------------------------------------

# Иконки скиллов боссов ОХОТЫ (12 шт, 96px)

Заменяют эмодзи-глифы из `SKILL_GLYPH` (ui/lab/hunt_calendar.gd:19) в
Календаре ОХОТЫ и Босс-табе гильдии (хелпер `HuntCalendar.portrait`).

Файлы названы ПО ID СКИЛЛА из data/boss_hunt_data.gd:
skill_quake, skill_blink, skill_dot_zone, skill_summon, skill_stun_nearest,
skill_vampiric, skill_dash, skill_shield, skill_regen, skill_backstab,
skill_hop_regen, skill_mark (.png)

Подключение: маппинг id -> путь "res://<папка>/skill_%s.png" вместо
глифа; там, где иконка не влезает (строка текста), оставить глиф.
Стиль — как assets/ui/abilities (тёмная октагон-пластина + золотое кольцо).

# Арт для топо-карты Зоны (ui/lab/journey_map.gd)

Сейчас карта рисуется целиком кодом (_draw). Пак даёт фон и спрайты:
- map_background.png (1600x900) — тёмная топография: контуры рельефа,
  лес, река, пунктирные дороги, сетка, знак радиации, виньетка;
- биконы 96px: bicon_boss (караван-босс), bicon_keeper (Хранитель),
  bicon_break (Прорыв), bicon_anomaly, bicon_location, bicon_you (маркер).

Палитра согласована с константами COL_* journey_map.gd (GOLD e8b93c,
BREAK ff8d5c, GREEN 49ff80). Код рисует маршрут/гало поверх фона;
биконы можно ставить в точки _special вместо кружков.

# CREDITS — new_mutants

## Всё содержимое — оригинальные процедурные ассеты, CC0

Модели, риги, клипы (Blender 4.5 bpy) и карточки (Cycles-рендер + PIL)
созданы агентом-подготовщиком для StalkerRevert. Creative Commons Zero 1.0,
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/


----------------------------------------
ФАЙЛ: res://inbox/new_mutants/README.md
----------------------------------------

# 8 новых ОРИГИНАЛЬНЫХ мутантов (ЗАДАЧА 43)

## Что это

Восемь новых базовых мутантов под роли пачек (ТАНК/ЛЕЧ/УРОН/БАФ), по 2 на
роль, 2 легендарных хедлайнера. У каждого: анимированная модель (риг + 4
клипа idle/walk/attack/death), карточка-портрет 620px (рендер самой модели
— арт совпадает с 3D один-в-один), готовый блок данных. Всё процедурное
Blender + PIL, CC0.

## Доставлено

- `models/<id>.glb` (8 шт) — **уже в `ui/cards/` как карточки** + серые
  версии в `ui/cards/gray/`. И игрока-модель (в `models/`) главному.
- Godot 4.6.1: все 8 грузятся, AnimationPlayer видит 4 клипа (проверено).

| id | Имя | Роль | Редкость | Силуэт | Клипы (характер) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| kremen | Кремень | ТАНК | uncommon | каменный купол-панцирь, таран, 4 лапы | тяжёлый таран |
| rzhavnik | Ржавник | ТАНК | rare | ржавый краб-сборщик, клешни-ковши, линза | крабовый шаг |
| sporonosets | Спороносец | ЛЕЧ | uncommon | гриб-страж, светящиеся споры, гифы | выброс спор |
| chrevo | Чрево | ЛЕЧ | epic | пульсирующая плоть, чрево-свет, пуповины | удар пуповинами |
| iskropluy | Искроплюй | УРОН | rare | парящий электрический угорь, разрядники | изгиб-разряд |
| kosar | Косарь | УРОН | LEGENDARY | трёхметровый жнец, руки-лезвия, безглазая маска | двойной взмах |
| mayak | Маяк | БАФ | uncommon | мутант-маяк, вращающийся прожектор-голова | ослепляющая вспышка |
| horovod | Хоровод | БАФ | LEGENDARY | кольцо трёх сросшихся фигур | вихревой разгон |

## Блок данных для main (paste-ready, формат species)

```gdscript
# добавить в BASE_STATS + пул редкостей + MutantRoles.ROLES + карточки/модели
const NEW_ORIGINALS := [
	{"id": "kremen", "name_ru": "Кремень", "role": "TANK", "rarity": "uncommon",
		"gate": 12, "hp": 2.0, "dmg": 0.6, "speed": 0.85, "family": "construct"},
	{"id": "rzhavnik", "name_ru": "Ржавник", "role": "TANK", "rarity": "rare",
		"gate": 26, "hp": 1.8, "dmg": 0.8, "speed": 0.95, "family": "construct"},
```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# ЗАДАЧА 43: 8 новых оригинальных мутантов (модель+риг+4 клипа) + карточки.
# Фреймворк boss_kit. Роли под пачки: ТАНК/ЛЕЧ/УРОН/БАФ.
import bpy
import math
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, r'E:\StalkerRevert\StalkerRevert\inbox\hunt_boss_models')
import importlib
import boss_kit
importlib.reload(boss_kit)
from boss_kit import (new_scene, make_armature, mat_simple, bind_parts, Anim,
                      export_glb, add_part, light_and_cam, render_clips)

OUT = r'E:\StalkerRevert\StalkerRevert\inbox\new_mutants'
MODELS = os.path.join(OUT, 'models')
CARDS = os.path.join(OUT, 'cards')


def P(parts, name, kind, size, loc, mat, bone, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    parts.append(add_part(name, kind, size, loc, mat, bone, rot))


def part(name, kind, size, loc, mat, bone, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    """Создать часть без регистрации в списке (для объектов-не-частей)."""
    return add_part(name, kind, size, loc, mat, bone, rot)


# ============================================================
# 1. КРЕМЕНЬ — каменный панцирник-таран (ТАНК, uncommon)
# ============================================================
def build_kremen(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 0.55), (0, 0, 0.95)),
        ('shell', 'root', (0, 0, 0.95), (0, 0, 1.25)),
        ('head', 'root', (0.95, 0, 0.55), (1.35, 0, 0.6)),
        ('legFL', 'root', (-0.55, -0.5, 0.35), (-0.75, -0.62, 0.0)),
        ('legFR', 'root', (0.55, -0.5, 0.35), (0.75, -0.62, 0.0)),
        ('legBL', 'root', (-0.55, 0.5, 0.35), (-0.75, 0.62, 0.0)),
        ('legBR', 'root', (0.55, 0.5, 0.35), (0.75, 0.62, 0.0)),
        ('tail', 'root', (-0.95, 0, 0.7), (-1.45, 0, 0.55)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('KremenArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    rock = mat_simple('km_rock', (0.38, 0.39, 0.36))
    rock2 = mat_simple('km_rock2', (0.30, 0.32, 0.28))
    moss = mat_simple('km_moss', (0.32, 0.42, 0.22))
    eye = mat_simple('km_eye', (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), (1.0, 0.55, 0.2), 2.0)
    # купол-панцирь (сплюснутая сфера)
    P(parts, 'dome', 'sphere', 0.95, (0, 0, 0.85), rock, 'shell')
    # наросты на панцире
    for i in range(5):
        a = math.tau * i / 5 + 0.4
        P(parts, f'growth_{i}', 'sphere', 0.28 + (i % 2) * 0.1,
          (math.cos(a) * 0.55, math.sin(a) * 0.45, 1.05 + (i % 3) * 0.08), moss, 'shell')
    # голова-таран
    P(parts, 'ram', 'box', (0.55, 0.62, 0.5), (1.12, 0, 0.62), rock2, 'head')
    P(parts, 'brow', 'box', (0.2, 0.5, 0.18), (1.28, 0, 0.82), rock2, 'head')
    for dy in (-0.14, 0.14):
        P(parts, f'eye_{dy}', 'sphere', 0.06, (1.3, dy, 0.66), eye, 'head')
    # 4 лапы (бедро+ступня одним мешом на кость)
    for tag, leg in (('FL', 'legFL'), ('FR', 'legFR'), ('BL', 'legBL'), ('BR', 'legBR')):
        h = bones_head(BONES, leg)
        P(parts, f'leg_{tag}', 'box', (0.34, 0.34, 0.5), (h[0], h[1], 0.18), rock2, leg)
    # обломок хвоста
    P(parts, 'tail', 'cone', (0.22, 0.06, 0.6), (-1.2, 0, 0.62), rock2, 'tail',
      rot=(0, 0, math.radians(-90)))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.03 * math.sin(t)))],
            'shell': [('X', math.sin(t) * 1.2)],
            'head': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.7) * 3.0), ('Y', math.sin(t * 0.5) * 4.0)],
            'tail': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 6.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'legFL': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 10.0)], 'legBR': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 10.0)],
            'legFR': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 10.0)], 'legBL': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 10.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.04 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
            'head': [('X', math.sin(t * 2) * 2.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (15, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'head': [('move', (k * 0.45, 0, 0)), ('X', k * -6.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, k * -0.12))],
            'shell': [('X', k * 4.0)],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, -0.25 * t)), ('X', 10.0 * t)],
            'shell': [('Z', 14.0 * t)],
            'head': [('move', (0, 0, -0.3 * t))],
            'legFL': [('Z', 25.0 * t)], 'legFR': [('Z', -25.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(out_path, arm)
    return arm, clips, (0, 0, 0.8)


def bones_head(bones, name):
    for n, p, h, t in bones:
        if n == name:
            return h
    return (0, 0, 0)


# ============================================================
# 2. РЖАВНИК — ржавый краб-сборщик (ТАНК, rare)
# ============================================================
def build_rzhavnik(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 0.95), (0, 0, 1.3)),
        ('lens', 'root', (0, -0.62, 1.35), (0, -0.75, 1.4)),
        ('clawL', 'root', (-0.72, -0.3, 1.05), (-1.15, -0.5, 0.9)),
        ('clawR', 'root', (0.72, -0.3, 1.05), (1.15, -0.5, 0.9)),
        ('legL1', 'root', (-0.5, 0.15, 0.75), (-1.05, 0.3, 0.3)),
        ('legR1', 'root', (0.5, 0.15, 0.75), (1.05, 0.3, 0.3)),
        ('legL2', 'root', (-0.5, 0.35, 0.75), (-1.0, 0.65, 0.3)),
        ('legR2', 'root', (0.5, 0.35, 0.75), (1.0, 0.65, 0.3)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('RzhavnikArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    rust = mat_simple('rz_rust', (0.45, 0.26, 0.14))
    rust2 = mat_simple('rz_rust2', (0.36, 0.20, 0.11))
    metal = mat_simple('rz_metal', (0.30, 0.31, 0.33))
    lens = mat_simple('rz_lens', (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), (1.0, 0.6, 0.2), 2.6)
    P(parts, 'hull', 'cylinder' if False else 'sphere', 0.72, (0, 0, 1.05), rust, 'root')
    P(parts, 'hull_top', 'sphere', 0.4, (0, 0, 1.55), rust2, 'root')
    P(parts, 'lens_rim', 'cone', (0.2, 0.12, 0.3), (0, -0.6, 1.4), metal, 'lens',
      rot=(math.radians(-90), 0, 0))
    P(parts, 'lens', 'sphere', 0.13, (0, -0.72, 1.4), lens, 'lens')
    # антенна
    P(parts, 'antenna', 'box', (0.04, 0.04, 0.5), (0.15, -0.1, 1.95), metal, 'root')
    # клешни-ковши
    for sx, claw in ((-1, 'clawL'), (1, 'clawR')):
        P(parts, f'arm_{sx}', 'box', (0.24, 0.24, 0.9), (sx * 0.95, -0.4, 0.95), rust2, claw,
          rot=(math.radians(-35), 0, 0))
        P(parts, f'bucket_{sx}', 'box', (0.42, 0.5, 0.36), (sx * 1.2, -0.62, 0.62), metal, claw,
          rot=(0, 0, math.radians(sx * 12)))
        P(parts, f'tooth_{sx}', 'cone', (0.09, 0.02, 0.3), (sx * 1.2, -0.85, 0.48), metal, claw,
          rot=(math.radians(150), 0, 0))
    # 4 ноги-краба (2 сегмента)
    for tag, leg, px, py in (('L1', 'legL1', -0.78, 0.22), ('R1', 'legR1', 0.78, 0.22),
                             ('L2', 'legL2', -0.75, 0.5), ('R2', 'legR2', 0.75, 0.5)):
        P(parts, f'thigh_{tag}', 'cone', (0.16, 0.08, 0.75), (px, py, 0.55), rust2, leg,
          rot=(math.radians(-55), 0, math.atan2(py, px)))
        P(parts, f'sh_{tag}', 'cone', (0.12, 0.05, 0.55), (px * 1.55, py * 1.45, 0.2), rust, leg,
          rot=(math.radians(115), 0, math.atan2(py, px)))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * math.sin(t)))],
            'clawL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 5.0)], 'clawR': [('X', math.sin(t + 1) * 5.0)],
            'lens': [('Y', math.sin(t * 0.6) * 8.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'legL1': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 12.0)], 'legR2': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 12.0)],
            'legR1': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 12.0)], 'legL2': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 12.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (15, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'clawL': [('X', k * -30.0), ('Y', k * -14.0)],
            'clawR': [('X', k * -30.0), ('Y', k * 14.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.3, 0))],
            'lens': [('X', k * 8.0)],
        })

            'lens': [('X', -20.0 * t)],

# 3. СПОРОНОСЕЦ — гриб-страж (ЛЕЧ, uncommon)
# ============================================================
def build_sporonosets(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 0.15), (0, 0, 0.5)),
        ('stalk', 'root', (0, 0, 0.5), (0, 0, 1.7)),
        ('cap', 'stalk', (0, 0, 1.7), (0, 0, 2.2)),
        ('tend1', 'stalk', (0.2, -0.1, 1.5), (0.55, -0.3, 0.7)),
        ('tend2', 'stalk', (-0.2, 0.1, 1.5), (-0.55, 0.3, 0.7)),
        ('tend3', 'stalk', (0.1, 0.2, 1.45), (0.4, 0.5, 0.75)),
        ('tend4', 'stalk', (-0.1, -0.2, 1.45), (-0.4, -0.5, 0.75)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('SporonosetsArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    stalk = mat_simple('sp_stalk', (0.62, 0.58, 0.46))
    cap = mat_simple('sp_cap', (0.42, 0.5, 0.3))
    glow = mat_simple('sp_glow', (0.55, 0.75, 0.4), (0.5, 0.8, 0.3), 2.2)
    P(parts, 'base', 'cone', (0.34, 0.2, 0.4), (0, 0, 0.2), stalk, 'root')
    P(parts, 'stalk_m', 'cone', (0.22, 0.15, 1.3), (0, 0, 1.1), stalk, 'stalk')
    P(parts, 'cap_m', 'sphere', 0.85, (0, 0, 1.85), cap, 'cap')
    P(parts, 'cap_glow', 'sphere', 0.5, (0, 0, 1.7), glow, 'cap')
    for i in range(6):  # поры под шляпкой
        a = math.tau * i / 6
        P(parts, f'pore_{i}', 'sphere', 0.09, (math.cos(a) * 0.5, math.sin(a) * 0.5, 1.55), glow, 'cap')
    for i, t in enumerate(('tend1', 'tend2', 'tend3', 'tend4')):
        h = bones_head(BONES, t)
        P(parts, f'tendr_{i}', 'cone', (0.1, 0.03, 1.1), (h[0] * 0.6, h[1] * 0.6, 1.1), stalk, t,
          rot=(math.radians(55), 0, math.atan2(h[1], h[0])))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.04 * math.sin(t)))],
            'cap': [('X', math.sin(t) * 3.0), ('Y', math.cos(t) * 3.0)],
            'tend1': [('X', math.sin(t) * 6.0)], 'tend2': [('X', math.sin(t + 1.6) * 6.0)],
            'tend3': [('Z', math.sin(t + 0.8) * 6.0)], 'tend4': [('X', math.sin(t + 2.4) * 6.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'stalk': [('X', math.sin(t) * 5.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * abs(math.sin(t))))],
            'cap': [('Y', math.sin(t) * 4.0)],
            'tend1': [('X', math.sin(t) * 8.0)], 'tend3': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 8.0)],
            'tend2': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 6.0)], 'tend4': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 6.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'cap': [('X', k * -14.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, k * 0.1))],
            'tend1': [('X', k * 25.0)], 'tend2': [('X', k * 25.0)],
            'tend3': [('X', k * 20.0)], 'tend4': [('X', k * 20.0)],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, -0.5 * t)), ('X', 20.0 * t)],
            'cap': [('X', 24.0 * t)],
            'stalk': [('X', 15.0 * t)],
            'tend1': [('X', 30.0 * t)], 'tend4': [('Z', 25.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(out_path, arm)
    return arm, clips, (0, 0, 1.4)

def build_chrevo(out_path):

        P(parts, f'tendr_{i}', 'cone', (0.16, 0.05, 1.2), (h[0] * 0.55, h[1] * 0.55, 0.5),

    an = Anim(arm)

            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.05 * math.sin(t * 1.5)))],

            'tend1': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.5) * 5.0)], 'tend2': [('X', math.sin(t + 2.0) * 5.0)],
            'tend3': [('Z', math.sin(t + 1.2) * 5.0)], 'tend4': [('Z', math.sin(t + 2.8) * 5.0)],
            'nub': [('Y', math.sin(t) * 5.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'tend1': [('X', math.sin(t) * 9.0)], 'tend2': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 9.0)],
            'tend3': [('Z', math.sin(t + math.pi / 2) * 8.0)], 'tend4': [('Z', math.sin(t + 3 * math.pi / 2) * 8.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.06 * abs(math.sin(t))))],
            'womb': [('X', math.sin(t * 2) * 4.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)

        an.pose(f, {
            'womb': [('move', (0, k * -0.5, 0)), ('X', k * 15.0)],
            'tend1': [('X', k * -20.0)], 'tend2': [('X', k * -20.0)],
            'tend3': [('X', k * -14.0)], 'tend4': [('X', k * -14.0)],

            'womb': [('X', -25.0 * t)],

def build_iskropluy(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 1.5), (0, 0, 1.8)),
        ('seg1', 'root', (0, 0, 1.8), (0, -0.35, 1.95)),
        ('seg2', 'seg1', (0, -0.35, 1.95), (0.1, -0.75, 1.8)),
        ('seg3', 'seg2', (0.1, -0.75, 1.8), (0.35, -1.0, 1.5)),
        ('seg4', 'seg3', (0.35, -1.0, 1.5), (0.7, -1.05, 1.2)),
        ('seg5', 'seg4', (0.7, -1.05, 1.2), (1.0, -0.9, 0.95)),
        ('hornL', 'seg1', (-0.12, -0.4, 2.05), (-0.3, -0.6, 2.45)),
        ('hornR', 'seg1', (0.12, -0.4, 2.05), (0.05, -0.62, 2.5)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('IskropluyArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    body = mat_simple('is_body', (0.14, 0.16, 0.22))
    belly = mat_simple('is_belly', (0.25, 0.3, 0.4))
    spark = mat_simple('is_spark', (0.3, 0.35, 0.5), (0.4, 0.75, 1.0), 2.8)
    segs = [('seg1', 0.3), ('seg2', 0.34), ('seg3', 0.3), ('seg4', 0.24), ('seg5', 0.16)]
    for i, (sn, r) in enumerate(segs):
        h = bones_head(BONES, sn)
        P(parts, f'seg_{i}', 'sphere', r, h, body if i % 2 == 0 else belly, sn)
    P(parts, 'head', 'sphere', 0.26, (0, 0.12, 1.72), body, 'seg1')
    P(parts, 'jaw', 'cone', (0.1, 0.03, 0.34), (0, -0.15, 1.62), body, 'seg1',
      rot=(math.radians(-70), 0, 0))
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        P(parts, f'eye_{sx}', 'sphere', 0.055, (sx * 0.11, 0.02, 1.8), spark, 'seg1')
    for h in (('hornL', (-0.12, -0.4, 2.05)), ('hornR', (0.12, -0.4, 2.05))):
        pass
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 73, 6):
        t = f / 72 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.12 * math.sin(t)))],
            'seg2': [('X', math.sin(t) * 7.0)], 'seg3': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.8) * 8.0)],
            'seg4': [('X', math.sin(t + 1.6) * 7.0)], 'seg5': [('X', math.sin(t + 2.4) * 9.0)],
            'seg1': [('Y', math.sin(t * 0.7) * 5.0)],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 72)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, -0.3 * math.sin(t), 0.08 * math.sin(t * 2)))],
            'seg2': [('X', math.sin(t) * 10.0)], 'seg3': [('X', math.sin(t + 0.7) * 11.0)],
            'seg4': [('X', math.sin(t + 1.4) * 10.0)], 'seg5': [('X', math.sin(t + 2.1) * 11.0)],
            'seg1': [('Y', math.sin(t) * 4.0)],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'seg1': [('X', k * -18.0)],
            'seg2': [('X', k * -14.0)], 'seg3': [('X', k * -10.0)],
            'hornL': [('Z', k * 20.0)], 'hornR': [('Z', k * -20.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.4, k * 0.15))],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        an.pose(f, {

            'seg2': [('X', 20.0 * t)], 'seg3': [('X', -15.0 * t)], 'seg4': [('X', 18.0 * t)],
            'seg5': [('X', -10.0 * t)],
            'seg1': [('Z', 20.0 * t)],
        })

def build_kosar(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 1.6), (0, 0, 1.9)),
        ('body', 'root', (0, 0, 1.7), (0, 0, 2.5)),
        ('chest', 'body', (0, 0, 2.5), (0, 0, 2.9)),
        ('hood', 'chest', (0, 0, 2.95), (0, 0, 3.25)),
        ('armL', 'chest', (-0.55, 0, 2.75), (-1.25, -0.1, 2.1)),
        ('bladeL', 'armL', (-1.25, -0.1, 2.1), (-1.9, -0.2, 1.1)),
        ('armR', 'chest', (0.55, 0, 2.75), (1.25, 0.1, 2.1)),
        ('bladeR', 'armR', (1.25, 0.1, 2.1), (1.9, 0.2, 1.1)),
        ('legL', 'root', (-0.3, 0, 1.55), (-0.4, 0, 0.75)),
        ('shinL', 'legL', (-0.4, 0, 0.75), (-0.42, 0, 0.05)),
        ('legR', 'root', (0.3, 0, 1.55), (0.4, 0, 0.75)),
        ('shinR', 'legR', (0.4, 0, 0.75), (0.42, 0, 0.05)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('KosarArm', BONES)
    parts = []

    cloth2 = mat_simple('ks_cloth2', (0.22, 0.2, 0.16))
    skin = mat_simple('ks_skin', (0.5, 0.48, 0.4))
    steel = mat_simple('ks_steel', (0.75, 0.76, 0.8), (0.4, 0.6, 0.8), 0.8)
    P(parts, 'robe', 'cone', (0.75, 0.45, 1.7), (0, 0, 1.45), cloth, 'root')

    P(parts, 'mask', 'sphere', 0.2, (0, -0.12, 2.95), skin, 'hood')
    # безглазая маска: просто щель
    d_none = None
    P(parts, 'slit', 'box', (0.18, 0.05, 0.03), (0, -0.28, 2.96), skin, 'hood')
    # руки-лезвия: плечо + длинное стальное лезвие
    for sx, up, bl in ((-1, 'armL', 'bladeL'), (1, 'armR', 'bladeR')):
        P(parts, f'shoulder_{sx}', 'sphere', 0.18, (sx * 0.55, 0, 2.72), cloth2, up)
        P(parts, f'arm_{sx}', 'box', (0.14, 0.14, 1.1), (sx * 0.9, -0.05, 2.45), skin, up,
          rot=(0, 0, math.radians(-sx * 12)))
        P(parts, f'blade_{sx}', 'box', (0.09, 0.5, 1.5), (sx * 1.55, -0.14, 1.6), steel, bl,
          rot=(math.radians(-14), 0, math.radians(-sx * 16)))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 8):
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.06 * math.sin(t)))],
            'body': [('X', math.sin(t) * 2.0)],
            'hood': [('Y', math.sin(t * 0.5) * 5.0)],
            'armL': [('X', math.sin(t) * 3.0)], 'armR': [('X', math.sin(t + math.pi) * 3.0)],

    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):

        an.pose(f, {

            'shinL': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 2.0)) * 18.0)],
            'shinR': [('X', -max(0, math.sin(t + 2.0 + math.pi)) * 18.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.035 * abs(math.sin(t * 2))))],

        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (8, -1.0), (17, 1.0), (29, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'armL': [('Z', k * -55.0), ('X', k * -20.0)],
            'bladeL': [('X', k * -18.0)],
            'armR': [('Z', k * 45.0), ('X', k * -12.0)],
            'bladeR': [('X', k * -12.0)],

# 7. МАЯК — мутант-маяк (БАФ, uncommon)
# ============================================================
def build_mayak(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 0.25), (0, 0, 0.55)),
        ('tower', 'root', (0, 0, 0.55), (0, 0, 2.4)),
        ('lamp', 'tower', (0, 0, 2.4), (0, 0, 2.85)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('MayakArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    stone = mat_simple('mk_stone', (0.34, 0.36, 0.32))
    stone2 = mat_simple('mk_stone2', (0.28, 0.30, 0.27))
    lens = mat_simple('mk_lens', (0.4, 0.4, 0.35), (1.0, 0.85, 0.4), 3.0)
    P(parts, 'base_r', 'cylinder' if False else 'cone', (0.75, 0.55, 0.5), (0, 0, 0.25), stone, 'root')
    P(parts, 'tower_b', 'cone', (0.55, 0.4, 1.0), (0, 0, 1.0), stone, 'tower')
    P(parts, 'tower_t', 'cone', (0.42, 0.3, 0.95), (0, 0, 1.95), stone2, 'tower')
    for i in range(4):  # окна-щели
        y = 0.85 + i * 0.42
        P(parts, f'win_{i}', 'box', (0.1, 0.08, 0.2), (0.42 - i * 0.04, 0, y), lens, 'tower')
    P(parts, 'lamp_room', 'cylinder' if False else 'sphere', 0.34, (0, 0, 2.6), stone2, 'lamp')
    P(parts, 'lamp_lens', 'sphere', 0.2, (0, -0.22, 2.6), lens, 'lamp')
    P(parts, 'cap', 'cone', (0.3, 0.03, 0.35), (0, 0, 3.0), stone, 'lamp')
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 97, 6):   # прожектор вращается ровно за клип
        t = f / 96 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.03 * math.sin(t)))],
            'tower': [('X', math.sin(t) * 1.2)],
            'lamp': [('Y', 360.0 * (f / 96.0))],
        })
    clips['idle'] = (1, 96)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):   # скольжение-шаг (двигается телепортом рывками)
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.06 * math.sin(t * 2)), )],
            'tower': [('Z', math.sin(t) * 3.0), ('X', math.sin(t * 2) * 1.5)],
            'lamp': [('Y', 360.0 * (f / 48.0))],
        })
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (7, -1.0), (16, 1.0), (28, 0.0)):
        an.pose(f, {
            'lamp': [('X', k * -14.0), ('Y', k * 30.0)],
            'tower': [('X', k * 3.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, k * 0.1))],
        })
    clips['attack'] = (1, 28)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        an.pose(f, {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, -0.15 * t))],
            'tower': [('X', 40.0 * t), ('Z', 20.0 * t)],
            'lamp': [('X', -30.0 * t)],
        })
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(out_path, arm)
    return arm, clips, (0, 0, 1.5)


# ============================================================
# 8. ХОРОВОД — кольцо трёх фигур (БАФ, LEGENDARY)
# ============================================================
def build_horovod(out_path):
    sc = new_scene()
    BONES = [
        ('root', None, (0, 0, 1.15), (0, 0, 1.4)),
        ('ring', 'root', (0, 0, 1.15), (0, 0, 1.3)),
        ('fig1', 'ring', (0, -0.95, 1.15), (0, -0.95, 1.9)),
        ('fig2', 'ring', (0.82, 0.48, 1.15), (0.82, 0.48, 1.9)),
        ('fig3', 'ring', (-0.82, 0.48, 1.15), (-0.82, 0.48, 1.9)),
    ]
    arm = make_armature('HorovodArm', BONES)
    parts = []
    robe = mat_simple('hd_robe', (0.3, 0.32, 0.4))
    robe2 = mat_simple('hd_robe2', (0.26, 0.28, 0.38))
    eth = mat_simple('hd_eth', (0.35, 0.3, 0.5), (0.55, 0.4, 1.0), 2.4)
    # кольцо-основание: плоский тор из 6 сегментов-боксов
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.tau * i / 6
        P(parts, f'ringseg_{i}', 'box', (0.62, 0.5, 0.22),
          (math.cos(a) * 0.95, math.sin(a) * 0.95, 0.12), robe2, 'ring',
          rot=(0, 0, a))
    # три фигуры: тело + голова + руки
    for i, fig in enumerate(('fig1', 'fig2', 'fig3')):
        a = math.tau * i / 3
        fx, fy = math.cos(a) * 0.95, math.sin(a) * 0.95
        P(parts, f'body_{i}', 'box', (0.44, 0.36, 1.05), (fx, fy, 0.95), robe, fig,
          rot=(0, 0, a))
        P(parts, f'head_{i}', 'sphere', 0.2, (fx, fy, 1.72), robe2, fig)
        P(parts, f'horn_{i}', 'cone', (0.07, 0.02, 0.3), (fx, fy, 2.0), eth, fig)
        for sx in (-1, 1):
            aa = a + math.pi / 2
            ddx = math.cos(aa) * sx * 0.3
            ddy = math.sin(aa) * sx * 0.3
            P(parts, f'arm_{i}_{sx}', 'cone', (0.09, 0.03, 0.6),
              (fx + ddx, fy + ddy, 1.3), robe2, fig,
              rot=(math.radians(-35), 0, aa + math.pi / 2))
    bind_parts(parts, arm)

    an = Anim(arm)
    clips = {}
    an.reset(); an.action('idle')
    for f in range(1, 121, 8):   # 4 с, вращение ровно за клип
        t = f / 120 * math.tau
        spec = {
            'root': [('move', (0, 0, 0.1 * math.sin(t)))],
            'ring': [('Z', 360.0 * (f / 120.0))],
        }
        for i, fig in enumerate(('fig1', 'fig2', 'fig3')):
            spec[fig] = [('X', math.sin(t + i * 2.1) * 4.0)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['idle'] = (1, 120)
    an.reset(); an.action('walk')
    for f in range(1, 49, 4):
        t = f / 48 * math.tau
        spec = {
            'root': [('move', (0, -0.3 * math.sin(t), 0.08 * abs(math.sin(t * 2)))),
                     ('Z', 360.0 * (f / 48.0) * 1.0)],
        }
        for i, fig in enumerate(('fig1', 'fig2', 'fig3')):
            spec[fig] = [('X', math.sin(t + i * 2.1) * 6.0)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['walk'] = (1, 48)
    an.reset(); an.action('attack')
    for f, k in ((1, 0.0), (8, -1.0), (18, 1.0), (30, 0.0)):
        spec = {
            'ring': [('Z', k * 60.0)],
            'root': [('move', (0, k * -0.3, k * 0.15))],
        }
        for i, fig in enumerate(('fig1', 'fig2', 'fig3')):
            spec[fig] = [('X', k * -18.0)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['attack'] = (1, 30)
    an.reset(); an.action('death')
    for f in range(1, 43, 3):
        t = min(1.0, f / 30.0)
        spec = {'root': [('move', (0, 0, -0.75 * t)), ('Z', 30.0 * t)]}
        for i, fig in enumerate(('fig1', 'fig2', 'fig3')):
            spec[fig] = [('X', 30.0 * t), ('Y', (i - 1) * 25.0 * t)]
        an.pose(f, spec)
    clips['death'] = (1, 42)
    export_glb(out_path, arm)
    return arm, clips, (0, 0, 1.2)


BONES_DATA = {}   # сохраняем спеки для справки


def bones_head(bones, name):
    for n, p, h, t in bones:
        if n == name:
            return h
    return (0, 0, 0)


BUILDERS = {
    'kremen': build_kremen, 'rzhavnik': build_rzhavnik, 'sporonosets': build_sporonosets,
    'chrevo': build_chrevo, 'iskropluy': build_iskropluy, 'kosar': build_kosar,
    'mayak': build_mayak, 'horovod': build_horovod,
}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for name, fn in BUILDERS.items():
        arm, clips, center = fn(os.path.join(MODELS, f'{name}.glb'))
        print(f'{name}: клипов {len(clips)}')

# managers/anomaly_manager.gd
extends Node
class_name AnomalyManager

## Менеджер аномалий - создание, уничтожение, связь с артефактами

signal anomaly_created(anomaly: Node, anomaly_type: String, difficulty: int)
signal anomaly_destroyed(anomaly_type: String, position: Vector3, difficulty: int)
signal artifact_created(artifact: Node, artifact_type: String, position: Vector3)
signal artifact_stolen(artifact: Node, stalker: Node)

# Сцены аномалий (загружаются из конфига)
var anomaly_scenes: Dictionary = {}

# Маппинг аномалия -> артефакт
var anomaly_artifact_map: Dictionary = {}

# Ценности артефактов по редкости
var artifact_values: Dictionary = {}

# Маппинг сложности -> редкость
var difficulty_to_rarity: Dictionary = {}

# Активные объекты
var active_anomalies: Array[Node] = []
var active_artifacts: Array[Node] = []

# Таймеры для артефактов
var artifact_timers: Dictionary = {}  # artifact_instance_id -> Timer

# Множители из лаборатории
var damage_multiplier: float = 1.0
var radius_multiplier: float = 1.0


func _ready():
	add_to_group("anomaly_manager")
	
	# Заполняем сцены аномалий
	anomaly_scenes = {
		"heat_anomaly": preload("res://anomalies/heat_anomaly.tscn"),
		"electric_anomaly": preload("res://anomalies/electric_anomaly.tscn"),
		"acid_anomaly": preload("res://anomalies/acid_anomaly.tscn"),
		"gravity_vortex": preload("res://anomalies/gravity_vortex.tscn"),
		"gravity_lift": preload("res://anomalies/gravity_lift.tscn"),
		"gravity_whirlwind": preload("res://anomalies/gravity_whirlwind.tscn"),
		"thermal_steam": preload("res://anomalies/thermal_steam.tscn"),
		"thermal_comet": preload("res://anomalies/thermal_comet.tscn"),
		"chemical_jelly": preload("res://anomalies/chemical_jelly.tscn"),
		"chemical_gas": preload("res://anomalies/chemical_gas.tscn"),
		"chemical_acid_cloud": preload("res://anomalies/chemical_acid_cloud.tscn"),
		"radiation_hotspot": preload("res://anomalies/radiation_hotspot.tscn"),
		"time_dilation": preload("res://anomalies/time_dilation.tscn"),
		"teleport": preload("res://anomalies/teleport.tscn"),
		"electric_tesla": preload("res://anomalies/electric_tesla.tscn"),
		"bio_burning_fluff": preload("res://anomalies/bio_burning_fluff.tscn")
	}
	
	# print("AnomalyManager инициализирован")


# ==================== АНОМАЛИИ ====================

func create_anomaly(anomaly_type: String, position: Vector3, difficulty: int, _energy_cost: float) -> Node:
	if not anomaly_scenes.has(anomaly_type):
		# print("Неизвестный тип аномалии: " + anomaly_type)
		return null
	
	var scene = anomaly_scenes[anomaly_type]
	var anomaly = scene.instantiate()
	
	# Проекция на рельеф: аномалия всегда стоит на земле, а не в воздухе
	var space = get_viewport().get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var ray = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
	ray.from = Vector3(position.x, position.y + 40.0, position.z)
	ray.to = Vector3(position.x, position.y - 60.0, position.z)
	ray.collision_mask = 1
	var hit = space.intersect_ray(ray)
	position.y = hit.position.y if hit else 0.0
	anomaly.position = position
	
	# Применяем множители из лаборатории
	if anomaly.has_method("set_damage_multiplier"):
		anomaly.set_damage_multiplier(damage_multiplier)
	if anomaly.has_method("set_radius_multiplier"):
		anomaly.set_radius_multiplier(radius_multiplier)
	
	# Подключаем сигнал уничтожения
	if anomaly.has_signal("destroyed"):
		anomaly.destroyed.connect(_on_anomaly_destroyed)
	
	anomaly.add_to_group("anomalies")
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(anomaly)
	
	# Сложность задаем ПОСЛЕ add_child: _ready() подклассов сбрасывает
	# difficulty_level на 1 (аналогично артефактам)
	if anomaly.has_method("set_difficulty"):
		anomaly.set_difficulty(difficulty)
	
	active_anomalies.append(anomaly)
	
	anomaly_created.emit(anomaly, anomaly_type, difficulty)
	# print("Аномалия создана: " + anomaly_type + " на позиции " + str(position))
	
	return anomaly


func remove_anomaly(anomaly: Node):
	if is_instance_valid(anomaly):
		active_anomalies.erase(anomaly)
		anomaly.queue_free()
	# print("Аномалия удалена")


func get_active_anomalies() -> Array[Node]:
	return active_anomalies.filter(func(a): return is_instance_valid(a))


func get_anomaly_count() -> int:
	return active_anomalies.size()


func get_anomaly_cost(anomaly_type: String) -> float:
	match anomaly_type:
		"heat_anomaly": return 50.0
		"electric_anomaly": return 75.0
		"acid_anomaly": return 100.0
		"gravity_vortex": return 150.0
		"gravity_lift": return 80.0
		"gravity_whirlwind": return 120.0
		"thermal_steam": return 70.0
		"thermal_comet": return 100.0
		"chemical_jelly": return 60.0
		"chemical_gas": return 85.0
		"chemical_acid_cloud": return 110.0
		"radiation_hotspot": return 95.0
		"time_dilation": return 200.0
		"teleport": return 180.0
		"electric_tesla": return 90.0
		"bio_burning_fluff": return 75.0
		_: return 50.0


func _on_anomaly_destroyed(anomaly: Node):
	# Получаем информацию
	var anomaly_type = "unknown"
	var difficulty = 1
	var position = anomaly.global_position
	
	if anomaly.has_method("get_type_name"):
		anomaly_type = anomaly.get_type_name()
	if anomaly.has_method("get_difficulty"):
		difficulty = anomaly.get_difficulty()
	
	# Удаляем из списка
	active_anomalies.erase(anomaly)
	
	# Создаём артефакт
	var artifact_type = anomaly_artifact_map.get(anomaly_type, "common_artifact")
	var rarity = difficulty_to_rarity.get(difficulty, "common")
	var values = artifact_values.get(rarity, [10])
	var value = values[randi() % values.size()]
	
	create_artifact(artifact_type, position, rarity, value)
	
	anomaly_destroyed.emit(anomaly_type, position, difficulty)
	# print("Аномалия уничтожена, создан артефакт: " + artifact_type)


# ==================== АРТЕФАКТЫ ====================

func create_artifact(artifact_type: String, position: Vector3, rarity: String = "common", value: float = 10.0) -> Node:
	# Пробуем загрузить сцену
	var scene_path = "res://entities/artifacts/" + artifact_type + ".tscn"
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(scene_path):
		# print("Сцена артефакта не найдена: " + scene_path)
		return null
	
	var scene = load(scene_path)
	var artifact = scene.instantiate()
	artifact.position = position
	
	# Подключаем сигналы
	if artifact.has_signal("stolen"):
		artifact.stolen.connect(_on_artifact_stolen)
	if artifact.has_signal("collected"):
		artifact.collected.connect(_on_artifact_collected)
	
	artifact.add_to_group("artifacts")
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(artifact)
	
	# Редкость и ценность задаём ПОСЛЕ add_child: _ready() артефакта
	# перетирает их экспортными значениями по умолчанию
	if artifact.has_method("set_rarity_and_value"):
		artifact.set_rarity_and_value(rarity, value)
	
	active_artifacts.append(artifact)
	
	# Запускаем таймер для артефактов на земле
	_start_artifact_timer(artifact)
	
	artifact_created.emit(artifact, artifact_type, position)
	# print("Артефакт создан: " + artifact_type + " на позиции " + str(position))
	
	return artifact


func _on_artifact_stolen(artifact: Node, stalker: Node):
	# Останавливаем таймер
	_stop_artifact_timer(artifact)
	
	artifact_stolen.emit(artifact, stalker)
	# print("Артефакт украден сталкером: " + str(stalker))


func _on_artifact_collected(artifact: Node, _collector: Node):
	if artifact in active_artifacts:
		active_artifacts.erase(artifact)
	_stop_artifact_timer(artifact)
	# print("Артефакт собран: " + str(collector))


func _start_artifact_timer(artifact: Node):
	var id = artifact.get_instance_id()
	if artifact_timers.has(id):
		return
	
	var timer = Timer.new()
	timer.wait_time = 30.0  # 30 секунд до превращения
	timer.one_shot = true
	timer.timeout.connect(_on_artifact_timeout.bind(artifact, id))
	add_child(timer)
	timer.start()
	
	artifact_timers[id] = timer
	# print("Таймер артефакта запущен на 30с")


func _stop_artifact_timer(artifact: Node):
	var id = artifact.get_instance_id()
	if artifact_timers.has(id):
		var timer = artifact_timers[id]
		if is_instance_valid(timer):
			timer.stop()
			timer.queue_free()
		artifact_timers.erase(id)


func _on_artifact_timeout(artifact: Node, timer_id: int):
	# Таймер одноразовый: запись в artifact_timers больше не нужна
	artifact_timers.erase(timer_id)
	
	if not is_instance_valid(artifact):
		return
	
	# Артефакт пролежал на земле 30 секунд - кристаллизуется в аномалию
	# (закрытый TODO ZCode: раньше артефакт просто исчезал)
	var pos: Vector3 = artifact.global_position
	var scene_name: String = String(artifact.scene_file_path.get_file().get_basename())
	
	# Удаляем артефакт
	active_artifacts.erase(artifact)
	_stop_artifact_timer(artifact)
	artifact.queue_free()
	
	# Ищем аномалию-хозяина по обратной карте аномалия -> артефакт
	var anomaly_type: String = ""
	for a_type in anomaly_artifact_map:
		if String(anomaly_artifact_map[a_type]) == scene_name:
			anomaly_type = String(a_type)
			break
	
	if not anomaly_type.is_empty() and anomaly_scenes.has(anomaly_type):
		create_anomaly(anomaly_type, pos, 1, 0.0)
	# print("Артефакт ", scene_name, " кристаллизовался в аномалию ", anomaly_type)


func remove_all_artifacts():
	for artifact in active_artifacts:
		if is_instance_valid(artifact):
			artifact.queue_free()
	active_artifacts.clear()
	
	for timer in artifact_timers.values():
		if is_instance_valid(timer):
			timer.stop()
			timer.queue_free()
	artifact_timers.clear()
	
	# print("Все артефакты удалены")


func stop_all_timers():
	for timer in artifact_timers.values():
		if is_instance_valid(timer):
			timer.stop()
	# print("Все таймеры артефактов остановлены")


func get_active_artifacts() -> Array[Node]:
	return active_artifacts.filter(func(a): return is_instance_valid(a))


func get_artifact_count() -> int:
	return active_artifacts.size()


# ==================== НАСТРОЙКИ ====================

func set_damage_multiplier(value: float):
	damage_multiplier = value
	# print("Множитель урона аномалий: " + str(value))


func set_radius_multiplier(value: float):
	radius_multiplier = value
	# print("Множитель радиуса аномалий: " + str(value))


func load_config(config: Dictionary):
	if config.has("anomaly_scenes"):
		anomaly_scenes = config["anomaly_scenes"]
	if config.has("anomaly_artifact_map"):
		anomaly_artifact_map = config["anomaly_artifact_map"]
	if config.has("artifact_values"):
		artifact_values = config["artifact_values"]
	if config.has("difficulty_to_rarity"):
		difficulty_to_rarity = config["difficulty_to_rarity"]
	
	# print("Конфигурация загружена")

# managers/billing_manager.gd
extends Node
class_name BillingManager

## Биллинг Google Play (спека D16). Требует официальный плагин
## GodotGooglePlayBilling (AssetLib) + включение в Android-пресете.
## На ПК/в редакторе биллинга нет - store_available() = false.
## ВЕСЬ класс неактивен, пока StoreData.ENABLED == false.
##
## Поток: start() -> queryProducts -> витрина (цены стора; таблица
## StoreData.PRODUCTS - фолбэк для офлайн-UI). Покупка: purchase ->
## токен -> acknowledge (требование Google: 3 дня) -> начисление payload
## -> сейв. Восстановление: queryPurchases (nc - всегда; расходники
## после расходования - нет, честная плашка в UI).

signal products_loaded(prices: Dictionary)     # sku -> локализованная цена
signal purchase_granted(sku: String)
signal purchase_failed(reason: String)

const PLUGIN_SINGLETON := "GodotGooglePlayBilling"

var _billing = null                            # Engine singleton плагина
var _connected: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("billing")


## Доступен ли магазин вообще (флаг + платформа + плагин)
func store_available() -> bool:
	if not StoreData.ENABLED:
		return false
	if not OS.has_feature("android"):
		return false
	return Engine.has_singleton(PLUGIN_SINGLETON)


## Подключение к стору. Безопасно звать всегда: без флага - тихий выход.
func start() -> void:
	if not store_available():
		return
	_billing = Engine.get_singleton(PLUGIN_SINGLETON)
	if _billing.has_signal("connected"):
		_billing.connect("connected", _on_connected)
	if _billing.has_signal("products_loaded"):
		_billing.connect("products_loaded", _on_products_loaded)
	if _billing.has_signal("purchases_updated"):
		_billing.connect("purchases_updated", _on_purchases_updated)
	if _billing.has_signal("purchase_error"):
		_billing.connect("purchase_error", _on_purchase_error)
	_billing.startConnection()


func query_products() -> void:
	if _connected and _billing:
		_billing.queryProducts(StoreData.PRODUCTS.keys())


func purchase(sku: String) -> void:
	if not store_available():
		purchase_failed.emit("store_unavailable")
		return
	if not StoreData.PRODUCTS.has(sku):
		purchase_failed.emit("unknown_sku")
		return
	_billing.purchaseProduct(sku)


## Восстановление nc-покупок (пропуск/косметика/удобства)
func restore() -> void:
	if _connected and _billing:
		_billing.queryPurchases()


func _on_connected(_result) -> void:
	_connected = true
	query_products()


func _on_products_loaded(products) -> void:
	# products: массив {id, price} - отдаём витрине
	var prices: Dictionary = {}
	for p in products:
		prices[str(p.get("id", ""))] = str(p.get("price", ""))
	products_loaded.emit(prices)


func _on_purchases_updated(purchases) -> void:
	# Каждую покупку: acknowledge + начисление (через zone/game_manager снаружи)
	for p in purchases:
		var sku: String = str(p.get("sku", ""))
		var token: String = str(p.get("purchase_token", ""))
		if sku == "" or token == "":
			continue
		if _billing and _billing.has_method("acknowledgePurchase"):
			_billing.acknowledgePurchase(token)
		purchase_granted.emit(sku)


func _on_purchase_error(_code, _msg) -> void:
	purchase_failed.emit("purchase_error")

ФАЙЛ: res://managers/billing_manager.gd.uid

uid://dadd52npbprdk
