# Временная проверка компиляции всех .gd проекта (не входит в сборку).
# Запуск: godot --headless --path <proj> -s res://tmp_compile_check.gd
extends SceneTree


func _init() -> void:
        var ok := 0
        var bad := 0
        var files: Array = []
        _collect("res://", files)
        for p in files:
                var s = load(p)
                if s == null:
                        bad += 1
                        printerr("FAIL_LOAD: " + p)
                elif s is GDScript and not (s as GDScript).can_instantiate():
                        bad += 1
                        printerr("FAIL_COMPILE: " + p)
                else:
                        ok += 1
        print("CHECK_DONE ok=%d bad=%d total=%d" % [ok, bad, ok + bad])
        quit(1 if bad > 0 else 0)


func _collect(path: String, out: Array) -> void:
        var d := DirAccess.open(path)
        if d == null:
                return
        d.list_dir_begin()
        var f := d.get_next()
        while f != "":
                var full := path.path_join(f)
                if d.current_is_dir():
                        if f != ".godot" and f != "android":
                                _collect(full, out)
                elif f.ends_with(".gd"):
                        out.append(full)
                f = d.get_next()
        d.list_dir_end()

# ui/base/base_panel.gd
extends Control
class_name BasePanel

## Базовый класс для всех панелей UI

signal opened
signal closed
signal back_pressed

@export var panel_name: String = "BasePanel"
@export var close_on_escape: bool = true
@export var close_on_click_outside: bool = false
@export var animation_duration: float = 0.2

var is_open: bool = false


func _ready():
    visible = false
    _setup_connections()


func _setup_connections():
    if close_on_escape:
        var back_button = find_child("BackButton", true, false)
        if back_button and back_button is Button:
            back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_pressed)


func _input(event):
    if close_on_escape and event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel") and is_open:
        close()


func _on_back_pressed():
    back_pressed.emit()
    close()


# ==================== ПУБЛИЧНОЕ API ====================

func open():
    if is_open:
        return
    
    is_open = true
    visible = true
    
    if animation_duration > 0:
        _play_open_animation()
    
    opened.emit()
    pass # print("Панель открыта: " + panel_name, "BasePanel")


func close():
    if not is_open:
        return
    
    is_open = false
    
    if animation_duration > 0:
        await _play_close_animation()
    
    visible = false
    closed.emit()
    pass # print("Панель закрыта: " + panel_name, "BasePanel")


func toggle():
    if is_open:
        close()
    else:
        open()


func _play_open_animation():
    modulate.a = 0
    scale = Vector2(0.9, 0.9)
    
    var tween = create_tween()
    tween.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 1.0, animation_duration)
    tween.parallel().tween_property(self, "scale", Vector2.ONE, animation_duration)
    await tween.finished


func _play_close_animation():
    var tween = create_tween()
    tween.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, animation_duration)
    tween.parallel().tween_property(self, "scale", Vector2(0.9, 0.9), animation_duration)
    await tween.finished


func set_title(text: String):
    var title = find_child("Title", true, false)
    if title and title is Label:
        title.text = text


func show_message(message: String, duration: float = 2.0):
    var msg_label = Label.new()
    msg_label.text = message
    msg_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    msg_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    msg_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
    msg_label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color.BLACK)
    msg_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 2)
    msg_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 2)
    
    add_child(msg_label)
    msg_label.position = Vector2(size.x / 2 - 100, size.y / 2)
    
    await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
    if is_instance_valid(msg_label):
        msg_label.queue_free()

extends Control
class_name SwipeHelper

## Единый свайп-слой игры (v0.29.2): тянешь - список едет за пальцем 1:1,
## отпускаешь на ходу - инерция с плавным торможением, тап без движения -
## нажимает кнопку/карточку под пальцем. Скроллбары обёрнутого ScrollContainer
## делаются невидимыми (Godot 4 рисует их ПОВЕРХ контента - перекрывали надписи).
##
## Математика против "плохого свайпа":
##  - дельта копится во float (старый int(round()) глотал медленные
##    микродвижения пальца);
##  - скорость сглаживается EMA, а не берётся с последнего кадра (флик был
##    непредсказуем: либо мёртвый, либо случайный);
##  - "отпустил после остановки" не даёт флинг (отсекатель устаревшего замера);
##  - инерция тормозит мягче (была почти мгновенная - список "умирал" под рукой);
##  - тап работает при любой длительности нажатия (был лимит 450 мс).

const DEADZONE_PX := 10.0        # порог "это уже свайп, а не тап"
const VEL_SMOOTH := 0.4          # вес нового замера в EMA скорости
const STALE_MS := 110            # отпустил позже - флинга нет (палец стоял)
const MIN_FLING := 60.0          # ниже - не инертно, а сразу стоп
const MAX_INST := 8000.0         # защита от выброса замера, px/s
const INERTIA_BASE := 0.05       # торможение: v *= base^delta (мягче старого 0.002)

var scroll: ScrollContainer = null
var horiz: bool = false
var tap_cb: Callable = Callable()   # Callable(scroll, global_pos); пусто - кнопка под пальцем

var _active := false
var _moved := false
var _total := 0.0
var _acc := 0.0                     # дробный хвост скролла (точное следование пальцу)
var _last_pos := 0.0
var _lt_ms := 0
var _vel := 0.0
var _inertia_vel := 0.0
var _inertia_on := false


## Обёртка над scroll: свайп-слой поверх + невидимые скроллбары.
## reserve_bottom/right - резерв пустого поля под/справа от списка (px).
static func attach(sc: ScrollContainer, horizontal: bool, reserve_bottom: float = 0.0, reserve_right: float = 0.0, tap_callback: Callable = Callable()) -> Control:
	var wrap := Control.new()
	wrap.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	wrap.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	wrap.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	sc.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	sc.offset_bottom = -reserve_bottom
	sc.offset_right = -reserve_right
	wrap.add_child(sc)
	var lay: SwipeHelper = SwipeHelper.new()
	lay.name = "SwipeLayer"
	lay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	lay.offset_bottom = -reserve_bottom
	lay.offset_right = -reserve_right
	lay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	wrap.add_child(lay)
	lay.scroll = sc
	lay.horiz = horizontal
	lay.tap_cb = tap_callback
	lay.hide_scrollbars()
	return wrap


## Полоса прокрутки исчезает: нулевой размер, прозрачность, мышь мимо.
## Прокрутка (свайпом/колесом/инерцией) остаётся живой.
func hide_scrollbars() -> void:
	if scroll == null or not is_instance_valid(scroll):
		return
	for bar in [scroll.get_h_scroll_bar(), scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()]:
		if bar == null:
			continue
		bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 0)
		bar.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
		bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE


func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
	if scroll == null or not is_instance_valid(scroll) or not scroll.visible:
		return
	if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if ev.pressed:
			_active = true
			_moved = false
			_total = 0.0
			_acc = 0.0
			_last_pos = ev.position.x if horiz else ev.position.y
			_lt_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()
			_vel = 0.0
			_inertia_on = false
			accept_event()
		elif _active:
			_active = false
			if not _moved:
				_emit_tap(ev.position)
			else:
				var stale: bool = Time.get_ticks_msec() - _lt_ms > STALE_MS
				var v: float = 0.0 if stale else _vel
				if absf(v) > MIN_FLING:
					_inertia_vel = -v
					_inertia_on = true
			accept_event()
	elif ev is InputEventMouseMotion and _active and (ev.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT):
		var pos: float = ev.position.x if horiz else ev.position.y
		var dx: float = pos - _last_pos
		_last_pos = pos
		_total += dx
		if absf(_total) > DEADZONE_PX:
			_moved = true
		if _moved:
			_apply_scroll_delta(-dx)
			var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
			var dt: float = float(maxi(now - _lt_ms, 1)) / 1000.0
			_lt_ms = now
			var inst: float = clampf(dx / dt, -MAX_INST, MAX_INST)
			_vel = inst if _vel == 0.0 else lerpf(_vel, inst, VEL_SMOOTH)
		accept_event()


## Плавное движение списка на d пикселей (дробь доезжает следующими событиями)
func _apply_scroll_delta(d: float) -> void:
	_acc += d
	var step := int(_acc)
	if step == 0:
		return
	_acc -= float(step)
	var bar: ScrollBar = scroll.get_h_scroll_bar() if horiz else scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()
	var mx := int(bar.max_value) if bar else 0
	if horiz:
		scroll.scroll_horizontal = clampi(scroll.scroll_horizontal + step, 0, maxi(mx, 0))
	else:
		scroll.scroll_vertical = clampi(scroll.scroll_vertical + step, 0, maxi(mx, 0))


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not _inertia_on or scroll == null or not is_instance_valid(scroll):
		return
	var bar: ScrollBar = scroll.get_h_scroll_bar() if horiz else scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()
	var mx := int(bar.max_value) if bar else 0
	var cur: int = scroll.scroll_horizontal if horiz else scroll.scroll_vertical
	_apply_scroll_delta(_inertia_vel * delta)
	var nxt: int = scroll.scroll_horizontal if horiz else scroll.scroll_vertical
	_inertia_vel *= pow(INERTIA_BASE, delta)
	if absf(_inertia_vel) < MIN_FLING or nxt == cur:
		_inertia_on = false


## Тап по слою: свой колбэк (карточки фермы) или кнопка под пальцем
func _emit_tap(local_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var gp: Vector2 = get_global_transform() * local_pos
	if tap_cb.is_valid():
		tap_cb.call(scroll, gp)
		return
	var btns: Array = scroll.find_children("*", "Button", true, false)
	btns.reverse()
	for b in btns:
		var btn := b as Button
		if btn == null or btn.is_queued_for_deletion() or not btn.visible or btn.disabled:
			continue
		if btn.get_global_rect().has_point(gp):
			btn.pressed.emit()
			return

## Рамка-арт больших панелей (болотная окантовка + золотые уголки): NinePatchRect
## ПОВЕРХ steel-панели — центр рамки прозрачный, фон даёт steel. Нет файла - тихо.
static func add_frame_overlay(panel: Control) -> void:
        var tex_path := LAB_ART_DIR + "panel_frame_9patch.png"
        if not ResourceLoader.exists(tex_path) or panel == null:
                return
        var frame := NinePatchRect.new()
        frame.name = "ArtFrame"
        frame.texture = load(tex_path)
        frame.patch_margin_left = PANEL_FRAME_MIN
        frame.patch_margin_top = PANEL_FRAME_MIN
        frame.patch_margin_right = PANEL_FRAME_MIN
        frame.patch_margin_bottom = PANEL_FRAME_MIN
        frame.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        frame.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        panel.add_child(frame)

static func make_plate(value: String, caption: String, width: float = 120.0, icon_path: String = "") -> PanelContainer:
        var p := PanelContainer.new()
        p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", steel())
        p.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(width, 0)
        var v := VBoxContainer.new()
        v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
        var lv := Label.new()
        lv.text = value
        lv.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        lv.add_theme_font_override("font", font_mono())
        lv.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
        lv.add_theme_color_override("font_color", HAZARD_BRIGHT)
        var lk := Label.new()
        lk.text = caption
        lk.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        lk.add_theme_font_override("font", font_body())
        lk.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
        lk.add_theme_color_override("font_color", TEXT_DIM)
        v.add_child(lv)
        v.add_child(lk)
        # Задача 22: иконка валюты ПОСЛЕ цифры (get_child(0) чужого кода
        # ожидает value-Label, не ломаем порядок детей)
        if icon_path != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(icon_path):
                var iv := TextureRect.new()
                iv.texture = load(icon_path)
                iv.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 26)
                iv.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                iv.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
                v.add_child(iv)
        p.add_child(v)
        return p

## kind: "primary" (зелёная 3D), "hazard" (жёлтая 3D), "danger" (красная 3D),
##       "steel" (плоская сталь), "ghost" (приглушённая)
static func style_button(btn: Button, kind: String = "steel", font_size: int = 18, big: bool = false) -> void:
        var fnt: Font = font_title() if (kind != "steel" and kind != "ghost") else font_body()
        btn.add_theme_font_override("font", fnt)
        btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
        btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE

        var empty := StyleBoxEmpty.new()

        match kind:
                "primary":
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", INK)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", INK)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", INK)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", Color(INK, 0.5))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sb3d(BTN_GREEN, BTN_EDGE_GREEN, GREEN_DARK, 10 if big else 7, 22 if big else 16))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sb3d(BTN_GREEN.lightened(0.1), BTN_EDGE_GREEN, GREEN_DARK, 10 if big else 7, 22 if big else 16))
                        var pr := _sb3d(BTN_GREEN.darkened(0.08), BTN_EDGE_GREEN, GREEN_DARK, 2, 22 if big else 16)
                        pr.content_margin_top = 14.0
                        pr.content_margin_bottom = 6.0
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pr)
                        var ds := _sb3d(BTN_GREEN.darkened(0.35), BTN_EDGE_GREEN, GREEN_DARK, 10 if big else 7, 22 if big else 16)
                        ds.bg_color = BTN_GREEN.darkened(0.45)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", ds)
                "hazard":
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("171003"))
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color("171003"))
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color("171003"))
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", Color(0.09, 0.06, 0.01, 0.5))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sb3d(HAZARD, BTN_EDGE_DARK, Color("7a5a10"), 9, 22 if big else 16))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sb3d(HAZARD_BRIGHT, BTN_EDGE_DARK, Color("7a5a10"), 9, 22 if big else 16))
                        var pr := _sb3d(HAZARD.darkened(0.1), BTN_EDGE_DARK, Color("7a5a10"), 2, 22 if big else 16)
                        pr.content_margin_top = 13.0
                        pr.content_margin_bottom = 5.0
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pr)
                        var ds := _sb3d(HAZARD.darkened(0.45), BTN_EDGE_DARK, Color("7a5a10"), 9, 22 if big else 16)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", ds)
                "danger":
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", INK_WARM)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", INK_WARM)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", INK_WARM)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", Color(INK_WARM, 0.5))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sb3d(DANGER, BTN_EDGE_DARK, DANGER_DARK, 9, 22 if big else 16))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sb3d(DANGER_HI, BTN_EDGE_DARK, DANGER_DARK, 9, 22 if big else 16))
                        var pr := _sb3d(DANGER.darkened(0.08), BTN_EDGE_DARK, DANGER_DARK, 2, 22 if big else 16)
                        pr.content_margin_top = 13.0
                        pr.content_margin_bottom = 5.0
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pr)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", _sb3d(DANGER.darkened(0.45), BTN_EDGE_DARK, DANGER_DARK, 9, 22 if big else 16))
                "ghost":
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", TEXT_DIM)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", TEXT_LIGHT)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", GREEN)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", ghost_box())
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", ghost_box(Color(GREEN, 0.5)))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", ghost_box(Color(GREEN, 0.8)))
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", ghost_box())
                _:
                        # steel: плоская стальная кнопка (рядовые кнопки)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", TEXT_LIGHT)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", TEXT_BRIGHT)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", GREEN)
                        btn.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", TEXT_FAINT)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", steel_btn_box())
                        var hv := steel_btn_box()
                        hv.border_color = Color(GREEN, 0.55)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hv)
                        var pr := steel_btn_box()
                        pr.bg_color = STEEL_HI
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pr)
                        var ds := steel_btn_box()
                        ds.bg_color = Color(STEEL, 0.6)
                        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", ds)

        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", empty)

        th.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", steel_panel())
        th.set_stylebox("panel", "PanelContainer", steel_panel())

        var btn_n := steel_btn_box()
        var btn_h := steel_btn_box()

        th.set_stylebox("hover", "Button", btn_h)

        return th


## Применить тему и общие декорации БУНКЕР к корню сцены.
## Возвращает словарь созданных узлов: {haz_top, haz_bottom, frame, overlay}
static func apply_bunker(root: Control, with_frame: bool = true) -> Dictionary:
        root.theme = build_theme()

        var haz_top := hazard_stripes(14.0)
        haz_top.name = "HazTop"
        haz_top.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
        root.add_child(haz_top)

        var haz_bottom := hazard_stripes(14.0)
        haz_bottom.name = "HazBottom"
        haz_bottom.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_WIDE)
        root.add_child(haz_bottom)

        var out := {"haz_top": haz_top, "haz_bottom": haz_bottom}

        if with_frame:
                var frame := Panel.new()
                frame.name = "BunkerFrame"
                frame.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", frame_style())
                frame.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                frame.offset_left = 10
                frame.offset_top = 10
                frame.offset_right = -10
                frame.offset_bottom = -10
                frame.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                root.add_child(frame)
                out["frame"] = frame

        # Полосы и рамка остаются СВЕРХУ (добавлены последними) - это вид макета:
        # хазард-ленты лежат поверх всего по кромкам экрана.
        return out


## Заголовок шапки: главная строка + подстрока
static func make_header(title_text: String, sub_text: String) -> VBoxContainer:
        var v := VBoxContainer.new()
        v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
        var h1 := Label.new()
        h1.text = title_text
        h1.add_theme_font_override("font", font_body())
        h1.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
        h1.add_theme_color_override("font_color", TEXT_LIGHT)
        var h2 := Label.new()
        h2.text = sub_text
        h2.add_theme_font_override("font", font_body())
        h2.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
        h2.add_theme_color_override("font_color", TEXT_DIM)
        v.add_child(h1)
        v.add_child(h2)
        return v


## Заголовок секции «▼ ТЕКСТ» (жёлтый, как .lbl)
static func make_section_label(text: String) -> Label:
        var l := Label.new()
        l.text = text
        l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_body())
        l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
        l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", HAZARD)
        return l


## Моноширинный технический текст
static func make_mono_label(text: String, size: int = 13, color: Color = TEXT_DIM) -> Label:
        var l := Label.new()
        l.text = text
        l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_mono())
        l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
        l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
        return l

ФАЙЛ: res://ui/bunker/hazard_stripes.gdshader

shader_type canvas_item;
// Хазард-полосы 45°: жёлтый/чёрный, как на макете БУНКЕР.

uniform vec4 col_a : source_color = vec4(0.909, 0.725, 0.235, 1.0);
uniform vec4 col_b : source_color = vec4(0.051, 0.051, 0.051, 1.0);
uniform float stripes = 6.0;

void fragment() {
	float v = fract((UV.x + UV.y) * stripes);
	COLOR = v < 0.5 ? col_a : col_b;
}

# ui/events/event_hub.gd
extends Control
class_name EventHub

## Хаб циклических событий (D24): баннер, счёт и осколки, вехи (10),
## магазин ивента, кнопка «ИГРАТЬ». Строится кодом; стиль BunkerUI.
## Игра инстансится как сцена мини-игры (game_zharva и др.).

const ART_DIR := "res://assets/ui/events/"

var _root: Control
var _title: Label
var _desc: Label
var _time: Label
var _score: Label
var _shards: Label
var _list: VBoxContainer
var _shop_list: VBoxContainer
var _play_btn: Button
var _banner: TextureRect
var _event: Dictionary = {}
var game_manager: Node


## Арт ивентов (задача 37): баннеры/иконки/виньетки из assets/ui/events/.
## Файла нет (не доставлен/не импортирован) — null, UI остаётся процедурным.
func _art(art_name: String) -> Texture2D:
	var path := ART_DIR + art_name + ".png"
	return load(path) if ResourceLoader.exists(path) else null


func _ready() -> void:
	game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	visible = false
	_build()


func open() -> void:
	_event = EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
	if game_manager and game_manager.current_save_data:
		EventOps.state(game_manager.current_save_data)
	_refresh()
	_root.visible = true


func close() -> void:
	_root.visible = false


func _build() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "HubRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.visible = false
	add_child(_root)

	var shade := ColorRect.new()
	shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shade.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.66)
	shade.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
			close())
	_root.add_child(shade)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var w: float = clampf(vp.x * 0.6, 380.0, 660.0)
	if vp.x < 900.0:
		w = vp.x * 0.94
	panel.offset_left = -w * 0.5
	panel.offset_right = w * 0.5
	panel.offset_top = -vp.y * 0.4
	panel.offset_bottom = vp.y * 0.4
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	sb.shadow_size = 22
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_child(head)
	_title = Label.new()
	_title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	_title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	head.add_child(_title)
	var x_btn := Button.new()
	x_btn.text = "✕"
	x_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 40)
	BunkerUI.style_button(x_btn, "steel", 15)
	x_btn.pressed.connect(close)
	head.add_child(x_btn)

	# Арт-баннер ивента (задача 37): 1920x640, название — строкой выше
	_banner = TextureRect.new()
	_banner.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
	_banner.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	_banner.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 128)
	_banner.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	v.add_child(_banner)

	_desc = Label.new()
	_desc.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_desc.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	_desc.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	_desc.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
	v.add_child(_desc)

	_time = Label.new()
	_time.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	_time.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	_time.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD)
	v.add_child(_time)

	_score = Label.new()
	_score.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	_score.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	_score.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT)
	v.add_child(_score)

	var shards_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	shards_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	v.add_child(shards_row)
	var shard_icon := TextureRect.new()
	shard_icon.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(18, 18)
	shard_icon.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	shard_icon.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	shard_icon.texture = _art("shard_zone")
	shard_icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	shards_row.add_child(shard_icon)
	_shards = Label.new()
	_shards.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	_shards.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	_shards.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.55, 0.85, 0.95))
	shards_row.add_child(_shards)

	_play_btn = Button.new()
	_play_btn.text = Loc.t("evt.play")
	_play_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 56)
	BunkerUI.style_button(_play_btn, "primary", 20, true)
	_play_btn.pressed.connect(_on_play)
	v.add_child(_play_btn)

	var tabs := HBoxContainer.new()
	tabs.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	v.add_child(tabs)
	var mile_tab := Button.new()
	mile_tab.text = Loc.t("evt.milestones")
	mile_tab.toggle_mode = true
	mile_tab.button_pressed = true
	mile_tab.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	BunkerUI.style_button(mile_tab, "steel", 12)
	tabs.add_child(mile_tab)
	var shop_tab := Button.new()
	shop_tab.text = Loc.t("evt.shop")
	shop_tab.toggle_mode = true
	shop_tab.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	BunkerUI.style_button(shop_tab, "steel", 12)
	tabs.add_child(shop_tab)

	var pages := Control.new()
	pages.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	v.add_child(pages)

	_list = VBoxContainer.new()
	_list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	pages.add_child(_list)

	_shop_list = VBoxContainer.new()
	_shop_list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_shop_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	_shop_list.visible = false
	pages.add_child(_shop_list)

	var toggle := func(on: Button, page: Control):
		for p in [_list, _shop_list]:
			p.visible = p == page
		for b in [mile_tab, shop_tab]:
			b.set_pressed_no_signal(b == on)
	mile_tab.pressed.connect(func(): toggle.call(mile_tab, _list))
	shop_tab.pressed.connect(func(): toggle.call(shop_tab, _shop_list))


func _refresh() -> void:
	var lang := "ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en"
	_title.text = Loc.t("evt.banner") % str(_event["title_" + lang])
	_desc.text = str(_event["desc_" + lang])
	_time.text = Loc.t("evt.time_left") % int(_event["days_left"])
	var es := EventOps.state(game_manager.current_save_data) \
		if game_manager and game_manager.current_save_data else {}
	_score.text = Loc.t("evt.score_line") % [int(es.get("score", 0)), int(es.get("best", 0))]
	# рядом с осколками стоит виньетка-кристалл — ◆ из строки убираем
	_shards.text = Loc.t("evt.shards_line").replace("◆ ", "") % int(es.get("shards", 0))
	_banner.texture = _art("ev_" + str(_event["base"]))
	_banner.visible = _banner.texture != null
	_play_btn.visible = str(_event["id"]) != "finale"
	_fill_milestones(es)
	_fill_shop()
	_fill_finale_games(es)


## Финал полугодия: все шесть игр открыты одновременно.
## Вызывается ПОСЛЕ _fill_milestones — кнопки игр лягут блоком сверху вех.
func _fill_finale_games(_es: Dictionary) -> void:
	if str(_event.get("id", "")) != "finale":
		return
	var games := [["zharva", "evt.g_zharva"], ["uley", "evt.g_uley"],
		["labyrinth", "evt.g_labyrinth"], ["chain", "evt.g_chain"],
		["vault", "evt.g_vault"], ["bolts", "evt.g_bolts"]]
	var built := ["zharva", "uley", "labyrinth", "chain", "vault", "bolts"]
	for g in games:
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = Loc.t(str(g[1])) + ("  ▶" if g[0] in built else "  ·  " + Loc.t("evt.soon"))
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
		b.icon = _art(str(g[0]) + "_icon")
		if b.icon != null:
			b.expand_icon = true
		BunkerUI.style_button(b, "steel", 13)
		b.disabled = not (g[0] in built)
		if g[0] in built:
			b.pressed.connect(_on_finale_play.bind(g[0]))
		_list.add_child(b)


func _on_finale_play(base: String) -> void:
	_play_click()
	close()
	var script_map := {
		"zharva": preload("res://ui/events/game_zharva.gd"),
		"uley": preload("res://ui/events/game_uley.gd"),
		"labyrinth": preload("res://ui/events/game_labyrinth.gd"),
		"chain": preload("res://ui/events/game_chain.gd"),
		"vault": preload("res://ui/events/game_vault.gd"),
		"bolts": preload("res://ui/events/game_bolts.gd"),
	}
	var game: Control = script_map[base].new()
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(game)


func _play_click() -> void:
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.5)


func _fill_milestones(es: Dictionary) -> void:
	for c in _list.get_children():
		_list.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	var mult: float = float(_event["mult"]) \
		if str(es.get("event_id", "")) == str(_event["id"]) else 1.0
	for i in EventsData.MILESTONE_SCORES.size():
		var goal := int(float(EventsData.MILESTONE_SCORES[i]) / mult)
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
		_list.add_child(row)
		# слот-иконка: сундук у готовых к вехе, пустой у прочих (ровная сетка)
		var ic := TextureRect.new()
		ic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(20, 20)
		ic.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		ic.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		ic.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		row.add_child(ic)
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
		lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		lbl.clip_text = true
		row.add_child(lbl)
		var claimed: bool = int(es.get("claimed", []).find(i)) != -1
		var mile_ready: bool = EventOps.milestone_ready(es, i)
		var score_now := int(es.get("score", 0)) if str(es.get("event_id", "")) == str(_event["id"]) else 0
		if claimed:
				lbl.text = "✓  %d — %s" % [goal, _milestone_text(i)]
				lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
		elif mile_ready:
				ic.texture = _art("milestone_chest")
				lbl.text = "%d — %s" % [goal, _milestone_text(i)]
				lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
				var claim := Button.new()
				claim.text = Loc.t("evt.claim")
				claim.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(120, 32)
				BunkerUI.style_button(claim, "hazard", 12)
				claim.pressed.connect(_on_claim.bind(i))
				row.add_child(claim)
		else:
				lbl.text = "%d — %s   (%d/%d)" % [goal, _milestone_text(i),
						score_now, goal]
				lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)


func _milestone_text(idx: int) -> String:
	var prem: Dictionary = EventsData.MILESTONE_REWARDS[idx]
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	if int(prem.get("rolls_mut", 0)) > 0:
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_mut") % int(prem["rolls_mut"]))
	if int(prem.get("rolls_art", 0)) > 0:
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_art") % int(prem["rolls_art"]))
	if float(prem.get("bio", 0.0)) > 0.0:
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_bio") % int(float(prem["bio"]) / 1000.0))
	if int(prem.get("sparks", 0)) > 0:
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_sparks") % int(prem["sparks"]))
	if prem.has("cos_frame"):
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_frame"))
	if prem.has("cos_title"):
		parts.append(Loc.t("evt.r_title"))
	return " + ".join(parts)


func _fill_shop() -> void:
	for c in _shop_list.get_children():
		_shop_list.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	var es := EventOps.state(game_manager.current_save_data) \
		if game_manager and game_manager.current_save_data else {}
	# финал полугодия: распродажа осколков ×0.7
	var sale: bool = str(_event.get("id", "")) == "finale"
	var shard_icon: Texture2D = _art("shard_zone")
	for shop_id in EventsData.SHOP:
		var item: Dictionary = EventsData.SHOP[shop_id]
		if sale:
			item = item.duplicate()
			item["shards"] = int(ceil(float(item["shards"]) * 0.7))
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
		_shop_list.add_child(row)
		var name_key := "name_ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "name_en"
		var ic := TextureRect.new()
		ic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(16, 16)
		ic.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		ic.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		ic.texture = shard_icon
		ic.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		row.add_child(ic)
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.text = "%s — %d" % [str(item[name_key]), int(item["shards"])]
		lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
		lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
		row.add_child(lbl)
		var bought: bool = es.get("bought", {}).has(shop_id)
		var is_cos := item.has("cos_frame")
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(140, 32)
		btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		BunkerUI.style_button(btn, "steel", 12)
		if bought and is_cos:
				btn.text = Loc.t("evt.owned")
				btn.disabled = true
		else:
				btn.text = Loc.t("evt.buy")
				btn.pressed.connect(_on_buy.bind(shop_id))
		row.add_child(btn)


func _on_claim(idx: int) -> void:
	if game_manager == null or game_manager.current_save_data == null:
		return
	var prem := EventOps.claim_milestone(game_manager.current_save_data, idx)
	if not prem.is_empty():
		var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
		if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
			sm.play_sound("upgrade", 0.9, 1.0)
	_refresh()


func _on_buy(shop_id: String) -> void:
	if game_manager == null or game_manager.current_save_data == null:
		return
	var payload := EventOps.shop_buy(game_manager.current_save_data, shop_id)
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("exchange" if not payload.is_empty() else "ui_hover", 0.7)
	_refresh()


func _on_play() -> void:
	close()
	# роутинг по базовому ивенту; не встроенные — «скоро»
	var game_script: GDScript = null
	match str(_event["base"]):
		"zharva":
			game_script = preload("res://ui/events/game_zharva.gd")
		"uley":
			game_script = preload("res://ui/events/game_uley.gd")
		"labyrinth":

		"chain":
			game_script = preload("res://ui/events/game_chain.gd")
		"vault":
			game_script = preload("res://ui/events/game_vault.gd")
		"bolts":
			game_script = preload("res://ui/events/game_bolts.gd")
	if game_script != null:
		var game: Control = game_script.new()

	else:

		var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
		if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
			sm.play_sound("ui_hover", 0.5)
		_show_message(Loc.t("evt.soon"))

# ui/events/game_bolts.gd
extends Control
class_name GameBolts

## «БОЛТЫ ГРАВИТОНА» (D24): физика-слэнгшот. Тяни рогатку, отпускай —
## болт летит по параболе; гравитационные карманы искривляют полёт
## (воронка — тянет внутрь, лифт — подкидывает, время — замедляет).
## Порази все мишени за отведённые болты. 30 уровней, счёт: уровень ×150
## + экономия бросков ×50 (+100 «золотой болт» за дугу через 2+ кармана);
## осколки = счёт / 200.

const LEVELS: int = 30
const G: float = 600.0
const LAUNCH_K: float = 3.2
const MAX_SPEED: float = 1300.0
const BOLT_R: float = 10.0
const TARGET_R: float = 26.0

var _level: int = 1
var _score: int = 0
var _over: bool = false
var _board: Control
var _player: Control          # рогатка/сталкер
var _launcher: Vector2
var _aiming: bool = false
var _aim_start: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _aim_cur: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _aim_line: Control = null
var _targets: Array = []      # [{node, base, phase, drift}]
var _zones: Array = []        # [{node, kind, pos, R}]
var _bolts: Array = []        # [{node, pos, vel, slow, pockets}]
var _bolt_budget: int = 0
var _event: Dictionary
var _game_manager: Node
var _info: Label
var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	_game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	_event = EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_build_chrome()
	_load_level(_level)


func _build_chrome() -> void:
	var shade := ColorRect.new()
	shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shade.color = Color(0.02, 0.02, 0.03)
	add_child(shade)

	var head := Label.new()
	head.text = Loc.t("evt.banner") % str(_event["title_" + ("ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en")])
	head.position = Vector2(20, 14)
	head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(head)

	_info = Label.new()
	_info.position = Vector2(20, 46)
	_info.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	_info.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	_info.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
	add_child(_info)

	var quit := Button.new()
	quit.text = "✕"
	quit.position = Vector2(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x - 60, 14)
	quit.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 44)
	BunkerUI.style_button(quit, "steel", 15)
	quit.pressed.connect(_finish)
	add_child(quit)


func _load_level(level: int) -> void:
	_level = level
	if _board:
		_board.queue_free()
	_board = Control.new()
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	_board.position = Vector2(0, 100)
	_board.size = Vector2(vp.x, vp.y - 190)
	add_child(_board)

	_rng.seed = 424000 + level
	_targets.clear()
	_zones.clear()
	_bolts.clear()

	# рогатка (сталкер-зевака): точка слева по центру
	_launcher = Vector2(70.0, _board.size.y * 0.5)
	_player = _make_dot(_launcher, 22.0, Color("8fd0e8"), "Σ")

	# мишени: правая половина, часть дрейфует по вертикали
	var count := mini(3 + level / 6, 7)
	for i in count:
		var pos := Vector2(
			_rng.randf_range(_board.size.x * 0.55, _board.size.x - 60.0),
			_rng.randf_range(70.0, _board.size.y - 70.0))
		var t := _make_dot(pos, TARGET_R, Color("ffd94d"), "◎")
		_targets.append({"node": t, "base": pos, "phase": _rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU),
			"drift": 40.0 * _rng.randf_range(0.0, 1.0) if level >= 4 else 0.0})

	# гравитационные карманы: 1-3 по уровню
	var zcount := mini(1 + level / 8, 3)
	var kinds := ["vortex", "lift", "time"]
	for i in zcount:
		var kind: String = kinds[_rng.randi_range(0, kinds.size() - 1)]
		var pos := Vector2(_rng.randf_range(_board.size.x * 0.28, _board.size.x * 0.68),
			_rng.randf_range(90.0, _board.size.y - 90.0))
		var R := _rng.randf_range(90.0, 140.0)
		var glyph := "🌀" if kind == "vortex" else "▲" if kind == "lift" else "⏳"
		var col := Color("5090e0") if kind == "vortex" else Color("50c878") if kind == "lift" else Color("a070e0")
		var z := _make_dot(pos, R, Color(col, 0.25), glyph)
		_zones.append({"node": z, "kind": kind, "pos": pos, "R": R})

	_bolt_budget = count + 2
	_update_info()


func _make_dot(pos: Vector2, r: float, col: Color, glyph: String) -> Control:
	var wrap := Control.new()
	wrap.position = pos - Vector2(r, r)
	wrap.size = Vector2(r * 2, r * 2)
	wrap.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var dot := Panel.new()
	dot.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(col, 0.35)
	sb.border_color = col
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(int(r))
	dot.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	dot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	wrap.add_child(dot)
	if glyph != "":
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		lbl.text = glyph
		lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(r))
		lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		wrap.add_child(lbl)
	_board.add_child(wrap)
	return wrap


func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	var board_pos: Vector2 = ev.position - _board.position
	if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if ev.pressed and board_pos.distance_to(_launcher) < 90.0:
			_aiming = true
			_aim_start = _launcher
			_aim_cur = board_pos
		elif not ev.pressed and _aiming:
			_aiming = false
			_launch()
			if _aim_line:
				_aim_line.queue_free()
				_aim_line = null
	elif ev is InputEventMouseMotion and _aiming:
		_aim_cur = board_pos
		_draw_aim()
	elif ev is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if ev.pressed and board_pos.distance_to(_launcher) < 110.0:
			_aiming = true
			_aim_start = _launcher
			_aim_cur = board_pos
		elif not ev.pressed and _aiming:
			_aiming = false
			_launch()


func _draw_aim() -> void:
	if _aim_line:
		_aim_line.queue_free()
	_aim_line = Control.new()
	_board.add_child(_aim_line)
	# траектория-превью: 18 точек симуляции
	var vel := _launch_velocity()
	var pos := _launcher
	for i in 20:
		vel.y += G * 0.05
		pos += vel * 0.05
		for z in _zones:
			var d: Vector2 = pos - z["pos"]
			if d.length() < float(z["R"]):
				if z["kind"] == "vortex":
					vel += -d.normalized() * 900.0 * 0.05
				elif z["kind"] == "lift":
					vel.y -= 1100.0 * 0.05
		var dot := _make_dot(pos, 5.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5), "")
		_aim_line.add_child(dot)


func _launch_velocity() -> Vector2:
	var pull := _aim_start - _aim_cur   # тянем назад — летит вперёд
	var vel := pull * LAUNCH_K
	if vel.length() > MAX_SPEED:
		vel = vel.normalized() * MAX_SPEED
	return vel


func _launch() -> void:
	var vel := _launch_velocity()
	if vel.length() < 120.0:
		return   # слишком слабый бросок — не тратим болт
	_bolt_budget -= 1
	var b := _make_dot(_launcher, BOLT_R, Color("e8f2e4"), "")
	_bolts.append({"node": b, "pos": _launcher, "vel": vel, "slow": 1.0,
		"pockets": {}, "t": 0.0})
	_update_info()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	# дрейф мишеней
	for t in _targets:
		if float(t["drift"]) > 0.0:
			t["phase"] += delta * 1.4
			var pos: Vector2 = t["base"] + Vector2(0, sin(float(t["phase"])) * float(t["drift"]))
			t["pos"] = pos
			t["node"].position = pos - t["node"].size * 0.5
	# болты
	for b in _bolts.duplicate():
		b["t"] = float(b["t"]) + delta
		if float(b["t"]) > 12.0:
			_bolts.erase(b)
			b["node"].queue_free()
			if _bolts.is_empty() and _bolt_budget <= 0 and not _targets.is_empty():
				_finish()
			continue
		b["slow"] = 1.0
		var hit_pockets := 0
		for z in _zones:
			var d: Vector2 = b["pos"] - z["pos"]
			if d.length() < float(z["R"]):
				hit_pockets += 1
				if z["kind"] == "vortex":
					b["vel"] += -d.normalized() * 900.0 * delta
				elif z["kind"] == "lift":
					b["vel"].y -= 1100.0 * delta
				elif z["kind"] == "time":
					b["slow"] = 0.45
		b["pockets"] = hit_pockets
		b["vel"].y += G * delta
		b["pos"] += b["vel"] * delta * float(b["slow"])
		b["node"].position = b["pos"] - b["node"].size * 0.5
		# попадания
		for t in _targets.duplicate():
			if b["pos"].distance_to(t.get("pos", t["base"])) <= TARGET_R:
				_target_hit(t, int(b["pockets"]))
		# улетел за поле
		if b["pos"].x > _board.size.x + 60.0 or b["pos"].y > _board.size.y + 60.0 \
				or b["pos"].x < -60.0 or b["pos"].y < -60.0:
			_bolts.erase(b)
			b["node"].queue_free()
			if _bolts.is_empty() and _bolt_budget <= 0 and not _targets.is_empty():
				_finish()
	# уровень пройден?
	if not _over and _targets.is_empty():
		_score += 150 * _level + maxf(0, _bolt_budget) * 50
		if _level >= LEVELS:
			_score += 1000
			_finish()
		else:
			_flash(Loc.t("bolts.cleared") % _level)
			_load_level(_level + 1)


func _target_hit(t: Dictionary, pockets: int) -> void:
	_targets.erase(t)
	t["node"].queue_free()
	_score += 50
	if pockets >= 2:
		_score += 100   # золотой болт
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("anomaly_hit", 0.6, 1.1)
	if _targets.is_empty():
		pass   # обработается в _process


func _update_info() -> void:
	_info.text = "%s %d/%d   ·   %s %d   ·   %s %d" % [
		Loc.t("bolts.level"), _level, LEVELS,
		Loc.t("bolts.bolts"), _bolt_budget,
		Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score]


func _flash(text: String) -> void:
	var note := Label.new()
	note.text = text
	note.anchor_left = 0.5
	note.anchor_right = 0.5
	note.anchor_top = 1.0
	note.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	note.offset_left = -240
	note.offset_right = 240
	note.offset_top = -92
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(note)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.1)
	tw.tween_property(note, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	tw.tween_callback(note.queue_free)


func _finish() -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	_over = true
	var shards := 0
	if _game_manager and _game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(_game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		_game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win", 0.8)
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("bolts.done")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)

# ui/events/game_chain.gd
extends Control
class_name GameChain

## «ЦЕПЬ ЭЛЕКТРЫ» (D24): pipes-головоломка. Вращай трубы (тап = 90°),
## замкни цепь от Теслы к Монолиту до таймера. Уровни процедурные
## (seed = номер уровня — гарантированно решаемые): генерируется решённая
## цепь, повороты перемешиваются. Конденсатор пропускает ток при 2 входах.
## Счёт: уровень ×100 + остаток времени ×5; осколки = счёт/300.

const DIRS := [Vector2i(0, -1), Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(-1, 0)]

const TIMER_MIN: float = 25.0
const LEVELS: int = 40

var _level: int = 1
var _w: int = 5
var _h: int = 4
var _cells: Array = []            # [y][x] -> {mask:int, fixed:bool, cond:bool}

var _solved: bool = false
var _time_left: float = TIMER_START
var _score: int = 0
var _over: bool = false
var _board: Control
var _cell_panels: Array = []
var _info: Label

var _event: Dictionary
var _game_manager: Node


func _ready() -> void:
	_game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")

	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_build_chrome()
	_load_level(_level)


func _build_chrome() -> void:

# ==================== ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ УРОВНЯ ====================

func _load_level(level: int) -> void:
	_level = level
	_w = mini(5 + (level - 1) / 7, 8)
	_h = mini(4 + (level - 1) / 9, 6)
	_time_left = maxf(TIMER_MIN, TIMER_START - float(level) * 0.8)
	_solved = false

	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 777000 + level

	_cells.clear()
	_powered.clear()
	for y in _h:
		var row: Array = []
		var prow: Array = []
		for x in _w:
			row.append({"mask": 0, "fixed": false, "cond": false})
			prow.append(false)
		_cells.append(row)
		_powered.append(prow)

	# Источник слева, сток справа
	var src := Vector2i(0, rng.randi_range(0, _h - 1))
	var dst := Vector2i(_w - 1, rng.randi_range(0, _h - 1))
	_cells[src.y][src.x] = {"mask": 2, "fixed": true, "cond": false}    # Tesla -> E
	_cells[dst.y][dst.x] = {"mask": 8, "fixed": true, "cond": false}    # Monolith <- W

	# Главный путь: монотонный блуждание вправо
	var path: Array = [src]
	var cur := src
	while cur.x < dst.x or cur.y != dst.y:
		var step: Vector2i
		if cur.x < dst.x and (cur.y == dst.y or rng.randf() < 0.6):
			step = Vector2i(1, 0)
		else:
			step = Vector2i(0, signi(dst.y - cur.y))
		cur += step
		path.append(cur)

	# Маски главного пути (связь к предыдущему и следующему);
	# Тесла/Монолит - fixed, но СМОТРЯТ на фактический шаг пути
	for i in range(1, path.size() - 1):
		var p: Vector2i = path[i]
		if _cells[p.y][p.x]["fixed"]:
			continue
		var m := _dir_to(path[i - 1], p) | _dir_to(path[i + 1], p)
		_cells[p.y][p.x]["mask"] = m
	_cells[src.y][src.x]["mask"] = _dir_to(src, path[1])
	_cells[dst.y][dst.x]["mask"] = _dir_to(dst, path[path.size() - 2])

	# Ветки-декойи (2-4 шага в свободные клетки)
	var branches := mini(1 + level / 12, 3)
	for b in branches:
		var start: Vector2i = path[rng.randi_range(1, path.size() - 2)]
		cur = start
		for step_n in rng.randi_range(2, 4):
			var free: Array = []
			for d in DIRS:
				var nxt: Vector2i = cur + d
				if nxt.x >= 0 and nxt.x < _w and nxt.y >= 0 and nxt.y < _h \
						and _cells[nxt.y][nxt.x]["mask"] == 0:
					free.append(nxt)
			if free.is_empty():
				break
			var nxt: Vector2i = free[rng.randi_range(0, free.size() - 1)]
			var d := nxt - cur
			_cells[cur.y][cur.x]["mask"] |= _dir_mask(d)
			_cells[nxt.y][nxt.x]["mask"] = _dir_mask(-d)
			cur = nxt

	# Конденсатор (ур. 10+): на главном пути; вторая ветка к нему от источника
	if level >= 10:
		var mid_i: int = path.size() / 2
		var mid: Vector2i = path[mid_i]
		_cells[mid.y][mid.x]["cond"] = true
		# вторая ветка: шагаем влево по пустым клеткам, пока не упрёмся
		# в уже подключённую клетку сети (тогда 2-й вход гарантирован)
		var back: Vector2i = mid
		var guard := 0
		while guard < _w:
			guard += 1
			var target: Vector2i = Vector2i(back.x - 1, back.y)
			if target.x < 0 or _cells[target.y][target.x]["fixed"]:
				break
			_cells[back.y][back.x]["mask"] |= _dir_to(back, target)
			if _cells[target.y][target.x]["mask"] != 0:
				_cells[target.y][target.x]["mask"] |= _dir_to(target, back)
				break   # упёрлись в сеть - цепь замкнута
			_cells[target.y][target.x]["mask"] = _dir_to(target, back)
			back = target

	# Декой-трубы в пустых клетках
	for y in _h:
		for x in _w:
			if _cells[y][x]["mask"] == 0 and not Vector2i(x, y) in [src, dst]:
				var kinds := [3, 6, 12, 9, 5, 10]   # прямые и углы
				_cells[y][x]["mask"] = kinds[rng.randi_range(0, kinds.size() - 1)]

	# Перемешать повороты (не трогая фиксированные)
	for y in _h:
		for x in _w:
			if not _cells[y][x]["fixed"]:
				var rot := rng.randi_range(0, 3)
				for i in rot:
					_cells[y][x]["mask"] = _rot90(_cells[y][x]["mask"])

	# Гарантия «не решено сразу»
	if _is_solved():
		var x2 := rng.randi_range(1, _w - 2)
		var y2 := rng.randi_range(0, _h - 1)
		if not _cells[y2][x2]["fixed"]:
			_cells[y2][x2]["mask"] = _rot90(_cells[y2][x2]["mask"])

	_propagate_power()
	_draw_board()
	_update_info()


func _dir_to(from: Vector2i, to: Vector2i) -> int:
	var d: Vector2i = to - from
	for i in DIRS.size():
		if DIRS[i] == d:
			return 1 << i
	return 0


func _dir_mask(d: Vector2i) -> int:
	for i in DIRS.size():
		if DIRS[i] == d:
			return 1 << i
	return 0


func _rot90(mask: int) -> int:
	# поворот по часовой: N->E, E->S, S->W, W->N
	return ((mask << 1) & 0b1111) | (mask >> 3)


func _opposite(mask: int) -> int:
	return ((mask << 2) & 0b1111) | (mask >> 2)


## Распространение тока до стабилизации (конденсатор требует 2 входа)
func _propagate_power() -> void:
	for y in _h:
		for x in _w:
			_powered[y][x] = false
	var changed := true
	var guard := 0
	while changed and guard < _w * _h + 4:
		guard += 1
		changed = false
		for y in _h:
			for x in _w:
				if _powered[y][x] or _cells[y][x]["mask"] == 0:
					continue
				var inputs := 0
				for i in DIRS.size():
					if (_cells[y][x]["mask"] & (1 << i)) == 0:
						continue
					var n: Vector2i = Vector2i(x, y) + DIRS[i]
					if n.x < 0 or n.x >= _w or n.y < 0 or n.y >= _h:
						continue
					if _powered[n.y][n.x] and (_cells[n.y][n.x]["mask"] & (1 << ((i + 2) % 4))) != 0:
						inputs += 1
				var need := 2 if _cells[y][x]["cond"] else 1
				if inputs >= need:
					_powered[y][x] = true
					changed = true


func _is_solved() -> bool:
	_propagate_power()
	for y in _h:
		for x in _w:
			if _cells[y][x]["fixed"] and _cells[y][x]["mask"] == 8:
				return _powered[y][x]
	return false


# ==================== ОТОБРАЖЕНИЕ И ВВОД ====================

func _draw_board() -> void:
	if _board:
		_board.queue_free()
	_board = Control.new()
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var cs := minf((vp.x - 60.0) / float(_w), (vp.y - 200.0) / float(_h))
	_board.position = Vector2((vp.x - float(_w) * cs) * 0.5,
		maxf((vp.y - float(_h) * cs) * 0.55, 110.0))
	_board.size = Vector2(float(_w) * cs, float(_h) * cs)
	add_child(_board)
	_cell_panels.clear()

	for y in _h:
		var prow: Array = []
		for x in _w:
			prow.append(_make_pipe_cell(Vector2i(x, y), cs))
		_cell_panels.append(prow)


func _make_pipe_cell(cell: Vector2i, cs: float) -> Control:
	var wrap := Control.new()
	wrap.position = Vector2(cell.x * cs, cell.y * cs)
	wrap.size = Vector2(cs, cs)
	wrap.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	wrap.gui_input.connect(_on_cell_input.bind(cell))
	_board.add_child(wrap)

	var base := ColorRect.new()
	base.position = Vector2(2, 2)
	base.size = Vector2(cs - 4, cs - 4)
	base.color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.06)
	base.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	wrap.add_child(base)

	var c: Dictionary = _cells[cell.y][cell.x]
	var mid := cs * 0.5
	var bar := cs * 0.22
	var powered: bool = _powered[cell.y][cell.x]
	var wire := BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT if powered else Color(0.35, 0.38, 0.34)
	if c["fixed"]:
		wire = Color(0.55, 0.85, 0.95) if c["mask"] == 2 else BunkerUI.GREEN
	for i in DIRS.size():
		if (int(c["mask"]) & (1 << i)) == 0:
			continue
		var bar_rect := ColorRect.new()
		bar_rect.color = wire
		bar_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		match i:
			0:   # N
				bar_rect.position = Vector2(mid - bar * 0.5, 2)
				bar_rect.size = Vector2(bar, mid - 2)
			1:   # E
				bar_rect.position = Vector2(mid, mid - bar * 0.5)
				bar_rect.size = Vector2(mid - 2, bar)
			2:   # S
				bar_rect.position = Vector2(mid - bar * 0.5, mid)
				bar_rect.size = Vector2(bar, mid - 2)
			3:   # W
				bar_rect.position = Vector2(2, mid - bar * 0.5)
				bar_rect.size = Vector2(mid - 2, bar)
		wrap.add_child(bar_rect)

	var glyph := Label.new()
	glyph.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	glyph.text = "⚡" if int(c["mask"]) == 2 else "🏛" if c["fixed"] else "◈" if c["cond"] else ""
	glyph.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	glyph.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	glyph.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(cs * 0.4))
	glyph.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	wrap.add_child(glyph)
	return wrap


func _on_cell_input(ev: InputEvent, cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	if _over or _solved:
		return
	if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if _cells[cell.y][cell.x]["fixed"]:
			return
		_cells[cell.y][cell.x]["mask"] = _rot90(int(_cells[cell.y][cell.x]["mask"]))
		_propagate_power()
		var was := _solved
		_solved = _is_solved()
		_redraw_cell(cell)
		if _solved and not was:
			_level_cleared()


func _redraw_cell(cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	var cs := _board.size.x / float(_w)
	var old: Control = _cell_panels[cell.y][cell.x]
	old.queue_free()
	_cell_panels[cell.y][cell.x] = _make_pipe_cell(cell, cs)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	if not _solved:
		_time_left -= delta
		if _time_left <= 0.0:
			_time_left = 0.0
			_over = true
			_flash(Loc.t("chain.timeout"))
			_finish()
			return
	_time_bar.max_value = maxf(TIMER_START - float(_level) * 0.8, TIMER_MIN)
	_time_bar.value = _time_left
	_update_info()


func _level_cleared() -> void:
	_score += _level * 100 + int(_time_left) * 5
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("anomaly_electric" if sm.get("anomaly_sounds").has("anomaly_electric") else "electric", 0.7)
	_flash(Loc.t("chain.closed"))
	# короткая пауза и следующий уровень (или финал)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.1)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		if _level >= LEVELS:
			_score += 2000
			_finish()
		else:
			_solved = false
			_load_level(_level + 1))


func _flash(text: String) -> void:
	var note := Label.new()
	note.text = text
	note.anchor_left = 0.5
	note.anchor_right = 0.5
	note.anchor_top = 1.0
	note.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	note.offset_left = -240
	note.offset_right = 240
	note.offset_top = -92
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(note)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.1)
	tw.tween_property(note, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	tw.tween_callback(note.queue_free)


func _update_info() -> void:
	_info.text = "%s %d/%d   ·   %s %d" % [
		Loc.t("chain.level"), _level, LEVELS,
		Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score]


func _finish() -> void:
	_over = true
	var shards := 0
	if _game_manager and _game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(_game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		_game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win", 0.8)
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("chain.done")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)

# ui/events/game_labyrinth.gd
extends Control
class_name GameLabyrinth

## «ЛАБИРИНТ ВЫБРОСА» (D24): maze-TD. Лабиринт 13×9 генерируется по дню
## (все игроки — один и тот же), сталкеры идут от входа к выходу по
## кратчайшему пути; строишь аномалии в клетках за энергию — жги и
## задерживай. 8 волн; 5 прорвавшихся — конец. Счёт -> осколки (/80).

const COLS: int = 13
const ROWS: int = 9
const CS: float = 56.0
const WAVES: int = 8
const ESCAPE_LIMIT: int = 5
const ENERGY_START: float = 500.0
const ENERGY_PER_KILL: float = 12.0

# Аномалии постройки: цена / dps / радиус (клеток) / замедление
const BUILDS := {
	"zharva_a": {"cost": 50.0, "dps": 25.0, "radius": 1.0, "slow": 0.0, "glyph": "🔥", "col": Color("e06040")},
	"electra_a": {"cost": 90.0, "dps": 40.0, "radius": 1.5, "slow": 0.0, "glyph": "⚡", "col": Color("e8c840")},
	"vortex_a": {"cost": 120.0, "dps": 10.0, "radius": 2.0, "slow": 0.5, "glyph": "🌀", "col": Color("5090e0")},
	"tesla_a": {"cost": 200.0, "dps": 90.0, "radius": 2.0, "slow": 0.0, "glyph": "☢", "col": Color("a070e0")},
}

var _walls: Array = []            # [y][x] -> true = стена
var _dist: Array = []             # BFS-дистанции до выхода
var _enemies: Array = []          # [{node, hp, speed, cell, next, t, slow_t}]
var _builds: Array = []           # [{node, key, cell, tick}]
var _wave: int = 0
var _spawn_queue: int = 0
var _spawn_t: float = 0.0
var _wave_break: float = 2.0
var _energy: float = ENERGY_START
var _score: int = 0
var _escaped: int = 0
var _over: bool = false
var _selected: String = ""
var _board: Control
var _info: Label

var _event: Dictionary
var _game_manager: Node
var _tick: float = 0.0


func _ready() -> void:
	_game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	_event = EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

			Loc.t("lab.slow") if float(def["slow"]) > 0.0 else ""]
		_dock.add_child(b)

	var quit := Button.new()
	quit.text = "✕"
	quit.position = Vector2(vp.x - 60, 14)
	quit.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 44)

func _on_build_selected(key: String) -> void:

# ==================== ЛАБИРИНТ ====================

## Карвинг лабиринта по чётным узлам (классический DFS) + просветы-петли.
## Seed дня: у всех игроков сегодня один и тот же лабиринт.
func _gen_maze() -> void:
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	var day := Time.get_date_dict_from_system()
	rng.seed = int(day["year"]) * 10000 + int(day["month"]) * 100 + int(day["day"])
	_walls.clear()
	for y in ROWS:
		var row: Array = []
		for x in COLS:
			row.append(true)
		_walls.append(row)
	# DFS по узлам (нечётные координаты)
	var stack: Array = [Vector2i(1, 1)]
	_walls[1][1] = false
	while not stack.is_empty():
		var cur: Vector2i = stack.back()
		var dirs: Array = [Vector2i(2, 0), Vector2i(-2, 0), Vector2i(0, 2), Vector2i(0, -2)]
		# сидированный Fisher-Yates: лабиринт дня одинаков у всех игроков
		for i in range(dirs.size() - 1, 0, -1):
			var j := rng.randi_range(0, i)
			var tmp_d: Vector2i = dirs[i]
			dirs[i] = dirs[j]
			dirs[j] = tmp_d
		var moved := false
		for d in dirs:
			var nxt: Vector2i = cur + d
			if nxt.x >= 1 and nxt.x < COLS - 1 and nxt.y >= 1 and nxt.y < ROWS - 1 \
					and _walls[nxt.y][nxt.x]:
				_walls[cur.y + (d.y >> 1)][cur.x + (d.x >> 1)] = false
				_walls[nxt.y][nxt.x] = false
				stack.append(nxt)
				moved = true
				break
		if not moved:
			stack.pop_back()
	# петли: прорезаем случайные стены (rng дня)
	var cuts := 0
	var tries := 0
	while cuts < 10 and tries < 200:
		tries += 1
		var x := rng.randi_range(1, COLS - 2)
		var y := rng.randi_range(1, ROWS - 2)
		if not _walls[y][x]:
			continue
		var horiz_open: bool = not _walls[y][x - 1] and not _walls[y][x + 1]
		var vert_open: bool = not _walls[y - 1][x] and not _walls[y + 1][x]
		if horiz_open or vert_open:
			_walls[y][x] = false
			cuts += 1
	# вход/выход
	_walls[1][0] = false
	_walls[ROWS - 2][COLS - 1] = false


## BFS-дистанции до выхода (ROWS-2, COLS-1)
func _bfs() -> void:
	_dist.clear()
	for y in ROWS:
		var row: Array = []
		for x in COLS:
			row.append(-1)
		_dist.append(row)
	var start := Vector2i(COLS - 1, ROWS - 2)
	var q: Array = [start]
	_dist[start.y][start.x] = 0
	var head := 0
	while head < q.size():
		var cur: Vector2i = q[head]
		head += 1
		for d in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1)]:
			var nxt: Vector2i = cur + d
			if nxt.x < 0 or nxt.x >= COLS or nxt.y < 0 or nxt.y >= ROWS:
				continue
			if _walls[nxt.y][nxt.x] or _dist[nxt.y][nxt.x] != -1:
				continue
			_dist[nxt.y][nxt.x] = _dist[cur.y][cur.x] + 1
			q.append(nxt)
	# отрисовка пола/стен
	for y in ROWS:
		for x in COLS:
			var cell := ColorRect.new()
			cell.position = Vector2(x * CS, y * CS)
			cell.size = Vector2(CS - 1.0, CS - 1.0)
			if _walls[y][x]:
				cell.color = Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.16)
			elif Vector2i(x, y) == Vector2i(0, 1) or Vector2i(x, y) == Vector2i(COLS - 1, ROWS - 2):
				cell.color = Color(0.45, 0.35, 0.1)   # вход/выход золотом
			else:
				cell.color = Color(0.07, 0.09, 0.07)
			cell.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
			if not _walls[y][x]:
				cell.gui_input.connect(_on_cell_input.bind(Vector2i(x, y)))
			_board.add_child(cell)


func _on_cell_input(ev: InputEvent, cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	if _over or _selected == "" or not (ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed):
		return
	_place_build(cell)


func _place_build(cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	if _walls[cell.y][cell.x] or _dist[cell.y][cell.x] == -1:
		return
	var def: Dictionary = BUILDS[_selected]
	if _energy < float(def["cost"]):
		_flash(Loc.t("labyrinth.no_energy"))
		return
	for b in _builds:
		if b["cell"] == cell:
			return   # клетка занята
	_energy -= float(def["cost"])
	var node := _make_dot(_cell_center(cell), 20.0, def["col"], str(def["glyph"]))
	_builds.append({"node": node, "key": _selected, "cell": cell, "tick": 0.0})
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.6)


func _cell_center(cell: Vector2i) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(cell.x * CS + CS * 0.5, cell.y * CS + CS * 0.5)


# ==================== ВОЛНЫ И ВРАГИ ====================

func _start_wave(n: int) -> void:
	_wave = n
	_spawn_queue = 4 + n * 2
	_spawn_t = 0.0
	_flash(Loc.t("labyrinth.wave") % n)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	# спавн волны
	if _spawn_queue > 0:
		_spawn_t -= delta
		if _spawn_t <= 0.0:
			_spawn_t = 1.1
			_spawn_queue -= 1
			_spawn_enemy(_wave)
	elif _enemies.is_empty():
		if _wave_break > 0.0:
			_wave_break -= delta
			if _wave_break <= 0.0:
				_wave_break = 2.0
				if _wave >= WAVES:
					_finish(true)
					return
				_start_wave(_wave + 1)
		elif _spawn_queue == 0 and _enemies.is_empty():
			_wave_break = 2.0

	# башни: тик урона 4 раза/с
	_tick += delta
	if _tick >= 0.25:
		_tick = 0.0
		_towers_tick()

	# враги
	for e in _enemies.duplicate():
		_move_enemy(e, delta)
	_update_info()


func _towers_tick() -> void:
	for b in _builds:
		var def: Dictionary = BUILDS[b["key"]]
		b["tick"] = float(b["tick"]) + 0.25
		if float(b["tick"]) < 0.5:
			continue
		b["tick"] = 0.0
		var center: Vector2 = _cell_center(b["cell"])
		var radius: float = float(def["radius"]) * CS
		var deads: Array = []
		for e in _enemies:
			if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0:
				continue
			if e["pos"].distance_to(center) <= radius:
				e["hp"] -= float(def["dps"]) * 0.5
				if float(def["slow"]) > 0.0:
					e["slow_t"] = 0.6
					e["slow_f"] = float(def["slow"])
				if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0:
					deads.append(e)
		for e in deads:
			_on_enemy_dead(e)


func _spawn_enemy(wave: int) -> void:
	var cell := Vector2i(0, 1)
	var hp := 60.0 * (1.0 + 0.35 * float(wave - 1))
	var speed := 70.0 + 6.0 * float(wave)
	var node := _make_dot(_cell_center(cell), 15.0, Color("d0d0d0"), "")
	var path := _descent_path(cell)
	_enemies.append({"node": node, "hp": hp, "max_hp": hp, "speed": speed,
		"path": path, "idx": 0, "pos": _cell_center(cell), "wave": wave,
		"slow_t": 0.0, "slow_f": 0.0})


## Путь спуском по BFS-полю (от входа к выходу)
func _descent_path(from: Vector2i) -> Array:
	var path: Array = [from]
	var cur := from
	var guard := 0
	while _dist[cur.y][cur.x] != 0 and guard < COLS * ROWS:
		guard += 1
		var stepped := false
		for d in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1)]:
			var nxt: Vector2i = cur + d
			if nxt.x < 0 or nxt.x >= COLS or nxt.y < 0 or nxt.y >= ROWS:
				continue
			if _dist[nxt.y][nxt.x] == _dist[cur.y][cur.x] - 1:
				cur = nxt
				path.append(cur)
				stepped = true
				break
		if not stepped:
			break   # поля консистентны — не бывает, но без вечного цикла
	return path


func _move_enemy(e: Dictionary, delta: float) -> void:
	if float(e["slow_t"]) > 0.0:
		e["slow_t"] = float(e["slow_t"]) - delta
	var slow: float = float(e["slow_f"]) if float(e["slow_t"]) > 0.0 else 0.0
	var speed: float = float(e["speed"]) * (1.0 - slow)
	var path: Array = e["path"]
	var idx: int = int(e["idx"])
	if idx >= path.size():
		_escape(e)
		return
	var target: Vector2 = _cell_center(path[idx])
	var pos: Vector2 = e["pos"]
	var to := target - pos
	if to.length() < 4.0:
		e["idx"] = idx + 1
		return
	e["pos"] = pos + to.normalized() * speed * delta
	e["node"].position = e["pos"] - e["node"].size * 0.5


func _escape(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	_enemies.erase(e)
	e["node"].queue_free()
	_escaped += 1
	_flash(Loc.t("labyrinth.escaped"))
	if _escaped >= ESCAPE_LIMIT:
		_finish(false)


func _on_enemy_dead(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	_enemies.erase(e)
	e["node"].queue_free()
	_energy += ENERGY_PER_KILL
	_score += 10 + 5 * int(e.get("wave", 1))
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("anomaly_hit", 0.5, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))


func _update_info() -> void:
	var pending := _spawn_queue + _enemies.size()
	_info.text = "%s %d/%d   ·   ⚡ %d   ·   %s %d/%d   ·   %s %d" % [
		Loc.t("labyrinth.wave_short"), _wave, WAVES,
		int(_energy),
		Loc.t("labyrinth.escape"), _escaped, ESCAPE_LIMIT,
		Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score]


func _finish(win: bool) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	_over = true
	if win:
		_score += 500
	var shards := 0
	if _game_manager and _game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(_game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		_game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win" if win else "pulse_warning", 0.8,
			1.0 if win else 0.7)
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD if win else BunkerUI.DANGER
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("labyrinth.win") if win else Loc.t("labyrinth.lost")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)


func _make_dot(pos: Vector2, r: float, col: Color, glyph: String) -> Control:
	var wrap_root := Control.new()
	wrap_root.position = pos - Vector2(r, r)
	wrap_root.size = Vector2(r * 2, r * 2)
	wrap_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var dot := Panel.new()
	dot.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = col.darkened(0.4)
	sb.border_color = col
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(int(r))
	dot.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	dot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	wrap_root.add_child(dot)
	if glyph != "":
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		lbl.text = glyph
		lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(r))
		lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		wrap_root.add_child(lbl)
	_board.add_child(wrap_root)
	return wrap_root

func _setup_room() -> void:
	# будка вызова в случайном углу (кроме низа)
	var corners := [Vector2(70, 70), Vector2(ROOM_W - 70, 70), Vector2(70, 140)]
	_caller_pos = corners[randi() % corners.size()]
	_caller_hp = CALLER_HP
	_caller = _make_dot(_caller_pos, 22.0, Color("c99a1e"), "⛏")
	_enemies.clear()
	var defs: Array = []
	match _room:
		1:

		3:
			defs = [["veteran", 4], ["master", 1], ["medic", 2]]
		4:
			defs = [["veteran", 3], ["master", 3], ["medic", 2]]
		5:

	for pair in defs:

	_update_hud()


func _spawn_enemy(type: String) -> void:
	var def: Dictionary = ENEMY_DEFS[type]
	var pos := _free_spot()
	var node := _make_dot(pos, float(def["r"]), def["col"], _glyph_for(type))
	_enemies.append({"node": node, "type": type, "hp": float(def["hp"]), "pos": pos})


func _spawn_boss() -> void:

	_enemies.append({"node": node, "type": "boss", "hp": BOSS_HP, "pos": pos,
		"shield": BOSS_SHIELD, "shield_t": 0.0})

	match type:

		"master": return "М"

func _alive_enemies() -> int:
	var n := 0
