func _free_spot() -> Vector2:
	for i in 40:
		var p := Vector2(randf_range(60, ROOM_W - 60), randf_range(60, ROOM_H * 0.55))
		if p.distance_to(_player_pos) > 220.0:
			return p
	return Vector2(randf_range(60, ROOM_W - 60), 120.0)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	_no_dmg_t += delta
	_jump_cd = maxf(0.0, _jump_cd - delta)
	var speed := PLAYER_SPEED * (1.25 if _bless.has("speed") else 1.0)

	# движение: WASD + тап-цель
	var dir := Vector2.ZERO
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP):
		dir.y -= 1
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN):
		dir.y += 1
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
		dir.x -= 1
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
		dir.x += 1
	if dir != Vector2.ZERO:
		_player_pos += dir.normalized() * speed * delta
	elif _input_point != Vector2.ZERO:
		var to := _input_point - _player_pos
		if to.length() > 6.0:
			_player_pos += to.normalized() * speed * delta
	_player_pos.x = clampf(_player_pos.x, 34.0, ROOM_W - 34.0)
	_player_pos.y = clampf(_player_pos.y, 34.0, ROOM_H - 34.0)
	_player.position = _player_pos - _player.size * 0.5

	# ярость
	if _rage:
		if not _bless.has("rage_free"):
			_hp -= RAGE_COST * delta
		if _hp <= 0.0:
			_finish(false)
			return

	# враги
	var dmg_mult: float = RAGE_MULT if _rage else 1.0
	if _bless.has("dmg"):
		dmg_mult *= 1.25
	for e in _enemies.duplicate():
		if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0:
			continue
		var def: Dictionary = ENEMY_DEFS.get(e["type"], {})
		var epos: Vector2 = e["pos"]
		var to_player := _player_pos - epos
		# босс: щит по кулдауну
		if e["type"] == "boss":
			e["shield_t"] = float(e["shield_t"]) - delta
			if e["shield_t"] <= 0.0:
				e["shield"] = BOSS_SHIELD
				e["shield_t"] = 6.0
		if e["type"] == "medic":
			# медик бежит к будке; добежал — зовёт подкрепление и отходит
			# (кулдаун, чтобы поток новичков не был бесконечным)
			e["call_cd"] = float(e.get("call_cd", 0.0)) - delta
			var to_call: Vector2 = _caller_pos - epos
			if _caller_hp <= 0.0:
				pass   # будка разбита — медики мечутся (стоят на месте)
			elif to_call.length() > 14.0:
				epos += to_call.normalized() * float(def["speed"]) * delta
			elif float(e.get("call_cd", 0.0)) <= 0.0 and _alive_enemies() < 12:
				_spawn_enemy("novice")
				e["call_cd"] = 10.0
				epos -= to_call.normalized() * 60.0   # отходит от будки
		else:
			if to_player.length() > float(def.get("r", 16.0)) + 24.0:
				epos += to_player.normalized() * float(def["speed"]) * delta
			else:
				# кусает химеру
				_no_dmg_t = 0.0
				_hp -= float(def["dmg"]) * delta * 2.0
		e["pos"] = epos
		e["node"].position = epos - e["node"].size * 0.5

	# автоукус химеры по касанию
	for e in _enemies:
		if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0:
			continue
		var def: Dictionary = ENEMY_DEFS.get(e["type"], {})
		if e["pos"].distance_to(_player_pos) < float(def.get("r", 16.0)) + 30.0:
			var dps: float = 40.0 * dmg_mult
			if e["type"] == "boss" and float(e.get("shield", 0.0)) > 0.0:
				e["shield"] = float(e["shield"]) - dps * delta
			else:
				e["hp"] = float(e["hp"]) - dps * delta
	# химера грызёт будку вплотную
	if _caller_hp > 0.0 and _player_pos.distance_to(_caller_pos) < 60.0:
		_caller_hp -= 40.0 * delta
		if _caller_hp <= 0.0:
			_caller.visible = false
			_score += 100
	_kill_check()
	_update_hud()
	if _hp <= 0.0:
		_finish(false)


func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		_input_point = _arena_pos(ev.position)
		if _jump_cd <= 0.0:
			_do_jump()
	elif ev is InputEventMouseMotion:
		if Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT):
			_input_point = _arena_pos(ev.position)
	elif ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not ev.pressed:
		_rage = false
	elif ev is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if ev.pressed:
			_input_point = _arena_pos(ev.position)
			if _jump_cd <= 0.0:
				_do_jump()
		else:
			_rage = false


func _arena_pos(screen_pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	return screen_pos - _arena.position


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# ярость: зажатие на игроке (ПК) / длинный тап
	if _over:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
		_rage = event.pressed


func _do_jump() -> void:
	_jump_cd = JUMP_CD * (0.6 if _bless.has("jump_cd") else 1.0)
	var target := _input_point
	var radius: float = JUMP_R * (1.4 if _bless.has("jump_r") else 1.0)
	var dmg_mult: float = (RAGE_MULT if _rage else 1.0) * (1.25 if _bless.has("dmg") else 1.0)
	# анимация прыжка к точке (ограничение дальности 260)
	var delta := target - _player_pos
	if delta.length() > 260.0:
		target = _player_pos + delta.normalized() * 260.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(_player, "position", target - _player.size * 0.5, 0.14)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		_player_pos = target
		# кольцо АОЕ
		var ring := _make_dot(target - Vector2(radius, radius), radius,
			Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.1, 0.85), "")
		var tw2 := create_tween()
		tw2.tween_property(ring, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
		tw2.tween_callback(ring.queue_free)
		if _caller_hp > 0.0 and target.distance_to(_caller_pos) <= radius + 22.0:
			_caller_hp -= JUMP_DMG * dmg_mult
			if _caller_hp <= 0.0:
				_caller.visible = false
				_score += 100
		for e in _enemies:
			if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0:
				continue
			if e["pos"].distance_to(target) <= radius:
				var dmg: float = JUMP_DMG * dmg_mult
				if e["type"] == "boss" and float(e.get("shield", 0.0)) > 0.0:
					e["shield"] = float(e["shield"]) - dmg
				else:
					e["hp"] = float(e["hp"]) - dmg
		_kill_check())


func _kill_check() -> void:
	var alive := 0
	for e in _enemies:
		if float(e["hp"]) <= 0.0 and e["node"].visible:
			e["node"].visible = false
			var def: Dictionary = ENEMY_DEFS.get(e["type"], {})
			var mult := 2.0 if _no_dmg_t > 8.0 else 1.0
			_score += int(def.get("score", 10)) * int(mult)
		if float(e["hp"]) > 0.0:
			alive += 1
	if alive == 0:
		_room_cleared()


func _room_cleared() -> void:
	_score += int(200.0 / maxf(1.0, float(_room)))   # бонус за быстроту комнаты
	if _room >= ROOMS:
		_finish(true)
		return
	_room += 1
	_offer_blessings()


func _offer_blessings() -> void:
	_over = true
	var pick_a: String = _bless_pool[randi() % _bless_pool.size()]
	var pool2 := _bless_pool.duplicate()
	pool2.erase(pick_a)
	var pick_b: String = pool2[randi() % pool2.size()]
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -280
	panel.offset_right = 280
	panel.offset_top = -160
	panel.offset_bottom = 160
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.GREEN
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("uley.blessing")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	for pick in [pick_a, pick_b]:
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = Loc.t("uley.bless_" + pick)
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 54)
		BunkerUI.style_button(b, "steel", 15)
		b.pressed.connect(func():
			_bless[pick] = true
			panel.queue_free()
			_over = false
			_setup_room()
			_update_hud())
		v.add_child(b)


var _hud_lbl: Label = null
var _hud2_lbl: Label = null


func _update_hud() -> void:
	if _hud_lbl == null:
		_hud_lbl = Label.new()
		_hud_lbl.position = Vector2(20, 46)
		_hud_lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
		_hud_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
		_hud_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
		add_child(_hud_lbl)
	if _hud2_lbl == null:
		_hud2_lbl = Label.new()
		_hud2_lbl.position = Vector2(20, 66)
		_hud2_lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
		_hud2_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
		_hud2_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
		add_child(_hud2_lbl)
	var lang := "ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en"
	_hud_lbl.text = "%s %d/%d   ·   HP %.0f   ·   %s %d" % [
		Loc.t("uley.room"), _room, ROOMS, maxf(_hp, 0.0), Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score]
	var enemy_alive := 0
	for e in _enemies:
		if float(e["hp"]) > 0.0:
			enemy_alive += 1
	_hud2_lbl.text = "%s %d   ·   ⛏ %s: %.0f" % [
		Loc.t("uley.enemies"), enemy_alive,
		Loc.t("uley.caller"), maxf(_caller_hp, 0.0) if _caller_hp > 0.0 else 0.0]
	_hud2_lbl.text += "   ·   ⚡ %s" % Loc.t("uley.rage_on") if _rage else ""


func _finish(win: bool) -> void:
	if _over and not win:
		return
	_over = true
	if win:
		_score += 500
	var shards := 0
	if _game_manager and _game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(_game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		_game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win" if win else "pulse_warning", 0.8,
			1.0 if win else 0.7)
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD if win else BunkerUI.DANGER
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("uley.win") if win else Loc.t("uley.dead")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)

# ui/events/game_vault.gd
extends Control
class_name GameVault

## «ВЗЛОМ КОТЕЛКА» (D24): Mastermind-сейфы. Код из 4 аномалий (6 видов,
## повторы есть) — выставляй комбинацию, «Электра» показывает: ⚡ стоит на
## месте, ○ есть не на месте. 8 попыток на сейф, 5 сейфов (+6-й «сейф
## Котелка» с кодом из 5). Счёт: сейф ×500 − попытки ×40 (≤3 попыток ×2);
## осколки = счёт / 40.

const CODE_LEN: int = 4
const CODE_LEN_FINAL: int = 5
const TRIES: int = 8
const SAFES: int = 5
const SAFE_SCORE: int = 500
const TRY_PENALTY: int = 40
const GLYPHS := ["🔥", "⚡", "☣", "🌀", "☢", "⏳"]
const COLORS := [Color("e06040"), Color("e8c840"), Color("70c850"),
	Color("5090e0"), Color("b0e040"), Color("a070e0")]

var _code: Array = []             # скрытый код [int]
var _guess: Array = []            # текущая комбинация
var _tries_left: int = TRIES
var _safes_done: int = 0
var _score: int = 0
var _over: bool = false
var _history: VBoxContainer
var _slots_row: HBoxContainer
var _slot_btns: Array = []
var _head: Label
var _event: Dictionary
var _game_manager: Node


func _ready() -> void:
	_game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	_event = EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_build()
	_new_safe()


func _build() -> void:
	var shade := ColorRect.new()
	shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shade.color = Color(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)
	add_child(shade)

	var head := Label.new()
	head.text = Loc.t("evt.banner") % str(_event["title_" + ("ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en")])
	head.position = Vector2(20, 14)
	head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(head)

	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -320
	panel.offset_right = 320
	panel.offset_top = -320
	panel.offset_bottom = 320
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	_head = Label.new()
	_head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	_head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 17)
	_head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT)
	v.add_child(_head)

	var hint := Label.new()
	hint.text = Loc.t("vault.hint")
	hint.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	hint.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	hint.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
	v.add_child(hint)

	_slots_row = HBoxContainer.new()
	_slots_row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_slots_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	v.add_child(_slots_row)

	var submit := Button.new()
	submit.text = Loc.t("vault.submit")
	submit.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 52)
	BunkerUI.style_button(submit, "primary", 18, true)
	submit.pressed.connect(_on_submit)
	v.add_child(submit)

	_history = VBoxContainer.new()
	_history.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_history.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
	v.add_child(_history)


func _new_safe() -> void:
	var code_len: int = CODE_LEN_FINAL if _safes_done >= SAFES else CODE_LEN
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.randomize()
	_code.clear()
	for i in code_len:
		_code.append(rng.randi_range(0, GLYPHS.size() - 1))
	_guess.clear()
	for i in code_len:
		_guess.append(0)
	_tries_left = TRIES
	_slots_row.queue_free()
	_slots_row = HBoxContainer.new()
	_slots_row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_slots_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	# вставить слоты сразу после head (история должна остаться внизу)
	var v: VBoxContainer = _history.get_parent()
	v.add_child(_slots_row)
	v.move_child(_slots_row, 2)
	_slot_btns.clear()
	for i in code_len:
		var b := Button.new()
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(64, 64)
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
		BunkerUI.style_button(b, "steel", 16)
		b.pressed.connect(_on_slot.bind(i))
		_slots_row.add_child(b)
		_slot_btns.append(b)
	_style_slots()
	_head.text = "%s %d/%d%s   ·   %s %d" % [
		Loc.t("vault.safe"), _safes_done + 1,
		CODE_LEN_FINAL if _safes_done >= SAFES else SAFES,
		" · " + Loc.t("vault.kotelok") if _safes_done >= SAFES else "",
		Loc.t("vault.tries"), _tries_left]


func _style_slots() -> void:
	for i in _slot_btns.size():
		var b: Button = _slot_btns[i]
		b.text = GLYPHS[_guess[i]]
		var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		sb.bg_color = COLORS[_guess[i]].darkened(0.6)
		sb.border_color = COLORS[_guess[i]]
		sb.set_border_width_all(2)
		sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", sb)
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", sb)


func _on_slot(i: int) -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	_play_click()
	_guess[i] = (_guess[i] + 1) % GLYPHS.size()
	_style_slots()


func _on_submit() -> void:
	if _over:
		return
	_tries_left -= 1
	# фидбек Mastermind
	var exact := 0
	var partial := 0
	var code_left: Dictionary = {}
	var guess_left: Dictionary = {}
	for i in _code.size():
		if _guess[i] == _code[i]:
			exact += 1
		else:
			code_left[_code[i]] = int(code_left.get(_code[i], 0)) + 1
			guess_left[_guess[i]] = int(guess_left.get(_guess[i], 0)) + 1
	for k in guess_left:
		partial += mini(int(guess_left[k]), int(code_left.get(k, 0)))

	var row := Label.new()
	var pips := ""
	for i in exact:
		pips += "⚡"
	for i in partial:
		pips += "○"
	for i in _code.size() - exact - partial:
		pips += "✕"
	var guess_str := ""
	for g in _guess:
		guess_str += GLYPHS[g]
	row.text = "%s  %s" % [guess_str, pips]
	row.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	row.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	row.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	row.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
		BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT if exact == _code.size() else BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
	_history.add_child(row)

	if exact == _code.size():
		_safe_cracked()
	elif _tries_left <= 0:
		_flash(Loc.t("vault.failed"))
		_next_safe()
	else:
		_head.text = "%s %d   ·   %s %d" % [
			Loc.t("vault.safe"), _safes_done + 1, Loc.t("vault.tries"), _tries_left]


func _safe_cracked() -> void:
	var bonus := 2 if _tries_left >= TRIES - 3 else 1
	_score += maxi(0, SAFE_SCORE - (TRIES - _tries_left) * TRY_PENALTY) * bonus
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("vault_open" if sm.get("ambient_sounds").has("vault_open") else "upgrade", 0.8)
	_flash(Loc.t("vault.cracked"))
	_next_safe()


func _next_safe() -> void:
	_safes_done += 1
	if _safes_done >= SAFES + 1:
		_finish()
		return
	# небольшая пауза перед следующим сейфом
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(0.8)
	tw.tween_callback(_new_safe)


func _flash(text: String) -> void:
	var note := Label.new()
	note.text = text
	note.anchor_left = 0.5
	note.anchor_right = 0.5
	note.anchor_top = 1.0
	note.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	note.offset_left = -240
	note.offset_right = 240
	note.offset_top = -92
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(note)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.1)
	tw.tween_property(note, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	tw.tween_callback(note.queue_free)


func _finish() -> void:
	_over = true
	var shards := 0
	if _game_manager and _game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(_game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		_game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win", 0.8)
	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("vault.done")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)


func _play_click() -> void:
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.5)

# ui/events/game_zharva.gd
extends Control
class_name GameZharva

## «ЖАТВА» (D24): match-3 7×9 на иконках аномалий. Свап соседних, каскады
## с комбо, особые тайлы (4-в-ряд = линия, 5 = саркофаг 3×3, L/T = крест),
## выброс-метр (полный = пересборка доски + ярость ×2 на 3 хода), 30 ходов.
## Результат: счёт -> EventManager (осколки/вехи).

const COLS: int = 7
const ROWS: int = 9
const TYPES: int = 6
const CS: float = 54.0     # размер клетки
const GAP: float = 4.0
const MOVES: int = 30
const FRENZY_MULT: int = 2
const FRENZY_MOVES: int = 3
const METER_4RUN: float = 40.0
const METER_5RUN: float = 100.0
const GLYPHS := ["🔥", "⚡", "☣", "🌀", "☢", "⏳"]
const COLORS := [Color("e06040"), Color("e8c840"), Color("70c850"),
	Color("5090e0"), Color("b0e040"), Color("a070e0")]
# Арт тайлов (задача 37): 6 аномалий по типу + 3 особых (линия/саркофаг/воронка).
# Нет файла — фолбэк на прежние глифы.
const ART_DIR := "res://assets/ui/events/"
const TILE_ART := ["tile_fire", "tile_bolt", "tile_gas", "tile_vortex",
	"tile_radiation", "tile_drop"]
const SPECIAL_ART := {"line": "tile_electra", "bomb": "tile_sarcophagus",
	"cross": "tile_funnel"}

var _grid: Array = []            # [y][x] -> {t:int, sp:String}
var _cells: Array = []           # [y][x] -> Panel
var _board: Control
var _moves_left: int = MOVES
var _score: int = 0
var _combo: int = 0
var _meter: float = 0.0
var _frenzy: int = 0
var _sel: Vector2i = Vector2i(-1, -1)
var _busy: bool = false
var _meter_bar: ProgressBar
var _info: Label
var _event: Dictionary
var _tile_tex: Array = []          # кэш текстур по типу, null = нет арта
var _special_tex: Dictionary = {}  # кэш текстур особых тайлов
var game_manager: Node


func _ready() -> void:
	game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_event = EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
	for art_name in TILE_ART:
		_tile_tex.append(_load_art(art_name))
	for sp in SPECIAL_ART:
		_special_tex[sp] = _load_art(SPECIAL_ART[sp])
	_build()
	_new_board()
	_update_info()


func _load_art(art_name: String) -> Texture2D:
	var path := ART_DIR + art_name + ".png"
	return load(path) if ResourceLoader.exists(path) else null


func _build() -> void:
	var shade := ColorRect.new()
	shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shade.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.85)
	add_child(shade)

	var board_w := COLS * (CS + GAP) + GAP
	var board_h := ROWS * (CS + GAP) + GAP
	_board = Control.new()
	_board.position = (get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size - Vector2(board_w, board_h + 120.0)) * 0.5
	_board.position.y = maxf(_board.position.y, 130.0)
	_board.size = Vector2(board_w, board_h)
	_board.clip_contents = false
	add_child(_board)

	# Шапка: название, ходы/счёт, метр
	var head := Label.new()
	head.text = Loc.t("evt.banner") % str(_event["title_ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "title_en"])
	head.position = Vector2(20, 14)
	head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	add_child(head)

	_info = Label.new()
	_info.position = Vector2(20, 50)
	_info.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	_info.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	_info.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
	add_child(_info)

	var meter_label := Label.new()
	meter_label.text = Loc.t("zharva.meter")
	meter_label.position = Vector2(20, 78)
	meter_label.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	meter_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	meter_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
	add_child(meter_label)
	_meter_bar = ProgressBar.new()
	_meter_bar.position = Vector2(20, 98)
	_meter_bar.size = Vector2(260, 14)
	_meter_bar.max_value = 100.0
	_meter_bar.show_percentage = false
	add_child(_meter_bar)

	var quit := Button.new()
	quit.text = "✕"
	quit.position = Vector2(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x - 60, 14)
	quit.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 44)
	BunkerUI.style_button(quit, "steel", 15)
	quit.pressed.connect(_on_quit)
	add_child(quit)


func _new_board() -> void:
	_grid.clear()
	for y in ROWS:
		_grid.append([])   # строки сначала — _random_cell смотрит в соседей
	for y in ROWS:
		for x in COLS:
			_grid[y].append(_random_cell(x, y))
	if not _has_moves():
		_new_board()
		return
	_draw_board()


func _random_cell(x: int, y: int) -> Dictionary:
	var t := randi() % TYPES
	# без стартовых матчей: тянем тип, не создающий тройку слева/сверху
	while (x >= 2 and _grid[y][x - 1]["t"] == t and _grid[y][x - 2]["t"] == t) \
			or (y >= 2 and _grid[y - 1][x]["t"] == t and _grid[y - 2][x]["t"] == t):
		t = (t + 1) % TYPES
	return {"t": t, "sp": ""}


func _draw_board() -> void:
	for c in _board.get_children():
		_board.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	_cells.clear()
	for y in ROWS:
		var row: Array = []
		for x in COLS:
			row.append(_make_cell(x, y))
		_cells.append(row)


func _make_cell(x: int, y: int) -> Panel:
	var cell: Dictionary = _grid[y][x]
	var p := Panel.new()
	p.size = Vector2(CS, CS)
	p.position = Vector2(GAP + x * (CS + GAP), GAP + y * (CS + GAP))
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = COLORS[cell["t"]].darkened(0.55)
	sb.border_color = COLORS[cell["t"]]
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(9)
	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	p.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	p.gui_input.connect(_on_cell_input.bind(Vector2i(x, y)))

	# арт тайла: особый целиком заменяет базовый, рамка остаётся цветом типа
	# (читаемость матча); нет арта — прежние глифы
	var sp: String = str(cell["sp"])
	var tex: Texture2D = _special_tex.get(sp) if sp != "" else null
	if tex == null:
		tex = _tile_tex[cell["t"]]
	if tex != null:
		var tr := TextureRect.new()
		tr.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		tr.offset_left = 4
		tr.offset_top = 4
		tr.offset_right = -4
		tr.offset_bottom = -4
		tr.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		tr.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		tr.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		tr.texture = tex
		p.add_child(tr)
	else:
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		lbl.text = GLYPHS[cell["t"]]
		lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
		lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		p.add_child(lbl)
	# особый тайл без собственного арта помечаем глифом поверх
	if sp != "" and not _special_tex.has(sp):
		var sp_lbl := Label.new()
		sp_lbl.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		sp_lbl.text = "✦" if sp == "line" else "☢" if sp == "bomb" else "✚"
		sp_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		sp_lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		sp_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
		sp_lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		p.add_child(sp_lbl)

	if _sel == Vector2i(x, y):
		sb.border_color = Color.WHITE
		sb.set_border_width_all(4)
	_board.add_child(p)
	return p


func _on_cell_input(ev: InputEvent, pos: Vector2i) -> void:
	if _busy or not (ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed) \
			or ev.button_index != MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		return
	if _sel == Vector2i(-1, -1):
		_sel = pos
		_redraw_cell(pos)
		return
	if _sel == pos:
		_redraw_cell(pos)  # снять выделение
		_sel = Vector2i(-1, -1)
		return
	var d: Vector2i = pos - _sel
	if absi(d.x) + absi(d.y) == 1:
		var from := _sel
		_sel = Vector2i(-1, -1)
		_try_swap(from, pos)
		return
	_redraw_cell(_sel)
	_sel = pos
	_redraw_cell(pos)


func _redraw_cell(pos: Vector2i) -> void:
	var old: Panel = _cells[pos.y][pos.x]
	_board.remove_child(old)
	old.queue_free()
	_cells[pos.y][pos.x] = _make_cell(pos.x, pos.y)


func _try_swap(a: Vector2i, b: Vector2i) -> void:
	_busy = true
	_swap_data(a, b)
	_animate_swap(a, b, func():
		var matches := _find_matches(a, b)
		if matches.is_empty():
			_swap_data(a, b)
			_animate_swap(a, b, func():
				_redraw_cell(a)
				_redraw_cell(b)
				_busy = false)
		else:
			_moves_left -= 1
			_frenzy = maxi(0, _frenzy - 1)
			_combo = 0
			_resolve_cascades([a, b]))


func _swap_data(a: Vector2i, b: Vector2i) -> void:
	var tmp: Dictionary = _grid[a.y][a.x]
	_grid[a.y][a.x] = _grid[b.y][b.x]
	_grid[b.y][b.x] = tmp


func _animate_swap(a: Vector2i, b: Vector2i, on_done: Callable) -> void:
	var pa: Panel = _cells[a.y][a.x]
	var pb: Panel = _cells[b.y][b.x]
	var ta := create_tween()
	var tb := create_tween()
	ta.tween_property(pa, "position", _cell_pos(b), 0.12)
	tb.tween_property(pb, "position", _cell_pos(a), 0.12)
	ta.finished.connect(func():
		_cells[a.y][a.x] = pb
		_cells[b.y][b.x] = pa
		on_done.call())


func _cell_pos(p: Vector2i) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(GAP + p.x * (CS + GAP), GAP + p.y * (CS + GAP))


## Все текущие совпадения: массив ранов [{cells:[Vector2i], horiz:bool}]
func _find_matches(swap_a: Vector2i, swap_b: Vector2i) -> Array:
	var runs: Array = []
	# горизонтальные
	for y in ROWS:
		var x := 0
		while x < COLS:
			var t: int = _grid[y][x]["t"]
			var x2 := x
			while x2 < COLS and _grid[y][x2]["t"] == t:
				x2 += 1
			if x2 - x >= 3:
				var cells: Array = []
				for i in range(x, x2):
					cells.append(Vector2i(i, y))
				runs.append({"cells": cells, "horiz": true})
			x = maxi(x + 1, x2)
	# вертикальные
	for x in COLS:
		var y := 0
		while y < ROWS:
			var t: int = _grid[y][x]["t"]
			var y2 := y
			while y2 < ROWS and _grid[y2][x]["t"] == t:
				y2 += 1
			if y2 - y >= 3:
				var cells: Array = []
				for i in range(y, y2):
					cells.append(Vector2i(x, i))
				runs.append({"cells": cells, "horiz": false})
			y = maxi(y + 1, y2)
	return runs


## Каскады: клир -> создание особых -> гравитация -> долив -> повтор
func _resolve_cascades(swap_cells: Array) -> void:
	_combo += 1
	var mult: int = FRENZY_MULT if _frenzy > 0 else 1
	var runs := _find_matches(Vector2i(-1, -1), Vector2i(-1, -1))
	if runs.is_empty():
		_end_turn()
		return

	# выделить клетки под клир (раны + срабатывающие особые)
	var clear: Dictionary = {}
	var specials: Array = []   # [{pos, sp}]
	var meter_gain := 0.0
	for run in runs:
		var n: int = run["cells"].size()
		meter_gain += METER_4RUN if n == 4 else (METER_5RUN if n >= 5 else 0.0)
		var anchor: Vector2i = run["cells"][0]
		for c in swap_cells:
			if run["cells"].has(c):
				anchor = c
		if n >= 5:
			specials.append({"pos": anchor, "sp": "bomb"})
		elif n == 4:
			specials.append({"pos": anchor, "sp": "line"})
		else:
			# пересечение гор./верт. ранов одного типа = L/T -> крест
			for other in runs:
				if other != run and other["horiz"] != run["horiz"] \
						and _grid[run["cells"][0].y][run["cells"][0].x]["t"] \
						== _grid[other["cells"][0].y][other["cells"][0].x]["t"] \
						and _intersect(run["cells"], other["cells"]):
					specials.append({"pos": _intersect(run["cells"], other["cells"]), "sp": "cross"})
					break
		for c in run["cells"]:
			clear[c] = true
	# особый тайл в клире — добавить его эффект
	for pos in clear.keys():
		var sp: String = str(_grid[pos.y][pos.x]["sp"])
		if sp == "line":
			for x in COLS:
				clear[Vector2i(x, pos.y)] = true
		elif sp == "bomb":
			for dy in range(-1, 2):
				for dx in range(-1, 2):
					var p := Vector2i(pos.x + dx, pos.y + dy)
					if p.x >= 0 and p.x < COLS and p.y >= 0 and p.y < ROWS:
						clear[p] = true
		elif sp == "cross":
			for x in COLS:
				clear[Vector2i(x, pos.y)] = true
			for y in ROWS:
				clear[Vector2i(pos.x, y)] = true

	# счёт и метр
	_score += clear.size() * 10 * _combo * mult
	_meter = minf(_meter + meter_gain, 100.0)

	# убрать клир (анимация схлопывания)
	for pos in clear:
		if pos.y < 0 or pos.y >= ROWS or pos.x < 0 or pos.x >= COLS:
			continue
		var p: Panel = _cells[pos.y][pos.x]
		if p:
			var tw := create_tween()
			tw.tween_property(p, "scale", Vector2(0.1, 0.1), 0.12)
			tw.tween_callback(p.queue_free)
			_cells[pos.y][pos.x] = null
		_grid[pos.y][pos.x] = {"t": -1, "sp": ""}

	# создать новые особые на якорях
	for s in specials:
		_grid[s["pos"].y][s["pos"].x] = {"t": _grid[s["pos"].y][s["pos"].x]["t"]
			if _grid[s["pos"].y][s["pos"].x]["t"] >= 0 else randi() % TYPES, "sp": s["sp"]}

	var tw2 := create_tween()
	tw2.tween_interval(0.16)
	tw2.tween_callback(func(): _gravity_and_refill(specials))


func _intersect(a: Array, b: Array) -> Vector2i:
	for c in a:
		if b.has(c):
			return c
	return Vector2i(-1, -1)


func _gravity_and_refill(specials: Array) -> void:
	# падение: в каждом столбце собрать снизу вверх не-пустые
	for x in COLS:
		var write := ROWS - 1
		for y in range(ROWS - 1, -1, -1):
			if _grid[y][x]["t"] >= 0:
				if y != write:
					_grid[write][x] = _grid[y][x]
					_grid[y][x] = {"t": -1, "sp": ""}
				write -= 1
		# долив сверху
		for y in range(write, -1, -1):
			_grid[y][x] = _random_cell(x, y)
	# перерисовать доску целиком (просто и надёжно)
	_draw_board()
	if _meter >= 100.0:
		_meter = 0.0
		_frenzy = FRENZY_MOVES
		_shake_board()
	# каскад продолжается, пока есть совпадения
	if not _find_matches(Vector2i(-1, -1), Vector2i(-1, -1)).is_empty():
		_resolve_cascades([])
	else:
		if not _has_moves():
			_new_board()
		_end_turn()


func _end_turn() -> void:
	_update_info()
	if _moves_left <= 0:
		_finish()
		return
	_busy = false


func _has_moves() -> bool:
	for y in ROWS:
		for x in COLS:
			for d in [Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1)]:
				var p: Vector2i = Vector2i(x, y) + d
				if p.x >= COLS or p.y >= ROWS:
					continue
				_swap_data(Vector2i(x, y), p)
				var ok := not _find_matches(Vector2i(-1, -1), Vector2i(-1, -1)).is_empty()
				_swap_data(Vector2i(x, y), p)
				if ok:
					return true
	return false


func _shake_board() -> void:
	var base := _board.position
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.set_loops(4)
	tw.tween_property(_board, "position", base + Vector2(6, 0), 0.04)
	tw.tween_property(_board, "position", base - Vector2(6, 0), 0.04)
	tw.chain().tween_property(_board, "position", base, 0.04)


func _update_info() -> void:
	_meter_bar.value = _meter
	_info.text = "%s %d   ·   %s %d   ·   %s ×%d%s" % [
		Loc.t("zharva.moves"), _moves_left,
		Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("zharva.combo"), _combo if _combo > 0 else 1,
		"  ·  " + Loc.t("zharva.frenzy") if _frenzy > 0 else ""]


func _on_quit() -> void:
	_finish()


func _finish() -> void:
	_busy = true
	var shards := 0
	if game_manager and game_manager.current_save_data:
		shards = EventOps.add_score(game_manager.current_save_data, _event, _score)
		game_manager.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ceremony_win", 0.8)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -240
	panel.offset_right = 240
	panel.offset_top = -140
	panel.offset_bottom = 140
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	add_child(panel)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 14
	v.offset_bottom = -14
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)
	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = Loc.t("zharva.result")
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	t.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(t)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = "%s %d\n%s %d" % [Loc.t("zharva.score"), _score,
		Loc.t("evt.shards_line"), shards]
	s.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(s)
	var ok := Button.new()
	ok.text = Loc.t("evt.back_hub")
	ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 18, true)
	ok.pressed.connect(func():
		queue_free()
		var hub := EventHub.new()
		get_tree().current_scene.add_child(hub)
		hub.open())
	v.add_child(ok)

# CREDITS — gacha_cards

## Всё содержимое — оригинальные процедурные ассеты, CC0

Сгенерировано скриптом `gen_gacha_cards.py` (Python + Pillow + numpy) для
проекта StalkerRevert агентом-подготовщиком. Creative Commons Zero 1.0,
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

| Файл | Статус |
|---|---|
| card_back.png, card_frame_*.png (4), glow_*.png (4), burst_*.png (2), ribbon_*.png (2), spark_card_*.png (3) | процедурные, CC0 |
| gen_gacha_cards.py | генератор, CC0 |

Цвета редкостей соответствуют `RARITY_COLORS` из `data/gacha_data.gd`
(код проекта). Сторонние ассеты и шрифты не используются.

# ui/gacha/gacha_controller.gd
extends Control

## ГАЧА ЗОНЫ — отдельный полноэкранный узел комплекса (стиль БУНКЕР).
## Макет «ДАР ЗОНЫ»: шапка с джекпот-строкой, два ряда карточных полос,
## свечение редкости, большой ПРИЗЫВ ×10, шансы справа внизу.
## Два рукава: МУТАНТЫ / АРТЕФАКТЫ (вкладки под шапкой).
## Механики из data/gacha_data.gd: шансы по уровню кампании, джекпот-Химера
## (исключена до ур.30, гарантия ур.50), дубликаты, бонусы артефактов.

const RAR_ORDER := ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "legendary"]
const RAR_RU := {"common": "ОБЫЧНЫЙ", "uncommon": "НЕОБЫЧНЫЙ", "rare": "РЕДКИЙ", "legendary": "ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫЙ", "ex": "ЭКСКЛЮЗИВ"}
const RAR_SHORT := {"common": "ОБЫЧНЫЙ", "uncommon": "НЕОБЫЧНЫЙ", "rare": "РЕДКИЙ", "legendary": "ЛЕГЕНДА", "ex": "ЭКСКЛЮЗИВ"}

var _arm: String = "mutants"
var _arm_buttons: Dictionary = {}
var _arm_counts: Dictionary = {}
# Тач-жест: свайп по витрине = сменить рукав (как в вратах ярусов — только mouse-семейство)
var _swipe_catcher: Control
var _swipe_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _swipe_active: bool = false
var _arm_tween: Tween
var _strips_home: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO   # дом витрины (до сдвигов; присваивание position перезаписывает offsets!)
const SWIPE_THRESHOLD := 80.0
# Полосы призыва (2 ряда по 6)
var _strips_row1: HBoxContainer
var _strips_row2: HBoxContainer
var _jackpot_line: Label
var _rolls_plate_value: Label = null
var _tries_label: Label
var _chances_label: Label
var _chances_btn_holder: Button = null
var _spin1_btn: Button
var _spin10_btn: Button
# ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР: кнопка супер-рукава + оверлей выбора из шести эксклюзивов
var _choice_btn: Button
var _choice_overlay: Control
var _choice_box: GridContainer
var _choice_title: Label
# Коллекция (оверлей)
var _coll_overlay: Control
var _coll_box: GridContainer
var _coll_title: Label
# Прочее
var _session_drops: Array = []
var _toast: PanelContainer
var _toast_label: Label
var _game_manager: Node


func _ready() -> void:
        # Фон
        var bg := TextureRect.new()
        bg.texture = load("res://ui/gacha/gacha_bg.svg")
        bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        bg.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
        bg.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
        bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        add_child(bg)

        var dim := ColorRect.new()
        dim.color = Color(0.012, 0.014, 0.008, 0.88)
        dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        add_child(dim)

        BunkerUI.apply_bunker(self, true)

        _build_header()
        _build_strips()
        _build_bottom()
        _build_collection_overlay()
        _build_choice_overlay()
        _build_toast()

        _game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        _refresh_all()
        Loc.changed.connect(_refresh_all)


# ==================== ПОСТРОЕНИЕ ====================

func _build_header() -> void:
        var head := HBoxContainer.new()
        head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
        head.anchor_left = 0.0
        head.anchor_right = 1.0
        head.offset_left = 44
        head.offset_right = -44
        head.offset_top = 30
        head.offset_bottom = 96
        add_child(head)

        var tv := VBoxContainer.new()
        tv.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
        var h1 := HBoxContainer.new()
        h1.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
        var t1 := Label.new()
        t1.text = "ДАР"
        t1.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        t1.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
        t1.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT)
        var t2 := Label.new()
        t2.text = "ЗОНЫ"
        t2.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        t2.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
        t2.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD)
        h1.add_child(t1)
        h1.add_child(t2)
        tv.add_child(h1)

        _jackpot_line = BunkerUI.make_mono_label("", 14, Color("66794f"))
        tv.add_child(_jackpot_line)
        head.add_child(tv)

        # Вкладки рукавов
        var arms := HBoxContainer.new()
        arms.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
        arms.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        arms.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        arms.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
        for arm in ["mutants", "artifacts", "super"]:
                var tab := Button.new()
                tab.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(190, 56)
                BunkerUI.style_button(tab, "steel", 17)
                tab.pressed.connect(_on_arm_pressed.bind(arm))
                tab.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)
                _arm_buttons[arm] = tab
                var hb := HBoxContainer.new()
                hb.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                hb.offset_left = 14
                hb.offset_right = -14
                hb.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                hb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
                var lamp := BunkerUI.make_lamp(arm == _arm)
                hb.add_child(lamp)
                var tl := Label.new()
                tl.text = Loc.t("gacha.arm_" + arm)
                tl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
                tl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
                tl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT)
                tl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
                tl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                hb.add_child(tl)
                var cnt := BunkerUI.make_mono_label("x0", 17, BunkerUI.GREEN)
                cnt.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                _arm_counts[arm] = cnt
                hb.add_child(cnt)
                tab.add_child(hb)
                arms.add_child(tab)
        head.add_child(arms)

        # Пластина круток текущего рукава
        var rolls_plate := BunkerUI.make_plate("0", "КРУТКИ", 150.0, "res://assets/ui/currency/icon_pull.png")
        rolls_plate.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
        head.add_child(rolls_plate)
        _rolls_plate_value = rolls_plate.get_child(0).get_child(0)

        box.anchor_right = 1.0
