# ==================== ДАННЫЕ ====================

func _lab():
        if _game_manager:
                return _game_manager.get_lab_data()
        return null


func _level() -> int:
        if _game_manager:
                return _game_manager.get_campaign_level()
        return 1


func _rolls_text(n: int) -> String:
        return "∞" if n >= 1000000 else str(n)


func _collection_types() -> Array:
        # 10 мутантов + 18 артефактов = 28, порядок как в пулах
        var out: Array = []
        for rarity in RAR_ORDER:
                for e in GachaData.MUTANT_POOL[rarity]:
                        out.append(["mut", e[0]])
        for rarity in ["common", "rare", "legendary"]:
                for t in GachaData.ARTIFACT_POOL[rarity]:
                        out.append(["art", t])
        # Эксклюзивы Чёрного ящика замыкают коллекцию (фиолетовая рамка)
        for ex in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_MUTANTS:
                out.append(["mut", str(ex["type"])])
        for ax in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_ANOMALIES:
                out.append(["art", str(ax["type"])])
        return out


## Витрина пула рукава: 12 позиций, легендарки первыми
func _showcase_items() -> Array:
        var out: Array = []
        if _arm == "super":
                for ex in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_MUTANTS:
                        out.append(["mut", str(ex["type"]), "ex"])
                for ax in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_ANOMALIES:
                        out.append(["art", str(ax["type"]), "ex"])
                return out
        if _arm == "mutants":
                for rarity in ["legendary", "rare", "uncommon", "common"]:
                        for e in GachaData.MUTANT_POOL[rarity]:
                                out.append(["mut", str(e[0]), rarity])
        else:
                for rarity in ["legendary", "rare", "common"]:
                        for t in GachaData.ARTIFACT_POOL[rarity]:
                                out.append(["art", str(t), rarity])
        return out


# ==================== ПОЛОСЫ ПРИЗЫВА ====================

# Арт-пак карточек (подготовщик, задача 8): ui/gacha/cards/. Все опциональны:
# нет файла - текстовая заглушка (буква), как в mode_ui/ceremony.
const CARD_ART_DIR := "res://ui/gacha/cards/"
# Редкость игры -> ореол пака (ex - фиолетовый эпик по цвету сцены)
const GLOW_BY_RARITY := {
        "common": "common", "uncommon": "common", "rare": "rare",
        "legendary": "legendary", "ex": "epic",
}


func _card_art(key: String) -> Texture2D:
        var path := CARD_ART_DIR + key + ".png"
        if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                return load(path) as Texture2D
        return null


func _make_strip(kind: String, type: String, rar: String, stars: int, status: String = "") -> Control:
        """Карточная полоса призыва: свечение редкости, тег редкости, буква, звёзды, имя"""
        var is_mut := kind == "mut"
        var col: Color = Color("b48cff") if rar == "ex" else BunkerUI.RARHEX.get(rar, BunkerUI.TEXT)
        var owned := stars > 0

        var strip := Panel.new()
        strip.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color(0.078, 0.098, 0.055)
        sb.border_color = Color(col, 0.75 if owned else 0.35)
        sb.set_border_width_all(2)
        sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
        var glow_power := 0.0
        match rar:
                "legendary": glow_power = 40.0
                "ex": glow_power = 40.0
                "rare": glow_power = 22.0
                "uncommon": glow_power = 10.0
        if owned:
                glow_power = maxf(glow_power, 14.0)
        sb.shadow_color = Color(col, 0.35)
        sb.shadow_size = int(glow_power)
        sb.shadow_offset = Vector2.ZERO
        strip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)

        var v := VBoxContainer.new()
        v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        v.offset_left = 8
        v.offset_right = -8
        v.offset_top = 8
        v.offset_bottom = -8
        v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
        v.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        strip.add_child(v)

        # Тег редкости
        var tag := Label.new()
        var tag_txt: String = RAR_SHORT.get(rar, "—")
        if not is_mut:
                tag_txt += " АРТ"
        if status == "new":
                tag_txt += " · НОВЫЙ"
        elif status == "dup":
                tag_txt += " · ДУБЛЬ"
        elif status == "star":
                tag_txt += " · +★"
        elif status == "dup_max":
                tag_txt += " · В БИО"
        tag.text = tag_txt
        tag.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
        tag.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
        tag.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("171003") if rar == "legendary" else col)
        var tag_sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        tag_sb.bg_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD if rar == "legendary" else Color(col, 0.16)
        tag_sb.set_corner_radius_all(4)
        tag_sb.content_margin_left = 6.0
        tag_sb.content_margin_right = 6.0
        tag_sb.content_margin_top = 2.0
        tag_sb.content_margin_bottom = 2.0
        tag.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", tag_sb)
        v.add_child(tag)

        # Большая иконка карточки (пак gacha_cards): ореол редкости + арт типа,
        # серый для невладельца; нет файла - прежняя буква-заглушка
        var icon_slot := Control.new()
        icon_slot.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        icon_slot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        v.add_child(icon_slot)

        var glow := _card_art("glow_" + str(GLOW_BY_RARITY.get(rar, "common")))
        if glow:
                var glow_rect := TextureRect.new()
                glow_rect.texture = glow
                glow_rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                glow_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                glow_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
                glow_rect.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9 if owned else 0.45)
                glow_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                icon_slot.add_child(glow_rect)

        var icon_path := GachaData.card_icon_path(type, is_mut, not owned)
        if ResourceLoader.exists(icon_path):
                var icon := TextureRect.new()
                icon.texture = load(icon_path)
                icon.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                icon.offset_left = 18
                icon.offset_right = -18
                icon.offset_top = 4
                icon.offset_bottom = -4
                icon.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                icon.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
                icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                icon_slot.add_child(icon)
        else:
                var letter := Label.new()
                letter.text = Loc.type_name(type).substr(0, 1)
                letter.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
                letter.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 84)
                letter.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(col, 0.5 if owned else 0.22))
                letter.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                letter.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                letter.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                icon_slot.add_child(letter)

        # Вспышка вскрытия за контентом дропа-легендарки/эксклюзива
        if status != "" and (rar == "legendary" or rar == "ex"):
                var burst := _card_art("burst_legendary" if rar == "legendary" else "burst_epic")
                if burst:
                        var burst_rect := TextureRect.new()
                        burst_rect.texture = burst
                        burst_rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
                        burst_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                        burst_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
                        burst_rect.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
                        burst_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                        strip.add_child(burst_rect)
                        strip.move_child(burst_rect, 0)

        # Лента статуса дропа (НОВЫЙ/ДУБЛЬ) поверх, уголком; текст остаётся тегом
        if status == "new" or status == "dup":
                var ribbon := _card_art("ribbon_new" if status == "new" else "ribbon_dup")
                if ribbon:
                        var rib_rect := TextureRect.new()
                        rib_rect.texture = ribbon
                        rib_rect.anchor_left = 1.0
                        rib_rect.anchor_right = 1.0
                        rib_rect.offset_left = -128.0
                        rib_rect.offset_right = -8.0
                        rib_rect.offset_top = 6.0
                        rib_rect.offset_bottom = 38.0
                        rib_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                        rib_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT
                        rib_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                        strip.add_child(rib_rect)

        # Звёзды (для витрины — по редкости, для дропа — реальные)
        var st := Label.new()
        var shown: int = stars
        if stars < 0:
                match rar:
                        "legendary": shown = 3
                        "ex": shown = 3
                        "rare": shown = 2
                        _: shown = 1
        if shown > 0:
                st.text = "★".repeat(shown) + "☆".repeat(maxi(5 - shown, 0))
        else:
                st.text = "☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆"
        st.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
        st.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
        st.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("ffd94d") if owned else Color("454b39"))
        st.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        v.add_child(st)

        var nm := Label.new()
        nm.text = Loc.type_name(type).to_upper()
        nm.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        nm.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
        nm.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT if owned else BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
        nm.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        nm.clip_text = true
        v.add_child(nm)
        return strip


## Звёзды витрины для любых типов: эксклюзивные аномалии живут в
## exclusive_anomalies (не в won_artifacts) - единая точка проверки владения.
func _owned_stars(kind: String, type: String, lab) -> int:
        if lab == null:
                return -1
        if kind == "mut":
                if lab.unlocked_mutants.has(type):
                        return lab.get_mutant_stars(type)
        elif lab.won_artifacts.has(type) or lab.exclusive_anomalies.has(type):
                return lab.get_artifact_stars(type)
        return -1


func _refresh_strips() -> void:
        for c in _strips_row1.get_children():
                _strips_row1.remove_child(c)
                c.queue_free()
        for c in _strips_row2.get_children():
                _strips_row2.remove_child(c)
                c.queue_free()
        var lab = _lab()
        var rows: Array = [[], []]

        if _session_drops.is_empty():
                # Витрина пула: 12 позиций, звёзды «по редкости» (stars = -1)
                for item in _showcase_items().slice(0, 12):
                        rows[0].append([item[0], item[1], item[2], _owned_stars(item[0], item[1], lab), ""])
        else:
                for r in _session_drops.slice(0, 12):
                        var dkind: String = str(r.get("kind", "mut" if str(r.get("arm", "mutants")) == "mutants" else "art"))
                        rows[0].append([dkind, str(r.get("type", "")), str(r.get("rarity", "common")), -2, str(r.get("status", ""))])
                # Реальные звёзды дропов
                var fixed: Array = []
                for item in rows[0]:
                        fixed.append([item[0], item[1], item[2], _owned_stars(item[0], item[1], lab), item[4]])
                rows[0] = fixed

        # Второй ряд: если дропов мало — добираем витриной пула
        if rows[0].size() <= 6:
                var showcase: Array = _showcase_items()
                var used: Array = []
                for item in rows[0]:
                        used.append(item[1])
                for item in showcase:
                        if rows[0].size() + rows[1].size() >= 12:
                                break
                        if used.has(item[1]):
                                continue
                        rows[1].append([item[0], item[1], item[2], _owned_stars(item[0], item[1], lab), ""])
        else:
                for item in rows[0].slice(6, 12):
                        rows[1].append(item)
                rows[0] = rows[0].slice(0, 6)

        for item in rows[0]:
                _strips_row1.add_child(_make_strip(item[0], item[1], item[2], int(item[3]), str(item[4])))
        for item in rows[1]:
                _strips_row2.add_child(_make_strip(item[0], item[1], item[2], int(item[3]), str(item[4])))


# ==================== ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ====================

func _refresh_all() -> void:
        _refresh_header()
        _refresh_arms()
        _refresh_strips()
        _refresh_bottom()
        _refresh_collection()


func _refresh_header() -> void:
        var lab = _lab()
        var unlocked := 0
        if lab:
                unlocked = lab.unlocked_mutants.size() + lab.won_artifacts.size()
        var jack_line := "джекпот: Химера · гарантия на 50-м уровне · хранилище %d/%d · дубликаты идут в копии и звёзды" % [unlocked, GachaData.total_collection_size()]
        if _arm == "artifacts":
                jack_line = "артефактный рукав · бонусы энергии и биомассы · хранилище %d/28" % unlocked
        if _arm == "super":
                jack_line = "супер-призыв: ТОЛЬКО эксклюзивы Чёрных ящиков · гарантия нового, пока собраны не все · хранилище %d/%d" % [unlocked, GachaData.total_collection_size()]
        _jackpot_line.text = jack_line


func _refresh_arms() -> void:
        var lab = _lab()
        for arm in ["mutants", "artifacts", "super"]:
            if _arm_buttons.has(arm):
                var tab: Button = _arm_buttons[arm]
                var is_on: bool = arm == _arm
                var cnt: Label = _arm_counts[arm]
                var n: int = lab.super_pulls if arm == "super" else (lab.gacha_rolls_mutants if arm == "mutants" else lab.gacha_rolls_artifacts)
                cnt.text = "x" + _rolls_text(n)
                cnt.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.GREEN if is_on else BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
                var sb: StyleBoxFlat = tab.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
                if sb:
                        sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD if is_on else BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE
        if _rolls_plate_value and lab:
                var n2: int = lab.super_pulls if _arm == "super" else (lab.gacha_rolls_mutants if _arm == "mutants" else lab.gacha_rolls_artifacts)
                _rolls_plate_value.text = _rolls_text(n2)


func _refresh_bottom() -> void:
        var lab = _lab()
        var rolls := 0
        if lab:
                rolls = lab.super_pulls if _arm == "super" else (lab.gacha_rolls_mutants if _arm == "mutants" else lab.gacha_rolls_artifacts)
        _spin1_btn.disabled = rolls < 1
        _spin10_btn.disabled = rolls < 1
        _spin1_btn.text = "СУПЕР-ПРИЗЫВ  ×1" if _arm == "super" else "ПРИЗЫВ  ×1"
        _spin10_btn.text = "СУПЕР-ПРИЗЫВ  ×10" if _arm == "super" else "ПРИЗЫВ  ×10"
        var prog: int = int(lab.super_pull_progress) if lab else 0
        if _arm == "super":
                _tries_label.text = "Супер-крутки: %d · бонус обычных: %d/%d · ВЫБОР приза: %d/%d" % [rolls, prog, GachaData.SUPER_PITY, int(lab.super_choice_progress) if lab else 0, GachaData.SUPER_CHOICE_PITY]
        elif _arm == "mutants":
                var to_guarantee: int = maxi(GachaData.CHIMERA_GUARANTEE_LEVEL - _level(), 0)
                if to_guarantee > 0:
                        _tries_label.text = "Попытки: %s · до гаранта Химеры ещё %d ур." % [_rolls_text(rolls), to_guarantee]
                else:
                        _tries_label.text = "Попытки: %s · гарант Химеры АКТИВЕН" % _rolls_text(rolls)
        else:
                _tries_label.text = "Попытки: %s · артефакты дают энергию и биомассу" % _rolls_text(rolls)

        # Шансы
        var w := GachaData.rarity_weights(_level())
        if _arm == "super":
                _chances_label.text = "пул: 3 эксклюзивных мутанта + 3 эксклюзивные аномалии\n+1 супер-крутка за каждые %d обычных призывов\n+1 ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР за каждые %d супер-призывов" % [GachaData.SUPER_PITY, GachaData.SUPER_CHOICE_PITY]
        elif _arm == "mutants":
                _chances_label.text = "шансы: %d%% обычный · %d%% необычный · %d%% редкий · %d%% легенда\n+1 крутка за 10-ю и 30-ю волну выживания" % [
                        roundi(w["common"]), roundi(w["uncommon"]), roundi(w["rare"]), roundi(w["legendary"])]
        else:
                _chances_label.text = "шансы: %d%% обычный · %d%% редкий · %d%% легенда\nсдача копий: 10 очков = 1 крутка артефактов" % [
                        roundi(w["common"]), roundi(w["rare"] + w["uncommon"]), roundi(w["legendary"])]
        
        # Кнопка приза на выбор: видна только в супер-рукаве
        var tokens: int = int(lab.super_choice_tokens) if lab else 0
        _choice_btn.visible = _arm == "super"
        _choice_btn.disabled = tokens < 1
        if tokens > 0:
                _choice_btn.text = "ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР ГОТОВ ×%d" % tokens
                BunkerUI.style_button(_choice_btn, "hazard", 16, true)
        else:
                _choice_btn.text = "ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР · %d/%d супер-призывов" % [int(lab.super_choice_progress) if lab else 0, GachaData.SUPER_CHOICE_PITY]
                BunkerUI.style_button(_choice_btn, "steel", 14)


func _refresh_collection() -> void:
        for c in _coll_box.get_children():
                c.queue_free()
        var lab = _lab()
        var unlocked := 0
        for pair in _collection_types():
                var kind: String = pair[0]
                var type: String = pair[1]
                var is_mut := kind == "mut"
                var has := false
                if lab:
                        if is_mut:
                                has = lab.unlocked_mutants.has(type)
                        elif GachaData.is_exclusive_anomaly(type):
                                has = lab.exclusive_anomalies.has(type)
                        else:
                                has = lab.won_artifacts.has(type)
                if has:
                        unlocked += 1
                _coll_box.add_child(_make_coll_tile(kind, type, has))
        _coll_title.text = "КОЛЛЕКЦИЯ %d/%d" % [unlocked, GachaData.total_collection_size()]


func _make_coll_tile(kind: String, type: String, has: bool) -> Control:
        var tile := Panel.new()
        tile.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(74, 74)
        var tsb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        tsb.bg_color = Color("0a100b")
        tsb.set_border_width_all(2)
        tsb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
        if has:
                if GachaData.is_exclusive(type) or GachaData.is_exclusive_anomaly(type):
                        tsb.border_color = Color("b48cff")
                else:
                        var rar := GachaData.get_mutant_rarity(type) if kind == "mut" else GachaData.get_artifact_rarity(type)
                        tsb.border_color = BunkerUI.RARHEX.get(rar, BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE)
        else:
                tsb.border_color = Color("232b23")
                tsb.bg_color = Color("0c0f0c")
        tile.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", tsb)
        if has and (GachaData.is_exclusive(type) or GachaData.is_exclusive_anomaly(type)):
                tile.tooltip_text = Loc.type_name(type) + "\nэксклюзив Чёрного ящика"
        else:
                tile.tooltip_text = Loc.type_name(type) if has else Loc.t("card.locked")
        var icon := TextureRect.new()
        var path := GachaData.card_icon_path(type, kind == "mut", not has)
        if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                icon.texture = load(path)
        icon.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        icon.offset_left = 3
        icon.offset_top = 3
        icon.offset_right = -3
        icon.offset_bottom = -3
        icon.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
        icon.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
        icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        tile.add_child(icon)
        return tile


# ==================== ОБРАБОТЧИКИ ====================

func _on_arm_pressed(arm: String) -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if _arm == arm:
                return
        var arm_order := ["mutants", "artifacts", "super"]
        var dir: int = 1 if arm_order.find(arm) > arm_order.find(_arm) else -1   # СУПЕР правее АРТЕФАКТОВ
        _arm = arm
        _session_drops.clear()
        _refresh_all()
        _animate_strips(dir)
        var sm_flip = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm_flip and sm_flip.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm_flip.play_sound("card_flip", 0.7)


func _on_swipe_gui(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        # Тач на Android приходит как мышь (emulate_mouse_from_touch = true по умолчанию),
        # поэтому обрабатываем ТОЛЬКО mouse-семейство — иначе жест задвоится.
        if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
                _swipe_active = event.pressed
                _swipe_pos = event.position
        elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and _swipe_active:
                var dx: float = event.position.x - _swipe_pos.x
                if absf(dx) >= SWIPE_THRESHOLD:
                        _swipe_active = false   # один жест = одна смена
                        var arm_order := ["mutants", "artifacts", "super"]
                        var nxt: int = clampi(arm_order.find(_arm) + (1 if dx < 0.0 else -1), 0, 2)   # влево = вперёд
                        if nxt != arm_order.find(_arm):
                                _on_arm_pressed(arm_order[nxt])


func _animate_strips(dir: int) -> void:
        """Витрина проявляется и выезжает с направления свайпа (полировка смены рукава)."""
        var box := _strips_row1.get_parent() as Control
        if box == null or box.size.x < 100.0:
                return   # до первичной раскладки анимировать нечего
        if _arm_tween and _arm_tween.is_valid():
                _arm_tween.kill()   # спам-свайпы не должны драться за свойства
        # «Дом» витрины — захвачен при построении (см. _build_strips):
        # ни offsets, ни текущая position после сдвига доверять нельзя.
        var home := _strips_home
        box.position = home + Vector2(34.0 * float(dir), 0.0)
        box.modulate.a = 0.2
        _arm_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
        _arm_tween.tween_property(box, "position", home, 0.20).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
        _arm_tween.tween_property(box, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.20)


func _on_spin(times: int) -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if not _game_manager:
                return
        var results: Array = []
        var lab = _lab()
        var super_before: int = int(lab.super_pulls) if lab else 0
        var choice_before: int = int(lab.super_choice_tokens) if lab else 0
        if _arm == "super":
                results = _game_manager.spin_super_gacha(times)
        elif _arm == "mutants":
                results = _game_manager.spin_mutant_gacha(times)
        else:
                results = _game_manager.spin_artifact_gacha(times)
        if results.is_empty():
                _show_toast(Loc.t("gacha.super_no_pulls") if _arm == "super" else Loc.t("gacha.no_rolls"))
                return
        # Дропы разворачиваются новыми полосами (новые — первыми)
        for r in results:
                var kind: String = str(r.get("kind", "mut"))
                if _arm == "mutants":
                        kind = "mut"
                elif _arm == "artifacts":
                        kind = "art"
                var rar: String = str(r.get("rarity", "common"))
                if _arm == "super":
                        rar = "ex"   # фиолетовая рамка и тег «ЭКСКЛЮЗИВ» на полосе
                _session_drops.push_front({"arm": _arm, "kind": kind, "type": r.get("type"), "rarity": rar, "status": r.get("status", "")})
        while _session_drops.size() > 12:
                _session_drops.pop_back()

        # Прогрессия: задачи и опыт за призыв (супер-призыв — награда, без прогрессии)
        if _arm != "super":
                Prog.notify_gacha(times)

        _refresh_all()
        # Церемония раскрытия (задача 18): whoosh + звон по редкости + лента
        _play_reveal_fx(results)
        # Задача 23: прокрутка рулетки (короткий прогон поверх)
        var sm_sp = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm_sp and sm_sp.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm_sp.play_sound("gacha_spin", 0.7)
        # Тост: заработанная супер-крутка важнее легендарки
        var lab2 = _lab()
        var super_earned: bool = lab2 != null and int(lab2.super_pulls) > super_before
        if super_earned:
                _show_toast("СУПЕР-КРУТКА +1 · ВКЛАДКА «СУПЕР»")
                return
        var choice_earned: bool = lab2 != null and int(lab2.super_choice_tokens) > choice_before
        if choice_earned:
                _show_toast("ВЫБОР ПРИЗА ГОТОВ · КНОПКА «ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР»")
                return
        # Мигнуть тостом при легендарке
        var any_legend := false
        for r in results:
                if str(r.get("rarity")) == "legendary":
                        any_legend = true
                        break
        if any_legend:
                _show_toast(Loc.t("gacha.legend_toast"))


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if _game_manager:
                _game_manager.change_scene("lab")
        else:
                get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/lab/lab.tscn")


## Звуки церемонии (задача 18): whoosh вылета карт, звон вскрытия по ЛУЧШЕЙ
## редкости батча (игрок слышит редкость до чтения), лента НОВЫЙ, искры легендарки
func _play_reveal_fx(results: Array) -> void:
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm == null or not sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                return
        sm.play_sound("card_whoosh", 0.8)
        var best: int = -1
        var any_new := false
        var any_legend := false
        for r in results:
                var rar: String = str(r.get("rarity", "common"))
                # СУПЕР-рукав всегда «ex» — звон эпика
                var idx: int = 4 if _arm == "super" else RAR_ORDER.find(rar)
                if rar == "legendary" and _arm != "super":
                        any_legend = true
                if str(r.get("status", "")) == "new":
                        any_new = true
                best = maxi(best, idx)
        var reveal_keys := ["reveal_common", "reveal_common", "reveal_rare", "reveal_legendary", "reveal_epic"]
        if best >= 0:
                sm.play_sound(reveal_keys[best], 0.9)
        if any_new:
                sm.play_sound("ribbon_pop", 0.7)
        if any_legend:
                sm.play_sound("burst_sparks", 1.0)



# ==================== ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР ====================

func _build_choice_overlay() -> void:
        _choice_overlay = Control.new()
        _choice_overlay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        _choice_overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        _choice_overlay.visible = false
        add_child(_choice_overlay)

        var shade := ColorRect.new()
        shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        shade.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.82)
        shade.gui_input.connect(func(ev):
                if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
                        _choice_overlay.visible = false)
        _choice_overlay.add_child(shade)

        var panel := PanelContainer.new()
        panel.anchor_left = 0.5
        panel.anchor_top = 0.5
        panel.anchor_right = 0.5
        panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
        panel.offset_left = -560
        panel.offset_top = -280
        panel.offset_right = 560
        panel.offset_bottom = 280
        _choice_overlay.add_child(panel)

        var v := VBoxContainer.new()
        v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
        panel.add_child(v)

        var top := HBoxContainer.new()
        _choice_title = BunkerUI.make_section_label("ПРИЗ НА ВЫБОР · эксклюзивы Чёрных ящиков")
        _choice_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
        _choice_title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        top.add_child(_choice_title)
        var cback := Button.new()
        cback.text = "НАЗАД"
        cback.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(140, 44)
        BunkerUI.style_button(cback, "steel", 15)
        cback.pressed.connect(func(): _choice_overlay.visible = false)
        top.add_child(cback)
        v.add_child(top)

        var note := BunkerUI.make_mono_label("каждые %d супер-призывов = 1 выбор · дубль мутанта = копия на ферму · дубль аномалии = +400 биомассы" % GachaData.SUPER_CHOICE_PITY, 13, Color("66794f"))
        v.add_child(note)

        var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
        scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        # v0.29.3: свайп-слой — выбор «1 из N» едет за пальцем
        v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(scroll, false))

        _choice_box = GridContainer.new()
        _choice_box.columns = 3
        _choice_box.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 14)
        _choice_box.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 14)
        _choice_box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        scroll.add_child(_choice_box)


func _rebuild_choice_tiles() -> void:
        for c in _choice_box.get_children():
                c.queue_free()
        for ex in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_MUTANTS:
                _choice_box.add_child(_make_choice_tile("mut", str(ex["type"]), str(ex.get("label", "")), str(ex.get("desc", ""))))
        for ax in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_ANOMALIES:
                _choice_box.add_child(_make_choice_tile("art", str(ax["type"]), str(ax.get("label", "")), str(ax.get("desc", ""))))


func _make_choice_tile(kind: String, type: String, label: String, desc: String) -> Control:
        var lab = _lab()
        var owned: bool = false
        if lab:
                owned = lab.unlocked_mutants.has(type) if kind == "mut" else lab.exclusive_anomalies.has(type)
        var btn := Button.new()
        btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(340, 118)
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color("0a100b")
        sb.set_border_width_all(2)
        sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
        sb.border_color = Color("b48cff") if owned else Color("3a4433")
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
        var sbh := sb.duplicate()
        sbh.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", sbh)
        var sbp := sb.duplicate()
        sbp.border_color = Color("ffd94d")
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", sbp)
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", sb.duplicate())

        var icon := TextureRect.new()
        var path := GachaData.card_icon_path(type, kind == "mut", false)
        if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                icon.texture = load(path)
        icon.anchor_left = 0.0
        icon.anchor_right = 0.0
        icon.anchor_top = 0.0
        icon.anchor_bottom = 1.0
        icon.offset_left = 10
        icon.offset_right = 110
        icon.offset_top = 10
        icon.offset_bottom = -10
        icon.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
        icon.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
        icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        btn.add_child(icon)

        var nm := Label.new()
        nm.text = label
        nm.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        nm.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
        nm.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("b48cff") if owned else BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT)
        nm.anchor_left = 1.0
        nm.anchor_right = 1.0
        nm.offset_left = -222
        nm.offset_right = -12
        nm.offset_top = 12
        nm.offset_bottom = 48
        nm.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        nm.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        btn.add_child(nm)

        var ds := BunkerUI.make_mono_label(("В КОЛЛЕКЦИИ · дубль = " + ("копия" if kind == "mut" else "+400 био")) if owned else ("НОВЫЙ · " + desc), 11, Color("66794f"))
        ds.anchor_left = 1.0
        ds.anchor_right = 1.0
        ds.anchor_top = 1.0
        ds.anchor_bottom = 1.0
        ds.offset_left = -222
        ds.offset_right = -12
        ds.offset_top = -46
        ds.offset_bottom = -10
        ds.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        ds.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        btn.add_child(ds)

        btn.pressed.connect(_on_choice_pick.bind(kind, type))
        return btn


func _on_choice_open() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        var lab = _lab()
        if lab == null or int(lab.super_choice_tokens) <= 0:
                _show_toast("Выбор не готов: %d/%d супер-призывов" % [int(lab.super_choice_progress) if lab else 0, GachaData.SUPER_CHOICE_PITY])
                return
        _rebuild_choice_tiles()
        _choice_overlay.visible = true


func _on_choice_pick(kind: String, type: String) -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if not _game_manager:
                return
        var roll: Dictionary = _game_manager.claim_super_choice(kind, type)
        if roll.is_empty():
                _show_toast("Выбор недоступен")
                return
        _choice_overlay.visible = false
        _session_drops.push_front({"arm": "super", "kind": kind, "type": type, "rarity": "ex", "status": roll.get("status", "new")})
        while _session_drops.size() > 12:
                _session_drops.pop_back()
        _refresh_all()
        var nm: String = Loc.type_name(type)
        if str(roll.get("status", "new")) == "dup":
                _show_toast("ПРИЗ ВЫБРАН: %s · дубль — %s" % [nm, "копия на ферму" if kind == "mut" else "+400 биомассы"])
        else:
                _show_toast("ПРИЗ ВЫБРАН: %s · новый в коллекции!" % nm)

func _show_toast(text: String) -> void:
        _toast_label.text = text
        _toast.visible = true
        _toast.reset_size()
        await get_tree().create_timer(1.6).timeout
        if is_instance_valid(_toast):
                _toast.visible = false


func _play_hover_sound() -> void:
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm.play_sound("ui_hover", 0.3)


func _play_click_sound() -> void:
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.6)


# ==================== ШАНСЫ ГАЧИ (D16 принцип 3) ====================

func _show_chances_popup() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
        var root := Control.new()
        root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        add_child(root)
        var dim := ColorRect.new()
        dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.7)
        dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP

        close.pressed.connect(func(): root.queue_free())

## -> 3D-переход (лестница/портал с кат-камерой) -> титр -> лаборатория.

func _make_rect(color: Color) -> ColorRect:
	var rect := ColorRect.new()
	rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	rect.color = color
	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return rect


func _make_star_slot() -> Control:
	var slot := Control.new()
	slot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_star_size, _star_size)
	slot.size = Vector2(_star_size, _star_size)
	slot.pivot_offset = Vector2(_star_size, _star_size) * 0.5
	var star_tex: Texture2D = _art("star_empty")
	if star_tex:
		var tex_rect := TextureRect.new()
		tex_rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		tex_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		tex_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		slot.add_child(tex_rect)
	else:
		var glyph := Label.new()
		glyph.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		glyph.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		glyph.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		glyph.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(_star_size * 0.8))
		slot.add_child(glyph)
	return slot


func _art(key: String) -> Texture2D:
	if not CeremonyData.ART.has(key):
		return null
	var path := CeremonyData.ART_DIR + String(CeremonyData.ART[key])
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		return load(path) as Texture2D
	return null


# ==================== ЗАПУСК ====================

## Играет церемонию по результату забега Башни и возвращается по концу/скипу.
## Вызов awaits из zone_controller.finish_run.
func play(result: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var mode := str(result.get("mode", ""))
	var played := true
	_begin()

	# Диспетчер режимов: у каждого свой финал; скип и построение общие
	if mode == "tower":
		var success: bool = bool(result.get("success", false))
		var summary: Dictionary = result.get("tower_summary", {})
		var floor_num: int = int(summary.get("floor", int(result.get("tower_floor", 1))))
		var stars: int = int(summary.get("stars", 1 if success else 0))
		var stars_before: int = int(summary.get("stars_before", 0))
		if success:
			await _play_victory(summary, floor_num, maxi(stars, 1), stars_before)
		else:
			var bio: int = int(summary.get("biomass", 0))
			await _play_defeat(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.consolation", {"b": bio}))
	elif mode == "campaign":
		await _play_campaign(result)
	elif mode == "survival":
		await _play_survival(result)
	else:
		played = false  # неизвестный режим - вызывающий делает свой фолбэк

	# Скип - короткое затемнение и выход; естественный конец уже в чёрном
	if played and _skipped:
		_fade.color.a = 0.0
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(_fade, "color:a", 1.0, CeremonyData.SKIP_FADE_TIME)
		await _wait_raw(CeremonyData.SKIP_FADE_TIME)
	finished.emit()
	return played


# ==================== ВАРИАНТ: КАМПАНИЯ ====================

## Победа: «КОЛЬЦО N ЗАХВАЧЕНО» -> доход -> глиф перехода -> «КОЛЬЦО N+1».
## Поражение: баннер поражения с боевым доходом (кампания платит его всегда).
func _play_campaign(result: Dictionary) -> void:
	var level: int = int(result.get("campaign_level", 0))
	var success: bool = bool(result.get("success", false))
	var bio: int = int(float(result.get("reward", 0.0)))
	var is_final: bool = level >= CampaignData.TOTAL_LEVELS

	_party_level = 2 if success else 0
	_time_scale = 1.0

	if not success:
		await _play_defeat(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.income_line", {"b": bio}))
		return

	_fade_to(CeremonyData.DIM_ALPHA, CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return

	_set_banner("ring", Loc.t("tower_ceremony.ring_captured", {"n": level}), "")
	_slam_banner("banner_slam")
	await _wait(CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return

	_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_WAVE_2STARS, "wave")
	_sfx("confetti_burst")
	await _wait(0.8)
	_show_line(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.income_line", {"b": bio}))
	await _wait(1.2)
	if _dead():
		return

	var next_title: String = Loc.t("tower_ceremony.next_ring", {"n": level + 1})
	await _transition("stairs", next_title, 0)
	if _dead():
		return
	# NG+ (D12): 100-е кольцо - «ЗОНА ПОКОРЕНА», строка мутации Зоны, залп конфетти
	if bool(result.get("campaign_victory", false)):
		var cyc_done: int = int(result.get("campaign_cycle_done", 1))
		var e_m: float = CampaignData.cycle_enemy_mult(cyc_done + 1)
		var r_m: float = CampaignData.cycle_reward_mult(cyc_done + 1)
		_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_WAVE_3STARS, "wave")
		_sfx("confetti_burst")
		await _wait(0.9)
		if _dead():
			return
		_show_line(Loc.t("ngplus.cycle_line",
			{"n": cyc_done, "e": "%.2f" % e_m, "r": "%.2f" % r_m}))
		await _wait(1.6)
		if _dead():
			return
		await _show_title(Loc.t("ngplus.victory_title"), CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD_MAX)
		return
	await _show_title(
		Loc.t("tower_ceremony.campaign_done") if is_final else next_title,
		CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD_MAX if is_final else CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD)


# ==================== ВАРИАНТ: ВЫЖИВАНИЕ ====================

## Победа (30+ волн / арена): баннер рекорда, строки волн и дохода, титр итога.
## Поражение: баннер поражения; награда за волны платится и показывается.
func _play_survival(result: Dictionary) -> void:
	var waves := maxi(0, int(result.get("waves_survived", 0)))
	var success: bool = bool(result.get("success", false))
	var bio: int = int(float(result.get("reward", 0.0)))

	_party_level = 2 if success else 0
	_time_scale = 1.0

	if not success:
		await _play_defeat(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.surv_line", {"w": waves, "b": bio}))
		return

	_fade_to(CeremonyData.DIM_ALPHA, CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return

	_set_banner("record", Loc.t("tower_ceremony.surv_record"), "")
	_slam_banner("banner_slam")
	await _wait(CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return

	_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_WAVE_3STARS, "wave")
	_sfx("confetti_burst")
	await _wait(0.8)
	_show_line(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.surv_line", {"w": waves, "b": bio}))
	await _wait(1.4)
	if _dead():
		return

	_fade_to(1.0, CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return
	await _show_title(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.surv_title", {"w": waves}),
		CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD_MAX)


## Одна строка текста в слоте наград (общие режимы)
func _show_line(text: String) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_rewards_label.text = text
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_rewards_label, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3)


## Подготовка: курсор, музыка, HUD, отключение боевой камеры
func _begin():
	Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)

	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("stop_music"):
		sm.stop_music(1.2)

	var hud = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("hud")
	if hud:
		hud.visible = false

	_game_cam = get_viewport().get_camera_3d()
	if _game_cam:
		_game_cam.set_process(false)
		_game_cam.set_physics_process(false)
		_game_cam.set_process_input(false)
		_game_cam.set_process_unhandled_input(false)

	set_process(true)
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_skip_hint, "modulate:a", 0.5, 0.4) \
		.set_delay(CeremonyData.SKIP_HINT_DELAY)


# ==================== ВАРИАНТ: ПОБЕДА ====================

func _play_victory(summary: Dictionary, floor_num: int, stars: int, stars_before: int) -> void:
	var floor_type := TowerData.get_floor_type(floor_num)
	var is_final := floor_num >= TowerData.TOTAL_FLOORS
	var record_improved := stars > stars_before
	var replay := (not record_improved) and stars_before >= 1

	# Уровень праздника: звёзды; улучшение рекорда и Прорыв - минимум «2 звезды»
	_party_level = stars
	if record_improved or floor_type == "break":
		_party_level = maxi(_party_level, 2)

	# Темп: Прорыв и реплей пройденного - бодрее
	_time_scale = CeremonyData.BREAK_TIME_SCALE if (floor_type == "break" or replay) else 1.0

	# 1. Затемнение сцены
	_fade_to(CeremonyData.DIM_ALPHA, CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	var t := CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME
	if _dead():
		return

	# 2. Пре-ролл Хранителя: баннер босса, двойной слэм с тряской, рык
	if floor_type == "keeper":
		await _keeper_preroll(floor_num)
		if _dead():
			return
		t += CeremonyData.KEEPER_PREROLL

	# 3. Баннер «ЭТАЖ ПРОЙДЕН» (вариант: Прорыв / Башня покорена)
	var kind := "cleared"
	var sub := ""
	if is_final:
		kind = "victory"
	elif floor_type == "break":
		kind = "break"
		sub = Loc.t("tower_ceremony.break_tag")
	_set_banner(kind, Loc.t("tower_ceremony.cleared"), sub)
	_slam_banner("banner_slam_break" if kind == "break" else "banner_slam")
	await _wait(CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME)
	t += CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME
	if _dead():
		return

	# 4. Слоты звёзд проявляются пустыми
	var kinds := _star_kinds(stars, stars_before)
	var shown: int = mini(stars + maxi(0, mini(stars_before, 3) - stars), 3)
	var shift: float = maxf(0.0, shown - 1) * CeremonyData.STAR_POP_INTERVAL

	await _wait(maxf(0.05, CeremonyData.T_STARS_BASE - t))
	_show_star_slots()
	await _wait(CeremonyData.STAR_SLOT_FADE)
	if _dead():
		return

	# 5. Поп-звёзды по очереди: gold - панч и лесенка звука, silver - тихо
	var gold_i := 0
	for i in shown:
		var slot: Control = _star_slots[i]
		if String(kinds[i]) == "gold":
			_pop_star(slot, gold_i)
			gold_i += 1
		else:
			_reveal_silver(slot)
		if i < shown - 1:
			await _wait(CeremonyData.STAR_POP_INTERVAL)
		if _dead():
			return
	t = maxf(t, CeremonyData.T_STARS_BASE) + CeremonyData.STAR_SLOT_FADE \
		+ maxf(0.0, shown - 1) * CeremonyData.STAR_POP_INTERVAL

	# Конфетти и искры - по уровню праздника (1★ без улучшения рекорда - сдержанно)
	if _party_level >= 2:
		_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_WAVE_3STARS if _party_level >= 3
			else CeremonyData.CONFETTI_WAVE_2STARS, "wave")
		if _party_level >= 3:
			_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_SIDE_BURST, "side")
		_sfx("confetti_burst")

	# 6. Строка наград (+ пометка рекорда, если реплей хуже)
	await _wait(maxf(0.05, CeremonyData.T_REWARDS_LINE + shift - t))
	_show_rewards(summary)
	t = maxf(t, CeremonyData.T_REWARDS_LINE + shift)
	if _dead():
		return

	# 7. Переход: лестница (обычный/Прорыв) или портал (Хранитель, финал)
	var use_portal := is_final or floor_type == "keeper"
	if _party_level >= 3:
		shift += CeremonyData.CONFETTI_EXTRA_HOLD
	await _wait(maxf(0.05, CeremonyData.T_TRANSITION + shift - t))
	if _dead():
		return
	await _transition("portal" if use_portal else "stairs",
		Loc.t("tower_ceremony.floor_up", {"n": floor_num + 1}), stars)
	if _dead():
		return

	# 8. Затемнение в чёрный и титр
	var hold := CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD_MAX if _party_level >= 3 else CeremonyData.TITLE_HOLD
	if is_final:
		await _show_title(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.tower_done") + "\n"
			+ Loc.t("tower_ceremony.tower_done_list"), CeremonyData.TITLE_LIST_HOLD)
	elif floor_type == "keeper":
		var next_tier: Dictionary = TowerData.get_tier(floor_num + 1)
		await _show_title(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.tier_up",
			{"name": String(next_tier.get("name", ""))}), hold)
	else:
		await _show_title(Loc.t("tower_ceremony.next_floor",
			{"n": floor_num + 1}), hold)


## Пре-ролл Хранителя: баннер босса, двойной слэм с тряской, рык
func _keeper_preroll(floor_num: int) -> void:
	var tier: Dictionary = TowerData.get_tier(floor_num)
	_set_banner("keeper", Loc.t("tower_ceremony.keeper_down",
		{"name": String(tier.get("boss", ""))}), "")
	_banner.position.y = _banner_base_y
	_banner.scale = Vector2(CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE, CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE)
	_sfx("keeper_roar")
	_sfx("keeper_slam")
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.25)
	await _wait(0.25)
	_shake_banner(Accessibility.shake(CeremonyData.KEEPER_SLAM_SHAKE))
	await _wait(CeremonyData.KEEPER_PREROLL - 0.45)
	if _dead():
		return
	# второй слэм перед уходом пре-ролла
	_sfx("keeper_slam")
	_banner.scale = Vector2(CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE, CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE)
	var tw2 := _tween()
	tw2.tween_property(_banner, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.15)
	await _wait(0.2)
	_hide_banner()


# ==================== ВАРИАНТ: ПОРАЖЕНИЕ ====================

func _play_defeat(sub_text: String) -> void:
	_party_level = 0
	_time_scale = 1.0

	_fade_to(CeremonyData.DIM_ALPHA_DEFEAT, CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return

	_set_banner("defeat", Loc.t("result.defeat"), sub_text)
	_slam_banner("defeat")
	await _wait(maxf(0.1, CeremonyData.DEFEAT_TOTAL - CeremonyData.FADE_IN_TIME
		- CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME))
	if _dead():
		return

	_fade.color.a = 0.0
	_fade_to(1.0, CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)


# ==================== ЗВЁЗДЫ ====================

## Порядок слотов: gold (заработано), silver (рекорд сверх заработанного), empty
func _star_kinds(stars: int, stars_before: int) -> Array:
	var kinds: Array = []
	for i in mini(stars, 3):
		kinds.append("gold")
	var silver_n: int = maxi(0, mini(stars_before, 3) - stars)
	for i in silver_n:
		kinds.append("silver")
	while kinds.size() < 3:
		kinds.append("empty")
	return kinds


## Слоты появляются пустыми (star_empty), звёзды «выстреливают» позже
func _show_star_slots() -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_stars_row.visible = true
	for slot: Control in _star_slots:
		_style_star_slot(slot, "empty")
		slot.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
		var tw := _tween()
		tw.tween_property(slot, "modulate:a", 0.45, CeremonyData.STAR_SLOT_FADE)


func _style_star_slot(slot: Control, kind: String) -> void:
	var colors := {
		"gold": Color(0.93, 0.78, 0.3),
		"silver": Color(0.72, 0.76, 0.82),
		"empty": Color(0.28, 0.3, 0.32),
	}
	var color: Color = colors.get(kind, colors["empty"])
	for child in slot.get_children():
		if child is TextureRect:
			var tex: Texture2D = _art("star_" + kind)
			if tex == null:
				tex = _art("star_empty")
			if tex:
				(child as TextureRect).texture = tex
		elif child is Label:
			(child as Label).text = "★"
			(child as Label).add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)


func _pop_star(slot: Control, gold_index: int) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_style_star_slot(slot, "gold")
	slot.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
	slot.scale = Vector2.ZERO
	var pitch := 1.0 + CeremonyData.STAR_PITCH_STEP * gold_index
	_sfx("star_pop", pitch)
	if gold_index >= 2:
		_sfx("star_third")
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(slot, "scale", Vector2(1.2, 1.2),
		CeremonyData.STAR_POP_TIME * 0.6) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(slot, "scale", Vector2.ONE, CeremonyData.STAR_POP_TIME * 0.4)
	if _party_level >= 2:
		_spark_star(slot)
	if gold_index >= 2 and _party_level >= 3:
		_shake_banner(Accessibility.shake(CeremonyData.KEEPER_SLAM_SHAKE * 0.6))


func _reveal_silver(slot: Control) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_style_star_slot(slot, "silver")
	slot.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
	_sfx("star_silver")
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(slot, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2)


func _show_rewards(summary: Dictionary) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_rewards_label.text = Loc.t("tower_ceremony.rewards_line", {
		"b": int(summary.get("biomass", 0)),
		"m": int(summary.get("mutant_rolls", 0)),
		"a": int(summary.get("anomaly_rolls", 0)),
	})
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_rewards_label, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3)
	var stars: int = int(summary.get("stars", 0))
	var stars_before: int = int(summary.get("stars_before", 0))
	if stars < stars_before:
		_record_label.text = Loc.t("tower_ceremony.record_note", {"n": stars_before})
		var tw2 := _tween()
		tw2.tween_property(_record_label, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3).set_delay(0.2)


# ==================== БАННЕР ====================

func _accent_for(kind: String) -> Color:
	var accents := {
		"cleared": Color(0.45, 0.5, 0.3),
		"break": Color(0.8, 0.5, 0.15),
		"keeper": Color(0.62, 0.16, 0.12),
		"victory": Color(0.85, 0.7, 0.25),
		"floor_up": Color(0.45, 0.5, 0.35),
		"defeat": Color(0.4, 0.22, 0.22),
		"ring": Color(0.85, 0.7, 0.25),
		"record": Color(0.9, 0.75, 0.2),
	}
	return accents.get(kind, Color(0.45, 0.5, 0.3))


func _banner_style(accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.06, 0.88)
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_border_width_all(4)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	return style


func _set_banner(kind: String, title_text: String, sub_text: String) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	var art: Texture2D = _art("banner_" + kind)
	if art:
		_banner_texture.texture = art
		_banner_texture.visible = true
		_banner_panel.visible = false
	else:
		_banner_texture.visible = false
		_banner_panel.visible = true
		_banner_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _banner_style(_accent_for(kind)))
	_banner.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
	_banner_title.text = title_text
	_banner_sub.text = sub_text
	_banner_sub.visible = sub_text != ""
	_banner.visible = true


## Влёт сверху + панч масштаба (слэм)
func _slam_banner(sfx_slot: String) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	_banner.position.y = -_banner.size.y - 60.0
	_banner.scale = Vector2(CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE, CeremonyData.BANNER_SLAM_SCALE)
	_sfx(sfx_slot)
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "position:y", _banner_base_y,
		_scaled(CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME)) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	var tw2 := _tween()
	tw2.tween_property(_banner, "scale", Vector2.ONE,
		_scaled(CeremonyData.BANNER_IN_TIME)) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Быстрый свап содержимого (баннер «ПОДЪЁМ» на переходе)
func _swap_banner(kind: String, title_text: String) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.15)
	_set_banner(kind, title_text, "")
	var tw2 := _tween()
	tw2.tween_property(_banner, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.15).set_delay(0.15)


func _hide_banner() -> void:
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.2)


func _shake_banner(px: float) -> void:
	var base_x := _banner.position.x
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.set_loops(3)
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "position:x", base_x + px, 0.05)
	tw.tween_property(_banner, "position:x", base_x - px, 0.05)
	tw.chain().tween_property(_banner, "position:x", base_x, 0.05)


# ==================== КОНФЕТТИ И ИСКРЫ ====================

func _confetti(amounts: Array[int], mode: String) -> void:
	if _skipped or _particles_budget <= 0:
		return
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var dir := Vector2(0, 1)
	var spread := 32.0
	var origins: Array[Vector2] = []
	match mode:
		"wave":
			origins = [Vector2(vp.x * (1.0 - CeremonyData.CONFETTI_EMISSION_WIDTH) * 0.5, -20.0)]
		"side":
			spread = 25.0
			origins = [_banner.position + Vector2(20.0, _banner.size.y),
				Vector2(vp.x - 20.0, _banner.position.y + _banner.size.y)]
		"fountain":
			dir = Vector2(0, -1)
			spread = 40.0
			origins = [Vector2(vp.x * 0.5, vp.y * 0.75)]

	for origin in origins:
		var side_flip := 1.0 if (mode != "side" or origin.x < vp.x * 0.5) else -1.0
		for i in mini(amounts.size(), 3):
			var amount: int = amounts[i]
			if _particles_budget <= 0:
				return
			amount = mini(amount, _particles_budget)
			var tex: Texture2D = _art("confetti_0" + str(i + 1))
			if tex == null:
				continue
			_particles_budget -= amount
			var node := _confetti_node(tex, amount, origin,
				Vector2(dir.x * side_flip, dir.y), spread)
			_confetti_host.add_child(node)
			node.emitting = true


func _confetti_node(tex: Texture2D, amount: int, origin: Vector2, dir: Vector2, spread: float) -> GPUParticles2D:
	var node := GPUParticles2D.new()
	node.texture = tex
	node.position = origin
	node.amount = amount
	node.lifetime = CeremonyData.CONFETTI_LIFETIME
	node.one_shot = true
	node.explosiveness = 1.0

	var pm := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	pm.direction = Vector3(dir.x, dir.y, 0.0)
	pm.spread = spread
	pm.gravity = Vector3(0, CeremonyData.CONFETTI_GRAVITY, 0)
	pm.initial_velocity_min = CeremonyData.CONFETTI_VELOCITY_MIN
	pm.initial_velocity_max = CeremonyData.CONFETTI_VELOCITY_MAX
	pm.scale_min = 0.5
	pm.scale_max = 0.9
	pm.angular_velocity_min = -360.0
	pm.angular_velocity_max = 360.0
	pm.lifetime_randomness = 0.15
	node.process_material = pm
	# Самоочистка после одноразового залпа
	node.finished.connect(node.queue_free)
	return node


## Твинклы искр за gold-звездой
func _spark_star(slot: Control) -> void:
	var tex: Texture2D = _art("spark_star")
	if tex == null or _particles_budget < CeremonyData.SPARKS_PER_STAR:
		return
	_particles_budget -= CeremonyData.SPARKS_PER_STAR
	var node := GPUParticles2D.new()
	node.texture = tex
	node.position = slot.global_position + Vector2(_star_size * 0.5, _star_size * 0.5)
	node.amount = CeremonyData.SPARKS_PER_STAR
	node.lifetime = 0.6
	node.one_shot = true
	node.explosiveness = 1.0
	var pm := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	pm.direction = Vector3(0, -1, 0)
	pm.spread = 180.0
	pm.gravity = Vector3(0, 220.0, 0)
	pm.initial_velocity_min = 70.0
	pm.initial_velocity_max = 150.0
	pm.scale_min = 0.4
	pm.scale_max = 0.9
	node.process_material = pm
	node.finished.connect(node.queue_free)
	_confetti_host.add_child(node)
	node.emitting = true


# ==================== ПЕРЕХОД 3D / 2D ====================

## Лестница/портал у Монолита + кат-камера. Нет glb - чисто 2D-переход
## (глиф + затемнение), ошибки не ломают выход в лабораторию.
func _transition(kind: String, next_title: String, stars: int) -> void:
	var prop := _spawn_transition_prop(kind)
	if prop:
		if kind == "portal":
			_sfx("transition_portal")
			_sfx("transition_portal_spark")
			var pm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("particle_manager")
			if pm and pm.has_method("spawn_sparks_at"):
				pm.spawn_sparks_at(prop.global_position + Vector3.UP * 2.0)
		else:
			_sfx("transition_stairs")

	var ok_3d := false
	if prop:
		ok_3d = await _cut_camera_fly(prop)

	if ok_3d:
		_swap_banner("floor_up", next_title)
		await _wait(_scaled(CeremonyData.CAM_TO_TARGET_TIME + CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_TIME))
		if kind == "portal" and stars >= 3:
			_confetti(CeremonyData.CONFETTI_PORTAL_FOUNTAIN, "fountain")
	else:
		await _transition_2d_fallback(next_title)


func _spawn_transition_prop(kind: String) -> Node3D:
	var monolith := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("monolith") as Node3D
	if monolith == null:
		return null
	var path := CeremonyData.MODEL_PORTAL if kind == "portal" else CeremonyData.MODEL_STAIRS
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		return null
	var scene := load(path) as PackedScene
	if scene == null:
		return null
	var node := scene.instantiate() as Node3D
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(node)

	# От Монолита в сторону боевой камеры, горизонтально
	var dir := Vector3(1, 0, 0)
	if _game_cam and is_instance_valid(_game_cam):
		var to_cam := _game_cam.global_position - monolith.global_position
		to_cam.y = 0.0
		if to_cam.length() > 0.5:
			dir = to_cam.normalized()
	node.global_position = monolith.global_position + dir * CeremonyData.STAIRS_OFFSET
	if _game_cam and is_instance_valid(_game_cam):
		node.look_at(_game_cam.global_position, Vector3.UP)
	if kind == "portal":
		_portal = node
	return node


## Кат-камера: спавн в текущей позе, подлёт к пропсу, подъём. false - без
## активной камеры (2D-фолбэк).
func _cut_camera_fly(prop: Node3D) -> bool:
	var active := get_viewport().get_camera_3d()
	if active == null:
		return false

	_cut_cam = Camera3D.new()
	_cut_cam.fov = 65.0
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(_cut_cam)
	_cut_cam.global_transform = active.global_transform
	_cut_cam.make_current()

	# Направление «от Монолита наружу» - вдоль пропса, горизонтально
	var dir_out := Vector3(1, 0, 0)
	var monolith := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("monolith") as Node3D
	if monolith:
		var v := prop.global_position - monolith.global_position
		v.y = 0.0
		if v.length() > 0.5:
			dir_out = v.normalized()

	var base := prop.global_position
	var fly_to := base + dir_out * 7.0 + Vector3.UP * 1.8
	_fly(fly_to, base + Vector3.UP * 2.2, CeremonyData.CAM_TO_TARGET_TIME)
	await _wait(_scaled(CeremonyData.CAM_TO_TARGET_TIME))
	if _dead():
		return true

	var rise_to := fly_to + Vector3.UP * CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_HEIGHT
	var look_b := base + Vector3.UP * (2.2 + CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_HEIGHT * 0.5)
	_fly(rise_to, look_b, CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_TIME)
	await _wait(_scaled(CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_TIME))
	return true


## Плавный перелёт кат-камеры (косинусный ease-in-out), ориентация на цель
func _fly(to: Vector3, look_target: Vector3, time: float) -> void:
	var from := _cut_cam.global_position
	var path := func(v: float):
		if _cut_cam == null or not is_instance_valid(_cut_cam):
			return
		var e := 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(PI * v)
		_cut_cam.global_position = from.lerp(to, e)
		if _cut_cam.global_position.distance_to(look_target) > 0.5:
			_cut_cam.look_at(look_target)
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_method(path, 0.0, 1.0, _scaled(time))


## 2D-фолбэк перехода: глиф (арт или «▲») всплывает по центру экрана
func _transition_2d_fallback(banner_title: String) -> void:
	_swap_banner("floor_up", banner_title)
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size

	var glyph := Control.new()
	glyph.position = Vector2(vp.x * 0.5 - _star_size, vp.y * 0.45)
	glyph.size = Vector2(_star_size * 2.0, _star_size * 2.0)
	glyph.pivot_offset = glyph.size * 0.5
	var tex: Texture2D = _art("glyph_stairs")
	if tex:
		var tex_rect := TextureRect.new()
		tex_rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		tex_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		tex_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		tex_rect.texture = tex
		glyph.add_child(tex_rect)
	else:
		var label := Label.new()
		label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(_star_size * 1.2))
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.85, 0.8, 0.55))
		label.text = "▲"
		glyph.add_child(label)
	glyph.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
	_root.add_child(glyph)

	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(glyph, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(glyph, "position:y", glyph.position.y - vp.y * 0.08, 1.2) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	var tw2 := _tween()
	tw2.tween_property(glyph, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3).set_delay(1.4)

	await _wait(_scaled(CeremonyData.CAM_TO_TARGET_TIME + CeremonyData.CAM_RISE_TIME))


# ==================== ТИТР И ЗАТЕМНЕНИЕ ====================

func _show_title(text: String, hold: float) -> void:
	_fade_to(1.0, CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)
	await _wait(CeremonyData.FADE_OUT_TIME)
	if _dead():
		return
	_title_label.text = text
	_title_label.visible = true
	_sfx("floor_title")
	await _wait(_scaled(hold))
	await _wait(CeremonyData.SCENE_CHANGE_DELAY)


func _fade_to(alpha: float, time: float) -> void:
	var tw := _tween()
	tw.tween_property(_fade, "color:a", alpha, time)


# ==================== СЕРВИС ====================

func _sfx(slot: String, pitch_override: float = -1.0) -> void:
	if _skipped:
		return
	var cfg: Dictionary = CeremonyData.SFX_MAP.get(slot, {})
	if cfg.is_empty():
		return
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm == null or not sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		return
	var pitch: float = pitch_override if pitch_override >= 0.0 else float(cfg.get("pitch", 1.0))
	sm.play_sound(String(cfg.get("key", "")), float(cfg.get("vol", 1.0)), pitch)


func _tween() -> Tween:
	var tw := create_tween()
	_tweens.append(tw)
	return tw


func _scaled(seconds: float) -> float:
	return seconds * _time_scale


func _dead() -> bool:
	return _skipped


## Ожидание с отзывчивым скипом (поллинг 20 раз/с)
func _wait(seconds: float) -> void:
	var left := _scaled(seconds)
	while left > 0.0 and not _skipped:
		var step := minf(left, 0.05)
		await get_tree().create_timer(step).timeout
		left -= step


## Ожидание без проверки скипа (финальное затемнение при скипе)
func _wait_raw(seconds: float) -> void:
	var left := seconds
	while left > 0.0:
		var step := minf(left, 0.05)
		await get_tree().create_timer(step).timeout
		left -= step


func _stop_all_particles() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_confetti_host):
		return
	for child in _confetti_host.get_children():
		if child is GPUParticles2D:
			(child as GPUParticles2D).emitting = false


func _process(delta: float):
	if _portal and is_instance_valid(_portal) and not _skipped:
		_portal.rotate_y(CeremonyData.PORTAL_SPIN_SPEED * delta)


# ==================== СКИП ====================

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _skipped or not is_instance_valid(_root):
		return
	var do_skip := false
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		do_skip = true
	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch and event.pressed:
		do_skip = true
	elif not event.is_echo() and (event.is_action_pressed("ui_accept")
			or event.is_action_pressed("ui_select")):
		do_skip = true
	if do_skip:
		_skip()


func _skip():
	_sfx("skip")
	_skipped = true
	for tw in _tweens:
		if tw.is_valid():
			tw.kill()
	_tweens.clear()
	_stop_all_particles()
	_hide_all_ui()


func _hide_all_ui() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_root):
		return
	for child in _root.get_children():
		if child != _fade:
			child.visible = false

func _on_echo_btn_pressed() -> void:
                _play_click_sound()

                                return
                if zc.get("_pending_placement") == "echo":
                                zc.set_pending_placement("")

func _refresh_tower_conditions():
                """Условия звёзд текущего этажа: только башня и только после старта забега"""
                if not is_instance_valid(_tower_conditions_panel) or not is_instance_valid(_tower_conditions_label):
                        return
                if not is_instance_valid(start_panel):
                        return
                var rp: Dictionary = {}
                if zone_controller != null:
                        var raw = zone_controller.get("run_params")
                        if raw is Dictionary:
                                rp = raw
                var is_tower: bool = str(rp.get("run_mode", "")) == "tower"
                var started: bool = not start_panel.visible
                var f: int = int(rp.get("tower_floor", 0))
                if not is_tower or not started or f < 1:
                        _tower_conditions_panel.visible = false
                        return
                var conds: Array = TowerData.get_star_conditions(f)
                if conds.size() < 2:
                        _tower_conditions_panel.visible = false
                        return
                var n2: String = str(TowerData.STAR_CONDITIONS.get(conds[0], {}).get("name", ""))
                var n3: String = str(TowerData.STAR_CONDITIONS.get(conds[1], {}).get("name", ""))
                _tower_conditions_label.text = "ЭТАЖ %d - условия звёзд\n★★ %s: %s\n★★★ %s: %s" % [
                                                f, n2, TowerData.condition_text(conds[0], f),
                                                n3, TowerData.condition_text(conds[1], f)]
                _tower_conditions_panel.visible = true


func _load_minimap():
                """SVG-карта сектора: res://ui/lab/minimap.svg (опционально).
                Нет файла - точки рисуются на голой панели."""
                const MAP_PATH := "res://ui/lab/minimap.svg"
                if ResourceLoader.exists(MAP_PATH):
                                minimap_art.texture = load(MAP_PATH)
                else:
                                minimap_art.visible = false

                if not zone_controller:

                var anomalies = {

                                jelly_button: ["chemical_jelly", "an.jelly", "chem"], gas_button: ["chemical_gas", "an.gas", "chem"],
                                acid_cloud_button: ["chemical_acid_cloud", "an.acid_cloud", "chem"], radiation_button: ["radiation_hotspot", "an.radiation", "rad"],
                                time_button: ["time_dilation", "an.time", "gravity"], teleport_button: ["teleport", "an.teleport", "gravity"],
                                tesla_button: ["electric_tesla", "an.tesla", "electric"], fluff_button: ["bio_burning_fluff", "an.fluff", "rad"],
                }
                var mutants = {
                                dog_button: ["dog_mutant", "mu.dog", "bio"], flesh_button: ["flesh", "mu.flesh", "bio"], snork_button: ["snork_mutant", "mu.snork", "bio"],
                                pseudodog_button: ["pseudodog", "mu.pseudodog", "bio"], controller_button: ["controller_mutant", "mu.controller", "bio"],
                                poltergeist_button: ["poltergeist", "mu.poltergeist", "bio"], bloodsucker_button: ["bloodsucker", "mu.bloodsucker", "bio"],
                                chimera_button: ["chimera", "mu.chimera", "bio"], zombie_button: ["zombie", "mu.zombie", "bio"],
                                pseudogiant_button: ["pseudogiant", "mu.pseudogiant", "bio"],
                }
                _mutant_buttons = {}
                _anomaly_buttons = {}
                _anomaly_base_costs = {}
                for btn in anomalies:
                                var cost: int = int(am.get_anomaly_cost(anomalies[btn][0])) if am else 0
                                # Имя и цена в ОДНОЙ строке; шрифт 9 - цена влезает в узкую кнопку
                                btn.text = Loc.t(anomalies[btn][1]) + " ⚡" + str(cost)
                                btn.clip_text = true
                                btn.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
                                btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 9)
                                btn.tooltip_text = Loc.t(anomalies[btn][1]) + " ⚡" + str(cost)
                                _apply_ability_icon(btn, "anomaly", anomalies[btn][0])
                                _anomaly_buttons[btn] = anomalies[btn][0]
                                _anomaly_base_costs[anomalies[btn][0]] = cost
                                _style_el_button(btn, anomalies[btn][2])
                for btn in mutants:
                                var cost: int = int(sm.get_mutant_cost(mutants[btn][0])) if sm else 0
                                btn.text = Loc.t(mutants[btn][1]) + " 🧬" + str(cost)
                                btn.clip_text = true
                                btn.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
                                btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 9)
                                btn.tooltip_text = Loc.t(mutants[btn][1]) + " 🧬" + str(cost)
                                _apply_ability_icon(btn, "mutant", mutants[btn][0])
                                _mutant_buttons[btn] = mutants[btn][0]
                                _mutant_base_costs[mutants[btn][0]] = cost
                                _style_el_button(btn, mutants[btn][2])
                refresh_mutant_unlocks()
                _update_affordability()


func refresh_mutant_unlocks():
                """Гейтинг коллекции: без разблокировки мутант/аномалия в бой не применить"""
                var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
                for btn in _anomaly_buttons:
                                var anomaly_type: String = _anomaly_buttons[btn]
                                var artifact_key: String = GachaData.get_artifact_for_anomaly(anomaly_type)
                                var art_unlocked: bool = artifact_key.is_empty() or (gm.is_artifact_unlocked(artifact_key) if gm else true)
                                btn.disabled = not art_unlocked
                                btn.tooltip_text = (Loc.t("hud.anomaly_locked_tip", {"artifact": Loc.type_name(artifact_key)})) if not art_unlocked else ""
                                if not art_unlocked and not btn.text.begins_with("🔒"):
                                                btn.text = "🔒" + btn.text
                                if art_unlocked and btn.text.begins_with("🔒"):
                                                btn.text = btn.text.trim_prefix("🔒")
                for btn in _mutant_buttons:
                                var type: String = _mutant_buttons[btn]
                                var ex_t: String = ""
                                if gm and gm.has_method("owned_mutant_exclusive_for"):
                                                ex_t = gm.owned_mutant_exclusive_for(type)
                                var unlocked: bool = true if gm == null else (gm.is_mutant_unlocked(type) or not ex_t.is_empty())
                                btn.disabled = not unlocked
                                # Показатели вида: ХП/урон (со звёздами) + скилл новых видов.
                                # Активный тип = эксклюзив владельца, если он замещает базовый
                                var tip_type: String = ex_t if not ex_t.is_empty() else type
                                var lab_tip = gm.get_lab_data() if gm else null
                                var st_t: int = lab_tip.get_mutant_stars(tip_type) if lab_tip else 1
                                var aw_t: int = lab_tip.get_awaken(tip_type) if lab_tip else 0
                                var ds: Dictionary = MutantRoles.display_stats(tip_type, st_t, aw_t)
                                var tip: String = Loc.t("card.stats", {"hp": str(int(ds["hp"])), "dmg": str(int(ds["dmg"]))})
                                var ak := "aura." + tip_type
                                if Loc.t(ak) != ak:
                                                tip += "
" + Loc.t(ak)
                                if not ex_t.is_empty():
                                                # Эксклюзив Чёрного ящика заменяет базовый вид (v0.21.0)
                                                var ex_label: String = EXCLUSIVE_SHORT.get(ex_t, GachaData.display_name(ex_t))
                                                btn.text = "✦ " + ex_label + "
🧬" + str(int(_mutant_base_costs.get(type, 0)))
                                                btn.tooltip_text = "Эксклюзив Чёрного ящика: %s - Зона ставит усиленную версию
%s" % [GachaData.display_name(ex_t), tip]
                                else:
                                                btn.tooltip_text = (Loc.t("hud.locked_tip") + "
" + tip) if not unlocked else tip
                                                if not unlocked and not btn.text.begins_with("🔒"):
                                                                btn.text = "🔒" + btn.text
                _refresh_loadout_ui()

func _setup_sounds():
                var buttons = [
                                fire_button, electric_button, acid_button,
                                vortex_button, lift_button, whirlwind_button,
                                steam_button, comet_button, jelly_button,
                                gas_button, acid_cloud_button, radiation_button,
                                time_button, teleport_button, tesla_button, fluff_button,
