extends CanvasLayer
class_name RunPopups

## Поп-апы забега (v0.28.0 «ПЕРЕДЫШКА С ПРИВКУСОМ»):
##  - show_event: событие Зоны, выбор 1 из 2 (эффект применяет zone_controller)
##  - show_shop: магазин торговца «Седого» за биомассу забега
## Слой живёт над HUD, на время выбора ставит паузу сцены: волны, таймеры
## и выброс замирают, кнопки поп-апа работают (PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS).

signal modal_closed

const COL_GOLD := Color("ffd94d")
const COL_ORANGE := Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.2)
const COL_SAFE := Color(0.55, 0.9, 0.4)
const COL_RISK := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.25)
const COL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.9, 0.8)
const COL_DIM := Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.58)
const COL_BG := Color(0.05, 0.045, 0.03, 0.97)

var _root: Control = null
var _center: CenterContainer = null
var _pause_set: bool = false
var _prev_mouse_mode: int = -1
# Магазин
var _on_buy: Callable = Callable()
var _biomass_getter: Callable = Callable()
var _items_getter: Callable = Callable()
var _biomass_label: Label = null
var _biomass_last: float = -1.0
var _shop_note_label: Label = null
var _shop_note_seq: int = 0
var _shop_grid: GridContainer = null
var _shop_buttons: Dictionary = {}


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 90
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS


func is_modal_open() -> bool:
	return is_instance_valid(_root)


# ==================== СОБЫТИЕ ЗОНЫ (ВЫБОР 1 ИЗ 2) ====================

func show_event(ev: Dictionary, on_choose: Callable) -> void:
	if is_modal_open():
		return
	_open_root()
	var ru: bool = Loc.lang == "ru"
	var panel := _make_panel(Vector2(920, 0))
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("run_ev.title"), 40, COL_ORANGE, true))
	v.add_child(_make_label(str(ev.get("title_ru" if ru else "title_en", "")), 52, COL_GOLD, true))
	v.add_child(_make_label(str(ev.get("desc_ru" if ru else "desc_en", "")), 24, COL_TEXT))
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("run_ev.choose"), 19, COL_DIM))
	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 26)
	h.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var opts: Array = ev.get("options", [])
	for i in range(opts.size()):
		h.add_child(_build_event_option(opts[i], i, on_choose))
	v.add_child(h)
	panel.add_child(v)
	_show_panel(panel)


func _build_event_option(opt: Dictionary, index: int, on_choose: Callable) -> PanelContainer:
	var ru: bool = Loc.lang == "ru"
	var safe: bool = RunEventsData.tone_of(opt) != "risk"
	var accent: Color = COL_SAFE if safe else COL_RISK
	var pc := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := _box_style(accent, Color(0.06, 0.055, 0.035, 0.98))
	sb.set_border_width_all(3)
	sb.content_margin_left = 18.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 18.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 14.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 14.0
	pc.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	v.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400, 0)
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("run_ev.safe") if safe else Loc.t("run_ev.risk"), 17, accent, true))
	v.add_child(_make_label(str(opt.get("label_ru" if ru else "label_en", "")), 34, Color.WHITE, true))
	v.add_child(_make_label(str(opt.get("desc_ru" if ru else "desc_en", "")), 20, COL_TEXT))
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = Loc.t("run_ev.pick")
	_style_button(btn, accent, 22)
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 62)
	btn.pressed.connect(func():
		btn.disabled = true
		var res: String = str(on_choose.call(index))
		_flash_and_close(res))
	v.add_child(btn)
	pc.add_child(v)
	return pc


# ==================== МАГАЗИН ТОРГОВЦА ====================

func show_shop(items: Array, on_buy: Callable, biomass_getter: Callable, items_getter: Callable) -> void:
	if is_modal_open():
		return
	_on_buy = on_buy
	_biomass_getter = biomass_getter
	_items_getter = items_getter
	_open_root()
	var panel := _make_panel(Vector2(1024, 0))
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("trader.title"), 44, COL_GOLD, true))
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("trader.note"), 18, COL_DIM))
	_biomass_label = _make_label("", 23, COL_SAFE, true)
	_biomass_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_SAFE)
	_biomass_last = -1.0
	v.add_child(_biomass_label)
	_shop_note_label = _make_label("", 19, COL_RISK, true)
	_shop_note_label.visible = false
	v.add_child(_shop_note_label)
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 470)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	var grid := GridContainer.new()
	grid.columns = 2
	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 18)
	grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 14)
	_shop_grid = grid
	scroll.add_child(grid)
	# Свайп-слой (v0.29.2): тянешь - едет, флик - инерция, тап - КУПИТЬ под пальцем
	v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(scroll, false))
	var close_btn := Button.new()
	close_btn.text = Loc.t("trader.close")
	_style_button(close_btn, COL_GOLD, 19)
	close_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(220, 54)
	close_btn.pressed.connect(_close_root)
	var ch := HBoxContainer.new()
	ch.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END
	ch.add_child(close_btn)
	v.add_child(ch)
	panel.add_child(v)
	_fill_shop(items)
	_update_biomass_label()
	_show_panel(panel)


func _fill_shop(items: Array) -> void:
	for c in _shop_grid.get_children():
		_shop_grid.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	_shop_buttons.clear()
	var ru: bool = Loc.lang == "ru"
	for item in items:
		var id: String = str(item.get("id", ""))
		var cost: int = int(item.get("cost", 0))
		var pc := PanelContainer.new()
		pc.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _box_style(Color(0.5, 0.46, 0.3), Color(0.07, 0.065, 0.045, 0.98)))
		var iv := VBoxContainer.new()
		iv.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 5)
		iv.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(462, 0)
		var nm: String = str(item.get("name", ""))
		if nm.is_empty():
			nm = str(item.get("name_ru", "") if ru else item.get("name_en", ""))
		var name_l := _make_label(nm, 25, COL_GOLD, true)
		name_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		iv.add_child(name_l)
		var cost_l := _make_label("%d" % cost, 21, COL_SAFE, true)
		cost_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		iv.add_child(cost_l)
		var ds: String = str(item.get("desc", ""))
		if ds.is_empty():
			ds = str(item.get("desc_ru", "") if ru else item.get("desc_en", ""))
		var desc_l := _make_label(ds, 17, COL_TEXT)
		desc_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		desc_l.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 62)
		iv.add_child(desc_l)
		var btn := Button.new()
		_style_button(btn, COL_SAFE, 17)
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 52)
		if bool(item.get("sold", false)):
			_mark_sold(btn)
		else:
			btn.text = "%s  %d" % [Loc.t("trader.buy"), cost]
			btn.pressed.connect(func():
				var res: String = str(_on_buy.call(id))
				if res.is_empty():
					_shop_note(Loc.t("trader.no_money"), Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.3))
				else:
					_shop_note(res, COL_SAFE)
					_refresh_shop())
		_shop_buttons[id] = btn
		iv.add_child(btn)
		pc.add_child(iv)
		_shop_grid.add_child(pc)


## Перечитать товар и биомассу после покупки (состояние ведёт zone_controller)
func _refresh_shop() -> void:
	_update_biomass_label()
	if not _items_getter.is_valid():
		return
	var items: Array = _items_getter.call()
	for item in items:
		var id: String = str(item.get("id", ""))
		var btn: Button = _shop_buttons.get(id, null)
		if btn == null or not is_instance_valid(btn):
			continue
		if bool(item.get("sold", false)) and not btn.disabled:
			_mark_sold(btn)
		elif not bool(item.get("sold", false)) and btn.disabled:
			btn.disabled = false
			btn.text = "%s  %d" % [Loc.t("trader.buy"), int(item.get("cost", 0))]


func _mark_sold(btn: Button) -> void:
	btn.disabled = true
	btn.text = Loc.t("trader.sold")


func _update_biomass_label() -> void:
	if _biomass_label == null or not is_instance_valid(_biomass_label):
		return
	var value: float = float(_biomass_getter.call()) if _biomass_getter.is_valid() else 0.0
	_biomass_label.text = Loc.t("trader.biomass", {"n": int(value)})
	# Списание видно глазом: цифра вздрагивает красным при трате, зелёным - к пополнению
	if _biomass_last >= 0.0 and not is_equal_approx(value, _biomass_last):
		var col: Color = Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.3) if value < _biomass_last else COL_SAFE
		_biomass_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_interval(0.6)
		tw.tween_callback(func():
			if is_instance_valid(_biomass_label):
				_biomass_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_SAFE))
	_biomass_last = value


func _shop_note(text: String, col: Color) -> void:
	if _shop_note_label == null or not is_instance_valid(_shop_note_label):
		return
	_shop_note_label.text = text
	_shop_note_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	_shop_note_label.visible = true
	_shop_note_seq += 1
	var seq := _shop_note_seq
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.6)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		if seq == _shop_note_seq and is_instance_valid(_shop_note_label):
			_shop_note_label.visible = false)


# ==================== КАРКАС ПОП-АПА ====================

func _open_root() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(_root):
		return
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "RunPopupRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	# 0.45 (было 0.66): затемнение не должно гасить HUD - кнопки забега
	# остаются читаемыми, поп-ап и так поверх со своей плотной подложкой
	dim.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.45)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_root.add_child(dim)
	_center = CenterContainer.new()
	_center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_center.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_root.add_child(_center)
	add_child(_root)
	# Пауза сцены на время выбора: волны/таймеры/выброс замирают
	if not get_tree().paused:
		get_tree().paused = true
		_pause_set = true
	# Пауза глушит _input камеры - ESC не освободит курсор. Показываем сами,
	# иначе на ПК поп-ап не кликнуть вовсе. Прежний режим помним - вернём его.
	if not DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available():
		_prev_mouse_mode = Input.mouse_mode
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE


func _close_root() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_root):
		return
	var root := _root
	_root = null
	_center = null
	_shop_grid = null
	_shop_buttons.clear()
	if _pause_set:
		_pause_set = false
		get_tree().paused = false
	# Курсор возвращаем в тот режим, что был до поп-апа (ПК)
	if _prev_mouse_mode >= 0 and not DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available():
		Input.mouse_mode = _prev_mouse_mode
		_prev_mouse_mode = -1
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(root, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.12)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		if is_instance_valid(root):
			root.queue_free()
		modal_closed.emit())


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	# Поп-ап жил при смене сцены (итог забега) - не оставлять паузу и захват
	if _pause_set:
		_pause_set = false
		get_tree().paused = false
	if not DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available():
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE


func _show_panel(panel: PanelContainer) -> void:
	_center.add_child(panel)
	panel.reset_size()
	panel.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
	panel.scale = Vector2(0.92, 0.92)
	panel.pivot_offset = panel.size / 2.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)
	tw.tween_property(panel, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.26).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Итог выбора: вспышка-итог на месте панели, затем закрытие и снятие паузы
func _flash_and_close(text: String) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_root):
		return
	var ok: bool = not text.is_empty()
	var panel := _make_panel(Vector2(620, 0))
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	v.add_child(_make_label(Loc.t("run_ev.outcome"), 21, COL_DIM))
	v.add_child(_make_label(text if ok else Loc.t("trader.no_money"), 30, COL_SAFE if ok else Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.3), true))
	panel.add_child(v)
	for c in _center.get_children():
		c.visible = false
	_center.add_child(panel)
	panel.reset_size()
	panel.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.15)
	tw.tween_interval(1.2)
	tw.tween_callback(_close_root)


# ==================== СТИЛЬ (БУНКЕР) ====================

func _make_panel(min_size: Vector2) -> PanelContainer:
	var pc := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := _box_style(COL_GOLD, COL_BG)
	sb.set_border_width_all(3)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
	sb.shadow_size = 24
	sb.content_margin_left = 30.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 30.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 20.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 20.0
	pc.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	pc.custom_minimum_size = min_size
	return pc


func _box_style(border: Color, bg: Color = Color(0.09, 0.085, 0.06, 1.0)) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = bg
	sb.border_color = border
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.content_margin_left = 12.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 12.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 8.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
	return sb


func _style_button(btn: Button, accent: Color, fs: int = 20) -> void:
	btn.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", Color(0.55, 0.53, 0.45))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _box_style(accent))
	var hv := _box_style(accent, Color(0.16, 0.14, 0.07, 1.0))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hv)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hv)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", _box_style(Color(0.35, 0.33, 0.25), Color(0.06, 0.055, 0.04, 1.0)))
	btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE


func _make_label(text: String, fs: int, color: Color, title := false) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title() if title else BunkerUI.font_body())
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return l

# ui/lab/accessibility_controls.gd
extends VBoxContainer
class_name AccessibilityControls

## Блок настроек доступности (D14): масштаб UI, дальтоник, тряска, мерцание.
## Живёт в settings.cfg [ui]; вставляется в настройки меню и лаборатории.
## Масштаб применяется к корню текущей сцены (HUD боя не масштабируется).

var _cb_values: Array = ["off", "protan", "deutan"]


func _ready() -> void:
	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(340, 158)
	_add_slider(Loc.t("access.scale"), Accessibility.ui_scale(), 0.8, 1.3, 0.05,
		func(v: float):
			Accessibility.set_value("scale", v)
			_apply_scale())
	_add_slider(Loc.t("access.shake"), Accessibility.shake_mult(), 0.0, 1.0, 0.1,
		func(v: float): Accessibility.set_value("shake", v))
	_add_slider(Loc.t("access.flicker"), Accessibility.flicker_mult(), 0.0, 1.0, 0.1,
		func(v: float): Accessibility.set_value("flicker", v))
	_add_colorblind_button()
	_apply_scale()


func _add_slider(text: String, value: float, mn: float, mx: float, step: float, on_change: Callable) -> void:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	add_child(l)
	var s := HSlider.new()
	s.min_value = mn
	s.max_value = mx
	s.step = step
	s.value = value
	s.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 18)
	s.value_changed.connect(on_change)
	add_child(s)


func _add_colorblind_button() -> void:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 30)
	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	b.pressed.connect(func():
		var nxt: int = (Accessibility.colorblind() + 1) % 3
		Accessibility.set_value("cb", nxt)
		_update_cb_text(b))
	_update_cb_text(b)
	add_child(b)


func _update_cb_text(b: Button) -> void:
	var names: Array = [Loc.t("access.cb_off"), Loc.t("access.cb_protan"), Loc.t("access.cb_deutan")]
	b.text = Loc.t("access.cb") + ": " + str(names[Accessibility.colorblind()])


func _apply_scale() -> void:
	var scene := get_tree().current_scene
	if scene is Control:
		Accessibility.apply_ui_scale(scene)

# ui/lab/codex_overlay.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name CodexOverlay

## КОДЕКС ЗОНЫ (спека zona_codex): 5 статичных страниц-справок в стиле
## панелей лаборатории. Тексты - ключи codex.* в Loc; данные страниц -
## статический контент здесь (это текст, не баланс). Слой 9 - поверх
## панелей лабы; работает и в меню без лаборатории.

const COL_GOLD := Color("ffd94d")
const COL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.9, 0.8)
const COL_DIM := Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.58)

var _root: Control = null
var _tabs_box: HBoxContainer = null
var _scroll: ScrollContainer = null
var _text: Label = null
var _page: int = 0
var _tab_group: ButtonGroup = null

# [ключ вкладки, [ключи абзацев]]
const PAGES := [
	["codex.tab_res", ["codex.res.energy", "codex.res.bio", "codex.res.rolls", "codex.res.sp"]],
	["codex.tab_anom", ["codex.anom.place", "codex.anom.unlock", "codex.anom.sets", "codex.anom.trophy"]],
	["codex.tab_mut", ["codex.mut.cost", "codex.mut.stars", "codex.mut.recycle"]],
	["codex.tab_packs", ["codex.pack.what", "codex.pack.unlock", "codex.pack.battle", "codex.pack.turn", "codex.pack.roles", "codex.pack.synergy", "codex.pack.stats"]],
	["codex.tab_rad", ["codex.rad.blow", "codex.rad.zone"]],
	["codex.tab_modes", ["codex.modes.campaign", "codex.modes.tower", "codex.modes.survival", "codex.modes.season"]],
	["codex.tab_hunt", ["codex.hunt.what", "codex.hunt.reward", "codex.hunt.escape"]],
	["codex.tab_guild", ["codex.guild.what", "codex.guild.boss", "codex.guild.tokens"]],
]


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 9
	_build()


func open() -> void:
	if _root == null:
		_build()
	_page = 0
	_refresh()
	_root.visible = true


func _build() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "CodexRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_root.visible = false
	add_child(_root)

	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	dim.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
			close())
	_root.add_child(dim)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var w: float = clampf(vp.x * 0.55, 340.0, 640.0)
	if vp.x < 900.0:
		w = vp.x * 0.94   # узкий экран: во всю ширину
	panel.offset_left = -w * 0.5
	panel.offset_right = w * 0.5
	panel.offset_top = -vp.y * 0.35
	panel.offset_bottom = vp.y * 0.35
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.GREEN
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	sb.shadow_size = 22
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = Loc.t("codex.title")
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.GREEN)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(title)

	_tabs_box = HBoxContainer.new()
	_tabs_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	v.add_child(_tabs_box)
	_tab_group = ButtonGroup.new()

	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	_scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(_scroll, false))

	_text = Label.new()
	_text.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_text.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	_text.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	_text.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_TEXT)
	_text.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_scroll.add_child(_text)

	var close_btn := Button.new()
	close_btn.text = Loc.t("lab.back")
	close_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 48)
	close_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	BunkerUI.style_button(close_btn, "steel", 15)
	close_btn.pressed.connect(close)
	v.add_child(close_btn)


func _refresh() -> void:
	for c in _tabs_box.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	for i in range(PAGES.size()):
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = Loc.t(str(PAGES[i][0]))
		b.toggle_mode = true
		b.button_group = _tab_group
		b.button_pressed = i == _page
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
		b.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		# вкладок много - мельче шрифт, чтобы названия не резались
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12 if PAGES.size() <= 6 else 10)
		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		b.pressed.connect(_on_tab.bind(i))
		_tabs_box.add_child(b)

	var paras: Array = PAGES[_page][1]
	var parts: Array = []
	for k in paras:
		parts.append(str(Loc.t(str(k))))
	_text.text = "  \n\n".join(parts)
	if _scroll:
		_scroll.scroll_vertical = 0


func _on_tab(i: int) -> void:
	_play_click()
	_page = i
	_refresh()


func close() -> void:
	if _root:
		_root.visible = false


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# ESC закрывает кодекс, но только пока он открыт - меню/лабе не мешаем
	if _root == null or not _root.visible:
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		close()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()


func _play_click() -> void:
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.5)

# ui/lab/guild_overlay.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name GuildOverlay

## ГИЛЬДИЯ (D21 офлайн): Обзор (состав/казна) · Босс (рейд) · Чат · Магазин.
## Слой 9, поверх панелей лабы. Боты детерминированы, чат - дневник событий.

const COL_GOLD := Color("ffd94d")
const COL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.9, 0.8)
const COL_DIM := Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.58)
const COL_PURPLE := Color(0.70, 0.40, 1.00)
const COL_GREEN := Color("a8ff7a")

var _root: Control = null
var _tabs_box: HBoxContainer = null
var _body: Control = null
var _page: int = 0
var _save = null
var _chat_log: VBoxContainer = null
var _quick_row: HBoxContainer = null


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 9


func open(save) -> void:
	_save = save
	if _root == null:
		_build()
	GuildSys.ensure(_save)
	_refresh()
	_root.visible = true
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("guild_banner", 0.7)


func close() -> void:
	if _root:
		_root.visible = false


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _root == null or not _root.visible:
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		close()


func _build() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "GuildRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_root.visible = false
	add_child(_root)

	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	dim.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
			close())
	_root.add_child(dim)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -430.0
	panel.offset_right = 430.0
	panel.offset_top = -370.0
	panel.offset_bottom = 370.0
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = COL_PURPLE
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
	sb.shadow_size = 22
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = Loc.t("guild.title")
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_PURPLE)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(title)

	_tabs_box = HBoxContainer.new()
	_tabs_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	v.add_child(_tabs_box)

	_body = Control.new()
	_body.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_body.clip_contents = true
	v.add_child(_body)


func _refresh() -> void:
	for c in _body.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	for c in _tabs_box.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var tabs := [
		[Loc.t("guild.tab_overview"), 0],
		[Loc.t("guild.tab_boss"), 1],
		[Loc.t("guild.tab_chat"), 2],
		[Loc.t("guild.tab_shop"), 3],
	]
	for i in range(tabs.size()):
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = str(tabs[i][0])
		b.toggle_mode = true
		b.button_pressed = i == _page
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 38)
		b.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		b.pressed.connect(func(): _play_click(); _page = i; _refresh())
		_tabs_box.add_child(b)
	# тело рендерит выбранная страница (все чистятся выше)
	match _page:
		0: _page_overview(_body)
		1: _page_boss(_body)
		2: _page_chat(_body)
		3: _page_shop(_body)


func _page_overview(body: Control) -> void:
	var g: Dictionary = GuildSys.ensure(_save)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	body.add_child(v)
	# Шапка гильдии: эмблема + имя/уровень + казна-полоса
	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	v.add_child(head)
	var emblem := TextureRect.new()
	# Эмблема гильдии (щит с трефойлом, помощник); нет файла - лого стека
	var emblem_path := "res://assets/ui/guild/guild_emblem_256.png"
	if ResourceLoader.exists(emblem_path):
			emblem.texture = load(emblem_path)
	elif ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_stack.png"):
			emblem.texture = load("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_stack.png")
	emblem.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(96, 78)
	emblem.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	emblem.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	head.add_child(emblem)
	var hv := VBoxContainer.new()
	hv.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	hv.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	head.add_child(hv)
	var hl := Label.new()
	hl.text = "%s  ·  ур. %d" % [str(g.get("name", "")), GuildSys.guild_level(g)]
	hl.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	hl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 19)
	hl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_PURPLE)
	hv.add_child(hl)
	var xp_bar := ProgressBar.new()
	xp_bar.max_value = GuildData.TREASURY_XP_PER
	xp_bar.value = int(g.get("xp", 0)) % GuildData.TREASURY_XP_PER
	xp_bar.show_percentage = false
	xp_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 8)
	hv.add_child(xp_bar)
	var kl := Label.new()
	kl.text = Loc.t("guild.treasury", {"n": int(g.get("treasury", 0))})
	kl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	kl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	hv.add_child(kl)
	_note(v, Loc.t("guild.perk", {"p": int(GuildSys.perk_hp_bonus(g) * 100)}))
	# D23: флаг войны в шапке + свежие баннеры (объявление/итог) со звуком
	var war: Dictionary = g.get("war", {})
	if not war.is_empty():
		var flag := Label.new()
		if str(war.get("state", "open")) == "open":
			flag.text = Loc.t("guild.war_flag", {"name": str(war.get("enemy", "")),
				"a": int(war.get("my_score", 0)), "b": int(war.get("enemy_score", 0))})
			flag.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
				COL_GOLD if int(war.get("my_score", 0)) >= int(war.get("enemy_score", 0)) else COL_DIM)
		else:
			flag.text = Loc.t("guild.war_flag_won") if str(war.get("state", "")) == "won" else Loc.t("guild.war_flag_lost")
			flag.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD if str(war.get("state", "")) == "won" else COL_DIM)
		flag.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
		flag.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
		v.add_child(flag)
		if bool(war.get("fresh", false)):
			war["fresh"] = false
			g["war"] = war
			_gm_save()
			_play_guild_war_sound()
			_note(v, Loc.t("guild.war_banner_new", {"name": str(war.get("enemy", "")), "n": GuildData.WAR_ATTEMPTS}))
		elif bool(war.get("result_fresh", false)):
			war["result_fresh"] = false
			g["war"] = war
			_gm_save()
			_play_guild_war_sound()
			if str(war.get("state", "")) == "won":
				_note(v, Loc.t("guild.war_banner_win", {"a": int(war.get("my_score", 0)),
					"b": int(war.get("enemy_score", 0)), "t": int(war.get("treasury_gain", 0))}))
			else:
				_note(v, Loc.t("guild.war_banner_lose", {"a": int(war.get("my_score", 0)),
					"b": int(war.get("enemy_score", 0)), "n": GuildData.WAR_LOSE_PERSONAL}))
	# Блок войны: соперник / счёт / попытки / В БОЙ
	if not war.is_empty() and str(war.get("state", "open")) == "open":
		v.add_child(_war_block(war))
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(scroll, false))
	# Состав карточками: GridContainer 5 в ряд
	var grid := GridContainer.new()
	grid.columns = 5
	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 10)
	grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 10)
	grid.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.add_child(grid)
	var icon_pool: Array = ["dog_mutant", "flesh", "snork_mutant", "pseudodog", "bloodsucker", "chimera", "zombie", "controller_mutant", "poltergeist", "pseudogiant", "leden", "vikhor", "mohovik", "guden", "tsveten", "zhivitsa", "zaveden", "shorokh"]
	var mi := 0
	for m in GuildSys.members(g):
		grid.add_child(_member_card(m, str(icon_pool[mi % icon_pool.size()]), mi == 0))
		mi += 1


func _page_boss(body: Control) -> void:
	var g: Dictionary = GuildSys.ensure(_save)
	GuildSys.ensure_week(_save, g)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	body.add_child(v)

	var boss_id: String = GuildSys.boss_id()
	var bdata: Dictionary = BossHuntData.BOSSES.get(boss_id, {})
	var pool: float = GuildSys.boss_pool(g)
	var dmg: int = int(g.get("boss_dmg", 0))
	var left: float = GuildSys.boss_hp_left(g)

	_head_line(v, Loc.t("hunt.guild_boss_name", {"name": str(bdata.get("name_ru", boss_id))}))
	# Портрет босса недели (общий хелпер D22; нет файла - заглушка-буква)
	var prow := HBoxContainer.new()
	prow.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(prow)
	prow.add_child(HuntCalendar.portrait(boss_id, 96.0))
	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.max_value = pool
	bar.value = dmg
	bar.show_percentage = false
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 16)
	v.add_child(bar)
	var pr := Label.new()
	pr.text = "Нанесено: %d / %d  ·  осталось %d" % [dmg, int(pool), int(left)]
	pr.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	pr.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_TEXT)
	v.add_child(pr)
	_note(v, Loc.t("guild.boss_note"))

	var raids_left: int = GuildSys.raids_left_today(g)
	var atk := Button.new()
	atk.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 56)
	atk.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	if raids_left > 0:
		atk.text = Loc.t("guild.attack") + "  (" + str(raids_left) + ")"
		BunkerUI.style_button(atk, "primary", 17)
	else:
		atk.text = Loc.t("guild.attack_extra", {"n": GuildData.EXTRA_RAID_SPARKS})
		BunkerUI.style_button(atk, "hazard", 15)
	atk.pressed.connect(func():
		_play_click()
		var gm2 = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
		var lab2 = gm2.get_lab_data() if gm2 else null
		var left2: int = GuildSys.raids_left_today(GuildSys.ensure(_save))
		if left2 <= 0:
				# Докупить за Искры Пробуждения
				if lab2 and lab2.spend_sparks(GuildData.EXTRA_RAID_SPARKS):
						if gm2:
								gm2.save_to_active_slot()
				else:
						_toast(Loc.t("guild.need_sparks", {"n": GuildData.EXTRA_RAID_SPARKS}))
						return
		close()
		gm_run_raid())
	v.add_child(atk)

	var help := Button.new()
	help.text = Loc.t("guild.call_help")
	help.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 44)
	help.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	BunkerUI.style_button(help, "hazard", 14)
	help.pressed.connect(func():
		_play_click()
		var res: String = GuildSys.call_help(_save, GuildSys.ensure(_save))
		if res != "":
			_toast(res)
		else:
			_toast(Loc.t("guild.help_done"))
		_refresh())
	v.add_child(help)

func _page_shop(body: Control) -> void:

	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)

		var icon_pair: Array = icon_types.get(str(sku), ["mut_dog_mutant", true])
		var av := TextureRect.new()

		row.add_child(price)

		buy.text = Loc.t("store.buy")

		v.add_child(card)

func _buy(sku: String) -> void:
	_play_click()
	var g: Dictionary = GuildSys.ensure(_save)
	var info: Dictionary = GuildData.SHOP.get(sku, {})
	var price: int = int(info.get("price", 0))
	if int(g.get("tokens", 0)) < price:
		_toast(Loc.t("guild.no_tokens"))
		return
	g["tokens"] = tokens_less(g, price)
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm:
		if int(info.get("rolls_mut", 0)) > 0:
			gm.grant_mutant_rolls(int(info["rolls_mut"]), "гильдия")
		if int(info.get("rolls_art", 0)) > 0:
			gm.grant_anomaly_rolls(int(info["rolls_art"]), "гильдия")
		if float(info.get("bio", 0.0)) > 0.0 and gm.get_lab_data():
			gm.get_lab_data().biomass += float(info["bio"])
		if int(info.get("star_feed", 0)) > 0 and gm.get_lab_data():
			gm.get_lab_data().awaken_sparks += int(info["star_feed"])
	gm.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm_b = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm_b and sm_b.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm_b.play_sound("guild_buy", 0.7)
	_toast(Loc.t("guild.bought"))
	_refresh()


func tokens_less(g: Dictionary, price: int) -> int:
	g["tokens"] = int(g.get("tokens", 0)) - price
	return int(g["tokens"])


func gm_run_raid() -> void:
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm:
		gm.change_scene("run", {"hunt": true, "guild_boss": true})


## Карточка члена гильдии: аватар (иконка мутанта), имя, сила/вклад
func _member_card(m: Dictionary, icon_type: String, is_me: bool) -> Control:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.06, 0.1, 0.95)
	sb.border_color = COL_GOLD if is_me else (COL_PURPLE if bool(m["online"]) else Color(0.3, 0.28, 0.36))
	sb.set_border_width_all(2 if is_me else 1)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(6)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	panel.add_child(vb)
	var av := TextureRect.new()
	var ap: String = GachaData.card_icon_path(icon_type, true, not bool(m["online"]))
	if ResourceLoader.exists(ap):
			av.texture = load(ap)
	av.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 64)
	av.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	av.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	vb.add_child(av)
	var nm := Label.new()
	nm.text = str(m["name"])
	nm.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	nm.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD if is_me else COL_TEXT)
	nm.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	nm.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	vb.add_child(nm)
	var pw := Label.new()
	pw.text = "сила %d" % int(m["power"])
	pw.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)
	pw.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	pw.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(pw)
	var ct := Label.new()
	ct.text = Loc.t("guild.contrib", {"n": int(m["contribution"])})
	ct.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)
	ct.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	ct.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(ct)
	return panel

## D23: карточка войны в Обзоре - соперник, счёт, попытки, В БОЙ
func _war_block(war: Dictionary) -> Control:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.09, 0.05, 0.03, 0.95)
	sb.border_color = COL_GOLD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(10)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(h)
	# Багровое знамя войны (глиф-молния)
	var banner := TextureRect.new()
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/ui/guild/guild_banner_crimson.png"):
			banner.texture = load("res://assets/ui/guild/guild_banner_crimson.png")
			banner.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
			banner.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
			banner.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(64, 64)
			h.add_child(banner)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	h.add_child(v)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = Loc.t("guild.war_block_title")
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	v.add_child(title)
	var info := Label.new()
	info.text = "%s\n%s · %s" % [str(war.get("enemy", "")),
		Loc.t("guild.war_score", {"a": int(war.get("my_score", 0)), "b": int(war.get("enemy_score", 0))}),
		Loc.t("guild.war_enemy_power", {"n": int(war.get("power", 0))})]
	info.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	info.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_TEXT)
	v.add_child(info)
	var left: int = maxi(GuildData.WAR_ATTEMPTS - int(war.get("attempts", 0)), 0)
	var att := Label.new()
	att.text = Loc.t("guild.war_attempts_left", {"n": left})
	att.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	att.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	v.add_child(att)
	var fight := Button.new()
	fight.text = Loc.t("guild.war_fight")
	fight.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	fight.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	BunkerUI.style_button(fight, "hazard" if left <= 1 else "primary", 15)
	fight.pressed.connect(_on_war_fight)
	v.add_child(fight)
	return panel


## «В БОЙ»: оборона Бункера обычным выживанием с флагом войны.
## Баг-фикс: раньше ставился только флаг — забег не стартовал (и тост
## уходил в несуществующий HUD лабы). Теперь старт через лабу, как у
## обороны арены: war_defense_run + survival + _on_start_run_pressed.
func _on_war_fight() -> void:
	_play_click()
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null:
		return
	var lab = gm.get_lab_data() if gm.has_method("get_lab_data") else null
	if lab == null or lab.arena_defense_squad.is_empty():
		_panel_note(Loc.t("guild.war_no_squad"))
		return
	gm.war_defense_run = true
	gm.arena_run_kind = ""   # война не двигает СП и счётчики арены
	gm.set_selected_run_mode("survival")
	var scene := get_tree().current_scene
	if scene != null and scene.has_method("_on_start_run_pressed"):
		close()
		scene._on_start_run_pressed()
	else:
		_panel_note(Loc.t("guild.war_no_start"))


## Заметка внутри панели оверлея (в лабе HUD-группы нет — _toast молчал)
func _panel_note(text: String) -> void:
	var note := Label.new()
	note.text = text
	note.anchor_left = 0.5
	note.anchor_right = 0.5
	note.anchor_top = 1.0
	note.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	note.offset_left = -300
	note.offset_right = 300
	note.offset_top = -84
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	note.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT)
	_root.add_child(note)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(1.8)
	tw.tween_property(note, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	tw.tween_callback(note.queue_free)


func _toast(text: String) -> void:

	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.5)

# ui/lab/hunt_calendar.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name HuntCalendar

## КАЛЕНДАРЬ ОХОТЫ (D22, спека design_inbox/hunt_calendar): неделя боссов

## Портрет босса одним контролом (календарь/гильдия/баннер); нет файла -

static func portrait(boss_id: String, size: float) -> Control:

		tr.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED

	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER

func _refresh() -> void:
	var days_box: VBoxContainer = _root.find_child("Days", true, false)
	for c in days_box.get_children():
		# снимаем СРАЗУ: голый queue_free отложен и при повторном
		# обновлении строки наслаивались (сообщение подготовщика 01.11)
		days_box.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	var today_ids: Array = BossHuntData.get_today_bosses()
	for day in BossHuntData.get_week_days():
		days_box.add_child(_make_day_row(day, today_ids))


func _make_day_row(day: Dictionary, today_ids: Array) -> Control:
	var day_v := VBoxContainer.new()
	day_v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	# прошедшие дни недели приглушаем (строго раньше сегодняшнего)
	var dimmed: bool = _day_before_today(day)
	var head := Label.new()
	head.text = Loc.t("huntcal.day_%d" % int(day.get("weekday", 0)))
	head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GREEN if bool(day.get("today")) else COL_DIM)
	if dimmed:
		head.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
	day_v.add_child(head)

	var ids: Array = day.get("ids", [])
	for id in ids:
		var row := _make_boss_row(str(id), bool(day.get("today")), dimmed)
		day_v.add_child(row)
	if ids.is_empty():
		var empty := Label.new()
		empty.text = "—"
		empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		empty.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
		day_v.add_child(empty)
	if dimmed:
		day_v.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
	return day_v


## День строго раньше сегодняшнего (для затемнения прошедших)
func _day_before_today(day: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var dt := Time.get_date_dict_from_system()
	var today_idx: int = (int(dt.get("weekday", 1)) + 6) % 7
	return int(day.get("weekday", 0)) < today_idx


func _make_boss_row(boss_id: String, is_today: bool, dimmed: bool) -> Control:
	var b: Dictionary = BossHuntData.BOSSES.get(boss_id, {})
	var row := Panel.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.09, 0.06, 0.95)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(6)
	if is_today:
		sb.border_color = COL_GREEN
		sb.set_border_width_all(3)
	else:
		sb.border_color = Color(0.26, 0.29, 0.21, 0.6)
		sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)

	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	row.add_child(h)

	h.add_child(portrait(boss_id, 96.0))

	var info := VBoxContainer.new()
	info.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	info.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	h.add_child(info)

	var name_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	info.add_child(name_row)
	var nm := Label.new()
	nm.text = str(b.get("name_ru", boss_id))
	nm.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	nm.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	nm.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	nm.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	name_row.add_child(nm)
	if is_today:
		var badge := Label.new()
		badge.text = Loc.t("huntcal.today")
		badge.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
		badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GREEN)
		name_row.add_child(badge)

	var speed: float = float(b.get("speed", 2.0))
	var stats := Label.new()
	stats.text = "%s  ·  %s  ·  %s" % [
		Loc.t("huntcal.hp", {"n": int(float(b.get("hp_x", 20.0)))}),
		Loc.t("huntcal.speed_slow") if speed <= 0.01 else Loc.t("huntcal.speed_n", {"n": "%.1f" % speed}),
		Loc.t("huntcal.sparks", {"n": int(b.get("sparks", 3))}),
	]
	stats.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	stats.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_TEXT)
	info.add_child(stats)

	var skills: Array = b.get("skills", [])
	var parts: Array = []
	for sk in skills:
		var sid := str(sk.get("id", ""))
		var glyph: String = str(SKILL_GLYPH.get(sid, "•"))
		parts.append("%s %s" % [glyph, Loc.t("huntcal.skill_" + sid)])
	if not parts.is_empty():
		var sk_label := Label.new()
		sk_label.text = "   ".join(parts)
		sk_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		sk_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
		sk_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		info.add_child(sk_label)
	if dimmed:
		row.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
	return row


func _on_go_pressed() -> void:
	# Старт сегодняшней охоты - тот же поток, что кнопка ОХОТА в лабе
	close()
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null:
		return
	if lab:
		gm.selected_campaign_level = lab._campaign_level
		lab._show_message(Loc.t("hunt.today", {"n": ", ".join(BossHuntData.today_names())}))
		await get_tree().create_timer(1.6).timeout
		if not is_instance_valid(gm):
			return
	gm.change_scene("run", {"hunt": true})


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _root == null or not _root.visible:
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		close()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
