func _briefing_open():
        if _brf_root == null:
                _briefing_build()
        if game_manager == null:
                game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        if game_manager == null:
                _briefing_launch()
                return
        # Башня: выбор этажа лабы уходит в менеджер до брифинга (как при запуске)
        if game_manager.get_selected_run_mode() == "tower":
                game_manager.set_selected_tower_floor(_tower_floor)
        var info: Dictionary = BriefingData.for_current_selection(game_manager)
        _brf_hot = bool(info.get("hot", false))
        var place: Dictionary = info.get("place", {})
        var kind: String = str(place.get("kind", "survival"))
        if kind == "tower":
                _brf_place.text = "%s %d/100 · %s" % [Loc.t("brf.place.tower"), int(place.get("level", 1)), str(place.get("title", ""))]
        elif kind == "survival":
                _brf_place.text = Loc.t("brf.place.survival")
        else:
                _brf_place.text = "%s %d/100 · %s" % [Loc.t("brf.place." + kind), int(place.get("level", 1)), str(place.get("title", ""))]
        _brf_header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT if _brf_hot else BunkerUI.GREEN)
        var lines: Array = []
        for k in info.get("keys", []):
                lines.append(Loc.t(str(k)))
        _brf_text.text = "\n\n".join(lines)
        _build_briefing_chips()
        _brf_root.visible = true
        _brf_root.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
        var tw := create_tween()
        tw.tween_property(_brf_root, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)
        _brf_start_typing()


func _briefing_close():
        if _brf_root == null or not _brf_root.visible:
                return
        _brf_skip_typing()
        _brf_root.visible = false


func _brf_start_typing():
        if _brf_tween != null and _brf_tween.is_valid():
                _brf_tween.kill()
        _brf_text.visible_ratio = 0.0
        var n: int = _brf_text.text.length()
        var dur: float = clampf(float(n) / 70.0, 0.7, 2.6)
        _brf_tween = create_tween()
        _brf_tween.tween_property(_brf_text, "visible_ratio", 1.0, dur)


func _brf_skip_typing():
        if _brf_tween != null and _brf_tween.is_valid():
                _brf_tween.kill()
        _brf_text.visible_ratio = 1.0


func _build_briefing_chips():
        for c in _brf_chips_box.get_children():
                c.queue_free()
        var chips: Array = []
        var mode: String = game_manager.get_selected_run_mode()
        if mode == "tower":
                var p: Dictionary = TowerData.get_floor_params(_tower_floor)
                var r: Dictionary = TowerData.get_floor_rewards(_tower_floor)
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.waves", {"n": int(p["waves"])}), BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM])
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.pulses", {"n": int(p["pulses_to_win"])}), BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM])
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.biomass", {"n": int(r["biomass"])}), BunkerUI.GREEN])
                var warden = TowerData.get_warden(_tower_floor)
                if warden != null:
                        chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.warden"), BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT])
                        chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.elite", {"n": int(round(float(warden["elite_pct"]) * 100.0))}), BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT])
                else:
                        match str(p.get("floor_type", "normal")):
                                "keeper":
                                        chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.keeper"), BunkerUI.HAZARD])
                                "break":
                                        chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.break"), BunkerUI.HAZARD])
        elif mode == "survival":
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.endless"), BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM])
                var rec := 0
                if game_manager.current_save_data and game_manager.current_save_data.statistics:
                        rec = int(game_manager.current_save_data.statistics.best_survival_wave)
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.record", {"n": rec}), BunkerUI.GREEN])
        else:
                var lvl: int = game_manager.get_selected_or_frontier_level()
                var p: Dictionary = CampaignData.get_level_params(lvl, game_manager.get_campaign_mode())
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.waves", {"n": int(p["waves"])}), BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM])
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.pulses", {"n": int(p["pulses_to_win"])}), BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM])
                chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.biomass", {"n": int(p["reward_bonus"])}), BunkerUI.GREEN])
                if bool(p.get("is_boss", false)):
                        chips.append([Loc.t("brf.chip.boss"), BunkerUI.HAZARD_BRIGHT])
        for c in chips:
                _brf_chips_box.add_child(_brf_chip(str(c[0]), c[1]))


func _brf_chip(txt: String, col: Color) -> Control:
        var p := Panel.new()
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.08, 0.045, 0.95)
        sb.border_color = col
        sb.set_border_width_all(1)
        sb.set_corner_radius_all(7)
        sb.content_margin_left = 10.0
        sb.content_margin_right = 10.0
        sb.content_margin_top = 5.0
        sb.content_margin_bottom = 5.0
        p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
        p.add_child(BunkerUI.make_mono_label(txt, 12, col))
        return p


# ==================== СЕТЫ АРТЕФАКТОВ В ГАЛЕРЕЕ (v0.27.0) ====================

func _gallery_sets_block():
        gallery_list.add_child(_gallery_section(Loc.t("sets.title")))
        var hint := BunkerUI.make_mono_label(Loc.t("sets.hint"), 11, BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
        hint.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        gallery_list.add_child(hint)
        var won: Array = lab_data.won_artifacts if lab_data != null else []
        var row := HBoxContainer.new()
        row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
        gallery_list.add_child(row)
        _sets_info_label = BunkerUI.make_mono_label("", 11, BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
        _sets_info_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        _sets_info_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 18)
        for state in ArtifactSets.sets_state(won):
                var def: Dictionary = state["def"]
                var stage: int = int(state["stage"])
                var col: Color = def["color"]
                var b := Button.new()
                b.text = "%s %d/%d" % [str(def["name"]), int(state["have"]), int(state["size"])]
                b.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
                b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
                b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col if stage > 0 else BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
                b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(104, 42)
                BunkerUI.style_button(b, "steel", 12)
                if stage >= 2:
                        b.tooltip_text = Loc.t(ArtifactSets.bonus_loc_key(str(def["id"]), stage))
                b.pressed.connect(_sets_show_info.bind(str(def["id"]), stage, col))
                b.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)
                row.add_child(b)
        gallery_list.add_child(_sets_info_label)


func _sets_show_info(set_id: String, stage: int, col: Color):
        _play_click_sound()
        var key: String = ArtifactSets.bonus_loc_key(set_id, stage) if stage >= 2 else "sets.none"
        _sets_info_label.text = Loc.t(key)
        _sets_info_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col if stage >= 2 else BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)

# ui/lab/mail_overlay.gd
extends Control
class_name MailOverlay

## ПОЧТА (D25): письма с наградами (итоги сезона арены, будущие начисления).
## Письмо: от кого / заголовок / тело / [ЗАБРАТЬ] или ✓ ПОЛУЧЕНО. Забор —
## через EventOps._grant_payload-совместимый payload. Пустой ящик — весточка
## от Проводника. Rollover сезона арены — В АРХИВАХ ArenaSeason (канон),
## оверлей только дёргает его при открытии и рисует ящик.

var _root: Control
var _list: VBoxContainer
var _badge: Panel = null


func _ready() -> void:
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	visible = false
	_build()


## Запись сезонных волн (зовёт zone_controller из забегов выживания).
## Делегирует канону в core — сам UI ничего не считает.
static func note_season_wave(save, waves: int) -> void:
	ArenaSeason.note_season_wave(save, waves)


func open() -> void:
	# rollover сезона арены: единая точка в ArenaSeason.ensure_season
	# (ключ сезона "S<N>" один на весь проект — вторых схем быть не должно);
	# сейв — здесь, у канона методов сохранения нет (паттерн GuildSys)
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm and gm.current_save_data != null:
		if not ArenaSeason.ensure_season(gm.current_save_data).is_empty():
			gm.save_to_active_slot()
	_refresh()
	_root.visible = true


func close() -> void:
	_root.visible = false


func _build() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "MailRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.visible = false
	add_child(_root)

	var shade := ColorRect.new()
	shade.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	shade.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.68)
	shade.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
			close())
	_root.add_child(shade)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var w: float = clampf(vp.x * 0.6, 380.0, 620.0)
	panel.offset_left = -w * 0.5
	panel.offset_right = w * 0.5
	panel.offset_top = -vp.y * 0.38
	panel.offset_bottom = vp.y * 0.38
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = BunkerUI.GREEN
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_child(head)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = Loc.t("mail.title")
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.GREEN)
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	head.add_child(title)
	var x_btn := Button.new()
	x_btn.text = "✕"
	x_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 40)
	BunkerUI.style_button(x_btn, "steel", 15)
	x_btn.pressed.connect(close)
	head.add_child(x_btn)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(scroll, false))
	_list = VBoxContainer.new()
	_list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	scroll.add_child(_list)


func open_badge(badge: Panel) -> void:
	_badge = badge
	open()


func _refresh() -> void:
	for c in _list.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	var mail: Array = []
	if gm and gm.current_save_data != null and gm.current_save_data.guild_state != null:
		mail = gm.current_save_data.guild_state.get("mail", [])
	if mail.is_empty():
		var empty := Label.new()
		empty.text = Loc.t("mail.empty")
		empty.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
		empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
		empty.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		_list.add_child(empty)
		return
	for i in mail.size():
		var m: Dictionary = mail[i]
		_list.add_child(_make_mail_card(i, m))


func _make_mail_card(idx: int, m: Dictionary) -> Control:
	var lang := "ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en"
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.08, 0.05, 0.98)
	sb.border_color = Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.8)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(10)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	card.add_child(v)

	var from := Label.new()
	from.text = "✉ %s" % str(m.get("from", "Зона"))
	from.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	from.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	from.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
	v.add_child(from)

	var t := Label.new()
	t.text = str(m.get("title_" + lang, m.get("title_ru", "")))
	t.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	t.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT)
	t.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	v.add_child(t)

	var b := Label.new()
	b.text = str(m.get("body_" + lang, m.get("body_ru", "")))
	b.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
	b.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	v.add_child(b)

	var reward: Dictionary = m.get("reward", {})
	var claimed: bool = bool(m.get("claimed", false))
	if reward.is_empty() or claimed:
		var done := Label.new()
		done.text = Loc.t("mail.claimed") if claimed or not reward.is_empty() else ""
		done.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
		done.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
		done.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
		v.add_child(done)
	else:
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.text = Loc.t("mail.claim")
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 44)
		BunkerUI.style_button(btn, "primary", 16, true)
		btn.pressed.connect(_on_claim.bind(idx))
		v.add_child(btn)
	return card


func _on_claim(idx: int) -> void:
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null or gm.current_save_data == null or gm.current_save_data.guild_state == null:
		return
	var mail: Array = gm.current_save_data.guild_state.get("mail", [])
	if idx < 0 or idx >= mail.size():
		return
	var m: Dictionary = mail[idx]
	if bool(m.get("claimed", false)):
		return
	var reward: Dictionary = m.get("reward", {})
	# начисление тем же пейлоадом, что у событий (гача одна — правило)
	var gm2 = gm
	if int(reward.get("rolls_mut", 0)) > 0:
		gm2.grant_mutant_rolls(int(reward["rolls_mut"]), "почта")
	if int(reward.get("rolls_art", 0)) > 0:
		gm2.grant_anomaly_rolls(int(reward["rolls_art"]), "почта")
	if float(reward.get("bio", 0.0)) > 0.0 and gm2.get_lab_data():
		gm2.get_lab_data().biomass += float(reward["bio"])
	var sparks := int(reward.get("sparks", 0))
	if sparks > 0 and gm2.get_lab_data():
		gm2.get_lab_data().awaken_sparks = int(gm2.get_lab_data().awaken_sparks) + sparks
	for cos_key in ["cos_frame", "cos_avatar", "cos_title", "cos_set"]:
		if reward.has(cos_key):
			gm2.current_save_data.owned["cos_" + str(reward[cos_key])] = true
	m["claimed"] = true
	gm.save_to_active_slot()
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("upgrade", 0.9)
	if _badge:
		_badge.queue_free()
		_badge = null
	_refresh()

# ui/lab/season_close_overlay.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name SeasonCloseOverlay

## Церемония закрытия сезона (D13): титр-слэм -> сводка построчно -> награда
## -> ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ. Слой 10 - поверх всех панелей лаборатории. Скип по клику.
## Награду крутками начисляет лаборатория ДО вызова play (числа приходят сюда).

signal closed

const COL_GOLD := Color("ffd94d")
const COL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.9, 0.8)
const COL_DIM := Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.58)
const COL_GREEN := Color("a8ff7a")

var _root: Control = null
var _rows_box: VBoxContainer = null
var _reward_label: Label = null
var _btn: Button = null
var _revealed: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 10
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_build()


func play(summary: Dictionary, reward_mut: int, reward_ano: int, great: bool) -> void:
	var next_cycle: int = maxi(int(summary.get("cycle", 1)), 1) + 1
	var title: Label = _root.get_node("Panel/V/Title")
	title.text = Loc.t("season_close.title", {"n": int(summary.get("cycle", 1))})
	title.scale = Vector2(1.6, 1.6)
	title.pivot_offset = title.size / 2.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(title, "scale", Vector2.ONE, SeasonCloseData.TITLE_SLAM) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("upgrade", 0.7)

	var rows: Array = [
		Loc.t("season_close.row_sp", {"n": int(summary.get("sp", 0))}),
		Loc.t("season_close.row_arena",
			{"ch": int(summary.get("arena_ch", 0)), "def": int(summary.get("arena_def", 0))}),
		Loc.t("season_close.row_blow", {"n": int(summary.get("blowouts", 0))}),
		Loc.t("season_close.row_exchange", {"n": int(summary.get("exchange", 0))}),
		Loc.t("season_close.row_tasks", {"n": int(summary.get("tasks", 0))}),
	]
	for i in range(rows.size()):
		var row := _make_label(str(rows[i]), 19, COL_TEXT)
		row.modulate.a = 0.0
		_rows_box.add_child(row)
		var rt := create_tween()
		rt.tween_interval(SeasonCloseData.TITLE_SLAM + SeasonCloseData.ROW_STEP * float(i))
		rt.tween_property(row, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)

	_reward_label.text = Loc.t("season_close.reward",
		{"m": reward_mut, "a": reward_ano}) + ("  ·  " + Loc.t("season_close.great") if great else "")
	if great:
		_reward_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	var rt2 := create_tween()
	rt2.tween_interval(SeasonCloseData.TITLE_SLAM + SeasonCloseData.ROW_STEP * float(rows.size()) + 0.2)
	rt2.tween_callback(func():
		_reward_label.visible = true
		if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
			sm.play_sound("reveal_legendary", 0.6))
	var bt := create_tween()
	bt.tween_interval(SeasonCloseData.TITLE_SLAM + SeasonCloseData.ROW_STEP * float(rows.size()) + 0.6)
	bt.tween_callback(_reveal_button)


func _build() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_root.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and not _revealed:
			_reveal_all())
	add_child(_root)

	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	dim.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and not _revealed:
			_reveal_all())
	_root.add_child(dim)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -360.0
	panel.offset_top = -270.0
	panel.offset_right = 360.0
	panel.offset_bottom = 270.0
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = COL_GOLD
	sb.set_border_width_all(3)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
	sb.shadow_size = 24
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.name = "V"
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 24
	v.offset_right = -24
	v.offset_top = 18
	v.offset_bottom = -18
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var title := Label.new()
	title.name = "Title"
	title.text = ""
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(title)

	var line := ColorRect.new()
	line.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 2)
	line.color = Color(COL_GOLD, 0.5)
	v.add_child(line)

	_rows_box = VBoxContainer.new()
	_rows_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	_rows_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	v.add_child(_rows_box)

	_reward_label = _make_label("", 22, COL_GREEN, true)
	_reward_label.visible = false
	v.add_child(_reward_label)

	var next_l := _make_label(Loc.t("season_close.next"), 15, COL_DIM)
	v.add_child(next_l)

	_btn = Button.new()
	_btn.text = Loc.t("season_close.continue")
	_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(280, 56)
	_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	BunkerUI.style_button(_btn, "primary", 17)
	_btn.pressed.connect(func():
		closed.emit()
		queue_free())
	v.add_child(_btn)
	_btn.visible = false


func _make_label(text: String, fs: int, col: Color, title_font := false) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title() if title_font else BunkerUI.font_body())
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	return l


## Скип: показать всё сразу и кнопку
func _reveal_all() -> void:
	if _revealed:
		return
	_revealed = true
	for c in _rows_box.get_children():
		c.modulate.a = 1.0
	_reward_label.visible = true
	_reveal_button()


func _reveal_button() -> void:
	if _revealed and _btn.visible:
		return
	_btn.visible = true
	_btn.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(_btn, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.25)

# ui/lab/store_panel.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name StorePanel

## Витрина монетизации (D16). Строится ТОЛЬКО при StoreData.ENABLED -
## lab_controller не зовёт build() иначе. Цены - из стора, фолбэк из
## таблицы StoreData.PRODUCTS (офлайн-UI). Покупки через BillingManager.

const COL_GOLD := Color("ffd94d")
const COL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.9, 0.8)
const COL_DIM := Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.58)

var _billing: BillingManager = null
var _root: Control = null
var _grid: GridContainer = null
var _note: Label = null
var _note_token: int = 0   # гасит старый таймер вспышки при новой покупке
var _prices: Dictionary = {}   # sku -> цена из стора (пусто = фолбэк таблицы)


func build() -> void:
	layer = 20
	if _root == null:
		_root = Control.new()
		add_child(_root)   # иначе Control-сирота не имеет размеров
	_root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_root.visible = false

	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	dim.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed:
			_root.visible = false)
	_root.add_child(dim)

	var panel := Panel.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	# Якоря-доли: панель центрируется при любом разрешении
	panel.anchor_top = 0.10
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.92
	panel.offset_left = -430.0
	panel.offset_right = 430.0
	panel.offset_top = 0.0
	panel.offset_bottom = 0.0
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.99)
	sb.border_color = COL_GOLD
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
	_root.add_child(panel)

	# Фон панели: тёмный градиент + туманные пятна (GradienTexture2D, без ассетов)
	var bg := TextureRect.new()
	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_SCALE
	var gtx := GradientTexture2D.new()
	var gr := Gradient.new()
	gr.colors = PackedColorArray([Color(0.055, 0.065, 0.05, 1.0), Color(0.02, 0.025, 0.018, 1.0)])
	gr.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 1.0])
	gtx.gradient = gr
	gtx.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.0)
	gtx.fill_to = Vector2(0.5, 1.0)
	bg.texture = gtx
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.add_child(bg)
	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	panel.move_child(bg, 0)   # фон под всем контентом

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.offset_left = 16
	v.offset_right = -16
	v.offset_top = 12
	v.offset_bottom = -12
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(v)

	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = Loc.t("store.title")
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.add_child(title)

	_note = Label.new()
	_note.text = Loc.t("store.note_power")
	_note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	_note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	_note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_note.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	v.add_child(_note)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	v.add_child(SwipeHelper.attach(scroll, false))
	_grid = GridContainer.new()
	_grid.columns = 2
	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 14)
	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 10)
	scroll.add_child(_grid)

	if StoreData.EMULATE_PURCHASES:
		var emu := Label.new()
		emu.text = Loc.t("store.emulate_note")
		emu.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
		emu.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
		emu.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.2))
		emu.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		v.add_child(emu)

		# DEV-тест: максимум всех валют, чтобы крутить гачу и проверять всё
		var cheat := Button.new()
		cheat.text = Loc.t("store.cheat_currency")
		cheat.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(320, 46)
		cheat.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		BunkerUI.style_button(cheat, "steel", 15)
		cheat.pressed.connect(_grant_infinite_currency)
		v.add_child(cheat)

	var close := Button.new()
	close.text = Loc.t("lab.back")
	close.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(220, 50)
	close.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	BunkerUI.style_button(close, "steel", 16)
	close.pressed.connect(func(): _root.visible = false)
	v.add_child(close)

	_fill()


func _fill() -> void:
	for c in _grid.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	# Первый экран: пропуск, стартовый пак, топ-паки, эксклюзив, слоты
	var show_order := ["pass_s1", "offer_first", "rolls_mut_10", "rolls_mut_10p",
		"rolls_art_15", "excl_choice", "conv_slots12", "conv_autofill"]
	for sku in show_order:
		if StoreData.PRODUCTS.has(sku):
			_grid.add_child(_make_card(sku))
	# Остальное - по вкладкам позже (косметика/биомасса)
	for sku in StoreData.PRODUCTS:
		if sku in show_order:
			continue
		_grid.add_child(_make_card(str(sku)))


func _make_card(sku: String) -> Control:
	var info: Dictionary = StoreData.PRODUCTS[sku]
	var price: String = str(_prices.get(sku, str(info.get("price_rub", 0)) + " ₽"))
	var pc := PanelContainer.new()
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.065, 0.045, 0.98)
	sb.border_color = COL_GOLD if sku.begins_with("pass") else Color(0.5, 0.46, 0.3)
	sb.set_border_width_all(2 if not sku.begins_with("pass") else 3)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(10)
	pc.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)

	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400, 0)
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 5)
	pc.add_child(v)

	var top := HBoxContainer.new()
	top.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	v.add_child(top)

	var ic_path := _icon_for_sku(sku, info)
	if ic_path != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(ic_path):
		var ic := TextureRect.new()
		ic.texture = load(ic_path)
		ic.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(52, 52)
		ic.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		ic.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		top.add_child(ic)

	var name_l := Label.new()
	name_l.text = Loc.t("store.sku_" + sku) if _has_key("store.sku_" + sku) else sku
	name_l.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
	name_l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_GOLD)
	name_l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	name_l.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	top.add_child(name_l)

	var price_l := Label.new()
	price_l.text = price
	price_l.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
	price_l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	price_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)
	price_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	v.add_child(price_l)

	var buy := Button.new()
	buy.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 48)
	BunkerUI.style_button(buy, "primary", 16)
	buy.pressed.connect(_on_buy.bind(sku))
	v.add_child(buy)

	# Разовые покупки (пропуск/удобства) после приобретения - серые «КУПЛЕНО»
	if _owned_one_time(sku):
		buy.disabled = true
		buy.text = Loc.t("store.owned")
		buy.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55)
	elif StoreData.EMULATE_PURCHASES:
		# Эмуляция: биллинг на ПК не поднимется - кнопки НЕ гасим,
		# покупка бесплатна и начисляет по-настоящему
		buy.text = Loc.t("store.buy_emu")
	elif not is_instance_valid(_billing) or not _billing.store_available():
		buy.disabled = true
		buy.text = Loc.t("store.unavailable")
		buy.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7)
	else:
		buy.text = Loc.t("store.buy") + "  " + price
	return pc


## Иконка товара (набор подготовщика, Задача 40-бис)
func _icon_for_sku(sku: String, info: Dictionary) -> String:
	var kind := str(info.get("kind", ""))
	var base := "res://assets/ui/store_icons/"  # инбокс в релизах не живёт (флаг помощника 03.11)
	if kind == "pass":
		return base + "icon_ticket.png"
	if sku == "offer_first":
		return base + "icon_pack.png"
	if kind == "excl":
		return base + "icon_exclusive.png"
	if kind == "conv":
		return base + ("icon_slots.png" if sku.find("slot") >= 0 else "icon_autocollect.png")
	if kind == "bio":
		return base + "icon_biomass.png"
	if kind == "rolls":
		return base + "icon_pull.png"
	return ""


## Разовый ли sku и уже куплен ли он (пропуск сезона, слоты, автосбор)
func _owned_one_time(sku: String) -> bool:
	var info: Dictionary = StoreData.PRODUCTS.get(sku, {})
	var kind := str(info.get("kind", ""))
	if kind != "pass" and kind != "conv":
		return false
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null or gm.current_save_data == null:
		return false
	return gm.current_save_data.owned.has(sku)


func _on_buy(sku: String) -> void:
	# Эмуляция (dev) ПРИОРИТЕТНЕЕ биллинга: мгновенная "оплата", начисление
	# настоящее - дев-сборки ничего не покупают по-настоящему
	if StoreData.EMULATE_PURCHASES:
		_grant_sku(sku)
		_fill()
		return
	if is_instance_valid(_billing) and _billing.store_available():
		_billing.purchase(sku)
		return
	_flash_note(Loc.t("store.unavailable"))
	var sm_dn = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm_dn and sm_dn.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm_dn.play_sound("ui_deny", 0.6)


func _has_key(key: String) -> bool:
	# Loc.t вернёт сам ключ при отсутствии - различаем по совпадению
	return Loc.t(key) != key


## DEV (только EMULATE_PURCHASES): максимум всех валют для тестов
func _grant_infinite_currency() -> void:
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null or gm.current_save_data == null:
		return
	var lab = gm.get_lab_data()
	if lab:
		lab.biomass = 9999999.0
		lab.gacha_rolls_mutants += 999
		lab.gacha_rolls_artifacts += 999
		lab.awaken_sparks += 999
	var g: Dictionary = GuildSys.ensure(gm.current_save_data)
	g["tokens"] = int(g.get("tokens", 0)) + 99999
	gm.save_to_active_slot()
	_flash_note(Loc.t("store.cheat_done"))
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("guild_coin", 0.8)
	_fill()


func open() -> void:
	if _billing == null:
		_billing = BillingManager.new()
		add_child(_billing)
		_billing.products_loaded.connect(func(prices: Dictionary):
			_prices = prices
			_fill())
		_billing.start()
	_root.visible = true
	_fill()


# ==================== НАЧИСЛЕНИЕ ПОКУПКИ (payload SKU) ====================

func _grant_sku(sku: String) -> void:
	var gm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
	if gm == null or gm.current_save_data == null:
		return
	# задачи Зоны: покупки магазина (D25)
	Prog.bump_task("store_buys", 1)
	var info: Dictionary = StoreData.PRODUCTS.get(sku, {})
	var save = gm.current_save_data
	var lab = gm.get_lab_data()
	var note_text := ""
	match str(info.get("kind", "")):
		"pass":
			save.owned[sku] = "emulated"
			save.pass_cycle = Prog.track_cycle()
			Prog.bump_task("pass", 1)
			note_text = Loc.t("store.got_pass")
		"pack", "rolls":
			if int(info.get("rolls_mut", 0)) > 0:
				gm.grant_mutant_rolls(int(info["rolls_mut"]), "магазин")
			if int(info.get("rolls_art", 0)) > 0:
				gm.grant_anomaly_rolls(int(info["rolls_art"]), "магазин")
			if info.has("cos_frame"):
				save.owned["cos_" + str(info["cos_frame"])] = true
			note_text = Loc.t("store.got_rolls")
		"bio":
			if lab:
				lab.biomass += float(info.get("bio", 0.0))
			note_text = Loc.t("store.got_bio")
		"conv":
			save.owned[sku] = "emulated"
			note_text = Loc.t("store.got_conv")
		"excl":
			note_text = _grant_random_exclusive(gm)
		_:
			note_text = sku
	gm.save_to_active_slot()
	_flash_note(note_text)


## Плашка результата: горит 3 с и возвращается к подписи по умолчанию.
## Токен гасит старый таймер, если покупку сделали быстрее
func _flash_note(text: String) -> void:
	if _note == null:
		return
	_note_token += 1
	var token := _note_token
	_note.text = text
	_note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("a8ff7a"))
	await get_tree().create_timer(3.0).timeout
	if _note == null or not is_instance_valid(_note) or token != _note_token:
		return
	_note.text = Loc.t("store.note_power")
	_note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", COL_DIM)

## Эксклюзив на выбор (v1 эмуляции: случайный неполученный; выбор руками -
## к реальному подключению биллинга)
func _grant_random_exclusive(gm) -> String:
	var lab = gm.get_lab_data()
	var candidates: Array = []
	for ex in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_MUTANTS:
		if not lab.unlocked_mutants.has(str(ex["type"])):
			candidates.append(["mut", str(ex["type"]), str(ex["name"])])
	for ax in GachaData.EXCLUSIVE_ANOMALIES:
		if not lab.won_artifacts.has(str(ax["type"])) and not lab.exclusive_anomalies.has(str(ax["type"])):
			candidates.append(["ano", str(ax["type"]), str(ax.get("name", ""))])
	if candidates.is_empty():
		if lab:
			lab.biomass += 50000.0
		return Loc.t("store.excl_all_owned")
	var pick: Array = candidates[randi() % candidates.size()]
	if pick[0] == "mut":
		gm.grant_exclusive_mutant(pick[1])
	else:
		gm.grant_exclusive_anomaly(pick[1])
	return Loc.t("store.got_excl", {"n": pick[2]})

# ui/lab/tier_gates.gd
extends Control
class_name TierGates

## ВРАТА ЯРУСОВ БАШНИ — дизайн «Монолит» (макет пользователя, 28.10.2026).
## 10 врат = 10 ярусов башни. Показываются три стелы: предыдущая/выбранная/следующая.
## Всё рисуется кодом (_draw): парящие плиты со сканлайнами, рунное кольцо над
## выбранной (вращается), символы награды над каждой плитой (звёзды/Хранитель/
## этажи — видно, что внутри, ещё до клика), восходящие пылинки, полоса звёзд.
## Клик по стеле — выбрать ярус (signal selection_changed). Свайп — соседний ярус.

signal selection_changed(tier_idx: int)   # 0..9

const COL_BG_GLOW := Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.25)
const COL_SLAB_TOP := Color("1f2618")
const COL_SLAB_BOT := Color("10140b")
const COL_SLAB_EDGE := Color("2c3422")
const COL_INNER := Color(0.016, 0.022, 0.012, 0.97)
const COL_GOLD := Color("e8b339")
const COL_GOLD_HI := Color("ffd061")
const COL_PLATE := Color("141810")
const COL_PLATE_EDGE := Color("3a4230")
const COL_NAME := Color("e8e0c8")
const COL_NAME_ON := Color("ffd061")
const COL_SUB := Color("93987f")
const COL_FAINT := Color("6b705f")
const COL_SCAN := Color(0.55, 0.67, 0.47, 0.028)
const COL_RING := Color("6d7a58")

var frontier_floor: int = 1            # открытый рубеж (лучший прогресс)
var tier_names: Array = []             # 10 имён ярусов
var tier_stars: Array = []             # 10 сумм звёзд яруса
var tier_bosses: Array = []            # 10 имён Хранителей
var selected_tier: int = 0             # выбранный ярус (0-based)

var _t: float = 0.0
var _slots: Array = []                 # Rect2 стел текущего кадра (хит-тест)
var _slot_tiers: Array = []            # параллельно _slots: какой ЯРУС в каждом слоте
var _press_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO # точка нажатия (для свайпа)
var _press_active: bool = false
var _swiped: bool = false              # свайп в этом нажатии уже сработал
var _nudge: float = 0.0                # анимация упругого кивка (0..1)
var _nudge_dir: float = 0.0            # направление кивка (+1 вправо / -1 влево)
var _dust: Array = []                  # восходящие пылинки {x(0..1), y, sp, ph}

const SWIPE_THRESHOLD := 80.0          # пикселей (дизайн-координаты) для срабатывания жеста
const DUST_COUNT := 16


func _ready() -> void:
        mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        for i in range(DUST_COUNT):
                _dust.append({
                        "x": randf(),
                        "y": randf(),
                        "sp": randf_range(0.045, 0.11),
                        "ph": randf() * TAU,
                })


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
        _t += delta
        if _nudge > 0.0:
                _nudge = maxf(_nudge - delta * 4.5, 0.0)
        for d in _dust:
                d["y"] -= d["sp"] * delta
                if d["y"] < -0.02:
                        d["y"] = 1.02
                        d["x"] = randf()
        if visible:
                queue_redraw()


func setup(frontier: int, names: Array, stars: Array, bosses: Array, sel: int = -1) -> void:
        frontier_floor = clampi(frontier, 1, 100)
        tier_names = names
        tier_stars = stars
        tier_bosses = bosses
        if sel >= 0:
                selected_tier = sel
        elif frontier_floor >= 100:
                selected_tier = 9
        else:
                selected_tier = clampi((frontier_floor - 1) / 10, 0, 9)
        queue_redraw()


func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        # Тач на Android приходит как мышь (emulate_mouse_from_touch = true по умолчанию),
        # поэтому обрабатываем ТОЛЬКО mouse-семейство — иначе жест задвоится.
        if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
                if event.pressed:
                        _press_pos = event.position
                        _press_active = true
                        _swiped = false
                else:
                        _press_active = false
                        if not _swiped:
                                _select_gate_at(event.position)
                accept_event()
        elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and _press_active:
                var dx: float = event.position.x - _press_pos.x
                if absf(dx) >= SWIPE_THRESHOLD:
                        _swiped = true
                        _step_tier(1 if dx < 0.0 else -1)   # свайп влево = следующий ярус
                        _press_pos = event.position          # можно продолжить — ещё шаг
                accept_event()


## Клик по стеле — выбрать ярус НА ЭТОМ СЛОТЕ (слот ≠ номер яруса!)
func _select_gate_at(pos: Vector2) -> void:
        for i in range(_slots.size()):
                if (_slots[i] as Rect2).has_point(pos):
                        var tier: int = int(_slot_tiers[i]) if i < _slot_tiers.size() else i
                        if selected_tier != tier:
                                selected_tier = tier
                                selection_changed.emit(tier)
                                queue_redraw()
                        return


## Шаг на соседний ярус жестом (или упор в край с упругим кивком)
func _step_tier(dir: int) -> void:
        var nxt: int = clampi(selected_tier + dir, 0, 9)
        _nudge = 1.0
        _nudge_dir = float(dir)
        if nxt != selected_tier:
                selected_tier = nxt
                selection_changed.emit(nxt)
        queue_redraw()


func _tier_unlocked(idx: int) -> bool:
        return frontier_floor > idx * 10


func _draw() -> void:
        var w := size.x
        var h := size.y
        if w < 300.0 or h < 300.0:
                return

        # Тёмная подложка (контрол самодостаточен по фону)
        draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, w, h), Color(0.027, 0.022, 0.014))

        # Водяной знак БАШНЯ
        draw_string(BunkerUI.font_title(), Vector2(w * 0.5 - 560, h * 0.40), "БАШНЯ",
                HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 1120, 210, Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.24, 0.04))

        # Световой луч из верхнего центра (над выбранной стелой)
        _draw_beam(Vector2(w * 0.5, 0.0), minf(w * 0.34, 420.0), h * 0.30)

        _slots.clear()
        _slot_tiers.clear()
        # Три стелы: окно из трёх ярусов, зажатое в 0..9 (выбранный в центре)
        var idxs: Array = []
        if selected_tier == 0:
                idxs = [0, 1, 2]
        elif selected_tier == 9:
                idxs = [7, 8, 9]
        else:
                idxs = [selected_tier - 1, selected_tier, selected_tier + 1]

        var slab_w: float = minf(500.0, w / 3.3)
        var gap: float = (w - float(idxs.size()) * slab_w) / float(idxs.size() + 1)
        var base_y: float = h - 78.0
        # Упругий кивок окна при свайпе/упоре в край (затухает в _process)
        var slide: float = _nudge_dir * sin(_nudge * PI) * 16.0

        var centers: Array = []
        for k in range(idxs.size()):
                var gx: float = gap + float(k) * (slab_w + gap)
                # Слот БЕЗ сдвига — хит-тест клика стабильный; визуально кивает
                _slots.append(Rect2(gx, base_y - h * 0.66, slab_w, h * 0.66))
                _slot_tiers.append(int(idxs[k]))
                centers.append(Vector2(gx + slab_w * 0.5 + slide, base_y))
                _draw_slab(Rect2(gx + slide, base_y - h * 0.66, slab_w, h * 0.66), int(idxs[k]), base_y)

        # Энергосвязь между основаниями стел
        for c in range(centers.size() - 1):
                _draw_energy(centers[c], centers[c + 1])

        # Восходящие пылинки (поверх всего, в пределах зоны стел)
        var zone := Rect2(0, h * 0.16, w, h * 0.84)
        for d in _dust:
                var px: float = zone.position.x + (d["x"] as float) * zone.size.x
                var py: float = zone.position.y + (d["y"] as float) * zone.size.y
                var tw: float = 0.45 + 0.55 * absf(sin(_t * 2.0 + (d["ph"] as float)))
                draw_circle(Vector2(px, py), 1.6, Color(COL_GOLD, 0.20 * tw))


func _draw_beam(pos: Vector2, width: float, height: float) -> void:
        """Мягкий световой конус из верхнего центра (над выбранной стелой)."""
        for i in range(4):
                var k: float = 1.0 - float(i) * 0.22
                draw_set_transform(pos + Vector2(0, -10.0), 0.0, Vector2(1.0 + i * 0.45, 0.34 + i * 0.05))
                draw_circle(Vector2(0, height * 0.5), width * 0.5, Color(COL_GOLD, 0.028 * k))
        draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)


func _draw_slab(rect: Rect2, tier_idx: int, base_y: float) -> void:
        var cx: float = rect.get_center().x
        var is_sel: bool = tier_idx == selected_tier
        var unlocked: bool = _tier_unlocked(tier_idx)
        var glow: float = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(_t * 2.2)

        var slab_w: float = rect.size.x * 0.74
        var slab_h: float = rect.size.y * 0.52
        var slab_top: float = base_y - 96.0 - slab_h
        var slab := Rect2(cx - slab_w * 0.5, slab_top, slab_w, slab_h)

        # ----- Пол: отражение и свечение под стелой -----
        draw_set_transform(Vector2(cx, base_y - 4.0), 0.0, Vector2(1.0, 0.22))
        if unlocked and is_sel:
                draw_circle(Vector2(0, 0), slab_w * 0.62, Color(COL_GOLD, 0.10 + 0.05 * glow))
        else:
                draw_circle(Vector2(0, 0), slab_w * 0.5, Color(0.35, 0.42, 0.28, 0.06))
        draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

        # ----- Плита -----
        var body := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        body.bg_color = COL_SLAB_TOP if not (unlocked and is_sel) else COL_SLAB_TOP.lightened(0.05)
        body.set_corner_radius_all(8)
        body.border_width_bottom = 0
        if unlocked and is_sel:
                body.border_width_left = 2
                body.border_width_right = 2
                body.border_width_top = 2
                body.border_color = COL_GOLD
                body.shadow_color = Color(COL_GOLD, 0.22)
                body.shadow_size = 22
        else:
                body.border_width_left = 1
                body.border_width_right = 1
                body.border_width_top = 1
                body.border_color = COL_SLAB_EDGE
        draw_style_box(body, slab)

        # Сканлайны на плите
        var scan_y: float = slab.position.y + 6.0
        while scan_y < slab.end.y - 4.0:
                draw_line(Vector2(slab.position.x + 5, scan_y), Vector2(slab.end.x - 5, scan_y), COL_SCAN, 1.0)
                scan_y += 5.0

        # ----- Сигил (руна яруса) в центре плиты -----
        var sigil_col: Color
        if is_sel and unlocked:
                sigil_col = Color(COL_GOLD, 0.85 + 0.15 * glow)
        elif unlocked:
                sigil_col = Color("7a8465")
        else:
                sigil_col = Color("39412f")
        _draw_sigil(Vector2(cx, slab.get_center().y - 6.0), tier_idx, sigil_col, slab_w * 0.16)

        # ----- Полоса звёзд внизу плиты -----
        var stars: int = int(tier_stars[tier_idx]) if tier_idx < tier_stars.size() else 0
        var bar := Rect2(cx - slab_w * 0.34, slab.end.y - 22.0, slab_w * 0.68, 4.0)
        draw_rect(bar, Color("1a1f14"))
        var frac: float = clampf(float(stars) / 30.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        if frac > 0.0:
                var fill := Rect2(bar.position, Vector2(bar.size.x * frac, bar.size.y))
                draw_rect(fill, COL_GOLD if is_sel else Color("8a9a6d"))
                if is_sel:
                        draw_circle(Vector2(bar.position.x + bar.size.x * frac, bar.get_center().y),
                                4.0, Color(COL_GOLD_HI, 0.8))

        # ----- Рунное кольцо над стелой -----
        var ring_c := Vector2(cx, slab_top - 44.0)
        var ring_r: float = 26.0
        var ring_col := COL_GOLD if (is_sel and unlocked) else (COL_RING if unlocked else Color("424a38"))
        var segs := 12
        for i in range(segs):
                var a0: float = float(i) * TAU / segs
                if is_sel:
                        a0 += _t * 1.1          # кольцо выбранной стелы вращается
                draw_arc(ring_c, ring_r, a0, a0 + TAU / segs * 0.55, 6, ring_col, 2.0)
        var num: String = ["I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX", "X"][tier_idx]
        draw_string(BunkerUI.font_title(), Vector2(ring_c.x - ring_r, ring_c.y + 8),
                num, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, ring_r * 2.0, 16,
                COL_GOLD_HI if (is_sel and unlocked) else (COL_NAME if unlocked else COL_FAINT))

        # ----- Символы награды над плитой (Hades-стиль: что внутри до клика) -----
        var boss: String = str(tier_bosses[tier_idx]) if tier_idx < tier_bosses.size() else "—"
        var chip_y: float = ring_c.y - ring_r - 34.0 - 27.0 * 3.0
        var chips := [
                "★ ×%d /30" % (stars if unlocked else 0),
                boss,
                "этажи %d–%d" % [tier_idx * 10 + 1, tier_idx * 10 + 10],
        ]
        var chip_w: float = slab_w * 0.86
        for ci in range(chips.size()):
                var crect := Rect2(cx - chip_w * 0.5, chip_y, chip_w, 24.0)
                draw_rect(crect, COL_PLATE)
                draw_rect(crect, COL_PLATE_EDGE, false, 1.0)
                draw_string(BunkerUI.font_mono(), crect.position + Vector2(0, 16), chips[ci],
                        HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, chip_w, 12,
                        COL_GOLD_HI if (ci == 0 and is_sel and unlocked) else COL_SUB)
                chip_y += 27.0

        # ----- Имя и статус под стелой -----
        var tname: String = str(tier_names[tier_idx]) if tier_idx < tier_names.size() else ""
        var title := "ЯРУС %d · «%s»" % [tier_idx + 1, tname] if is_sel else "ЯРУС %d · %s" % [tier_idx + 1, tname]
        draw_string(BunkerUI.font_title(), Vector2(cx - slab_w, base_y - 44.0), title,
                HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, slab_w * 2.0, 18,
                COL_NAME_ON if is_sel else COL_NAME)
        var status: String
        var status_col: Color
        if is_sel:
                status = "ВЫБРАНО · ЭТАЖ %d" % (tier_idx * 10 + 1)
                status_col = COL_GOLD
        elif unlocked:
                status = "ОТКРЫТ"
                status_col = COL_FAINT
        else:
                status = "ЗАПЕРТО · ЭТАЖ %d" % (tier_idx * 10 + 1)
                status_col = COL_FAINT
        draw_string(BunkerUI.font_mono(), Vector2(cx - slab_w, base_y - 22.0), status,
                HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, slab_w * 2.0, 12, status_col)


func _draw_sigil(c: Vector2, tier_idx: int, col: Color, r: float) -> void:
        """Руна яруса: детерминированный узор из лучей и дуг."""
        var rays := 3 + (tier_idx % 5)
        draw_arc(c, r, 0, TAU, 40, Color(col, 0.5), 1.5)
        for i in range(rays):
                var a: float = TAU * float(i) / float(rays) + float(tier_idx) * 0.7
                var p0: Vector2 = c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r * 0.34
                var p1: Vector2 = c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r * 0.92
                draw_line(p0, p1, col, 2.0)
                draw_circle(p1, 2.4, col)
        draw_circle(c, r * 0.16, col)


func _draw_energy(a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> void:
        """Энергосвязь между основаниями стел: тусклая линия + бегущие искры."""
        draw_line(a, b, Color(COL_GOLD, 0.10), 2.0)
        var n := 5
        for i in range(n):
                var ph: float = fmod(_t * 0.35 + float(i) / float(n), 1.0)
                var p: Vector2 = a.lerp(b, ph)
                draw_circle(p, 2.0, Color(COL_GOLD, 0.35 * (1.0 - absf(ph - 0.5) * 1.2)))

# ui/main_menu/main_menu.gd
extends Control

## Главное меню игры

signal new_game_pressed
signal load_pressed
signal settings_pressed
signal quit_pressed

@onready var new_game_button: Button = $VBox/Buttons/NewGameButton
@onready var load_button: Button = $VBox/Buttons/LoadButton
@onready var settings_button: Button = $VBox/Buttons/SettingsButton
@onready var quit_button: Button = $VBox/Buttons/QuitButton

@onready var load_screen: Control = $LoadScreen
@onready var settings_screen: Control = $SettingsScreen
@onready var save_slots_container: VBoxContainer = $LoadScreen/Panel/VBox/SaveSlots
@onready var title_label: Label = $VBox/Title
@onready var cover_art: TextureRect = $CoverArt
@onready var back_button: Button = $SettingsScreen/Panel/BackButton
@onready var load_back_button: Button = $LoadScreen/Panel/VBox/BackButton
@onready var music_slider: HSlider = $SettingsScreen/Panel/MusicSlider
@onready var sfx_slider: HSlider = $SettingsScreen/Panel/SfxSlider

var game_manager: Node


func _ready():
        _setup_buttons()
        _setup_sounds()
        _setup_settings()
        _setup_save_slot_selector()
        _load_cover_art()
        
        load_screen.visible = false
        settings_screen.visible = false
        
        # Ищем GameManager один раз при старте
        game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        # print("MainMenu: инициализирован, GameManager найден: ", game_manager != null)


        _apply_static_texts()
        Loc.changed.connect(_apply_static_texts)
        _build_language_button()
        _apply_bunker_style()
        _maybe_show_disclaimer()

func _load_cover_art():
        """Фон меню: арт-пак lab_ui (ночная Зона, ЧАЭС на горизонте) с фолбэком
        на бункерный зал (ui/main_menu/bunker_menu.svg). Заголовок рисуется
        кодом (штамп REVERT), поэтому текстовый Title переоформляем."""
        const PACK_PATH := "res://assets/ui/lab/menu_background_2k.png"
        const COVER_PATH := "res://ui/main_menu/bunker_menu.svg"
        # Задача 39: «ЗОНА ДЫШИТ» - новый фон (ПК 1920x1080 / вертикальная кадка)
        var bg := "res://assets/ui/menu/menu_bg.png"
        if DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available() or get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x < get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y:
                var v := "res://assets/ui/menu/menu_bg_v.png"
                if ResourceLoader.exists(v):
                        bg = v
        if ResourceLoader.exists(bg):
                cover_art.texture = load(bg)
                title_label.visible = false
                # Задача 30: фирменное лого поверх фона (нет файла - заголовок-текст)
                if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_wide.png"):
                        var logo := TextureRect.new()
                        logo.texture = load("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_wide.png")
                        logo.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                        logo.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
                        logo.anchor_left = 0.5
                        logo.anchor_right = 0.5
                        logo.anchor_top = 0.06
                        logo.anchor_bottom = 0.06
                        logo.offset_left = -300.0
                        logo.offset_right = 300.0
                        logo.offset_top = 0.0
                        logo.offset_bottom = 134.0
                        logo.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                        cover_art.add_child(logo)
                return
        if ResourceLoader.exists(PACK_PATH):
                cover_art.texture = load(PACK_PATH)
                title_label.visible = false
                # Задача 30: фирменное лого поверх фона (нет файла - заголовок-текст)
                if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_wide.png"):
                        var logo := TextureRect.new()
                        logo.texture = load("res://assets/ui/brand/logo_wide.png")
                        logo.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
                        logo.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
                        logo.anchor_left = 0.5
                        logo.anchor_right = 0.5
                        logo.anchor_top = 0.06
                        logo.anchor_bottom = 0.06
                        logo.offset_left = -300.0
                        logo.offset_right = 300.0
                        logo.offset_top = 0.0
                        logo.offset_bottom = 134.0
                        logo.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
                        cover_art.add_child(logo)
                return
        if ResourceLoader.exists(COVER_PATH):
                cover_art.texture = load(COVER_PATH)
                title_label.visible = false
                # print("MainMenu: фон-обложка загружена")


func _setup_buttons():
        new_game_button.pressed.connect(_on_new_game_pressed)
        load_button.pressed.connect(_on_load_pressed)
        settings_button.pressed.connect(_on_settings_pressed)
        quit_button.pressed.connect(_on_quit_pressed)
        back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_pressed)
        load_back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_pressed)


func _setup_settings():
        """Слайдеры громкости управляют аудиошинами Music и SFX"""
        music_slider.value_changed.connect(_on_music_volume_changed)
        sfx_slider.value_changed.connect(_on_sfx_volume_changed)
        
        var music_idx = AudioServer.get_bus_index("Music")
        var sfx_idx = AudioServer.get_bus_index("SFX")
        if music_idx >= 0:
                music_slider.set_value_no_signal(db_to_linear(AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(music_idx)))
        if sfx_idx >= 0:
                sfx_slider.set_value_no_signal(db_to_linear(AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(sfx_idx)))


func _on_music_volume_changed(value: float):
        _set_bus_volume("Music", value)


func _setup_save_slot_selector():
        """Выбор активного слота сохранения между слайдерами и кнопкой НАЗАД"""
        var panel = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel")
        if not panel:
                # print("MainMenu: SettingsScreen/Panel не найден, селектор слота не построен")
                return

        var selector := SaveSlotSelector.new()
        selector.position = Vector2(30, 202)
        selector.size = Vector2(340, 28)
        panel.add_child(selector)


func _on_sfx_volume_changed(value: float):
        _set_bus_volume("SFX", value)


func _set_bus_volume(bus_name: String, value: float):
        var idx = AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus_name)
        if idx >= 0:
                AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(max(value, 0.0001)))
                AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, value <= 0.001)


func _setup_sounds():
        new_game_button.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)
        load_button.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)
        settings_button.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)
        quit_button.mouse_entered.connect(_play_hover_sound)


func _play_hover_sound():
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm.play_sound("ui_hover", 0.3)


func _play_click_sound():
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm.play_sound("ui_click", 0.6)


func _on_new_game_pressed():
        _play_click_sound()
        new_game_pressed.emit()
        
        if game_manager:
                # print("GameManager найден! Запускаем новую игру")
                game_manager.start_new_game()
        else:
                # print("GameManager НЕ НАЙДЕН! Ищем снова...")
                game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
                if game_manager:
                        game_manager.start_new_game()
                else:
                        # print("GameManager не найден, переходим напрямую в ЛК")
                        get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/lab/lab.tscn")


func _on_load_pressed():
        _play_click_sound()
        load_pressed.emit()
        load_screen.visible = true
        _refresh_save_slots()


func _on_settings_pressed():
        _play_click_sound()
        settings_pressed.emit()
        settings_screen.visible = true


func _on_quit_pressed():
        _play_click_sound()
        quit_pressed.emit()
        await get_tree().create_timer(0.2).timeout
        get_tree().quit()


func _refresh_save_slots():
        # Очищаем старые кнопки
        for child in save_slots_container.get_children():
                child.queue_free()
        
        if not game_manager:
                game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        
        if not game_manager:
                # print("GameManager не найден, не могу загрузить сохранения")
                # Показываем пустые слоты
                for i in range(3):
                        var slot_container = HBoxContainer.new()
                        var info_label = Label.new()
                        info_label.text = Loc.t("menu.empty_slot", {"n": i + 1})
                        slot_container.add_child(info_label)
                        
                        var load_btn = Button.new()
                        load_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.load")
                        load_btn.disabled = true
                        slot_container.add_child(load_btn)
                        
                        var delete_btn = Button.new()
                        delete_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.slot_delete")
                        delete_btn.disabled = true
                        slot_container.add_child(delete_btn)
                        
                        save_slots_container.add_child(slot_container)
                return
        
        var saves_info = game_manager.get_all_saves_info()

        # get_all_saves_info возвращает ручные слоты 1..3 (автосейв - отдельный механизм)
        for save_info in saves_info:
                var slot_number = int(save_info.get("slot", 1))
                var slot_container = HBoxContainer.new()

                var info_label = Label.new()
                if save_info.get("exists", false):
                        info_label.text = Loc.t("menu.slot_info", {"n": slot_number, "run": save_info.get("run_number", 1), "bio": save_info.get("biomass", 0), "wins": save_info.get("wins", 0)})
                else:
                        info_label.text = Loc.t("menu.empty_slot", {"n": slot_number})

                slot_container.add_child(info_label)

                var load_btn = Button.new()
                load_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.load")
                load_btn.disabled = not save_info.get("exists", false)
                load_btn.pressed.connect(_load_slot.bind(slot_number))
                slot_container.add_child(load_btn)

                var delete_btn = Button.new()
                delete_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.slot_delete")
                delete_btn.disabled = not save_info.get("exists", false)
                delete_btn.pressed.connect(_delete_slot.bind(slot_number))
                slot_container.add_child(delete_btn)

                save_slots_container.add_child(slot_container)


func _load_slot(slot: int):
        _play_click_sound()
        
        if not game_manager:
                game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        
        if game_manager and game_manager.load_game(slot):
                await get_tree().create_timer(0.2).timeout
                game_manager.change_scene("lab")
        else:
                pass
                # print("Не удалось загрузить слот ", slot)


func _delete_slot(slot: int):
        _play_click_sound()
        
        if not game_manager:
                game_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("game_manager")
        
        if game_manager:
                game_manager.delete_save(slot)
        _refresh_save_slots()


func _on_back_pressed():
        _play_click_sound()
        load_screen.visible = false
        settings_screen.visible = false


func _apply_static_texts():
        """Локализация статических надписей меню (Loc.changed пере apply)"""
        var title: Label = get_node_or_null("VBox/Title")
        if title:
                title.text = Loc.t("menu.title_top")
        var revert: Label = get_node_or_null("VBox/RevertLabel")
        if revert:
                revert.text = Loc.t("menu.title_sub")
        var new_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("VBox/Buttons/NewGameButton")
        if new_btn:
                new_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.new_game")
        var load_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("VBox/Buttons/LoadButton")
        if load_btn:
                load_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.load")
        var settings_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("VBox/Buttons/SettingsButton")
        if settings_btn:
                settings_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.settings")
        var quit_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("VBox/Buttons/QuitButton")
        if quit_btn:
                quit_btn.text = Loc.t("menu.quit")
        var load_title: Label = get_node_or_null("LoadScreen/Panel/VBox/Title")
        if load_title:
                load_title.text = Loc.t("menu.load")
        var load_back: Button = get_node_or_null("LoadScreen/Panel/VBox/BackButton")
        if load_back:
                load_back.text = Loc.t("menu.back")
        var settings_title: Label = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel/SettingsTitle")
        if settings_title:
                settings_title.text = Loc.t("menu.settings")
        var music_label: Label = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel/MusicLabel")
        if music_label:
                music_label.text = Loc.t("menu.music")
        var sfx_label: Label = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel/SfxLabel")
        if sfx_label:
                sfx_label.text = Loc.t("menu.sound")
        var settings_back: Button = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel/BackButton")
        if settings_back:
                settings_back.text = Loc.t("menu.back")
        if _lang_button:
                _lang_button.text = Loc.t("menu.language")
        _refresh_load_screen_texts()


func _refresh_load_screen_texts():
        """Перезаполнить строки слотов на текущем языке (переиспользует существующий rebuild)"""
        _refresh_save_slots()


var _lang_button: Button = null


func _build_language_button():
        """Кнопка RU/EN в настройках меню"""
        var panel = get_node_or_null("SettingsScreen/Panel")
        if not panel:
                return
        _lang_button = Button.new()

        _lang_button.size = Vector2(340, 36)

        var acc := AccessibilityControls.new()
        acc.position = Vector2(30, 332)
        panel.add_child(acc)

func _apply_bunker_style():

        # --- Баннер ивента (D24): кнопка над версией слева, лёгкий пульс ---
        var ev := EventsData.current_event(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
        if get_node_or_null("EventBanner") == null:
                var ev_btn := Button.new()

                ev_btn.text = Loc.t("evt.banner") % str(ev["title_" + ("ru" if Loc.lang == "ru" else "en")])

                if ResourceLoader.exists(ev_icon_path):

                ev_btn.anchor_top = 1.0
                ev_btn.anchor_bottom = 1.0

                ev_btn.offset_right = 340
                ev_btn.offset_top = -80
                ev_btn.offset_bottom = -40
                ev_btn.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN

                tw.tween_property(ev_btn, "modulate:a", 0.65, 0.6)
                tw.tween_property(ev_btn, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.6)

        _play_click_sound()

        _event_hub.open()

const DISCLAIMER_CFG := "user://disclaimer.cfg"


func _maybe_show_disclaimer():
        """Юридический дисклеймер фан-проекта — один раз при первом запуске (v0.31.1)"""
        var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
        if cfg.load(DISCLAIMER_CFG) == OK and cfg.get_value("legal", "acknowledged_2", false):
                return

        var overlay := ColorRect.new()
        overlay.name = "DisclaimerOverlay"
        overlay.color = Color(0.01, 0.05, 0.02, 0.88)
        overlay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        overlay.z_index = 100
        overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        add_child(overlay)

        var center := CenterContainer.new()
        center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        center.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
        overlay.add_child(center)

        var panel := PanelContainer.new()
        panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(640, 0)
        panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", BunkerUI.steel_panel())
        center.add_child(panel)

        var margin := MarginContainer.new()
        for m in ["margin_left", "margin_right", "margin_top", "margin_bottom"]:
                margin.add_theme_constant_override(m, 36)
        panel.add_child(margin)

        var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
        vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
        margin.add_child(vb)

        var badge := Label.new()
        badge.text = Loc.t("disclaim.badge")
        badge.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        badge.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
        badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
        badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.HAZARD)
        vb.add_child(badge)

        var head := Label.new()
        head.text = Loc.t("menu.title_top")
        head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
        head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT)
        vb.add_child(head)

        var body := Label.new()
        body.text = Loc.t("disclaim.body")
        body.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        body.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 0)
        body.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
        body.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
        body.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT)
        vb.add_child(body)

        # Атрибуция ассетов (ODbL/CC-BY/OFL — обязательна в билде)
        var credits_head := Label.new()
        credits_head.text = Loc.t("disclaim.credits_head")
        credits_head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        credits_head.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_mono())
        credits_head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
        credits_head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
        vb.add_child(credits_head)

        var credits := Label.new()
        credits.text = Loc.t("disclaim.credits")
        credits.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        credits.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 0)
        credits.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
        credits.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
        credits.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
        vb.add_child(credits)

        var stripes := BunkerUI.hazard_stripes(10.0)
        vb.add_child(stripes)

        var ok := Button.new()
        ok.text = Loc.t("disclaim.ok")
        ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 58)
        BunkerUI.style_button(ok, "primary", 20, true)
        ok.pressed.connect(_on_disclaimer_ack)
        vb.add_child(ok)


func _on_disclaimer_ack():
        """Кнопка «Понятно»: запоминаем и больше не показываем.
        Ключ acknowledged_2: сброс после добавления атрибуции (v0.31.2),
        чтобы её увидели и прежние инсталляции."""
        _play_click_sound()
        var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
        cfg.set_value("legal", "acknowledged_2", true)
        cfg.save(DISCLAIMER_CFG)
        var overlay := get_node_or_null("DisclaimerOverlay")
        if overlay:
                overlay.queue_free()

# ui/onboarding/dialogue_box.gd
extends CanvasLayer
class_name DialogueBox

## Сюжетный диалог онбординга: нижняя плашка с портретом, имя, печатающийся
## текст, «ДАЛЕЕ» и «ПРОПУСТИТЬ». Клик/тап и Enter тоже листают.
## Сигналы:
##   finished - показаны все строки (Prog помечает историю прочитанной)
##   closed   - бокс закрыт и освободился (Prog снимает активность)

signal finished
signal closed

const CPS := 46.0  # скорость печати, символов в секунду

const WHO_COLOR := {
        "ГОЛОС ЗОНЫ": Color("e8b93c"),
        "ДИСПЕТЧЕР": Color("49ff80"),
        "СТАРОЖИЛ": Color("6fc4ff"),
}

var _lines: Array = []
var _idx := -1
var _visible_chars := 0.0
var _typing := false
var _built := false

var _dim: ColorRect
var _name_label: Label
var _text_label: Label
var _next_label: Label
var _portrait: PanelContainer
var _portrait_letter: Label
var _plate: PanelContainer


func show_dialogue(lines: Array) -> void:
        _lines = lines
        _idx = -1
        _build()
        _advance()


func _build() -> void:
        if _built:
                return
        _built = true
        layer = 90

        _dim = ColorRect.new()
        _dim.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.45)
        _dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        _dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        _dim.gui_input.connect(_on_dim_input)
        add_child(_dim)

        _plate = PanelContainer.new()
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.045, 0.97)
        sb.border_color = Color("3a4a3a")
        sb.set_border_width_all(2)
        sb.corner_radius_top_left = 14
        sb.corner_radius_top_right = 14
        sb.content_margin_left = 18.0
        sb.content_margin_right = 18.0
        sb.content_margin_top = 14.0
        sb.content_margin_bottom = 12.0
        _plate.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
        _plate.anchor_left = 0.0
        _plate.anchor_right = 1.0
        _plate.anchor_top = 1.0
        _plate.anchor_bottom = 1.0
        _plate.offset_left = 14
        _plate.offset_right = -14
        _plate.offset_top = -214
        _plate.offset_bottom = -12
        _plate.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        _plate.gui_input.connect(_on_dim_input)
        add_child(_plate)

        var h := HBoxContainer.new()
        h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
        _plate.add_child(h)

        # Портрет: рамка с первой буквой имени персонажа.
        _portrait = PanelContainer.new()
        var psb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        psb.bg_color = Color(0.09, 0.12, 0.08)
        psb.border_color = Color("e8b93c")
        psb.set_border_width_all(2)
        psb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
        psb.content_margin_left = 12.0
        psb.content_margin_right = 12.0
        psb.content_margin_top = 8.0
        psb.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
        _portrait.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", psb)
        _portrait.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(64, 64)
        _portrait.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
        h.add_child(_portrait)
        _portrait_letter = Label.new()
        _portrait_letter.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        _portrait_letter.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
        _portrait_letter.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("e8b93c"))
        _portrait_letter.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        _portrait_letter.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        _portrait.add_child(_portrait_letter)

        var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
        vb.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
        h.add_child(vb)

        _name_label = Label.new()
        _name_label.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        _name_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 19)
        _name_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("e8b93c"))
        vb.add_child(_name_label)

        _text_label = Label.new()
        _text_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
        _text_label.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
        _text_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
        _text_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT)
        _text_label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        vb.add_child(_text_label)

        var foot := HBoxContainer.new()
        foot.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
        vb.add_child(foot)

        _next_label = Label.new()
        _next_label.text = "▼  ДАЛЕЕ"
        _next_label.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_body())
        _next_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
        _next_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.GREEN)
        foot.add_child(_next_label)

        var spacer := Control.new()
        spacer.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        foot.add_child(spacer)

        var skip := Button.new()
        skip.text = "ПРОПУСТИТЬ"
        skip.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(170, 40)
        BunkerUI.style_button(skip, "steel", 15)
        skip.pressed.connect(_on_skip)
        skip.mouse_entered.connect(func() -> void: _play_hover())
        foot.add_child(skip)


func _advance() -> void:
        if _typing:
                _text_label.visible_characters = -1
                _typing = false
                return
        _idx += 1
        if _idx >= _lines.size():
                _finish()
                return
        var line: Dictionary = _lines[_idx]
        var who := str(line.get("who", ""))
        var col: Color = WHO_COLOR.get(who, BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT)
        _name_label.text = who
        _name_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
        _portrait_letter.text = who.substr(0, 1)
        _portrait_letter.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
        var psb: StyleBoxFlat = _portrait.get_theme_stylebox("panel")
        if psb:
                psb.border_color = col
        _text_label.text = str(line.get("text", ""))
        _text_label.visible_characters = 0
        _visible_chars = 0.0
        _typing = true
        _play_hover()


func _finish() -> void:
        finished.emit()
        closed.emit()
        queue_free()


func _on_skip() -> void:
        _finish()


func _on_dim_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
                _advance()
        elif event is InputEventScreenTouch and event.pressed:
                _advance()


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        if event.is_action_pressed("ui_accept"):
                _advance()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
        if not _typing:
                return
        _visible_chars += delta * CPS
        _text_label.visible_characters = int(_visible_chars)
        if _text_label.visible_characters >= _text_label.text.length():
                _typing = false


func _play_hover() -> void:
        var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
        if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
                sm.play_sound("ui_hover", 0.3)

uid://cjno3dr4acrsv

# ui/onboarding/story.gd
extends RefCounted
class_name Story

## Сюжет онбординга. Формат строки: {"who": "ИМЯ", "text": "..."}.
## Персонажи:
##   ПРОВОДНИК  -campaign- бывалый ходок, ведёт к Саркофагу (скрывает прошлое)
##   ДИСПЕТЧЕР  -выживание- голос арены на радиочастоте
##   СТАРОЖИЛ   -башня- хранитель врат ярусов
## Кампания: вводная + диалог при входе в каждую новую главу (между этапами).

const C_GUIDE := "ГОЛОС ЗОНЫ"
const C_DISP := "ДИСПЕТЧЕР"
const C_ELDER := "СТАРОЖИЛ"


static func _g(text: String) -> Dictionary:
        return {"who": C_GUIDE, "text": text}


static func _d(text: String) -> Dictionary:
        return {"who": C_DISP, "text": text}


static func _e(text: String) -> Dictionary:
        return {"who": C_ELDER, "text": text}


# ==================== КАМПАНИЯ ====================

static func camp_intro() -> Array:
        return [
                _g("Ну, здравствуй, лаборант. Я — голос Зоны: подскажу, что происходит и что готовится."),
                _g("Зона тебя приняла — а значит, у тебя есть шанс. Впереди сто забегов до Саркофага: каждый забег — кольцо ближе."),
                _g("Сталкеры попрут за артефактами — не пусти. Аномалии ставь умнее, мутантов корми сытнее."),
                _g("Первая глава — «Тропы новичков». Тут даже дурак выживает. Но ты — не дурак. Иди."),
        ]


static func chapter_intro(chapter_idx: int, title: String) -> Array:
        var tail := [
                _g("Дальше будет хуже. И интереснее. Держи хребет прямо."),

        match chapter_idx:
                1:

                                _g("И слушай Зону. Если затихла — жди беды. Если поёт — беда уже здесь."),
                        ]
                2:
                        return [
