func _refresh_avatar_dlg() -> void:
        var unlocked := 0
        for id_v in _dlg_tiles:
                var id := str(id_v)
                var btn: Button = _dlg_tiles[id]
                var badge: HexBadge = btn.get_meta("badge")
                var name_l: Label = btn.get_meta("name_l")
                var sel := id == (str(_save.profile_avatar) if _save else "zombie")
                if id == "custom":
                        var tex := _load_custom_tex()
                        badge.tex = tex
                        badge.locked = false
                        badge.rarity = ""
                        badge.queue_redraw()
                        name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                                BunkerUI.GREEN if tex else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
                        _style_item(btn, sel, false)
                        continue
                var av: Dictionary = btn.get_meta("av")
                var ok := ProfileData.is_avatar_unlocked(av, _save.lab_data if _save else null)
                if ok:
                        unlocked += 1
                badge.tex = load(ProfileData.get_avatar_icon(av, ok))
                badge.locked = not ok
                badge.rarity = str(av.rar)
                badge.queue_redraw()
                name_l.text = GachaData.display_name(id)
                name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                        GachaData.rarity_color(str(av.rar)) if ok else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
                _style_item(btn, sel, not ok)
        _dl_count.text = "%d / %d" % [unlocked, ProfileData.get_avatar_count()]


func _on_dlg_avatar_pressed(id: String, av: Dictionary) -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if not ProfileData.is_avatar_unlocked(av, _save.lab_data if _save else null):
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_locked"))
                return
        if _save:
                _save.profile_avatar = id
                _persist()
        _refresh_all()
        _refresh_avatar_dlg()
        _show_toast("%s%s" % [Loc.t("profile.dl_installed"), GachaData.display_name(id)])


func _on_dlg_custom_pressed() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        if OS.get_name() == "Android":
                # v0.31.0: системный Photo Picker — фото из галереи без разрешений
                _pick_photo_android()
                return
        if OS.get_name() == "iOS":
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_pc_only"))
                return
        var dir := OS.get_system_dir(OS.SYSTEM_DIR_PICTURES)
        if dir.is_empty():
                dir = OS.get_environment("USERPROFILE")
        if dir.is_empty():
                dir = OS.get_environment("HOME")
        if not dir.is_empty():
                _file_dlg.current_dir = dir
        _file_dlg.popup_centered()


func _on_custom_photo_picked(path: String) -> void:
        var img := Image.new()
        if img.load(path) != OK or img.is_empty():
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))
                return
        _apply_custom_photo(img)


# ==================== АВАТАР С ТЕЛЕФОНА (Android Photo Picker, v0.31.0) ====================

var _picker_connected: bool = false


## Открывает системный Photo Picker (плагин GodotGetImage, без разрешений на хранилище).
## На старых Android без Google Play Services плагин сам откатится на SAF-выбор.
func _pick_photo_android() -> void:
        if not Engine.has_singleton("GodotGetImage"):
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_pc_only"))
                return
        var plugin = Engine.get_singleton("GodotGetImage")
        if not _picker_connected:
                plugin.connect("image_request_completed", _on_picked_images)
                plugin.connect("error", _on_picker_error)
                _picker_connected = true
        plugin.setOptions({
                        "image_width": 512,
                        "image_height": 512,
                        "keep_aspect": true,
                        "image_format": "png",
        })
        plugin.getGalleryImage()


func _on_picked_images(images: Dictionary) -> void:
        for buffer_v in images.values():
                var buffer: PackedByteArray = buffer_v
                if buffer.is_empty():
                                continue
                var img := Image.new()
                if img.load_png_from_buffer(buffer) != OK:
                                if img.load_jpg_from_buffer(buffer) != OK:
                                                continue
                _apply_custom_photo(img)
                return
        _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))


func _on_picker_error(_err: String) -> void:
        _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))


## Общий финиш для фото с ПК и с телефона: центр-кроп до квадрата, 256×256,
## сохранение в user://custom_avatar.png, включение аватара «свой снимок».
func _apply_custom_photo(img: Image) -> void:
        if img == null or img.is_empty():
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))
                return
        # центр-кроп до квадрата, затем 256×256 (иконка сканера квадратная)
        var s := mini(img.get_width(), img.get_height())
        if s < 8:
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))
                return
        var ox := (img.get_width() - s) / 2
        var oy := (img.get_height() - s) / 2
        img = img.get_region(Rect2i(ox, oy, s, s))
        img.resize(256, 256, Image.INTERPOLATE_LANCZOS)
        if img.save_png("user://custom_avatar.png") != OK:
                _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_fail"))
                return
        if _save:
                _save.profile_avatar = "custom"
                _persist()
        _refresh_all()
        _refresh_avatar_dlg()
        _show_toast(Loc.t("profile.dl_custom_saved"))


func _load_custom_tex() -> Texture2D:
        if not FileAccess.file_exists("user://custom_avatar.png"):
                return null
        var img := Image.new()
        if img.load("user://custom_avatar.png") != OK or img.is_empty():
                return null
        return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)


func _persist() -> void:
        if _gm and _gm.has_method("save_to_active_slot"):
                _gm.save_to_active_slot()


# ==================== ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ====================

func _refresh_all() -> void:
        _ctx = ProfileData.make_ctx(_save)
        _refresh_header()
        _refresh_titles()
        _refresh_statuses()
        _refresh_scanner()
        _refresh_strips()
        _refresh_stats()


func _refresh_header() -> void:
        _name_label.text = ProfileData.stalker_name(_save)
        _sub_label.text = Loc.t("profile.sub_line", {
                "lvl": str(_ctx.campaign),
                "day": "%03d" % ProfileData.zone_day(_save),
        })
        var cur_title := str(_save.profile_title) if _save else "green"
        _title_val.text = ProfileData.title_name(cur_title)
        var pinned := str(_save.profile_status) if _save else ""
        var eff := ProfileData.effective_status(pinned, _ctx)
        _status_val.text = ProfileData.status_name(eff)


func _refresh_titles() -> void:
        var unlocked := 0
        for refs_v in _title_rows:
                var refs: Dictionary = refs_v
                var id := str(refs.id)
                var t := ProfileData.get_title(id)
                var ok := ProfileData.is_title_unlocked(t, _ctx)
                if ok:
                        unlocked += 1
                var is_cur := id == (str(_save.profile_title) if _save else "green")
                var name_l: Label = refs.name_l
                var how_l: Label = refs.how_l
                var cur_l: Label = refs.cur_l
                var btn: Button = refs.btn
                name_l.text = ProfileData.title_name(id)
                name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                        BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT if is_cur else (BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT if ok else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT))
                how_l.text = ProfileData.title_how(id)
                cur_l.visible = is_cur
                btn.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55) if not ok else Color.WHITE
                var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
                sb.bg_color = Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.10) if is_cur else Color(0.08, 0.10, 0.06, 0.55)
                sb.border_color = BunkerUI.GREEN if is_cur else (BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE if ok else Color(BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE, 0.6))
                sb.border_width_left = 3
                sb.border_width_top = 1
                sb.border_width_bottom = 1
                sb.border_width_right = 1
                sb.content_margin_left = 4
                sb.content_margin_right = 4
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
                var hv := sb.duplicate()
                hv.border_color = Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.6) if not is_cur else BunkerUI.GREEN
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hv)
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hv)
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", sb)
        _titles_count.text = "%d/%d" % [unlocked, ProfileData.TITLES.size()]


func _refresh_statuses() -> void:
        var pinned := str(_save.profile_status) if _save else ""
        var eff := ProfileData.effective_status(pinned, _ctx)
        for refs_v in _status_rows:
                var refs: Dictionary = refs_v
                var id := str(refs.id)
                var s := ProfileData.get_status(id)
                var ok := ProfileData.is_status_unlocked(s, _ctx)
                var is_pinned := id == pinned and ok
                var is_eff := id == eff
                var name_l: Label = refs.name_l
                var mood_l: Label = refs.mood_l
                var dot: ColorRect = refs.dot
                var btn: Button = refs.btn
                name_l.text = ProfileData.status_name(id)
                name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                        BunkerUI.TEXT_BRIGHT if is_eff else (BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT if ok else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT))
                if is_pinned:
                        mood_l.text = Loc.t("profile.pinned")
                else:
                        mood_l.text = ProfileData.status_how(id)
                # закреплённый - зелёная точка; авто-текущий - жёлтая
                dot.visible = is_eff
                dot.color = BunkerUI.GREEN if is_pinned else BunkerUI.HAZARD
                btn.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.55) if not ok else Color.WHITE
                var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
                sb.bg_color = Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.10) if is_eff else Color(0.08, 0.10, 0.06, 0.55)
                sb.border_color = Color("3d5a2a") if is_eff else BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE
                sb.set_border_width_all(1)
                sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
                sb.content_margin_left = 4
                sb.content_margin_right = 4
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
                var hv := sb.duplicate()
                hv.border_color = Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.6)
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hv)
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hv)
                btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", sb)


func _refresh_scanner() -> void:
        var av_id := str(_save.profile_avatar) if _save else "zombie"
        var fr_id := str(_save.profile_frame) if _save else "steel"
        if av_id == "custom":
                _refresh_scanner_custom(fr_id)
                return
        var av: Dictionary = {"id": av_id, "is_mutant": true, "rar": "common"}
        for a in ProfileData.get_avatar_list():
                if str(a.id) == av_id:
                        av = a
                        break
        var unlocked := ProfileData.is_avatar_unlocked(av, _save.lab_data if _save else null)
        var f := ProfileData.get_frame(fr_id)
        _scanner.set_avatar(ProfileData.get_avatar_icon(av, unlocked), unlocked)
        _scanner.set_frame_colors(f.dark, f.light)
        _scanner.set_frame_art(str(f.get("art", "")))
        var fx := ProfileData.frame_fx(fr_id)
        _scanner.set_frame_fx(fx)
        _cap_av.text = Loc.t("profile.avatar_prefix") + GachaData.display_name(av_id) + (" · " + Loc.t("profile.rar_" + str(av.rar)) if unlocked else "")
        _cap_av.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GachaData.rarity_color(str(av.rar)) if unlocked else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
        _cap_frame.text = Loc.t("profile.frame_prefix") + ProfileData.frame_name(fr_id)
        _cap_frame.add_theme_color_override("font_color", f.light)
        var fx_txt := "" if fx == "none" else " · ◈ " + Loc.t("profile.fx_" + fx)
        _cap_sub.text = "%s · %s%s" % [Loc.t("profile.rar_" + str(f.rar)), ProfileData.frame_how(fr_id), fx_txt]


## Сканер для аватара «СВОЙ СНИМОК»: PNG из user://, фоллбек — серый зомби.
func _refresh_scanner_custom(fr_id: String) -> void:
        var f := ProfileData.get_frame(fr_id)
        var fx := ProfileData.frame_fx(fr_id)
        _scanner.set_frame_colors(f.dark, f.light)
        _scanner.set_frame_art(str(f.get("art", "")))
        _scanner.set_frame_fx(fx)
        var tex := _load_custom_tex()
        if tex:
                _scanner.set_avatar_tex(tex, false)
        else:
                _scanner.set_avatar(ProfileData.get_avatar_icon(
                        {"id": "zombie", "is_mutant": true}, false), true)
        _cap_av.text = Loc.t("profile.avatar_prefix") + Loc.t("profile.dl_custom")
        _cap_av.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                BunkerUI.GREEN if tex else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
        _cap_frame.text = Loc.t("profile.frame_prefix") + ProfileData.frame_name(fr_id)
        _cap_frame.add_theme_color_override("font_color", f.light)
        var fx_txt := "" if fx == "none" else " · ◈ " + Loc.t("profile.fx_" + fx)
        _cap_sub.text = "%s · %s%s" % [Loc.t("profile.rar_" + str(f.rar)), ProfileData.frame_how(fr_id), fx_txt]


func _refresh_strips() -> void:
        var av_unlocked := 0
        for av in ProfileData.get_avatar_list():
                var id := str(av.id)
                var ok := ProfileData.is_avatar_unlocked(av, _save.lab_data if _save else null)
                if ok:
                        av_unlocked += 1
                var btn: Button = _av_buttons[id]
                var badge: HexBadge = _av_badges[id]
                var name_l: Label = btn.get_meta("name_l")
                var sel := id == (str(_save.profile_avatar) if _save else "zombie")
                badge.tex = load(ProfileData.get_avatar_icon(av, ok))
                badge.locked = not ok
                badge.rarity = str(av.rar)
                badge.queue_redraw()
                name_l.text = GachaData.display_name(id)
                name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                        GachaData.rarity_color(str(av.rar)) if ok else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
                _style_item(btn, sel, not ok)
        _av_count.text = "%d / %d · %s" % [av_unlocked, ProfileData.get_avatar_count(), Loc.t("profile.scroll_hint")]

        var fr_unlocked := 0
        _anim_fr_ids = []
        for f in ProfileData.FRAMES:
                var id := str(f.id)
                var ok := ProfileData.is_frame_unlocked(f, _ctx)
                if ok:
                        fr_unlocked += 1
                var btn: Button = _fr_buttons[id]
                var badge: HexBadge = _fr_badges[id]
                var name_l: Label = btn.get_meta("name_l")
                var sel := id == (str(_save.profile_frame) if _save else "steel")
                badge.light = f.light
                badge.dark = f.dark
                badge.fx = str(f.get("fx", "none"))
                badge.locked = not ok
                badge.queue_redraw()
                if ok and badge.fx != "none":
                        _anim_fr_ids.append(id)
                name_l.text = ProfileData.frame_name(id)
                name_l.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                        f.light if ok else BunkerUI.TEXT_FAINT)
                _style_item(btn, sel, not ok)
        _fr_count.text = "%d / %d · %s" % [fr_unlocked, ProfileData.FRAMES.size(), Loc.t("profile.scroll_hint")]


func _style_item(btn: Button, selected: bool, locked: bool) -> void:
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color(0.055, 0.075, 0.05, 0.85)
        sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
        sb.set_border_width_all(2)
        if selected:
                sb.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD
        else:
                sb.border_color = Color(BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE, 0.9 if not locked else 0.5)
        sb.content_margin_left = 4
        sb.content_margin_right = 4
        sb.content_margin_top = 4
        sb.content_margin_bottom = 4
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
        var hv := sb.duplicate()
        hv.border_color = BunkerUI.HAZARD if selected else Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.55)
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hv)
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hv)
        btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", sb)
        btn.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.62) if locked else Color.WHITE


func _refresh_stats() -> void:
        for key in _stat_vals:
                var text := ""
                match key:
                        "campaign":
                                text = "%d/100" % int(_ctx.campaign)
                        "floor":
                                text = str(int(_ctx.tower))
                        "waves":
                                text = str(int(_ctx.wave))
                        "arena":
                                text = str(int(_ctx.arena))
                        "runs":
                                text = str(int(_ctx.runs))
                        "coll":
                                text = "%d/%d" % [int(_ctx.collection), ProfileData.get_avatar_count()]
                        "rolls":
                                text = str(_art_rolls())
                _stat_vals[key].text = text


# ==================== ВНУТРЕННИЕ КЛАССЫ ====================

## Правильный шестиугольник (острая вершина сверху), 6 точек по часовой.
static func hex_points(center: Vector2, rx: float, ry: float) -> PackedVector2Array:
        var fxs := [0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0]
        var fys := [0.0, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0, 0.75, 0.25]
        var pts := PackedVector2Array()
        for i in 6:
                pts.append(center + Vector2((fxs[i] - 0.5) * 2.0 * rx, (fys[i] - 0.5) * 2.0 * ry))
        return pts


## Точка и направление на границе гекса при параметре u (0..1 по периметру).
static func hex_walk(outer: PackedVector2Array, u: float) -> Dictionary:
        var lens := PackedFloat32Array()
        var total := 0.0
        for i in 6:
                var l := outer[i].distance_to(outer[(i + 1) % 6])
                lens.append(l)
                total += l
        var d := fposmod(u, 1.0) * total
        for i in 6:
                if d <= lens[i] or i == 5:
                        var dir := (outer[(i + 1) % 6] - outer[i]).normalized()
                        return {"pos": outer[i] + dir * d, "dir": dir}
                d -= lens[i]
        return {"pos": outer[0], "dir": Vector2.RIGHT}


class ScannerView:
        extends Control

        ## Гексагональный сканер: сетка-фон, три кольца (пунктир зелёный,
        ## тонкая зелёная, жёлтая) с разным направлением вращения, шестигранник
        ## с поясом рамки (конический перелив имитируется цветом кромок),
        ## иконка аватара и бегающая скан-линия.

        var ring_ang := [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        var scan_t := 0.0
        var fx_t := 0.0
        var fx := "none"
        var frame_dark: Color = Color("3a4a3a")
        var frame_light: Color = Color("9aa89a")
        var frame_art: Texture2D = null   # Задача 24: PNG-рамка (арт подготовщика)
        var avatar_tex: Texture2D = null
        var avatar_locked := false

        func set_avatar(path: String, locked: bool) -> void:
                avatar_locked = locked
                avatar_tex = null
                if not path.is_empty() and ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                        avatar_tex = load(path)
                queue_redraw()

        func set_avatar_tex(tex: Texture2D, locked: bool) -> void:
                avatar_locked = locked
                avatar_tex = tex
                queue_redraw()

        func set_frame_colors(dark: Color, light: Color) -> void:
                frame_dark = dark
                frame_light = light
                queue_redraw()

        func set_frame_art(path: String) -> void:
                var tex: Texture2D = load(path) if path != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(path) else null
                var changed := tex != frame_art
                frame_art = tex
                if changed:
                        queue_redraw()

        func set_frame_fx(fx_id: String) -> void:
                var changed := fx_id != fx
                fx = fx_id
                if changed:
                        queue_redraw()

        func _process(delta: float) -> void:
                ring_ang[0] += delta * (TAU / 40.0)
                ring_ang[1] -= delta * (TAU / 28.0)
                ring_ang[2] += delta * (TAU / 34.0)
                scan_t += delta
                fx_t += delta
                queue_redraw()

        func _draw() -> void:
                _draw_grid()
                var c := size * 0.5
                var ring_r := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.49
                if ring_r < 40.0:
                        return
                _draw_rings(c, ring_r)
                _draw_hex(c, ring_r)
                _draw_scanline(c, ring_r)
                # Задача 24 (фикс помощника): рамка-арт - квадрат ПО ЦЕНТРУ
                # гекса (ring_r x 1.18), ПОВЕРХ аватара; НЕ растяжка на весь
                # виджет (та растяжка накрывала сканер и обрывала _draw)
                if frame_art:
                        var fr := ring_r * 1.18
                        draw_texture_rect(frame_art, Rect2(c - Vector2(fr, fr) * 0.5, Vector2(fr, fr)), false)

        func _draw_grid() -> void:
                var g := 44.0
                var col := Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.035)
                var x := 0.0
                while x < size.x:
                        draw_line(Vector2(x, 0), Vector2(x, size.y), col, 1.0)
                        x += g
                var y := 0.0
                while y < size.y:
                        draw_line(Vector2(0, y), Vector2(size.x, y), col, 1.0)
                        y += g

        func _draw_dashed(c: Vector2, r: float, col: Color, rot: float, dash_deg: float, gap_deg: float) -> void:
                var step := deg_to_rad(dash_deg + gap_deg)
                var a := rot
                while a < rot + TAU:
                        draw_arc(c, r, a, a + deg_to_rad(dash_deg), 4, col, 2.0, true)
                        a += step

        func _draw_rings(c: Vector2, ring_r: float) -> void:
                # внешняя: зелёный пунктир, вращение вперёд
                _draw_dashed(c, ring_r, Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.32), ring_ang[0], 7.0, 7.0)
                # средняя: тонкая зелёная, вращение назад
                draw_arc(c, ring_r * 0.885, 0, TAU, 96, Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.15), 2.0, true)
                # внутренняя: жёлтая, вперёд
                draw_arc(c, ring_r * 0.775, 0, TAU, 96, Color(BunkerUI.HAZARD, 0.30), 2.0, true)
                # яркий тик на внешнем кольце
                var a: float = ring_ang[0]
                var p := c + Vector2(cos(a), sin(a)) * ring_r
                var tang := Vector2(-sin(a), cos(a))
                draw_line(p - tang * 9.0, p + tang * 9.0, Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.30), 7.0, true)
                draw_line(p - tang * 8.0, p + tang * 8.0, BunkerUI.GREEN, 3.0, true)

        func _draw_hex(c: Vector2, ring_r: float) -> void:
                var rx := ring_r / 1.41
                var ry := rx * 1.1547
                var outer := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx, ry)
                # пояс рамки: тело тёмное, кромки с переливом (светлее сверху)
                draw_colored_polygon(outer, frame_dark)
                var mid := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 0.88, ry * 0.88)
                draw_colored_polygon(mid, Color("0e130d"))
                var inner := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 0.80, ry * 0.80)
                draw_colored_polygon(inner, Color("151c12"))
                # мягкое свечение по контуру
                var closed := outer.duplicate()
                closed.append(outer[0])
                draw_polyline(closed, Color(frame_light, 0.22), 9.0, true)
                # кромки: цвет ребра зависит от угла его середины (имитация коники)
                for i in 6:
                        var a: Vector2 = outer[i]
                        var b: Vector2 = outer[(i + 1) % 6]
                        var m := (a + b) * 0.5
                        var ang := atan2(m.y - c.y, m.x - c.x)
                        var t := 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(ang + PI * 0.5)
                        var edge_col := frame_dark.lerp(frame_light, 0.30 + 0.70 * t)
                        draw_line(a, b, edge_col, 3.0, true)
                _draw_fx(c, rx, ry, outer)
                # иконка аватара (квадратная карточка внутри шестигранника)
                if avatar_tex:
                        var side := rx * 1.16
                        var rect := Rect2(c - Vector2(side, side) * 0.5, Vector2(side, side))
                        var tint := Color(0.62, 0.66, 0.62, 0.85) if avatar_locked else Color.WHITE
                        draw_texture_rect(avatar_tex, rect, false, tint)

        func _draw_scanline(c: Vector2, ring_r: float) -> void:
                var rx := ring_r / 1.41
                var ry := rx * 1.1547
                var y := c.y + sin(scan_t * 1.15) * ry * 0.82
                var x0 := c.x - rx * 0.92
                var x1 := c.x + rx * 0.92
                draw_line(Vector2(x0, y), Vector2(x1, y), Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.12), 10.0, true)
                draw_line(Vector2(x0, y), Vector2(x1, y), Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.28), 5.0, true)
                draw_line(Vector2(x0, y), Vector2(x1, y), Color(BunkerUI.GREEN, 0.95), 2.0, true)

        ## Эффекты рамок поверх кромок: pulse (пульс) / shine (бегущий блик) /
        ## reactor (свечение САРКОФАГА: гало, дуги-обход, искры, мерцание).
        func _draw_fx(c: Vector2, rx: float, ry: float, outer: PackedVector2Array) -> void:
                match fx:
                        "pulse":
                                var k := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(fx_t * 1.9)
                                var g := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 1.05, ry * 1.05)
                                var gc := g.duplicate()
                                gc.append(g[0])
                                draw_polyline(gc, Color(frame_light, 0.05 + 0.15 * k), 10.0, true)
                        "shine":
                                var u := fposmod(fx_t * 0.11, 1.0)
                                for i in 3:
                                        var w := ProfileScreen.hex_walk(outer, u - 0.055 * float(i))
                                        var wp: Vector2 = w.pos
                                        var wd: Vector2 = w.dir
                                        var tail: Vector2 = wp - wd * (rx * 0.11)
                                        var a := 0.85 - 0.25 * float(i)
                                        draw_line(wp, tail, Color(frame_light, a * 0.5), 6.0, true)
                                        draw_line(wp, tail, Color(1, 1, 1, a), 2.2, true)
                        "reactor":
                                var kr := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(fx_t * 2.6)
                                var fl := pow(maxf(0.0, sin(fx_t * 7.3 + sin(fx_t * 2.9) * 1.7)), 24.0)
                                var g2 := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 1.07, ry * 1.07)
                                var g2c := g2.duplicate()
                                g2c.append(g2[0])
                                draw_polyline(g2c, Color(frame_light, 0.06 + 0.10 * kr), 24.0, true)
                                draw_polyline(g2c, Color(frame_light, 0.10 + 0.16 * kr + 0.22 * fl), 11.0, true)
                                var sr := rx * 1.26
                                for s_i in 2:
                                        var a0 := fx_t * 0.85 + PI * float(s_i)
                                        draw_arc(c, sr, a0, a0 + 0.5, 12,
                                                Color(frame_light, 0.10 + 0.22 * kr), 3.0, true)
                                for i in 10:
                                        var fi := float(i)
                                        var ph := fi * 0.618034
                                        var yy := fposmod(fx_t * (0.055 + 0.03 * fmod(fi, 3.0)) + ph, 1.0)
                                        var ang := TAU * (0.18 * yy + ph * 0.13) + fi * TAU / 10.0
                                        var rad := rx * (1.12 + 0.08 * yy)
                                        var pos := c + Vector2(cos(ang) * rad, sin(ang) * rad * 1.1547)
                                        var al := sin(yy * PI)
                                        draw_circle(pos, 1.6 + 0.9 * fmod(fi, 2.0),
                                                Color(frame_light, 0.45 * al))
                                        draw_circle(pos, 0.8, Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.8, 0.6 * al))


class HexBadge:
        extends Control

        ## Мини-шестигранник для лент: рамка-пояс + иконка карточки
        ## (серая, если закрыто) или пустой центр для превью рамок.

        var light: Color = Color("9aa89a")
        var dark: Color = Color("3a4a3a")
        var tex: Texture2D = null
        var locked := false
        var rarity := ""
        var is_frame_preview := false
        var fx := "none"

        func _draw() -> void:
                if size.x < 8.0 or size.y < 8.0:
                        return
                var c := size * 0.5
                var rx := size.x * 0.5
                var ry := size.y * 0.5
                var outer := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx, ry)
                draw_colored_polygon(outer, dark)
                var inner := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 0.84, ry * 0.84)
                draw_colored_polygon(inner, Color("10150f"))
                if is_frame_preview:
                        # превью рамки: подсветить цвет пояса изнутри
                        var belt := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 0.70, ry * 0.70)
                        draw_colored_polygon(belt, Color(dark.lightened(0.10), 0.9))
                        var core := ProfileScreen.hex_points(c, rx * 0.52, ry * 0.52)
                        draw_colored_polygon(core, Color("10150f"))
                elif tex:
                        var side := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.66
                        var rect := Rect2(c - Vector2(side, side) * 0.5, Vector2(side, side))
                        var tint := Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.55, 0.75) if locked else Color.WHITE
                        draw_texture_rect(tex, rect, false, tint)
                var border_col := light
                if not is_frame_preview and not rarity.is_empty():
                        border_col = GachaData.rarity_color(rarity)
                if locked:
                        border_col = Color(border_col, 0.35)
                var closed := outer.duplicate()
                closed.append(outer[0])
                draw_polyline(closed, border_col, 2.0, true)
                if locked:
                        draw_string(BunkerUI.font_title(), Vector2(0, size.y * 0.5 + 8), "?",
                                HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, size.x, 24, Color(light, 0.55))
                        return
                if fx == "none":
                        return
                # эффекты рамок на открытых бейджах (время общее, без состояния)
                var t := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
                match fx:
                        "pulse":
                                var k := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 2.0)
                                draw_polyline(closed, Color(light, 0.10 + 0.22 * k), 4.0, true)
                        "shine":
                                var u := fposmod(t * 0.13, 1.0)
                                var w: Dictionary = ProfileScreen.hex_walk(outer, u)
                                var wp: Vector2 = w.pos
                                draw_circle(wp, 2.8, Color(light, 0.85))
                                draw_circle(wp, 1.2, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
                        "reactor":
                                var k2 := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 2.6)
                                draw_polyline(closed, Color(light, 0.12 + 0.26 * k2), 5.0, true)
                                for i in 2:
                                        var fi := float(i)
                                        var yy := fposmod(t * 0.22 + fi * 0.5, 1.0)
                                        var yoff := (0.5 - yy) * ry * 0.9
                                        var xoff := sin(t * 1.7 + fi * PI) * rx * 0.35
                                        draw_circle(c + Vector2(xoff, yoff), 1.8,
                                                Color(light, 0.55 * sin(yy * PI)))


# ==================== УРОВЕНЬ ЛАБОРАНТА (прогрессия Prog) ====================

var _prog_plate_hooked := false


func _hook_prog_plate() -> void:
        if _prog_plate_hooked:
                return
        _prog_plate_hooked = true
        Prog.xp_changed.connect(_refresh_prog_plate)
        _refresh_prog_plate(Prog.level(), Prog.xp_in_level(), Prog.xp_need(Prog.level()))


func _refresh_prog_plate(lvl: int = 0, xp: int = 0, need: int = 0) -> void:
        var v: Label = find_child("ProgLvlValue", true, false) as Label
        var bar: ProgressBar = find_child("ProgLvlBar", true, false) as ProgressBar
        var sub: Label = find_child("ProgLvlSub", true, false) as Label
        if v == null or bar == null:
                return
        if lvl <= 0:
                lvl = Prog.level()
                xp = Prog.xp_in_level()
                need = Prog.xp_need(lvl)
        v.text = "УР. %d" % lvl
        bar.max_value = need
        bar.value = xp
        if sub:
                sub.text = "опыт %d / %d" % [xp, need]

var _dossier_root: Control = null
var _dossier_rows: Array = []
var _medals_root: Control = null
var _medals_grid: GridContainer = null
var _medals_head_count: Label = null
var _medal_tiles: Array = []
var _medal_btn: Button = null
var _medal_btn_dot: Panel = null
var _prof_pulse_t := 0.0


func _build_dossier() -> void:
        _dossier_root = Control.new()
        _dossier_root.name = "DossierPopup"
        _dossier_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        _dossier_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        _dossier_root.visible = false
        add_child(_dossier_root)

        var dim := ColorRect.new()
        dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.78)
        dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
        dim.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent):
                if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.pressed and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
                        _dossier_close())
        _dossier_root.add_child(dim)

        var panel := Panel.new()
        panel.anchor_left = 0.5
        panel.anchor_right = 0.5
        panel.anchor_top = 0.5
        panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
        panel.offset_left = -470.0
        panel.offset_right = 470.0
        panel.offset_top = -330.0
        panel.offset_bottom = 330.0
        var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
        sb.bg_color = Color(0.031, 0.045, 0.026, 0.995)
        sb.border_color = BunkerUI.GREEN
        sb.set_border_width_all(2)
        sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
        sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55)
        sb.shadow_size = 22
        panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", sb)
        _dossier_root.add_child(panel)

        var marg := MarginContainer.new()
        marg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
        marg.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 22)
        marg.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 22)
        marg.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 14)
        marg.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 14)
        panel.add_child(marg)
        var v := VBoxContainer.new()
        v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
        marg.add_child(v)

        var title := Label.new()
        title.text = Loc.t("dossier.title")
        title.add_theme_font_override("font", BunkerUI.font_title())
        title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
        title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BunkerUI.GREEN)
        title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        v.add_child(title)
        var sub := BunkerUI.make_mono_label(Loc.t("dossier.sub"), 12, BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
        sub.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        v.add_child(sub)

        var sc := ScrollContainer.new()
        sc.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        sc.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        sc.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
        v.add_child(sc)
        var box := VBoxContainer.new()
        box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
        box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
        sc.add_child(box)
        for key in ["runs", "wins", "losses", "kills", "artifacts", "anoms", "mutants",
                                "best_wave", "bio_earned", "bio_spent", "tower", "campaign",
                                "collection", "arena", "level", "sp"]:
                var row := HBoxContainer.new()
                row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
                box.add_child(row)
                var kl := BunkerUI.make_mono_label(Loc.t("dossier." + key), 14, BunkerUI.TEXT_DIM)
                kl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
                row.add_child(kl)
                var vl := BunkerUI.make_mono_label("—", 14, BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT)
                vl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
                row.add_child(vl)
                var ln := ColorRect.new()
                ln.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 1)
                ln.color = Color(BunkerUI.STEEL_EDGE, 0.5)
                box.add_child(ln)
                _dossier_rows.append({"key": key, "val": vl})

        var btns := HBoxContainer.new()
        btns.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
        v.add_child(btns)
        var cb := Button.new()
        cb.text = Loc.t("cal.close")
        cb.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 52)
        BunkerUI.style_button(cb, "steel", 16)
        cb.pressed.connect(_dossier_close)
        btns.add_child(cb)


func _dossier_refresh() -> void:
        var s = _save
        var stats = null
        if s != null and s.statistics != null:
                stats = s.statistics
        var lab = null
        if _gm and _gm.has_method("get_lab_data"):
                lab = _gm.get_lab_data()
        var runs := Prog.count("runs")
        var wins := Prog.count("wins")
        var vals := {
                "runs": str(runs),
                "wins": str(wins),
                "losses": str(maxi(0, runs - wins)),
                "kills": str(Prog.count("kills")),
                "artifacts": str(Prog.count("artifacts")),
                "anoms": str(int(stats.anomalies_created)) if stats != null else "0",
                "mutants": str(int(stats.mutants_created)) if stats != null else "0",
                "best_wave": str(int(stats.best_survival_wave)) if stats != null else "0",
                "bio_earned": "%d" % int(stats.biomass_earned) if stats != null else "0",
                "bio_spent": "%d" % int(stats.biomass_spent) if stats != null else "0",
                "tower": str(int(s.tower_floor)) if s != null else "0",
                "campaign": str(int(s.campaign_level)) if s != null else "1",
                "collection": "%d / 34" % Prog._collection_count(),
                "arena": "%d / %d" % [
                        int(lab.arena_wins_challenge) if lab != null else 0,
                        int(lab.arena_wins_defense) if lab != null else 0],
                "level": "%d (%d)" % [Prog.level(), Prog.xp_total()],
                "sp": str(int(lab.season_points)) if lab != null else "0",
        }
        for r in _dossier_rows:
                (r["val"] as Label).text = str(vals.get(r["key"], "—"))


func _dossier_open() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        _dossier_refresh()
        _dossier_root.visible = true


func _dossier_close() -> void:
        _dossier_root.visible = false

func _medals_rebuild() -> void:
        for c in _medals_grid.get_children():
                c.queue_free()
        _medal_tiles.clear()
        var earned := 0
        for m in MedalsData.MEDALS:
                var id := str(m["id"])
                var claimed := Prog.medal_claimed(id)
                if claimed:
                        earned += 1
                var pr := Prog.medal_progress(m)
                var claimable: bool = (not claimed) and pr.x >= pr.y
                var tile := _medal_make_tile(m, claimed, claimable, pr)
                _medals_grid.add_child(tile["panel"])
                _medal_tiles.append(tile)
        _medals_head_count.text = Loc.t("medals.count", {"n": earned, "total": MedalsData.MEDALS.size()})


func _medal_txt(m: Dictionary, key: String) -> String:
        return str(m[key + "_en"]) if Loc.lang == "en" else str(m[key + "_ru"])


func _medal_make_tile(m: Dictionary, claimed: bool, claimable: bool, pr: Vector2i) -> Dictionary:
        var p := PanelContainer.new()

        vv.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

        head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
        vv.add_child(head)

        ttl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
        ttl.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
                BunkerUI.TEXT_LIGHT if not claimed else BunkerUI.GREEN)
        head.add_child(ttl)
        var hsp := Control.new()
        hsp.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

        # Статус "открыто или нет" - ВВЕРХ плитки (v0.29.2): раньше сидел внизу
        # и перекрывался ползунком скролла

                head.add_child(st_lbl)

        return {"panel": p, "sb": sb, "state": status}


func _medal_reward_text(rew: Dictionary) -> String:
        if int(rew.get("sp", 0)) > 0:
                return Loc.t("medals.r_sp", {"n": int(rew["sp"])})
        if int(rew.get("mut", 0)) > 0:
                return Loc.t("cal.r_mut", {"n": int(rew["mut"])})
        if int(rew.get("ano", 0)) > 0:
                return Loc.t("cal.r_ano", {"n": int(rew["ano"])})
        return Loc.t("cal.r_bio", {"n": int(rew.get("bio", 0))})


func _medal_claim(id: String) -> void:
        var res := Prog.claim_medal(id)
        if res.is_empty():
                return
        _play_click_sound()
        _show_toast(Loc.t("medals.done_msg", {"title": str(res["title"]), "what": _medal_reward_text(res["reward"])}))
        _medals_rebuild()
        _refresh_medal_dot()


func _medals_open() -> void:
        _play_click_sound()
        _medals_rebuild()
        _medals_root.visible = true


func _medals_close() -> void:
        _medals_root.visible = false


func _refresh_medal_dot() -> void:
        if _medal_btn_dot == null:
                return
        _medal_btn_dot.visible = Prog.medals_claimable_count() > 0


func _prof_pulse(delta: float) -> void:
        _prof_pulse_t += delta
        if _medal_btn_dot != null and _medal_btn_dot.visible:
                var s := 1.0 + 0.25 * sin(_prof_pulse_t * 5.2)
                _medal_btn_dot.scale = Vector2(s, s)
        if _medals_root != null and _medals_root.visible:
                for t_v in _medal_tiles:
                        var t: Dictionary = t_v
                        if str(t["state"]) == "claimable":
                                var pn: PanelContainer = t["panel"]
                                pn.self_modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.82 + 0.18 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_prof_pulse_t * 4.0)))

# ui/ui_theme.gd
class_name UiTheme
extends RefCounted

## Общая тема UI-оболочки: НЕПРОЗРАЧНЫЕ тёмные панели — всплывающие окна
## читаются поверх живого фона (жалоба: текст просвечивал из-под панелей).
## Применять корню сцены: `theme = UiTheme.build()`.
## В теме описаны только панели — остальные контролы падают в тему по
## умолчанию Godot и выглядят как раньше.

static func build() -> Theme:
	var t := Theme.new()
	var box := panel_box()
	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PanelContainer", box)
	t.set_stylebox("panel", "Panel", box)
	t.set_stylebox("panel", "PopupPanel", box)
	return t


static func panel_box() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.055, 0.07, 0.09, 0.98)  # почти непрозрачный графит
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(6)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.border_color = Color(0.34, 0.42, 0.31, 0.9)  # болотная окантовка Зоны
	sb.content_margin_left = 10.0
	sb.content_margin_right = 10.0
	sb.content_margin_top = 8.0
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
	return sb

# utils/anim_cache.gd
class_name AnimCache
extends RefCounted

## Кеш анимаций, извлечённых из тяжёлых моделей (FBX/GLB).
##
## ПРОБЛЕМА, КОТОРУЮ РЕШАЕТ:
## раньше каждый спавн сталкера делал load("..._убит.fbx") + instantiate()
## модели с 4K-текстурами только ради одного клипа смерти, а кровосос грузил
## bloodsucker_run.glb. Первый такой load в сессии давал фриз на 0.2-2 с
## (диск + декомпрессия VRAM-текстур + instantiate скелета), последующие -
## хитчи по 5-20 мс на instantiate/free целой модели ради анимации.
##
## РЕШЕНИЕ:
## 1) warm_up() вызывается SpawnManager'ом на старте уровня - вся загрузка
##    происходит до боя, по одной модели за кадр.
## 2) Animation - это Resource, их можно безопасно разделять между многими
##    AnimationPlayer'ами. Кеш отдаёт готовые клипы, спавн больше не трогает
##    тяжёлые модели вообще.

static var _cache: Dictionary = {}

# Модели, из которых извлекаются клипы (грузятся на старте уровня).
const WARMUP_PATHS: Array[String] = [
	"res://models/новичёк_убит.fbx",
	"res://models/ветеран_убит.fbx",
	"res://models/мастер_убит.fbx",
	"res://models/bloodsucker_run.glb",
]


## Возвращает словарь {имя_клипа: Animation} для модели по пути.
## Первое обращение грузит модель (на старте это уже сделано warm_up'ом).
static func get_animations(path: String) -> Dictionary:
	if _cache.has(path):
		return _cache[path]

	var result: Dictionary = {}
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		var ps: PackedScene = load(path) as PackedScene
		if ps:
			var inst: Node = ps.instantiate()
			for ap in inst.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false):
				var apl := ap as AnimationPlayer
				for an in apl.get_animation_list():
					if not result.has(an):
						result[an] = apl.get_animation(an)
			inst.free()
	_cache[path] = result
	return result


## Добавляет клипы из кеша в AnimationPlayer сущности.
## Возвращает имя добавленного клипа смерти (или "").
static func apply_animations(player: AnimationPlayer, path: String, skip_names: Array = []) -> String:
	var added_name: String = ""
	var anims: Dictionary = get_animations(path)
	var lib: AnimationLibrary = player.get_animation_library("")
	for an in anims:
		if an in skip_names or player.has_animation(an):
			continue
		lib.add_animation(an, anims[an])
		if added_name == "":
			added_name = an
	return added_name


## Прогрев: грузит все WARMUP_PATHS. Вызывается из SpawnManager._ready()
## распределённо (по одной модели за кадр), чтобы не подвесить загрузку уровня.
static func warm_up_step(index: int) -> void:
	if index < 0 or index >= WARMUP_PATHS.size():
		return
	get_animations(WARMUP_PATHS[index])

# utils/helpers.gd
extends Node
class_name Helpers

## Жёсткая граница мира по XZ (периметр + запас на кламп камер)
const WORLD_LIMIT: float = 200.0  # крайний круг периметра (150) + итерация кольца


static func format_number(value: float, decimals: int = 0) -> String:
    var s = str(int(value))
    var result = ""
    var count = 0
    
    for i in range(s.length() - 1, -1, -1):
        if count > 0 and count % 3 == 0:
            result = " " + result
        result = s[i] + result
        count += 1
    
    if decimals > 0:
        var fractional = value - int(value)
        if fractional > 0:
            var frac_str = str(fractional).substr(1, decimals + 1)
            result += frac_str
    
    return result


static func get_random_position_in_circle(center: Vector3, min_radius: float, max_radius: float) -> Vector3:
    var angle = randf() * TAU
    var distance = min_radius + randf() * (max_radius - min_radius)
    return center + Vector3(cos(angle) * distance, 0, sin(angle) * distance)


static func get_random_position_on_ground(center: Vector3, radius: float, space_state: PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D, attempts: int = 10) -> Vector3:
    for i in range(attempts):
        var pos = center + Vector3(randf_range(-radius, radius), 100, randf_range(-radius, radius))
        
        var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
        query.from = pos
        query.to = pos + Vector3(0, -200, 0)
        query.collision_mask = 1
        
        var result = space_state.intersect_ray(query)
        if result:
            return result.position + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
    
    return center


static func is_point_on_navmesh(point: Vector3, navigation_region: Node) -> bool:
    if not navigation_region:
        return false
    
    var map = navigation_region.get_navigation_map()
    var closest = NavigationServer3D.map_get_closest_point(map, point)
    return closest.distance_to(point) < 1.0


static func lerp_color(color1: Color, color2: Color, t: float) -> Color:
    return Color(
        lerp(color1.r, color2.r, t),
        lerp(color1.g, color2.g, t),
        lerp(color1.b, color2.b, t),
        lerp(color1.a, color2.a, t)
    )


static func get_anomaly_color(anomaly_type: GameEnums.AnomalyType) -> Color:
    match anomaly_type:
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.HEAT:
            return Color(1, 0.3, 0)
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.ELECTRIC:
            return Color(0.2, 0.6, 1)
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.ACID:
            return Color(0.6, 1, 0)
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.GRAVITY_VORTEX:
            return Color(0.5, 0, 1)
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.RADIATION_HOTSPOT:
            return Color(0.3, 1, 0.3)
        GameEnums.AnomalyType.TIME_DILATION:
            return Color(0.6, 0.3, 0.8)
        _:
            return Color.WHITE


static func get_rarity_color(rarity: GameEnums.Rarity) -> Color:
    match rarity:
        GameEnums.Rarity.COMMON:
            return Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
        GameEnums.Rarity.RARE:
            return Color(0.3, 0.5, 1.0)
        GameEnums.Rarity.LEGENDARY:
            return Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2)
        _:
            return Color.WHITE


static func safe_call(obj: Object, method: String, args: Array = [], default_return = null):
    if obj and obj.has_method(method):
        return obj.callv(method, args)
    return default_return


static func get_all_children(node: Node) -> Array:
    var children = []
    for child in node.get_children():
        children.append(child)
        children.append_array(get_all_children(child))
    return children


static func find_node_by_name(node: Node, node_name: String) -> Node:
    if node.name == node_name:
        return node
    
    for child in node.get_children():
        var result = find_node_by_name(child, node_name)
        if result:
            return result
    
    return null

# zones/echo_monolith.gd
extends Node3D
class_name EchoMonolith

## Эхо Монолита (D20): доп. рубеж обороны. Ставится в подготовке кистью ЭХО.
## Узел в группе "monolith" - сталкеры сами выбирают ближайший рубеж и бьют
## его. Пал (HP 0) - исключается из группы, его пачка отступает к соседнему.

signal fallen(echo: EchoMonolith)

var echo_hp: float = 1500.0
var echo_max_hp: float = 1500.0
var _hp_label: Label3D = null
var _body: MeshInstance3D = null
var _model: Node3D = null
var _fallen: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("monolith")
	add_to_group("echo_fronts")
	set_meta("is_echo", true)

	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cap := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	cap.radius = 1.2
	cap.height = 5.0
	col.shape = cap
	col.position.y = 2.5
	add_child(col)

	# Модель обелиска (задача 35, процедурная CC0); нет файла - цилиндр-фолбэк
	var model_path := "res://models/echo_obelisk.glb"
	if ResourceLoader.exists(model_path):
		_model = load(model_path).instantiate()
		add_child(_model)
	else:
		_body = MeshInstance3D.new()
		var obelisk := CylinderMesh.new()
		obelisk.top_radius = 0.25
		obelisk.bottom_radius = 0.9
		obelisk.height = 5.0
		var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat.albedo_color = Color(0.16, 0.10, 0.26)
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = Color(0.70, 0.40, 1.00)
		mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.8
		_body.mesh = obelisk
		_body.material_override = mat
		_body.position.y = 2.5
		add_child(_body)

	_hp_label = Label3D.new()
	_hp_label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	_hp_label.no_depth_test = true
	_hp_label.font_size = 40
	_hp_label.pixel_size = 0.01
	_hp_label.modulate = Color(0.85, 0.6, 1.0)
	_hp_label.outline_size = 8
	_hp_label.position.y = 6.0
	_hp_label.text = "ЭХО"
	add_child(_hp_label)


func setup(cycle: int) -> void:
	echo_max_hp = 1200.0 + 800.0 * float(maxi(cycle, 1) - 1)
	echo_hp = echo_max_hp
	_update_label()


func take_damage(amount: float, _source = null) -> void:
	if _fallen:
		return
	echo_hp -= float(amount)
	if echo_hp <= 0.0:
		_fall()
		return
	_update_label()


func _update_label() -> void:
	if _hp_label:
		_hp_label.text = "ЭХО %d%%" % int(100.0 * echo_hp / maxf(echo_max_hp, 1.0))


func _fall() -> void:
	_fallen = true
	remove_from_group("monolith")
	remove_from_group("echo_fronts")
	if _hp_label:
		_hp_label.text = "ЭХО ПАЛО"
	if _body:
		var mat := _body.material_override as StandardMaterial3D
		if mat:
			mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.1
			mat.albedo_color = Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.12)
	elif _model:
		# модель: глушим руны-эмиссию и оседаем
		for m in _model.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
			var mi := m as MeshInstance3D
			for si in range(mi.get_surface_override_material_count()):
				var sm := mi.get_active_material(si)
				if sm is StandardMaterial3D and (sm as StandardMaterial3D).emission_enabled:
					var dimmed := sm.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
					dimmed.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.05
					mi.set_surface_override_material(si, dimmed)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(self, "scale", Vector3(0.4, 0.1, 0.4), 0.8).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD)
	fallen.emit(self)


func is_fallen() -> bool:
	return _fallen

# res://zones/monolith/monolith.gd
extends Node3D
class_name Monolith

## Центр игры. Сталкеры пытаются его коснуться (GAME OVER)
## Источник энергии и прогрессии

signal energy_changed(current: float, max_energy: float)
signal game_over

# Радиусы защиты (настраиваются в редакторе)
@export var inner_radius: float = 20.0      # 0-20м: уровень 3 аномалии (сильные)
@export var middle_radius: float = 40.0     # 20-40м: уровень 2 аномалии
@export var outer_radius: float = 60.0      # 40-60м: уровень 1 аномалии
@export var spawn_radius: float = 80.0      # >60м: спавн сталкеров

# Базовые параметры
@export var base_energy: float = 500.0
@export var energy_regen_rate: float = 1.0
@export var current_level: int = 1

# Текущее состояние
var current_energy: float
var radiation_pulse_count: int = 0
var is_radiating: bool = false
var run_number: int = 1

# Визуал
@onready var mesh_instance: MeshInstance3D = $MeshInstance3D
@onready var point_light: OmniLight3D = $OmniLight3D
@onready var label: Label3D = $Label3D

# Радиационный фон Припяти (RadiationData): цвет света по зоне (D3)
var _rad_light_color: Color = Color.WHITE


func _ready():
    # Добавляем в группу для поиска из других скриптов
    add_to_group("monolith")

    current_energy = get_max_energy()

    # Визуальная инициализация
    if label:
        label.text = "Монолит\nУровень " + str(current_level)

    pass # print("🔮 Monolith: инициализирован на уровне ", current_level)


## Радиационный фон Припяти: свет зеленеет по зоне (пульсация энергии в
## _process остаётся), Label3D получает строку зоны. Вызывает ZoneController.
func apply_radiation_zone(light_color: Color, label_text: String):
    _rad_light_color = light_color
    if point_light:
        point_light.light_color = light_color
    if label:
        label.text = label_text


func get_max_energy() -> float:
    """Максимальная энергия растёт с уровнем и номером забега"""
    return base_energy + (current_level * 100.0) + ((run_number - 1) * 100.0)


func spend_energy(amount: float) -> bool:
    """Трата энергии на создание артефактов"""
    if current_energy >= amount:
        current_energy -= amount
        energy_changed.emit(current_energy, get_max_energy())
        return true
    return false


func add_energy(amount: float):
    """Добавление энергии (регенерация)"""
    current_energy = min(current_energy + amount, get_max_energy())
    energy_changed.emit(current_energy, get_max_energy())


func _process(delta):
    if not is_radiating:
        add_energy(energy_regen_rate * delta)
    
    # Анимация свечения
    if point_light:
        var pulse = sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7
        point_light.light_energy = pulse * 2.0


func check_stalker_touch(stalker: Node3D):
    """Проверка касания сталкера"""
    if global_position.distance_to(stalker.global_position) < 5.0:
        game_over.emit()
        get_tree().paused = true
        pass # print("💀 GAME OVER - Сталкер коснулся Монолита!")


func get_inner_radius() -> float:
    return inner_radius


func get_middle_radius() -> float:
    return middle_radius


func get_outer_radius() -> float:
    return outer_radius


func get_spawn_radius() -> float:
    return spawn_radius

# zones/pripyat_weather.gd
extends Node
class_name PripyatWeather

## Погода (v0.31.2): радиоактивный дождь между волнами.
## Частицы следуют за камерой, гром - редкие раскатa, луп дождя на шине
## Ambient, реген энергии +25% пока льёт (дождь питает Зону). Ставится
## ZoneController на ОБЕИХ картах (01.11.2026: и на процедурной тоже);
## бросок кубика на каждой передышке. Имя класса историческое.

var _rain: GPUParticles3D = null
var _rain_player: AudioStreamPlayer = null
var _thunder_timer: Timer = null
var _stop_timer: Timer = null
var _regen_saved: float = -1.0
var _resource: Node = null
var _hud_notified: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	_thunder_timer = Timer.new()
	_thunder_timer.one_shot = true
	_thunder_timer.timeout.connect(_on_thunder)
	add_child(_thunder_timer)
	_stop_timer = Timer.new()
	_stop_timer.one_shot = true
	_stop_timer.timeout.connect(stop)
	add_child(_stop_timer)


## Зона зовёт на каждой передышке: бросок кубика на дождь
func roll_break() -> void:
	if _rain != null and _rain.emitting:
		return   # уже льёт
	if randf() < WeatherData.RAIN_CHANCE:
		start(lerpf(WeatherData.DURATION_MIN, WeatherData.DURATION_MAX, randf()))


func start(duration: float) -> void:
	if _rain != null and _rain.emitting:
		return
	_ensure_rain()
	_rain.emitting = true
	if not _hud_notified:
		_hud_notified = true
		_announce()
	# Звук: луп дождя на шине Ambient (отдельным плеером - эмбиент-ветер
	# занимает штатный AmbientPlayer)
	if _rain_player == null:
		var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
		var stream: AudioStream = sm.ambient_sounds.get("rain_medium_01") if sm else null
		if stream != null:
			if stream is AudioStreamOggVorbis:
				stream.loop = true
			_rain_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
			_rain_player.stream = stream
			_rain_player.bus = "Ambient"
			_rain_player.volume_db = WeatherData.RAIN_VOLUME_DB
			add_child(_rain_player)
	if _rain_player:
		_rain_player.play()
	# Дождь питает Зону: реген энергии +25% (сохраняем прежнее значение)
	var zc = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("zone_controller")
	_resource = zc.resource_manager if zc and zc.get("resource_manager") != null else get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("resource_manager")
	if _resource and "energy_regen_rate" in _resource and _regen_saved < 0.0:
		_regen_saved = _resource.energy_regen_rate
		_resource.energy_regen_rate = _regen_saved * WeatherData.REGEN_BONUS
	# Гром и таймер конца
	_on_thunder()
	_stop_timer.start(duration)


func stop() -> void:
	if _rain:
		_rain.emitting = false
	if _rain_player and _rain_player.playing:
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(_rain_player, "volume_db", -40.0, 2.0)
		tw.tween_callback(_rain_player.stop)
	_thunder_timer.stop()
	if _resource and _regen_saved >= 0.0:
		_resource.energy_regen_rate = _regen_saved
		_regen_saved = -1.0
		_resource = null


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	# Забег закрыт во время дождя - вернуть реген немедленно
	if _resource and _regen_saved >= 0.0:
		_resource.energy_regen_rate = _regen_saved
		_regen_saved = -1.0


func _on_thunder() -> void:
	var sm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("sound_manager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play_sound"):
		sm.play_sound("thunder_far_01", randf_range(0.5, 0.8), randf_range(0.9, 1.1))
	_thunder_timer.start(randf_range(WeatherData.THUNDER_MIN_DELAY, WeatherData.THUNDER_MAX_DELAY))


func _announce() -> void:
	var hud = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("hud")
	if hud and hud.has_method("show_event_note"):
		hud.show_event_note({
			"title_ru": "РАДИОАКТИВНЫЙ ДОЖДЬ",
			"title_en": "RADIOACTIVE RAIN",
			"desc_ru": "Дождь питает Зону: реген энергии +25%, пока льёт.",
			"desc_en": "The rain feeds the Zone: +25% energy regen while it lasts.",
		})


func _ensure_rain() -> void:
	if _rain:
		return
	_rain = GPUParticles3D.new()
	_rain.name = "Rain"
	_rain.amount = 900
	_rain.lifetime = 1.1
	_rain.preprocess = 1.0
	var mat := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	# Короб над камерой: покрывает экран и на максимальном зуме
	mat.emission_shape = ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX
	mat.emission_box_extents = Vector3(90, 4, 90)
	mat.gravity = Vector3(0, -26, 0)
	mat.initial_velocity_min = 2.0
	mat.initial_velocity_max = 5.0
	mat.direction = Vector3(0, -1, 0)
	mat.spread = 2.0
	_rain.process_material = mat
	var quad := QuadMesh.new()
	quad.size = Vector2(0.03, 0.7)
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD   # светлая струя, а не тёмный квадрат
	m.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED   # всегда лицом к камере
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.75, 0.85, 0.9, 0.18)
	quad.material = m
	_rain.draw_pass_1 = quad
	add_child(_rain)
	set_process(true)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _rain == null or not _rain.emitting:
		return
	var cam := get_viewport().get_camera_3d()
	if cam:
		_rain.global_position = cam.global_position + Vector3(0, 14, 0)
